papers.title: Progenitor T cells drive chronic pulmonary type 2 inflammation
papers.abstract: Type 2 inflammation is coordinated by remarkably durable CD4 + T helper 2 (T H 2) cell responses, yet the cellular architecture that drives this chronic inflammation and prevents exhaustion remains poorly understood. To define the T H 2 landscape in chronic type 2 inflammation, we established a mouse model of long-term pulmonary allergen exposure, finding that type 2 inflammation was broadly sustained over time and included an expanded T cell factor 1-expressing progenitor-like population. In vivo, lung T H 2 progenitors were sufficient to both initiate and sustain type 2 inflammation, coupling self-renewal with effector cell differentiation. Transcriptomic and spatial deconstruction of chronic pulmonary T H 2 responses identified interleukin-7 receptor signaling and lung tissue B cell infiltration in the context of tertiary lymphoid structure formation as key factors contributing to the maintenance of T H 2 progenitors. Our data define the T H 2 progenitor as a distinct cellular state arising during pathogenic chronic type 2 inflammation with a central role in sustaining T H 2 responses over time.
papers.abstractKo: 제2형 염증(type 2 inflammation)은 놀라울 정도로 지속성이 높은 CD4 + T helper 2(T H 2) 세포 반응에 의해 조절되지만, 이러한 만성 염증을 유도하고 탈진(exhaustion)을 방지하는 세포적 구조는 아직 충분히 이해되지 않았다. 만성 제2형 염증에서 T H 2 경관(landscape)을 규명하기 위해, 우리는 장기 폐 알레르겐 노출(long-term pulmonary allergen exposure) 마우스 모델을 확립하였고, 제2형 염증이 시간 경과에 따라 광범위하게 유지되며 T cell factor 1을 발현하는 확장된 progenitor-like 집단을 포함함을 발견하였다. 생체 내에서(live in vivo) 폐 T H 2 progenitor는 제2형 염증을 개시하고 유지하는 데 모두 충분하였으며, 자기재생(self-renewal)과 effector cell 분화를 연계하였다. 만성 폐 T H 2 반응의 전사체적(transcriptomic) 및 공간적(spatial) 분석을 통해, tertiary lymphoid structure 형성의 맥락에서 interleukin-7 receptor signaling과 폐 조직 B cell 침윤이 T H 2 progenitor의 유지에 기여하는 핵심 요인임이 확인되었다. 우리의 데이터는 T H 2 progenitor를 병적 만성 제2형 염증 동안 발생하는 독특한 세포 상태로 규정하며, 시간 경과에 따른 T H 2 반응의 지속에 중심적 역할을 함을 보여준다.

papers.title: Bispecific chimeric autoantibody receptor T cells eliminate acetylcholine receptor-specific B cells in myasthenia gravis models
papers.abstract: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is an autoimmune neuromuscular disorder mediated by autoantibodies targeting the nicotinic acetylcholine receptor (nAChR), which can lead to severe disability and life-threatening crises. Current therapies rely on broad immunosuppression and fail to achieve sustained remission in the majority of patients. Here, we report the development of AChR chimeric autoantibody receptor (CAAR) T cells engineered to selectively eliminate autoreactive B cells producing anti-AChR autoantibodies. T cells were co-transduced with CAARs expressing extracellular domains of the AChRα1 or β1 subunits, enabling recognition of a broad range of pathogenic antibodies. AChR CAAR T cells selectively secreted effector cytokines upon activation, and efficiently lysed target cells. In a xenograft mouse model, they depleted pathogenic B cell lines and reduced autoantibody levels in the circulation and at the neuromuscular junction. These findings establish AChR CAAR T cells as a precision immunotherapy with the potential to achieve durable remission in refractory MG.
papers.abstractKo: 중증근무력증(myasthenia gravis, MG)은 니코틴성 아세틸콜린 수용체(nicotinic acetylcholine receptor, nAChR)를 표적으로 하는 자가항체에 의해 매개되는 자가면역성 신경근육 질환으로, 심각한 장애와 생명을 위협하는 위기로 이어질 수 있다. 현재의 치료는 광범위한 면역억제에 의존하며 대부분의 환자에서 지속적인 관해를 달성하지 못한다. 여기에서 우리는 anti-AChR 자가항체를 생성하는 자가반응성 B 세포를 선택적으로 제거하도록 공학적으로 설계한 AChR 키메라 자가항체 수용체(chimeric autoantibody receptor, CAAR) T 세포의 개발을 보고한다. T 세포는 AChRα1 또는 β1 소단위의 세포외 도메인을 발현하는 CAAR와 공동 형질도입되었으며, 이를 통해 광범위한 병원성 항체를 인식할 수 있었다. AChR CAAR T 세포는 활성화 시 선택적으로 effector cytokine을 분비하였고, 표적 세포를 효율적으로 용해하였다. 이종이식(xenograft) 마우스 모델에서 이들은 병원성 B 세포 계통을 고갈시키고 순환계 및 신경근접합부(neuromuscular junction)에서 자가항체 수준을 감소시켰다. 이러한 결과는 AChR CAAR T 세포가 불응성 MG에서 지속적인 관해를 달성할 잠재력을 지닌 정밀 면역치료(precision immunotherapy)임을 입증한다.

papers.title: RAD51 stabilizes neutrophil extracellular traps to compartmentalize inflammation
papers.abstract: Neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) feature a branched chromatin architecture whose origin and function remain unknown. We found that NET branching is mediated by RAD51, a protein generating DNA junctions during DNA recombination repair. Pharmacological inhibition, RAD51 knockdown, or GEN1 and RuvC resolvase treatment reduced branching and destabilized NETs, whereas RAD51 up-regulation by different stimuli generated NETs with variable stability. RAD51 inhibition during murine pulmonary Aspergillus fumigatus infection dismantled NETs and reduced lung cytokines. However, the increased accumulation of NET components in the circulation led to interleukin-6 (IL-6) induction in circulating monocytes that exacerbated type 2 inflammation and asthma. Extracellular plasma DNA correlated with IL-6 and eotaxin in human aspergillosis. By structurally stabilizing NETs, RAD51 compartmentalizes inflammation to thwart aberrant systemic immune activation, linking DNA repair to inflammation.
papers.abstractKo: 호중구 세포외 덫(neutrophil extracellular traps, NETs)은 분지형 chromatin 구조를 특징으로 하나, 그 기원과 기능은 아직 알려져 있지 않다. 우리는 NET 분지가 DNA recombination repair 동안 DNA junctions를 생성하는 단백질인 RAD51에 의해 매개됨을 발견하였다. 약리학적 억제, RAD51 knockdown, 또는 GEN1 및 RuvC resolvase 처리로 분지가 감소하고 NETs가 불안정해졌으나, 서로 다른 자극에 의해 RAD51 발현이 증가하면 안정성이 다양한 NETs가 생성되었다. 생쥐 폐 Aspergillus fumigatus 감염 동안 RAD51을 억제하면 NETs가 붕괴되고 폐 cytokines가 감소하였다. 그러나 순환계에서 NET 구성 성분의 증가된 축적은 순환 monocytes에서 interleukin-6(IL-6) 유도를 초래하여 type 2 inflammation 및 asthma를 악화시켰다. 사람 aspergillosis에서 세포외 혈장 DNA는 IL-6 및 eotaxin과 상관관계를 보였다. RAD51은 구조적으로 NETs를 안정화함으로써 염증을 구획화하여 비정상적인 전신 면역 활성화를 차단하며, DNA repair와 염증을 연결한다.

papers.title: Inhibiting cyclin D1–CDK6 suppresses senescence-associated inflammatory gene expression and age-related functional decline
papers.abstract: Cellular senescence contributes to aging and age-related diseases by driving chronic inflammation through the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP), including interferon-stimulated genes (ISGs). Here we confirm and extend previous observations that cyclin D1 (CCND1), a key cell cycle regulator, is paradoxically upregulated across models of nonproliferating senescent cells. We show that CCND1 and its kinase partner CDK6 drive SASP and ISG expression in senescent cells by promoting DNA damage accumulation. This leads to the formation of cytoplasmic chromatin fragments that activate pro-inflammatory cyclic GMP-AMP synthase (cGAS)-stimulator of interferon genes (STING) signaling. In aged mouse livers, senescent hepatocytes show increased Ccnd1 expression. Hepatocyte-specific Ccnd1 knockout or treatment with the clinical grade CDK4/6 inhibitor palbociclib reduces DNA damage and ISGs in aged mouse liver. Further, palbociclib suppresses frailty and improves physical performance of aged mice. These findings demonstrate a role for CCND1/CDK6 in regulating DNA damage and inflammation in senescence and aging, highlighting it as a promising target for therapeutic repurposing.
papers.abstractKo: 세포 노화(cellular senescence)는 senescence-associated secretory phenotype(SASP)를 통해 만성 염증을 유발함으로써 노화 및 노화 관련 질환에 기여하며, 여기에는 interferon-stimulated genes(ISGs)도 포함된다. 본 연구에서는 세포주기 조절의 핵심 인자인 cyclin D1(CCND1)이 비증식성 노화 세포(nonproliferating senescent cells)의 여러 모델에서 역설적으로 상향 조절된다는 기존 관찰을 확인하고 이를 확장하였다. 우리는 CCND1과 그 kinase 파트너인 CDK6가 DNA damage 축적을 촉진함으로써 노화 세포에서 SASP 및 ISG 발현을 유도함을 보여준다. 이는 pro-inflammatory cyclic GMP-AMP synthase(cGAS)-stimulator of interferon genes(STING) signaling을 활성화하는 세포질 chromatin fragment의 형성으로 이어진다. 노화된 마우스 간에서 노화 간세포(senescent hepatocytes)는 Ccnd1 발현 증가를 보였다. 간세포 특이적 Ccnd1 knockout 또는 임상 등급 CDK4/6 inhibitor인 palbociclib 처치는 노화 마우스 간에서 DNA damage와 ISGs를 감소시킨다. 더 나아가 palbociclib는 노쇠(frailty)를 억제하고 노화 마우스의 신체 수행능력을 향상시킨다. 이러한 결과는 노화와 aging에서 DNA damage와 inflammation을 조절하는 데 있어 CCND1/CDK6의 역할을 입증하며, 치료적 재창출(therapeutic repurposing)을 위한 유망한 표적으로서의 가능성을 강조한다.

papers.title: Injury-driven stromal exhaustion disrupts intrinsic regenerative capability
papers.abstract: Bone marrow stromal cells, marked by leptin receptor (Lepr) and C-X-C motif chemokine ligand 12 (Cxcl12), orchestrate osteogenesis and maintain bone homeostasis. Following injury, these stromal cells directly generate reparative bone and subsequently restore the marrow microenvironment, a process widely regarded as a reliable regenerative response. However, it remains unclear whether stromal cells retain full regenerative capacity after prior injury. Here, we show that Lepr + Cxcl12 + stromal cells have limited regenerative capacity and become dysfunctional upon repeated activation, defining a state of stromal exhaustion. Lepr-Cre-labeled stromal cells progressively lose osteogenic potential after repeated injury and instead differentiate into bone marrow adipocytes. Exhausted stromal cells are distinct from aging stromal cells, exhibiting metabolic abnormalities, chronic inflammation associated with stress responses, and impaired regenerative plasticity. Furthermore, β-catenin deletion during injury repair induces adipogenesis through stromal lineage switching, whereas pharmacological and genetic activation of Wnt/β-catenin signaling partially rescues osteogenesis, indicating that dysregulated Wnt/β-catenin signaling drives stromal exhaustion and impaired regeneration. As repeated regenerative activation may occur in recurrent fractures, orthopedic surgeries, osteoporosis, and osteogenesis imperfecta, stromal exhaustion represents a critical barrier to bone regeneration and a potential therapeutic target for restoring stromal plasticity.
papers.abstractKo: 골수 기질세포(bone marrow stromal cells)는 렙틴 수용체(leptin receptor, Lepr) 및 C-X-C motif chemokine ligand 12(Cxcl12)로 표지되며, 골형성(osteogenesis)을 조절하고 골 항상성(bone homeostasis)을 유지한다. 손상 후 이러한 기질세포는 직접적으로 재생성 골(reparative bone)을 생성하고 이어서 골수 미세환경(marrow microenvironment)을 복원하는데, 이 과정은 널리 신뢰할 수 있는 재생 반응으로 여겨진다. 그러나 이전 손상 이후 기질세포가 완전한 재생 능력을 유지하는지는 여전히 불분명하다. 여기서 우리는 Lepr + Cxcl12 + 기질세포가 제한된 재생 능력을 가지며 반복적 활성화 시 기능장애를 보이고, 이를 통해 기질 소진(stromal exhaustion) 상태가 정의됨을 보인다. Lepr-Cre 표지 기질세포는 반복 손상 후 점진적으로 골형성 잠재력을 잃고 대신 골수 지방세포(bone marrow adipocytes)로 분화한다. 소진된 기질세포는 노화 기질세포와 구별되며, 대사 이상, 스트레스 반응과 연관된 만성 염증, 그리고 손상된 재생 가소성(regenerative plasticity)을 나타낸다. 또한, 손상 복구 동안의 β-catenin 결실은 기질 계통 전환(stromal lineage switching)을 통해 지방형성(adipogenesis)을 유도하는 반면, Wnt/β-catenin signaling의 약리학적 및 유전적 활성화는 골형성을 부분적으로 회복시켜, 조절 이상이 있는 Wnt/β-catenin signaling이 기질 소진과 재생 장애를 유도함을 시사한다. 반복적인 재생 활성화는 재발성 골절, 정형외과 수술, 골다공증(osteoporosis), 그리고 골형성부전증(osteogenesis imperfecta)에서 발생할 수 있으므로, 기질 소진은 골 재생의 중대한 장벽이자 기질 가소성 회복을 위한 잠재적 치료 표적을 대표한다.

papers.title: Portal sinusoidal vascular diseases: Assessment and therapy
papers.abstract: The term porto-sinusoidal vascular disease (PSVD) was introduced in 2019 to describe a group of liver conditions that can lead to portal hypertension (PH) in the absence of cirrhosis or PVT, with or without specific findings on liver histology. The new nomenclature has facilitated the consolidation of knowledge on diseases previously referred to by various terms, including Banti disease, noncirrhotic portal hypertension, noncirrhotic portal fibrosis, and idiopathic portal hypertension, while excluding certain etiologies like sarcoidosis, congenital hepatic fibrosis, and Budd-Chiari syndrome. The prevalence and recognition of the disorder have been increasing. Advances in diagnostics and treatment have improved life expectancy for patients with associated conditions, such as immunodeficiencies and autoimmune diseases. Similar to cirrhosis, patients with PSVD may experience complications of PH, including variceal bleeding and ascites. However, less is known about its natural history, screening strategies, prognosis, and treatment options. This review discusses methods for assessing PSVD, including clinical and histological features, imaging techniques, and currently available treatments. It also addresses the challenges posed by the new nomenclature and the remaining questions in disease assessment.
papers.abstractKo: 포르토-정맥동성 혈관 질환(porto-sinusoidal vascular disease, PSVD)이라는 용어는 2019년에 도입되었으며, 간경변(cirrhosis)이나 PVT가 없는 상태에서 간 조직학(liver histology)상 특정 소견의 유무와 관계없이 문맥고혈압(portal hypertension, PH)으로 이어질 수 있는 간 질환군을 설명하기 위해 사용되었다. 이 새로운 명명법은 Banti disease, noncirrhotic portal hypertension, noncirrhotic portal fibrosis, idiopathic portal hypertension 등 이전에 다양한 용어로 지칭되던 질환들에 대한 지식의 통합을 촉진하는 한편, sarcoidosis, congenital hepatic fibrosis, Budd-Chiari syndrome과 같은 특정 병인은 배제하였다. 이 질환의 유병률과 인식은 증가하고 있다. 진단 및 치료의 발전으로 면역결핍증과 자가면역 질환 같은 동반 질환을 가진 환자들의 기대수명이 향상되었다. 간경변과 유사하게, PSVD 환자도 식도정맥류 출혈(variceal bleeding) 및 복수(ascites)를 포함한 PH의 합병증을 경험할 수 있다. 그러나 그 자연 경과, 선별 전략, 예후 및 치료 옵션에 대해서는 아직 덜 알려져 있다. 이 종설은 임상적 및 조직학적 특징, 영상 기법, 그리고 현재 이용 가능한 치료를 포함하여 PSVD를 평가하는 방법을 논의한다. 또한 새로운 명명법이 제기하는 과제와 질환 평가에서 남아 있는 질문들도 다룬다.

papers.title: Advances in imaging—Elastography
papers.abstract: Chronic liver disease affects over a billion people worldwide. Liver fibrosis is the key driver of liver-related complications and mortality. Elastography has been a transformative tool in hepatology, allowing for the diagnosis and staging of liver fibrosis noninvasively, and is evolving beyond these purposes into a prognostication tool. By measuring tissue stiffness, elastography techniques such as shear-wave and magnetic resonance elastography offer critical insights into liver fibrosis, portal hypertension, and the progression of disease. Magnetic resonance elastography stands out for its reliability across fibrosis stages and robustness in obese patients affected by metabolic liver disease. Spleen stiffness measurement complements liver assessments, enhancing the identification of portal hypertension and refining patient risk stratification. This review covers current clinical applications but also anticipates future innovations such as artificial intelligence-based algorithms that could expand elastography's clinical impact, thereby improving patient outcomes.

papers.title: NAP1 switches from an activator to a limiter of interferon induction by trapping TBK1 in condensates
papers.abstract: Abstract TBK1 kinase is a central regulator of type I IFN production. Upon activation of the IFN-β induction pathway, TBK1-adaptor proteins (NAP1, SINTBAD, TANK) form liquid condensates. We show that NAP1 condensates concentrate TBK1. Using NAP1 KO cell lines, we demonstrate that NAP1 exerts a dual effect on TBK1 activity. Initially, NAP1 binds TBK1 and increases its activity, promoting IFN pathway activation. Subsequently, TBK1-mediated phosphorylation of NAP1 induces the formation of condensates. These NAP1 condensates concentrate both TBK1 and the phosphatase PP2A, which dephosphorylates and consequently deactivates TBK1, thus limiting IFN induction. Additionally, in patients with lupus or interferonopathies, we identify NAP1 variants unable to form condensates upon danger signal exposure, which sustain TBK1 activation without limiting its activity. This study reveals a mode of regulating a signaling pathway through condensate formation and provides a potential molecular explanation for immune dysregulation associated with NAP1 variants in certain patients with interferonopathies.

papers.title: Assessment of liver injury potential of investigational medicines in drug development
papers.abstract: DILI is rare in clinical practice, but when it occurs, it can lead to acute liver failure and death. Drug developers and regulators undertake a series of steps to identify the DILI potential of a medication before it is approved for marketing. Preclinical testing by drug developers typically involves a multitude of in vitro assays and in vivo animal experiments before a compound is moved into first-in-human phase 1 testing. Over the last 2 decades, there have been a number of advances in preclinical screening for DILI potential of a new chemical entity, but these approaches tend to be overly sensitive with insufficient positive predictive value. Once in clinical trials, the DILI potential of an investigational agent and risks to a participant are carefully managed through patient selection, DILI monitoring paradigms, and drug interruption and discontinuation criteria, in close concert with the regulators. Recent developments in quantitative systems toxicology offer promising and complementary in silico approaches to predict the compound's risk for DILI via multifaceted systems biology. When a drug developer submits a New Drug Application for marketing approval, regulators review the preclinical and clinical trial data in a structured fashion to assess the DILI risk. While these approaches have been successful in dramatically reducing the marketing approval of medications eventually associated with hepatotoxicity, many challenges remain in identifying the risk for DILI during preclinical and early-to-late clinical development stages for genetic medicines, biological agents, and immunotherapies. In this review, we discuss current preclinical, in-silico, and clinical development approaches to screen for the DILI potential of an investigational agent and provide a high-level description of regulators' approach for assessing DILI risk in a New Drug Application.
papers.abstractKo: DILI는 임상 진료에서 드물지만, 발생할 경우 급성 간부전과 사망으로 이어질 수 있다. 약물 개발자와 규제 당국은 의약품이 시판 승인되기 전에 DILI 잠재성을 식별하기 위한 일련의 단계를 수행한다. 약물 개발자가 시행하는 전임상 시험은 일반적으로 화합물이 사람 최초 투여(first-in-human) phase 1 시험으로 진행되기 전에 다수의 in vitro assay와 in vivo 동물 실험을 포함한다. 지난 20년 동안 새로운 화학 물질(new chemical entity)의 DILI 잠재성에 대한 전임상 screening에서 여러 진전이 있었지만, 이러한 접근법은 지나치게 민감한 반면 양성 예측도(positive predictive value)는 불충분한 경향이 있다. 임상시험에 진입한 후에는, 연구 중인 약제(investigational agent)의 DILI 잠재성과 참여자에 대한 위험이 환자 선정, DILI 모니터링 패러다임, 그리고 약물 중단 및 중지(discontinuation) 기준을 통해, 규제 당국과 긴밀히 협력하여 신중하게 관리된다. 정량적 systems toxicology의 최근 발전은 다면적 systems biology를 통해 화합물의 DILI 위험을 예측하는 유망하고 보완적인 in silico 접근법을 제공한다. 약물 개발자가 시판 승인을 위해 New Drug Application을 제출하면, 규제 당국은 DILI 위험을 평가하기 위해 전임상 및 임상시험 자료를 구조화된 방식으로 검토한다. 이러한 접근법은 궁극적으로 간독성과 연관되는 의약품의 시판 승인을 극적으로 줄이는 데 성공해 왔지만, genetic medicines, biological agents, 그리고 immunotherapies에 대해 전임상 및 초기-후기 임상 개발 단계에서 DILI 위험을 식별하는 데에는 여전히 많은 과제가 남아 있다. 본 종설에서는 연구 중인 약제의 DILI 잠재성을 선별하기 위한 현재의 전임상, in-silico, 및 임상 개발 접근법을 논의하고, New Drug Application에서 DILI 위험을 평가하는 규제 당국의 접근법에 대한 개괄적 설명을 제공한다.

papers.title: Intestinal cGAS–STING–IFN signalling promotes obesity by downregulating microbiota-derived IAA in male mice
papers.abstract: The gut constantly interacts with both pathogens and dietary signals, but how it balances immune and metabolic responses remains unclear. Here we show that intestinal cGAS, a key DNA sensor, acts as a regulator linking gut immunity to whole-body metabolism. We show that cGAS signalling is activated in the intestines of humans and male mice with obesity, leading to increased type I interferon production and heightened immune activity in intestinal cells. Strikingly, deleting cGAS specifically in intestinal epithelial cells enhances energy expenditure, protects against diet-induced obesity and improves metabolic health. These effects depend on the gut microbiota, particularly Lactobacillus murinus and its metabolite indole-3-acetic acid (IAA), which promotes adipose thermogenesis. Our findings position intestinal cGAS as a key driver of obesity through gut-to-fat signalling and suggest that targeting the intestinal cGAS-microbiota IAA axis could offer promising strategies to combat obesity and related metabolic diseases.

papers.title: Noncircadian BMAL1–YAP activity amplifies persistent inflammation in aged epidermis
papers.abstract: Aging is characterized by persistent low-grade inflammation linked to impaired tissue homeostasis, yet the underlying molecular mechanisms remain poorly understood. The mammalian skin is a clinically relevant site of aging-driven inflammation associated with compromised barrier function, inefficient wound healing, elevated oxidative stress and DNA damage accumulation. In addition, aged pro-inflammatory IL-17 signaling activates YAP in a Hippo-independent manner. These findings unveil a transcriptional mechanism underlying epidermal aging, linking chromatin dynamics to inflammatory programs through rewiring of BMAL1-YAP-occupied enhancers, highlighting potential strategies to counteract chronic inflammation and restore tissue homeostasis during aging.

papers.title: Plasma proteomics defines two reproducible subphenotypes of sepsis-associated acute kidney injury with distinct outcomes
papers.abstract: Abstract Sepsis is the leading cause of acute kidney injury in critically ill patients, and this complication carries a high risk of death. The biology underlying it varies between patients, which may explain why treatments have not succeeded. Here we show, using an ensemble method that groups patients by patterns across hundreds of blood proteins in three independent groups of patients, that sepsis-associated acute kidney injury comprises two reproducible subphenotypes. One subphenotype shows widespread activation of inflammation, metabolism, and oxidative stress; the other shows a quieter profile. Patients in the inflammatory subtype have higher mortality, more complications, and fewer days alive and out of the intensive care unit. A simple seven-protein test reproduces these groupings and identifies them accurately in separate cohorts. In a randomized trial, the drug ilofotase alfa appears to benefit the inflammatory subtype but not the other, suggesting that this classification could guide future treatment.
papers.abstractKo: 초록 패혈증(sepsis)은 중환자 환자에서 급성 신손상(acute kidney injury)의 주요 원인이며, 이 합병증은 높은 사망 위험을 동반한다. 이에 기저하는 생물학은 환자 간에 다양하여, 치료가 성공하지 못한 이유를 설명할 수 있다. 여기서는 세 개의 독립적인 환자군에서 수백 개의 혈액 단백질 전반의 패턴에 따라 환자들을 군집화하는 앙상블 방법을 사용하여, 패혈증 연관 급성 신손상(sepsis-associated acute kidney injury)이 두 개의 재현 가능한 아형(subphenotype)으로 구성됨을 보였다. 한 아형은 염증, 대사, 산화 스트레스의 광범위한 활성화를 보이는 반면, 다른 아형은 더 조용한 프로파일을 보였다. 염증성 아형 환자들은 더 높은 사망률, 더 많은 합병증, 그리고 중환자실에서 생존하여 벗어난 날 수가 더 적었다. 단순한 7단백질 검사는 이러한 군집을 재현하고 별도의 코호트에서 이를 정확하게 식별하였다. 무작위배정 임상시험에서 ilofotase alfa 약물은 다른 아형이 아니라 염증성 아형에 이득을 주는 것으로 보였으며, 이는 이러한 분류가 향후 치료를 안내할 수 있음을 시사한다.

papers.title: Functional role of skull lymphoid structures in CNS immunosurveillance
papers.abstract: Accumulating evidence demonstrates that the central nervous system (CNS) is not disconnected from the peripheral immune system; however, precisely how the adaptive immune system surveils the CNS remains a critical question. Recent findings reveal that channels between the skull and the dura mater facilitate the exchange of cerebrospinal fluid and immune cells between the CNS and skull bone marrow of mice under both homeostatic and disease conditions 1-6 . Skull bone marrow functions as a source of immune cells for the CNS 5 , yet its role in CNS antigen-specific adaptive immune responses remains unclear. Here we identify lymphoid structures within the skull bone marrow, featuring germinal-centre-like formations and containing a distinct population of follicular-helper-like T cells that promote B cell activation and humoral immunity through CD40L, IL-21 and IFNγ signalling. Adaptive immune cells within these skull bone marrow lymphoid structures surveil and respond to CNS-derived antigens and contribute to anti-tumour immune responses in mouse brain cancer models. Together, our findings show that the skull bone marrow is a site of CNS immunosurveillance that may influence immune responses across diverse neurological diseases.

papers.title: Convection-enhanced delivery of dexamethasone in glioma models suppresses myeloid inflammation while avoiding systemic toxicities
papers.abstract: Dexamethasone is widely used to control cerebral edema and inflammation in glioblastoma, but its benefits are limited by systemic toxicities and adverse prognostic associations. We evaluated local administration of dexamethasone via convection-enhanced delivery (CED) to maximize intratumoral anti-inflammatory effects by increasing local corticosteroid exposure while minimizing systemic exposure. In two glioma mouse models, continuous intraparenchymal infusion of dexamethasone was well tolerated with no adverse effects. Pharmacokinetic analyses supported preferential intratumoral distribution and reduced systemic exposure with CED compared with systemic dosing. Single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) and immunohistochemistry showed attenuation of glioma-associated inflammation with downregulation of reactive microglial/macrophage programs and reduced tumor-infiltrating myeloid cells with a morphology consistent with a less activated state. Experiments in human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived microglia confirmed that dexamethasone directly suppresses inflammatory gene expression, indicating a conserved mechanism across species. This inflammatory suppression was recapitulated in both immortalized microglial (HMC3) and macrophage (THP1) cell lines. These findings suggest that localized dexamethasone delivered by CED reprograms the glioma immune microenvironment and achieves control of inflammation without the systemic adverse effects associated with standard systemic dexamethasone therapy. This clinically translatable strategy may improve symptom management and provide a platform for integrating local immunomodulation with future glioblastoma therapies.
papers.abstractKo: 덱사메타손(dexamethasone)은 교모세포종(glioblastoma)에서 뇌부종과 염증을 조절하기 위해 널리 사용되지만, 그 유익성은 전신 독성 및 불량한 예후와의 연관성에 의해 제한된다. 우리는 국소 corticosteroid 노출을 증가시켜 종양 내 항염증 효과를 극대화하는 동시에 전신 노출을 최소화하기 위해 convection-enhanced delivery(CED)를 통한 덱사메타손의 국소 투여를 평가하였다. 두 가지 교모세포종 마우스 모델에서, 덱사메타손의 지속적 뇌실질 내 주입은 어떠한 이상반응 없이 잘 견디었다. 약동학적 분석은 전신 투여와 비교하여 CED가 종양 내 우선적 분포 및 감소된 전신 노출을 보임을 뒷받침하였다. 단일핵 RNA 시퀀싱(single-nucleus RNA sequencing, snRNA-seq)과 면역조직화학(immunohistochemistry) 결과, 반응성 미세아교세포/대식세포 프로그램의 하향조절과 덜 활성화된 상태와 일치하는 형태를 보이는 종양 침윤성 myeloid 세포의 감소를 통해 교모세포종 관련 염증이 완화됨이 나타났다. 인간 유도만능줄기세포(human induced pluripotent stem cell, iPSC) 유래 미세아교세포에서의 실험은 덱사메타손이 염증성 유전자 발현을 직접 억제함을 확인하여, 종 간 보존된 기전을 시사하였다. 이러한 염증 억제는 불멸화 미세아교세포(immortalized microglial) 세포주(HMC3)와 대식세포(macrophage) 세포주(THP1) 모두에서 재현되었다. 이러한 소견은 CED로 전달된 국소 덱사메타손이 교모세포종 면역 미세환경을 재프로그램하고, 표준 전신 덱사메타손 치료와 연관된 전신 부작용 없이 염증을 조절함을 시사한다. 이 임상적으로 적용 가능한 전략은 증상 관리를 향상시키고 향후 교모세포종 치료와 국소 면역조절을 통합하기 위한 플랫폼을 제공할 수 있다.

papers.title: The metabokine β-aminoisobutyric acid mediates exercise performance and skeletal muscle adaptation through a PGC1α-BAIBA-PPARδ axis
papers.abstract: Exercise orchestrates an interorgan communication network, in which skeletal muscle releases signaling molecules known as myokines that contribute to exercise training-induced adaptations. We identified the muscle-derived metabolite beta-aminoisobutyric acid (BAIBA) as a regulator of adipose and hepatic metabolic responses to exercise. Here, we demonstrate that BAIBA regulates muscle metabolism, morphology and function via peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor delta (PPARδ) to determine exercise performance in mice. BAIBA mitigates muscle dysfunction in a mouse model of diabetes. Physiologically, BAIBA exists as D- and L- enantiomers. We identify L-BAIBA as the primary mediator of muscular effects. Knockdown of L-BAIBA's biosynthetic enzyme, 4-aminobutyrate aminotransferase, in mouse hindlimb muscle impairs exercise-induced adaptations and performance gains. L-BAIBA regulates human myotube fibertype and differentiation markers through Mas-related G-protein coupled receptor D. In humans, plasma L-BAIBA correlates with aerobic fitness and increases with endurance exercise training. BAIBA acts through the PGC1α-BAIBA-PPARδ axis to facilitate muscle adaptation and exercise performance.
papers.abstractKo: 운동은 장기 간(interorgan) 통신 네트워크를 조율하며, 이 과정에서 골격근은 myokines로 알려진 신호 분자를 방출하여 운동 훈련 유도 적응에 기여한다. 우리는 근육 유래 대사산물 beta-aminoisobutyric acid(BAIBA)를 운동에 대한 지방조직 및 간의 대사 반응을 조절하는 인자로 규명하였다. 여기서 우리는 BAIBA가 peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor delta(PPARδ)를 통해 근육 대사, 형태 및 기능을 조절하여 마우스에서 운동 수행능력을 결정함을 입증한다. BAIBA는 당뇨병 마우스 모델에서 근기능 이상을 완화한다. 생리학적으로 BAIBA는 D- 및 L-엔안티오머로 존재한다. 우리는 L-BAIBA가 근육 효과의 주요 매개체임을 확인하였다. 마우스 뒷다리 근육에서 L-BAIBA의 생합성 효소인 4-aminobutyrate aminotransferase의 knockdown은 운동 유도 적응 및 수행능력 증가를 저해한다. L-BAIBA는 Mas-related G-protein coupled receptor D를 통해 인간 myotube의 섬유형 및 분화 표지자를 조절한다. 인간에서 혈장 L-BAIBA는 유산소 체력(aerobic fitness)과 상관관계를 보이며 지구력 운동 훈련에 따라 증가한다. BAIBA는 PGC1α-BAIBA-PPARδ 축을 통해 근육 적응과 운동 수행능력을 촉진한다.

papers.title: Hallmarks of the multidimensional immune response to trauma in humans
papers.abstract: Trauma disrupts the structure-function interplay of life, instantly engaging innate and adaptive immunity together with neuroendocrine, endovascular and metabolic axes. The immune response emerges from disturbances in overarching hallmarks of any living being-barrier systems, molecular communication and adaptation-further shaped by patient-specific, injury-specific and modern care-specific determinants. These factors drive adaptive or maladaptive immune trajectories, from restitution to chronic dysfunction or death. Multi-omics analyses of trauma cohorts now enable endotype discovery, providing a framework for mechanism-guided, spatiotemporal precision immunomodulation. This Review focuses exclusively on human studies to conceptualize major themes in clinical trauma immunology to guide future research.
papers.abstractKo: 외상(trauma)은 생명체의 구조-기능 상호작용을 붕괴시키며, 선천면역과 적응면역을 즉각적으로 활성화하는 동시에 신경내분비, 혈관내피(endovascular) 및 대사 축을 함께 동원한다. 면역 반응은 모든 생명체의 포괄적 특징인 장벽 시스템, 분자적 소통 및 적응의 교란에서 비롯되며, 환자 특이적, 손상 특이적 및 현대 치료 특이적 결정 요인에 의해 추가로 형성된다. 이러한 요인들은 회복(restoration)에서 만성 기능장애 또는 사망에 이르기까지 적응적 또는 부적응적 면역 궤적을 구동한다. 외상 코호트에 대한 다중오믹스(multi-omics) 분석은 이제 endotype 발견을 가능하게 하며, 기전 유도형의 시공간적 정밀 면역조절(spatiotemporal precision immunomodulation)을 위한 틀을 제공한다. 본 리뷰는 향후 연구를 안내하기 위해 임상 외상 면역학(clinical trauma immunology)의 주요 주제를 개념화하는 데 초점을 맞추며, 인간 연구에만 한정한다.

papers.title: CD73 inhibition overcomes adaptive immune resistance to PARP inhibiton in models of prostate cancer
papers.abstract: Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) remains a leading cause of cancer-related mortality in men. Although poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase inhibitors (PARP inhibitor) are approved for mCRPC patients with homologous recombination repair (HRR) deficiencies, clinical trials combining Olaparib with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors have shown limited efficacy in unselected populations. To investigate the immunomodulatory effects of PARP inhibitor in an unbiased manner, we performed bulk RNA sequencing on HRR-proficient MycCaP cells treated with the PARP inhibitor (Olaparib) versus vehicle control. Transcriptomics analysis revealed robust upregulation of CD73 (NT5E), an ectoenzyme and emerging immune checkpoint that generates extracellular adenosine, suggesting an adaptive mechanism that undermines Olaparib efficacy and promotes immunosuppression. CD73 induction by Olaparib was validated in both human and mouse prostate cancer cell lines, with more pronounced effects in HRR-compromised PTEN knockout (KO) cells. Mechanistically, olaparib-driven CD73 expression was mediated through DNA damage-activated ATR-CHEK1-IRF1 and TGF-β1-AKT signaling pathways. In parallel, Olaparib enhanced tumor immunogenicity by activating type I interferon (IFN) signaling and antigen presentation machinery. In vivo, combining olaparib with CD73 blockade significantly delayed tumor growth, improved T-cell infiltration, and augmented CD8⁺ T-cell effector function across HRR-proficient and PTEN KO prostate cancer models. These findings identify Olaparib-induced CD73 upregulation as an adaptive resistance mechanism and support Olaparib plus CD73 blockade as a promising therapeutic strategy for advanced prostate cancer, irrespective of HRR status.
papers.abstractKo: 전이성 거세저항성 전립선암(mCRPC)은 남성에서 암 관련 사망의 주요 원인으로 남아 있다. 상동 재조합 복구(HRR) 결핍이 있는 mCRPC 환자에게는 poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase inhibitors(PARP inhibitor)가 승인되어 있지만, Olaparib와 PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors를 병용한 임상시험은 비선별 집단에서 제한적인 효능을 보여 주었다. PARP inhibitor의 면역조절 효과를 편향 없이 조사하기 위해, 우리는 PARP inhibitor(Olaparib) 처리군과 vehicle 대조군을 비교하여 HRR-정상 MycCaP 세포에서 bulk RNA sequencing을 수행하였다. 전사체학(transcriptomics) 분석에서 extracellular adenosine을 생성하는 ectoenzyme이자 새로운 immune checkpoint인 CD73(NT5E)의 강력한 발현 증가가 확인되었으며, 이는 Olaparib 효능을 저해하고 면역억제를 촉진하는 적응적 기전을 시사하였다. Olaparib에 의한 CD73 유도는 인간 및 마우스 전립선암 세포주 모두에서 검증되었고, HRR가 손상된 PTEN knockout(KO) 세포에서 더 뚜렷한 효과를 보였다. 기전적으로, olaparib에 의해 유도되는 CD73 발현은 DNA damage에 의해 활성화되는 ATR-CHEK1-IRF1 및 TGF-β1-AKT 신호전달 경로를 통해 매개되었다. 이와 병행하여, Olaparib는 type I interferon(IFN) 신호전달과 항원 제시 기구를 활성화함으로써 종양의 면역원성(tumor immunogenicity)을 증가시켰다. 생체 내(in vivo)에서 olaparib와 CD73 blockade의 병용은 HRR-정상 및 PTEN KO 전립선암 모델 전반에서 종양 성장을 유의하게 지연시키고, T 세포 침윤을 개선하며, CD8⁺ T 세포의 효과기 기능을 증강시켰다. 이러한 결과는 Olaparib에 의해 유도되는 CD73 상향조절을 적응적 저항성 기전으로 규명하며, HRR 상태와 무관하게 진행성 전립선암에 대한 유망한 치료 전략으로서 Olaparib plus CD73 blockade를 지지한다.

papers.title: Neutrophil-integrated syncytial CAR macrophage for cancer immunotherapy
papers.abstract: The limited effectiveness of chimeric antigen receptor macrophage (CAR-M) therapy is largely due to poor tumor infiltration, reduced effector function and immune escape of target antigen-low tumors. Here we developed syncytial CAR-Ms (S-CAR-M) by fusing CAR-Ms with neutrophils. S-CAR-Ms accumulated in tumors more than conventional CAR-Ms because of chemokine-driven migration. By releasing neutrophil extracellular traps and reactive oxygen species inherited from neutrophils, S-CAR-Ms increased PtdSer exposure on tumor cells, leading to efficient phagocytosis of tumor debris through both the scFv-antigen and PtdSer-MerTK pathways. Thus, a single dose of S-CAR-Ms can reduce tumor burden, limit metastasis and prevent tumor recurrence in syngeneic and xenograft mouse models. Additionally, S-CAR-M therapy triggered antigen spreading, minimizing escape by target antigen-low tumor cells. S-CAR-Ms overcome limitations of conventional CAR-Ms toward solid tumors.
papers.abstractKo: 키메라 항원 수용체 대식세포(chimeric antigen receptor macrophage, CAR-M) 치료의 제한된 유효성은 주로 낮은 종양 침윤, 감소된 효과기 기능 및 표적 항원-저발현 종양의 면역 회피에 기인한다. 여기에서 우리는 CAR-M을 호중구와 융합하여 syncytial CAR-Ms(S-CAR-Ms)를 개발하였다. S-CAR-Ms는 케모카인 유도 이동(chemokine-driven migration)으로 인해 기존 CAR-Ms보다 종양에 더 많이 축적되었다. 호중구로부터 유래한 neutrophil extracellular traps와 reactive oxygen species를 방출함으로써, S-CAR-Ms는 종양 세포에서 PtdSer 노출을 증가시켰고, 그 결과 scFv-antigen 및 PtdSer-MerTK 경로 모두를 통해 종양 잔해의 효율적인 식세포작용(phagocytosis)을 유도하였다. 따라서 S-CAR-Ms의 단일 투여는 동계(syngeneic) 및 이종이식(xenograft) 마우스 모델에서 종양 부담을 감소시키고, 전이를 제한하며, 종양 재발을 예방할 수 있다. 또한, S-CAR-M 치료는 항원 확산(antigen spreading)을 유도하여 표적 항원-저발현 종양 세포에 의한 탈출을 최소화하였다. S-CAR-Ms는 고형 종양에 대한 기존 CAR-Ms의 한계를 극복한다.

papers.title: A viral-based individualized neoantigen vaccine as adjuvant treatment in resected head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: a randomized Phase I trial
papers.abstract: Abstract In approximately one third of patients, resected head and neck squamous cell carcinoma will recur. We postulated that the induction of tumor neoantigen-specific T cell responses could prevent relapse. To this end, we developed TG4050, an individualized neoantigen therapeutic vaccine encoding up to 30 patient-specific predicted tumor neoantigens delivered by a Modified Vaccinia Ankara viral vector. We tested adjuvant TG4050 as single agent in a randomized phase I trial comparing treatment with TG4050 immediately after standard of care adjuvant therapy versus watchful waiting and treatment with TG4050 after recurrence (NCT04183166). The primary endpoint was safety, secondary endpoints included feasibility and efficacy, and immunogenicity was exploratory. TG4050 was well tolerated. Of 16 evaluable patients randomized the immediate treatment arm, none relapsed after a median follow-up of 30 months, while 3 of 16 relapsed in the control arm. T cell responses to vaccine neoantigens were detected in 73.3% of patients treated with TG4050 immediately, with a median of 3 neoantigens per responder. These responses were maintained throughout treatment and persisted for over one year after the last dose. Vaccine neoantigen-specific CD8 + T cells had an effector phenotype, displayed high expression of cytotoxic and tissue-resident markers, were polyclonal and comprised both de novo responses and amplification of pre-existing tumor-infiltrating T cell clones. Together, these translational data are consistent with the hypothesis in which single-agent delivery of TG4050 induces long-lasting tumor neoantigen-specific cytotoxic T cell responses that can prevent tumor recurrence.
papers.abstractKo: 초록 약 3분의 1의 환자에서 절제된 두경부 편평상피세포암(head and neck squamous cell carcinoma)은 재발한다. 우리는 종양 neoantigen-특이적 T 세포 반응의 유도가 재발을 예방할 수 있다고 가정하였다. 이를 위해, Modified Vaccinia Ankara viral vector에 의해 전달되는 최대 30개의 환자-특이적 예측 종양 neoantigen을 암호화하는 개인맞춤형 neoantigen 치료 백신 TG4050을 개발하였다. 우리는 표준 치료 보조요법(adjuvant therapy) 직후 TG4050으로 치료하는 군과 감시 대기(watchful waiting) 후 재발 시 TG4050으로 치료하는 군을 비교한 무작위 배정 phase I 시험(NCT04183166)에서 단독제로서의 보조요법 TG4050을 평가하였다. 1차 평가변수는 안전성이었고, 2차 평가변수에는 실행 가능성과 유효성이 포함되었으며, 면역원성은 탐색적 평가변수였다. TG4050은 내약성이 좋았다. 평가 가능한 16명의 무작위 배정 환자 중 즉시 치료군에서는 중앙 추적 관찰 기간 30개월 후 재발한 환자가 없었고, 대조군에서는 16명 중 3명이 재발하였다. 백신 neoantigen에 대한 T 세포 반응은 TG4050을 즉시 투여받은 환자의 73.3%에서 검출되었으며, 반응자당 중앙 neoantigen 수는 3개였다. 이러한 반응은 치료 기간 내내 유지되었고 마지막 투여 후 1년 이상 지속되었다. 백신 neoantigen-특이적 CD8 + T 세포는 effector phenotype을 보였고, 세포독성 및 tissue-resident marker의 높은 발현을 나타냈으며, polyclonal이었고, de novo 반응과 기존의 tumor-infiltrating T cell clone의 증폭을 모두 포함하였다. 종합하면, 이러한 중개연구(translational) 자료는 단일제 TG4050 투여가 종양 재발을 예방할 수 있는 장기간 지속되는 종양 neoantigen-특이적 세포독성 T 세포 반응을 유도한다는 가설과 일치한다.

papers.title: Identifying phenotype-genotype-function coupling in 3D organoid imaging using Shape, Appearance and Motion Phenotype Observation Tool (SPOT)
papers.abstract: Live cells in tissue are plastic, phenotypically dynamic, and modify their function in response to genetic and environmental perturbations. To unleash the power of live-cell imaging to identify phenotype-genotype-function coupling over time, we report the development of a standardized Shape-Appearance-Motion (SAM) "phenome" and SAM-Phenotype-Observation-Tool (SPOT), that act as an image-"transcriptome" and image-"transcriptome analyzer" respectively, and provide an unbiased and comprehensive description of morpho-dynamic phenotypes without prior knowledge. We apply SAM-SPOT to our simulated organoids database with known ground-truth and >1.6 million mouse and human organoid instances with defined genetic and chemical perturbations. SAM-SPOT can effectively and robustly characterize 3D morpho-dynamics from 2D projection videos. Combined with single-cell RNA sequencing, SAM-SPOT reveals that altered WNT signaling, but not mutant RAS or p53, predisposes intestinal organoids to irregular morphogenesis. SAM-SPOT advances biomedical discovery by empowering live-cell imaging to identify phenotype-genotype-function relationships through large-scale and cost-effective label-free live-cell imaging.

papers.title: Radiotherapy and immunotherapy in cancer treatment: mechanisms of clinical synergy
papers.abstract: Synergizing radiotherapy (RT) with immune checkpoint inhibitors has emerged as a promising strategy for solid tumors. RT acts as a potent immunomodulator, capable of functioning as an in situ vaccine through the induction of immunogenic cell death and activation of innate immune sensing, thereby promoting DC maturation and CD8+ T cell responses. However, RT also triggers counter-regulatory immunosuppression, including PD-L1 upregulation and the recruitment of suppressive cells, providing the biological rationale for synergy. Here, we systematically review advances in radioimmunotherapy, covering immunomodulatory mechanisms, clinical optimization of dose and sequencing, and the emerging role of artificial intelligence (AI) in guiding treatment paradigms. We adopt a spatial interaction-centric perspective to synthesize current knowledge on how RT governs the DC/CD8+ T cell interaction axis across the tumor microenvironment and tumor-draining lymph nodes, aiming to chart a rational course from empirical combination toward personalized, precision radioimmunotherapy. Furthermore, we explore how AI-driven analysis of radiomics and multiomics data is being applied to predict responders and personalize treatment planning.

RT는 강력한 면역조절인자(immunomodulator)로 작용하며, 면역원성 세포사멸(immunogenic cell death)의 유도와 선천면역 감지(innate immune sensing)의 활성화를 통해 in situ 백신으로 기능할 수 있고, 그 결과 DC 성숙과 CD8+ T 세포 반응을 촉진한다. 그러나 RT는 또한 PD-L1 상향조절과 억제성 세포의 모집을 포함한 역조절성 면역억제(counter-regulatory immunosuppression)를 유발하여, 병용의 생물학적 근거를 제공한다. 본고에서는 면역조절 기전, 용량 및 순서의 임상적 최적화, 그리고 치료 패러다임을 안내하는 데 있어 인공지능(artificial intelligence, AI)의 부상하는 역할을 포괄하여 방사선면역치료(radioimmunotherapy)의 진전을 체계적으로 검토한다. 우리는 공간적 상호작용 중심(spatial interaction-centric) 관점을 채택하여, RT가 종양 미세환경(tumor microenvironment)과 종양 배액 림프절(tumor-draining lymph nodes) 전반에서 DC/CD8+ T 세포 상호작용 축을 어떻게 조절하는지에 대한 현재의 지식을 종합하고, 경험적 병용에서 개인맞춤형 정밀 방사선면역치료(personalized, precision radioimmunotherapy)로 나아가기 위한 합리적 경로를 제시하는 것을 목표로 한다. 또한 우리는 AI 기반 radiomics 및 multiomics 데이터 분석이 반응 예측자(responder) 예측과 치료 계획의 개인화에 어떻게 적용되고 있는지 탐구한다.

papers.title: Monoclonal antibody CIS43LS sets the bar for long-acting malaria protection
papers.abstract: Monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) targeting Plasmodium falciparum epitopes aim to address gaps in malaria prevention, with potential to profoundly impact high-risk populations. In this issue of the JCI, Tran et al. performed pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic analyses on the mAb CIS43LS, which targets a unique conserved hinge region on the sporozoite protein CSP and previously demonstrated a high level of durable protection in controlled human malaria infections. Their findings establish a solid benchmark for mAb protection, demonstrating 80% protection from liver-stage invasion for 4-6 months. A clinical correlate of protection was estimated at antibody levels over 64 μg/mL. Successful protection could also be achieved from subcutaneous injections requiring lower doses. While efficacy of individual mAbs is more straightforward to demonstrate, exploring combination approaches targeting variable regions and diverse effector functions seems prudent to address the problem of evolving microbial pathogens. Combining both mAbs and long-acting malaria drugs may improve efficacy and reduce resistance.

papers.title: Shear wave elastography demonstrates similar risk stratification performance to vibration-controlled transient elastography in FIB-4–based two-step algorithms for MASLD
papers.abstract: Background aims The role of shear wave elastography (SWE) in two-step MASLD risk stratification remains unclear. We compared SWE with vibration-controlled transient elastography (VCTE) using American Gastroenterological Association (AGA) and European Association for the Study of the Liver (EASL) algorithms. Approach results Patients with MASLD who underwent both VCTE and SWE during the same session between 2019 and 2025 were included. Risk stratification was performed using AGA- and EASL-based two-step approaches. The primary endpoint was liver-related events (LRE). Among 2,817 patients, the AGA-SWE algorithm classified 2,196, 140, and 481 patients as low-, intermediate-, and high-risk, respectively. Using the AGA-SWE algorithm, both intermediate- and high-risk groups showed increased risks of LREs compared with the low-risk group (subdistribution hazard ratio [sHR] 7.60 and 9.86, respectively). The EASL-SWE algorithm also stratified LRE risk relative to the low-risk group, with higher sHRs observed for the intermediate-low, intermediate-high, and high-risk groups (sHR 2.99, 10.83, and 18.87, respectively). The integrated time-dependent area under the curve through 60 months was 0.770 (95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.709, 0.827) and 0.775 (95% CI: 0.712, 0.835) for AGA-SWE and AGA-VCTE, respectively, and 0.804 (95% CI: 0.753, 0.849) and 0.805 (95% CI: 0.750, 0.852) for EASL-SWE and EASL-VCTE, respectively, with no significant differences between SWE and VCTE in either algorithm. No significant net reclassification improvement was observed between SWE- and VCTE-based AGA algorithms. SWE and VCTE demonstrated a strong correlation (Spearman's ρ = 0.713, 95% CI: 0.691-0.735, p Conclusions SWE-based two-step risk stratification showed similar predictive performance to VCTE-based models for predicting LREs in MASLD, although these findings do not establish formal equivalence.

papers.title: Evolutionary conservation analysis reveals a primordial function of STING as a regulator of lipid metabolism via FADS2
papers.abstract: Abstract The stimulator of interferon genes (STING) is a pivotal regulator of type I interferon (IFN) responses. Although the IFN system is confined to vertebrates, STING is present across metazoans and in some unicellular eukaryotes, suggesting involvement in distinct functions prior to vertebrate divergence. Here we explore the conservation of STING-mediated regulation of polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA) metabolism. We find that STING homologs from vertebrates, invertebrates, and unicellular eukaryotes interact with fatty acid desaturase 2 (FADS2), the rate-limiting enzyme in PUFA metabolism, and influence subsequent functional outputs. Specifically, we show that STING homologs differentially shape cell susceptibility to infection by DNA and RNA viruses independently of the activation of IFN responses, suggesting that STING-mediated metabolic pathway regulation may participate in primitive host defense mechanisms. Thus, we identify STING-mediated metabolic regulation as an evolutionarily conserved feature and a primordial function of STING.

papers.title: Physical activity delays ovarian aging in part through adiponectin-related signaling pathways
papers.abstract: Ovarian aging leads to infertility, endocrine dysregulation and increased chronic disease risk, yet there are currently no approved therapies to delay ovarian aging. Physical activity (PA) is a crucial lifestyle factor for human health and antiaging, but its effects and mechanisms on ovarian aging remain unclear. Here we show, through a cross-sectional analysis of 152,435 participants in the UK Biobank, that lower PA levels were observed among postmenopausal persons when compared to premenopausal persons, and this finding was supported by another cross-sectional study of 12,418 participants in the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey. Animal studies in mice show that higher levels of PA can delay ovarian aging. In addition, PA significantly increased adiponectin levels in the ovary, and the protective effects of PA on ovarian aging were attenuated in adiponectin-deficient mice. The adiponectin receptor agonist AdipoRon delayed ovarian aging and extended reproductive lifespan in mice. Our findings elucidate the role and mechanisms of PA in delaying ovarian aging, highlighting potential therapeutic targets for extending the reproductive lifespan.

papers.title: Potent type-specific de novo antibodies complement broadly reactive imprinted antibodies in immune responses to SARS-CoV-2 variants
papers.abstract: For rapidly mutating viruses such as influenza viruses and severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), immune memory recalled by antigenically drifted variants primarily comprises antibodies that cross-react to the priming strain rather than de novo elicited responses, a phenomenon termed original antigenic sin or immune imprinting. The composition and functionality of de novo responses elicited by variant exposures remain unclear. Here we isolated and characterized hundreds of recall and de novo neutralizing monoclonal antibodies after sequential exposures to SARS-CoV-2 variants in ancestral-imprinted humans. De novo variant type-specific antibodies used different V(D)J genes that were closer to germline sequence, potently neutralized future variants and targeted distinct receptor binding domain epitopes compared to ancestral cross-reactive (recall) antibodies. Nevertheless, neutralizing responses to the updated 2024-2025 booster were predominantly ancestral cross-reactive. These results reveal the distinct contributions of recall and de novo antibodies to a balanced immune response and underscore the benefit of updated booster vaccines, which augment both subsets.

papers.title: Chemovaccination with a late-liver-stage antimalarial induces durable immunity against malaria
papers.abstract: Plasmodium falciparum sporozoite vaccines, in which parasites are attenuated at the liver stage, provide high efficacy but require complex manufacture and intravenous administration of high sporozoite doses. Protection involved anti-circumsporozoite protein (CSP) antibodies and CD8+ T cells, including liver-resident memory subsets that recognized diverse antigens (SERA1, RPL6, GAP50, RNT, PHIST, S20, and RBP). CALM vaccination merits clinical evaluation, including by natural mosquito exposure if long-acting injectable PMIX/X inhibitor formulations prove feasible.

papers.title: Insulin resistance is associated with mammary mitochondrial dysfunction at the onset of human lactation
papers.abstract: Insulin resistance (IR) has emerged as a risk factor for lactation insufficiency and delays the onset of milk secretion after childbirth, termed secretory activation (SA). This may cause inadequate infant weight gain and early breastfeeding cessation. However, the mechanisms underlying delayed SA in insulin resistant women are unknown. To investigate this, we characterized the mammary transcriptomes and IR-related hormones of 75 breastfeeding women with healthy term infants during postpartum days 1-5. Participants were divided into IR tertiles based on plasma leptin-to-adiponectin ratio measurements. Those in the highest tertile had later SA onset with greater neonatal weight loss during postpartum days 1-5. Transcriptomic analysis on postpartum day 2 (n=4 high IR vs. n=8 low IR participants) showed transient suppression of mammary insulin and prolactin signaling genes, increased pro-inflammatory gene expression and altered expression of >200 mammary mitochondrial genes. These alterations were absent on postpartum days 3-5. Cultured mammary epithelial cells (MECs) treated with insulin showed upregulation of prolactin signaling and oxidative phosphorylation (OXPHOS) genes, with imaging and bioenergetic studies demonstrating that insulin promotes mitochondrial biogenesis and OXPHOS. Thus, our findings delineate roles for insulin in mammary bioenergetics and highlight mitochondrial dysfunction as a mechanism for delayed SA in insulin resistant women.

papers.title: Macrophages tune NK cell IFNγ production through direct lipid transfer
papers.abstract: Abstract Natural killer (NK) cells are critical effectors of innate immunity, but their activity is strongly influenced by metabolic state. While intrinsic NK metabolism has been studied extensively, less is known about how surrounding immune cells shape NK cell function. Here, we identify a direct metabolic communication axis between macrophages and NK cells. Using co-culture and in vivo models, we show that lipopolysaccharide-stimulated macrophages induce lipid accumulation in NK cells that suppresses mTORC1 activity and the production of IFNγ. This lipid accumulation is visualised as increased lipid droplets content in NK cells, generated using fatty acids synthesised within the macrophages. Genetic and pharmacological approaches show that fatty acid transfer from macrophages to NK cells requires cell-cell contact and is associated with CD36 protein transfer via trogocytosis. Blocking fatty acid synthesis specifically in macrophages prevents lipid accumulation in NK cells and restores both mTORC1 activity and IFNγ production. These findings define a previously unrecognized mechanism of macrophage-NK cell cross-regulation, revealing how metabolic exchange constrains NK effector function and establishing a feedback circuit with implications for hyperinflammation and immunotherapy.
papers.abstractKo: 초록 자연살해세포(NK cells)는 선천면역(innate immunity)의 중요한 효과기이지만, 그 활성은 대사 상태에 의해 강하게 영향을 받는다. NK 세포 내재적 대사(intrinsic NK metabolism)는 광범위하게 연구되어 왔으나, 주변 면역세포가 NK 세포 기능을 어떻게 형성하는지에 대해서는 알려진 바가 적다. 본 연구에서는 대식세포(macrophages)와 NK 세포 사이의 직접적인 대사적 소통 축을 규명하였다. 공배양(co-culture) 및 생체 내(in vivo) 모델을 이용하여, lipopolysaccharide로 자극된 대식세포가 NK 세포 내 지질 축적(lipid accumulation)을 유도하며, 이는 mTORC1 활성과 IFNγ 생성(production)을 억제함을 보여주었다. 이러한 지질 축적은 NK 세포에서 증가된 lipid droplets 함량으로 가시화되며, 이는 대식세포 내에서 합성된 지방산(fatty acids)을 이용하여 생성된다. 유전적 및 약리학적 접근은 대식세포에서 NK 세포로의 지방산 전달이 세포-세포 접촉(cell-cell contact)을 필요로 하며, trogocytosis를 통한 CD36 단백질 전달과 연관되어 있음을 보여준다. 대식세포에서의 지방산 합성만을 선택적으로 차단하면 NK 세포 내 지질 축적이 예방되고 mTORC1 활성과 IFNγ 생성이 모두 회복된다. 이러한 결과는 대식세포-NK 세포 상호조절(cross-regulation)의 이전에 알려지지 않았던 기전을 규정하며, 대사 교환이 NK 효과기 기능을 어떻게 제약하는지 밝히고, 과염증(hyperinflammation) 및 면역치료(immunotherapy)에 대한 함의를 지닌 피드백 회로를 확립한다.

papers.title: In vivo genome-wide CRISPR screens of human T cells in solid tumours
papers.abstract: Large-scale CRISPR screening in human T cells holds significant promise for identifying genetic modifications that enhance cellular immunotherapy. Yet, many regulators of T cell performance in solid tumours are not revealed in vitro 1,2 . In vivo screening in tumour-bearing mice is more physiological but has been limited by low intratumoural T cell recovery. Here we developed an in vivo model that efficiently recovers human T cells from solid tumours, permitting genome-wide CRISPR screens with few mice. Tumour-infiltrating T cells from this model exhibit hallmarks of dysfunction compared with splenic T cells, creating an ideal screening context. We performed two genome-wide CRISPR knockout screens to identify regulators of intratumoural T cell abundance and effector function. The abundance screen revealed the P2RY8-Gα13 GPCR signalling axis as a negative regulator of T cell tumour infiltration. The effector function screen identified GNAS as a key driver of T cell dysfunction in tumours, whose product, Gαs, acts as a convergent node downstream of multiple GPCRs sensing distinct suppressive ligands. Knockout of GNAS rendered T cells resistant to multiple suppressive cues and significantly improved efficacy across diverse solid tumour models in chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) and T cell receptor (TCR) systems. Combinatorial knockout of P2RY8-GNAS further enhanced tumour control, demonstrating that complementary in vivo screens can identify orthogonal targets whose combined editing improves therapeutic potency. This flexible, scalable platform can be adapted for systematic discovery of genetic strategies to improve solid tumour T cell therapies.
papers.abstractKo: 대규모 CRISPR screening은 인간 T 세포에서 세포 면역치료(cellular immunotherapy)를 향상시키는 유전적 변형을 식별하는 데 큰 가능성을 지닌다. 그러나 고형 종양(solid tumours)에서 T 세포 기능의 많은 조절자는 in vitro에서는 밝혀지지 않는다1,2. 종양을 이식한 마우스에서의 in vivo screening은 보다 생리학적이지만, 종양 내(intratumoural) T 세포 회수율이 낮아 제한되어 왔다. 여기서 우리는 고형 종양으로부터 인간 T 세포를 효율적으로 회수하는 in vivo 모델을 개발하였으며, 이를 통해 적은 수의 마우스로 genome-wide CRISPR screens를 수행할 수 있었다. 이 모델에서 종양 침윤 T 세포(tumour-infiltrating T cells)는 비장에서 얻은 T 세포와 비교하여 기능장애(dysfunction)의 특징을 나타내어, 이상적인 screening 맥락을 형성하였다. 우리는 종양 내 T 세포 abundance와 effector function의 조절자를 규명하기 위해 두 개의 genome-wide CRISPR knockout screens를 수행하였다. abundance screen에서는 P2RY8-Gα13 GPCR signaling axis가 T 세포의 종양 침윤에 대한 음성 조절자임이 밝혀졌다. effector function screen에서는 GNAS가 종양에서의 T 세포 기능장애의 핵심 유도인자임이 확인되었으며, 그 산물인 Gαs는 서로 다른 억제성 리간드(suppressive ligands)를 감지하는 다수의 GPCRs 하류에서 수렴 노드(convergent node)로 작용하였다. GNAS의 knockout은 T 세포를 여러 억제성 신호(suppressive cues)에 대해 저항성으로 만들었고, chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) 및 T cell receptor (TCR) 시스템 전반의 다양한 고형 종양 모델에서 효능을 유의하게 향상시켰다. P2RY8-GNAS의 조합적 knockout은 종양 조절을 더욱 향상시켰으며, 이는 상보적인 in vivo screens가 결합 편집(combined editing) 시 치료 효능을 높이는 직교적 표적(orthogonal targets)을 식별할 수 있음을 입증한다. 이 유연하고 확장 가능한 플랫폼은 고형 종양 T 세포 치료를 개선하기 위한 유전적 전략의 체계적 발굴에 맞춤화될 수 있다.

papers.title: Three-dimensional mapping of intact ovaries reveals the aging dynamics of the ovarian reserve
papers.abstract: Female fertility depends on a finite pool of oocytes that depletes during aging 1,2 , yet the spatiotemporal dynamics of this depletion remain poorly understood. Traditional methods obscure the three-dimensional architecture of the ovary, limiting quantitative insights. Here we combine light-sheet microscopy, artificial intelligence-driven segmentation and mathematical modeling to map over 85,000 oocytes in whole ovaries across the reproductive lifespan in mouse. We find that newly activated oocytes represent a fixed fraction of the total oocyte pool despite an age-related decline in oocyte numbers. Spatial analysis revealed that oocytes are enriched along the lateral ovarian axis, and local oocyte density positively correlates with activation. We also uncover a bimodal distribution of oocyte sizes, suggesting a bottleneck during oogenesis. Finally, a differential equation-based model captures the kinetics of oocyte activation and loss. Our findings establish a quantitative framework for understanding ovarian aging and suggest that an organ-scale regulatory mechanism coordinates the age-related decline in oocyte numbers.
papers.abstractKo: 여성 생식력은 노화 동안 고갈되는 한정된 난모세포(oocyte) 풀에 의존하지만1,2, 이러한 고갈의 시공간적 역학은 여전히 잘 이해되지 않고 있다. 전통적인 방법은 난소의 3차원 구조를 가려 정량적 통찰을 제한한다. 여기에서 우리는 light-sheet microscopy, artificial intelligence-driven segmentation 및 수학적 모델링을 결합하여 생쥐의 생식 수명 전반에 걸친 전체 난소에서 85,000개 이상의 난모세포를 지도화하였다. 우리는 새롭게 활성화된 난모세포가 난모세포 수의 연령 관련 감소에도 불구하고 전체 난모세포 풀의 고정된 비율을 차지함을 발견하였다. 공간 분석은 난모세포가 난소의 측면 축(lateral ovarian axis)을 따라 풍부하게 분포함을 보여주었고, 국소 난모세포 밀도는 활성화와 양의 상관관계를 보였다. 또한 우리는 난모세포 크기의 이봉 분포(bimodal distribution)를 규명하여 난자발생(oogenesis) 동안의 병목(bottleneck)을 시사하였다. 마지막으로, 미분방정식(differential equation)-기반 모델은 난모세포 활성화와 소실의 동역학을 포착하였다. 우리의 결과는 난소 노화를 이해하기 위한 정량적 틀을 확립하며, 기관 규모(organ-scale)의 조절 기전이 난모세포 수의 연령 관련 감소를 조정함을 시사한다.

papers.title: Epigenetic modulation of stromal cell states underpins pathological tissue niches in Crohn’s disease
papers.abstract: Abstract Stromal cell states are altered in active Crohn’s disease (CD), but their origin and phenotypic stability are unknown. Using single-cell spatial transcriptomics, RNA sequencing and ATAC sequencing of ~2,500,000 cells, we map 18 distinct stromal cell states within their cellular and cytokine signaling environments in human full-thickness CD bowel. Inflammatory fibroblasts (IFs) reside in immune cell-rich mucosal ulcers and are induced through combinatorial cytokine exposure suppressing submucosal universal fibroblast programs. The IF state is stabilized through transcription factor (TF) activity of GLI3, TWIST1, ETV4, PRDM1 and RELB, and does not spontaneously revert; however, histone deacetylase inhibition destabilizes the IF state, preventing IF secretome-induced epithelial transmigration and activation of neutrophils. The IF open chromatin configuration is distinct from that of fibrotic contractile stroma, which populate adjoining immune-depleted submucosal fibrotic niches. These findings show that microenvironments in pathological tissue niches shape open chromatin configuration of stromal states that are amenable to modulation by epigenetic modifiers.
papers.abstractKo: 초록 스트로말 세포 상태(stromal cell states)는 활성 크론병(Crohn’s disease, CD)에서 변화하지만, 그 기원과 표현형적 안정성은 알려져 있지 않다. 단일세포 공간 전사체학(single-cell spatial transcriptomics), RNA sequencing 및 ATAC sequencing을 약 2,500,000개의 세포에 적용하여, 우리는 인간 전층(full-thickness) CD 장내에서 세포 및 cytokine signaling 환경 내에 존재하는 18개의 서로 구별되는 stromal cell states를 지도화하였다. 염증성 섬유아세포(inflammatory fibroblasts, IFs)는 면역세포가 풍부한 점막 궤양(mucosal ulcers)에 존재하며, 화합적(combinatorial) cytokine 노출을 통해 유도되는데, 이는 점막하(universal) 섬유아세포 프로그램(submucosal universal fibroblast programs)을 억제한다. IF 상태는 GLI3, TWIST1, ETV4, PRDM1 및 RELB의 transcription factor (TF) 활성에 의해 안정화되며, 자발적으로 원래 상태로 되돌아가지 않는다; 그러나 histone deacetylase 억제는 IF 상태를 불안정하게 하여, IF secretome에 의해 유도되는 상피 transmigration과 호중구(neutrophils) 활성화를 방지한다. IF의 open chromatin configuration은 섬유화성 contractile stroma의 것과 구별되며, 이러한 섬유화성 contractile stroma는 인접한 면역세포가 고갈된 점막하 섬유화 niche(submucosal fibrotic niches)에 분포한다. 이러한 결과는 병적 조직 niche(pathological tissue niches)의 미세환경이 epigenetic modifiers에 의해 조절 가능한 stromal states의 open chromatin configuration을 형성한다는 것을 보여준다.

papers.title: Youth-associated protein TIMP2 regulates microglial state and function in healthy and aged mice
papers.abstract: Abstract There is little understanding of how aging serves as the strongest risk factor for several neurodegenerative diseases. Microglia undergo age-related maladaptive changes, including increased inflammation, impaired debris clearance, and cellular senescence, yet specific mediators that regulate these processes remain unclear. The aged brain is rejuvenated by youth-associated plasma factors, including tissue inhibitor of metalloproteinases 2 (TIMP2), which we have shown acts on the extracellular matrix (ECM) to regulate synaptic plasticity. Given emerging roles for microglia in these processes, we examined the impact of TIMP2 on microglial function. We show that TIMP2 deletion in mice exacerbates microglial phenotypes associated with aging, including transcriptomic changes in cell activation, changes in lysosomal-associated markers and phagocytosis, and elevated levels of stress and inflammatory proteins in the brain extracellular space measured by in vivo microdialysis. Deleting specific cellular pools of TIMP2 in vivo increases microglial CD68 and alters myelin phagocytosis. Treating aged mice with TIMP2 reverses several phenotypes observed in our deletion models, resulting in decreased microglial activation, reduced proportions of proinflammatory microglia, and enhanced phagocytosis of physiological substrates. Our results identify TIMP2 as a modulator of age-associated microglia dysfunction. Harnessing its activity may mitigate detrimental effects of age-associated insults on microglia function.

papers.title: TIF1γ regulates stability of regulatory T cells during inflammation
papers.abstract: Regulatory T (T reg ) cells are essential for controlling inflammation and maintaining tissue homeostasis. Transcriptional intermediary factor 1-γ (TIF1γ) has been implicated in noncanonical TGFβ-Smad signaling in hematopoietic stem cells, but its role in T reg cell function has not been explored. Here we show that TIF1γ-deficient T reg cells lose Foxp3 expression and acquire effector phenotypes in a cell-intrinsic manner upon inflammatory challenge. In vivo, TIF1γ-deficient T reg cells adopt type 1 helper T cell-like or pro-inflammatory ex-T reg cell states in autoimmune settings and display type 2 helper T cell-like features during helminth infection. These cells exhibit transcriptional programs associated with proliferation, T cell activation and T helper differentiation, along with increased chromatin accessibility at regulatory regions enriched for key transcription factors controlling T cell activation and lineage specification. Mechanistically, T reg cell instability in the absence of TIF1γ is largely independent of transforming growth factor beta signaling and instead is driven by activation of the β-catenin pathway. TIF1γ-deficient T reg cells accumulate β-catenin and display enhanced TCF7 activity. Genetic or pharmacological targeting of β-catenin restores T reg cell stability and function. We identify TIF1γ as a critical regulator of T reg cell stability that restrains β-catenin-TCF7 signaling, thereby preserving Foxp3 expression and preventing inflammatory reprogramming.

papers.title: TNFR1 signaling connects inflammation to impaired fatty acid oxidation to drive intestinal stem cell aging
papers.abstract: Aging is characterized by a decline in function of intestinal stem cells (ISCs), but the extent to which this is shaped by systemic factors is unclear. Here we show that the ISC aging phenotype can be propagated from old to young mice utilizing heterochronic parabiosis, and implicate a role for inflammation in these effects, as anti-inflammatory drugs, including TNF antibodies, restored function. Parabiotic rescue experiments demonstrate that TNFR1 knockout protected young ISCs from the old environment. In young organoids, TNF downregulated crypt budding, while impairing mitochondrial pathways and fatty acid oxidation (FAO). However, aged ISC function was enhanced by boosting mitochondrial fusion, whereas FAO in aged crypts was improved by countering inflammation with salicylate treatment. Thus, these data identify the old environment through the progeronic factor TNF, as a driver of ISC aging phenotypes through intestinal epithelial cell TNF receptor 1 signaling to downregulate FAO, proliferation and regenerative capacity in these cells.
papers.abstractKo: 노화는 장 줄기세포(intestinal stem cells, ISCs) 기능의 저하를 특징으로 하지만, 이러한 변화가 전신적 요인에 의해 어느 정도 형성되는지는 불분명하다. 본 연구에서는 heterochronic parabiosis를 이용하여 ISC 노화 표현형이 노령 마우스에서 젊은 마우스로 전파될 수 있음을 보였고, 이러한 효과에서 염증의 역할을 시사하였다. 항-TNF 항체를 포함한 항염증 약물은 기능을 회복시켰다. papers.title: A novel CAF population coordinates hyper-suppressive regulatory T cell recruitment and localization in lung cancer
papers.abstract: Abstract Across many solid tumor types, cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) are abundant and heterogeneous, with distinct subpopulations exerting immunomodulatory functions. Here we identify a novel population of immunomodulatory CAFs (imCAFs) in primary lung adenocarcinoma and pulmonary metastases, characterized by cell adhesion molecule L1-like (CHL1) expression and enriched in immune regulation and chemokine signaling programs. Through single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, we demonstrate that imCAFs are spatially colocalized with CXCR3 + regulatory T (T reg ) cells, a hyper-suppressive subset accumulating at the tumor border. imCAFs produce CXCL9, driving CXCR3 + T reg cell recruitment and promoting an immunosuppressive microenvironment. CXCR3 + T reg cells display enhanced proliferative and suppressive capacity and are transcriptionally distinct from CXCR3 − counterparts. Genetic ablation of Cxcr3 in T reg cells or Cxcl9 in stromal cells reduces T reg cell accumulation, enhances CD8 + T cell activation and decreases tumor burden. Analogous CHL1 + imCAF-like fibroblasts in human non-small cell lung cancer colocalize with T reg cells, and elevated CHL1 expression is associated with reduced cytotoxicity and decreased progression-free survival, highlighting the imCAF–CXCL9–CXCR3 + T reg axis as a promising therapeutic target.
papers.abstractKo: 초록 여러 고형 종양 유형에서 암연관 섬유아세포(cancer-associated fibroblasts, CAFs)는 풍부하고 이질적이며, 서로 구별되는 하위 집단이 면역조절 기능을 발휘한다. 본 연구에서는 원발성 폐선암과 폐 전이에서 면역조절성 CAF(immunomodulatory CAFs, imCAFs)의 새로운 집단을 규명하였으며, 이들은 cell adhesion molecule L1-like(CHL1) 발현을 특징으로 하고 면역 조절 및 chemokine signaling 프로그램이 풍부하였다. 단일세포 및 공간 전사체학(single-cell and spatial transcriptomics)을 통해, imCAF가 종양 경계에서 축적되는 과도 억제성(hyper-suppressive) 하위집단인 CXCR3 + regulatory T(T reg) 세포와 공간적으로 공위치(spatially colocalized)함을 입증하였다. imCAF는 CXCL9를 생성하여 CXCR3 + T reg 세포의 모집을 유도하고 면역억제성 미세환경을 촉진한다. CXCR3 + T reg 세포는 증식 및 억제 능력이 향상되어 있으며 CXCR3 − 대응 세포와 전사적으로 구별된다. T reg 세포에서 Cxcr3의 유전적 제거 또는 기질 세포(stromal cells)에서 Cxcl9의 유전적 제거는 T reg 세포 축적을 감소시키고, CD8 + T 세포 활성화를 강화하며, 종양 부담을 감소시킨다. 인간 비소세포폐암(non-small cell lung cancer)에서 유사한 CHL1 + imCAF 유사 섬유아세포는 T reg 세포와 공위치하며, CHL1 발현 증가가 세포독성 감소 및 무진행 생존(progression-free survival) 감소와 연관되어, imCAF–CXCL9–CXCR3 + T reg 축을 유망한 치료 표적으로 부각시킨다.

papers.title: Ultra-sensitive profiling of CRISPR-Cas off-target effects with Tracking-seq2
papers.abstract: Abstract Accurate detection of off-target activity in primary human cells is crucial for ensuring the safety of gene therapies, yet existing methods often lack sufficient sensitivity. To address this limitation, we develop Tracking-seq2, an advanced technology that integrates exogenous 5′ → 3′ exonuclease treatment and non-homologous end joining (NHEJ) pathway inhibitors with the original Tracking-seq. Tracking-seq2 exhibits enhanced sensitivity in profiling off-target sites of diverse genome editors—including Cas9, Cas12a, cytosine base editors (CBEs), adenine base editors (ABEs), and prime editors (PEs). Critically, Tracking-seq2 is directly applicable to clinically relevant primary human cell types, such as T cells and CD34 + hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs). Furthermore, our findings reveal that genomic variations drive distinct off-target heterogeneity across different individuals, highlighting the necessity for personalized safety assessment in clinical genome editing applications. Tracking-seq2 provides a robust platform for sensitive off-target detection in primary cells, with sensitivity comparable to or exceeding current state-of-the-art methods.
papers.abstractKo: 초록 정확한 off-target activity의 검출은 유전자 치료의 안전성을 보장하는 데 있어 원발 인간 세포(primary human cells)에서 매우 중요하지만, 기존 방법들은 종종 충분한 민감도가 부족하다. 이러한 한계를 해결하기 위해, 우리는 기존 Tracking-seq에 외인성 5′ → 3′ exonuclease 처리와 non-homologous end joining (NHEJ) 경로 억제제를 통합한 고급 기술인 Tracking-seq2를 개발하였다. Tracking-seq2는 Cas9, Cas12a, cytosine base editors (CBEs), adenine base editors (ABEs), prime editors (PEs)를 포함한 다양한 genome editor의 off-target sites를 프로파일링하는 데서 향상된 민감도를 보였다. 특히 Tracking-seq2는 T cells 및 CD34 + hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs)와 같이 임상적으로 관련 있는 원발 인간 세포 유형에 직접 적용 가능하다. 더 나아가, 우리의 결과는 genomic variation이 서로 다른 개인들 사이에서 서로 구별되는 off-target heterogeneity를 유도함을 보여주며, 임상 genome editing 응용에서 개인맞춤형 안전성 평가의 필요성을 강조한다. Tracking-seq2는 원발 세포에서 민감한 off-target 검출을 위한 견고한 플랫폼을 제공하며, 그 민감도는 현재의 최첨단 방법과 동등하거나 이를 능가한다.

papers.title: Inhibiting menin attenuates high-fat diet-induced weight gain by limiting intestinal lipid absorption in mice
papers.abstract: Intestinal lipid metabolism is essential for systemic energy homeostasis, and its modulation is emerging as a therapeutic strategy for obesity. Menin, a scaffold protein that regulates chromatin remodeling and gene expression, is abundantly expressed in intestinal epithelial cells (IECs), but its metabolic role remains underexplored. Here, we generated IEC-specific Men1 knockout mouse and found that Men1 deficiency protected against high-fat diet-induced obesity, accompanied by elevated carboxylesterase 1 (CES1) expression in IECs. Increased CES1 promoted triglyceride (TG) hydrolysis and reduced intracellular TG storage, thereby limiting the lipid substrate pool required for ApoB48-dependent chylomicron assembly. Although lipid hydrolysis was enhanced, steady-state free fatty acid levels were not increased; instead, Men1 deficiency activated fatty acid β-oxidation programs and increased etomoxir-sensitive fatty acid–dependent mitochondrial respiration, supporting enhanced fatty acid catabolism. Mechanistically, menin recruited histone deacetylase 1 and interacted with the nuclear receptor LXRβ to suppress Ces1g transcription, thereby sustaining efficient intestinal lipid absorption. Pharmacological inhibition of menin with MI-463 recapitulated the metabolic effects of inducible Men1 deletion. In a human gut organoid-on-chip system, MI-463 dose-dependently increased CES1 expression and markedly reduced lipid accumulation. Collectively, our findings identify menin as a regulator of intestinal lipid metabolism and suggest menin inhibition as a potential therapeutic strategy for obesity-related metabolic disorders.

papers.title: Targeting KIT prevents brain arteriovenous malformations driven by ALK1-deficient angiogenic endothelial cells
papers.abstract: Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia type 2 (HHT2), caused by mutations in ACVRL1 ( also known as ALK1 ), is characterized by brain arteriovenous malformations (bAVMs), abnormal artery–vein connections for which treatment options remain limited. Despite evidence of endothelial cell (EC) heterogeneity, its role in bAVM pathogenesis remains poorly defined. Using endothelial-specific inducible Alk1 knockout mice ( Alk1iECKO ) and regionally resolved single-cell RNA sequencing, we show that loss of ALK1 signaling induces bAVMs predominantly in the perineural vascular plexus (PNVP). This process is driven by the emergence of a KIT + angiogenic EC population with human AVM-like transcriptional features, including tip-cell markers and activation of PI3K and KRAS signaling pathways. Cross-species analyses and validation in human samples demonstrate that KIT expression is conserved in endothelial cells from both sporadic and HHT2 brain AVMs. Drug repurposing analysis identified KIT as a top actionable target, and we show that Kit is directly repressed by BMP9–ALK1–SMAD4 signaling. Pharmacological inhibition of KIT reduced angiogenic reprogramming and vascular malformations in vivo without affecting normal vasculature. These findings identify a pathogenic angiogenic EC state and position KIT signaling as a therapeutically actionable pathway in brain AVMs.

KIT의 약리학적 억제는 정상 혈관계에는 영향을 주지 않으면서 in vivo에서 angiogenic reprogramming과 혈관 기형을 감소시켰다. 이러한 결과는 병인성 angiogenic EC 상태를 규명하고, KIT signaling을 뇌 AVM에서 치료적으로 표적화 가능한 pathway로 제시한다.

papers.title: Hepatocyte hnRNPK preserves mitochondrial integrity to restrain liver injury and fibrosis
papers.abstract: Background & Aims: Liver fibrosis is a global health issue with unclear unified drivers. The RNA-binding protein hnRNPK is critical for hepatic homeostasis, but its role in chronic fibrosis remains undefined. This study investigated hnRNPK-mediated splicing dysregulation in liver fibrosis and its therapeutic potential. Approach & Results: We mapped hepatocellular hnRNPK expression across a broad spectrum of human and murine fibrotic etiologies. Mechanistic insights were obtained by integrating snRNA-seq, hepatocyte-specific alternative splicing profiling, untargeted and spatial metabolomics, and 3D mitochondrial reconstruction using AT-SEM. We identified reduced hepatocellular hnRNPK abundance as a conserved hallmark of liver fibrosis across distinct pathogenic insults, including MASH, ALD, HBV, and DILI. Hepatocyte-specific Hnrnpk ablation in mice induced aberrant Opa1 splicing, specifically promoting exon 4b inclusion. This disrupted the balance of OPA1 isoforms, depleting L-OPA1 and driving severe mitochondrial fragmentation characterized by distinct “spheroid” ultrastructures. This loss of mitochondrial integrity triggered HSC activation through the cytosolic mtDNA-cGAS-STING pro-inflammatory signaling cascade and the mitochondria-containing pellet. Notably, restoring the hnRNPK- Opa1 axis via AAV-mediated overexpression of Hnrnpk or the Opa1 -Δ4b isoform (lacking exon 4b), together with pharmacological promotion of mitochondrial fusion, effectively arrested and regressed established liver fibrosis in multiple murine models. Conclusions: Our findings establish the loss of hnRNPK as a central, unifying mechanism in liver fibrogenesis. By governing the Opa1 splicing axis, hnRNPK maintains mitochondrial integrity and prevents the pro-inflammatory signaling and secretome that fuel HSC activation. Targeting this RNA-mitochondria axis represents a potent, etiology-independent therapeutic strategy for chronic liver disease.
papers.abstractKo: 배경 및 목적: 간 섬유화는 전 지구적 건강 문제이지만, 이를 유발하는 공통된 통합 인자는 명확하지 않다. RNA 결합 단백질 hnRNPK는 간 항상성에 중요하지만, 만성 섬유화에서의 역할은 규명되지 않았다. 본 연구는 간 섬유화에서 hnRNPK 매개 스플라이싱 이상(splicing dysregulation)과 그 치료적 가능성을 조사하였다. 접근법 및 결과: 우리는 광범위한 인간 및 마우스 섬유화 원인에 걸쳐 간세포성 hnRNPK 발현을 지도화하였다. 기전적 통찰은 snRNA-seq, 간세포 특이적 alternative splicing 분석, 비표적 및 공간 대사체학(spatial metabolomics), 그리고 AT-SEM을 이용한 3D 미토콘드리아 재구성을 통합하여 얻었다. 우리는 MASH, ALD, HBV 및 DILI를 포함한 서로 다른 병인성 자극 전반에서 간세포 hnRNPK 감소가 간 섬유화의 보존된 특징임을 확인하였다. 마우스에서 간세포 특이적 Hnrnpk 제거는 비정상적인 Opa1 스플라이싱을 유도하였고, 특히 exon 4b 포함을 촉진하였다. 이로 인해 OPA1 isoform의 균형이 붕괴되어 L-OPA1가 고갈되었고, 뚜렷한 “spheroid” 초미세구조로 특징지어지는 심한 미토콘드리아 fragmentation이 유발되었다. 이러한 미토콘드리아 무결성 상실은 세포질 mtDNA-cGAS-STING 전염증성 신호 전달 연쇄와 mitochondria-containing pellet을 통해 HSC 활성화를 촉발하였다. 주목할 점은, AAV 매개 Hnrnpk 과발현 또는 Opa1 -Δ4b isoform(exon 4b 결손)과 약리학적 미토콘드리아 fusion 촉진을 통해 hnRNPK- Opa1 축을 복원하면, 여러 마우스 모델에서 확립된 간 섬유화를 효과적으로 중단시키고 퇴행시켰다는 것이다. 결론: 우리의 결과는 hnRNPK 소실이 간 섬유화 형성의 중심적이고 통합적인 기전임을 확립한다. hnRNPK는 Opa1 splicing 축을 조절함으로써 미토콘드리아 무결성을 유지하고, HSC 활성화를 촉진하는 전염증성 신호 및 secretome을 방지한다. 이 RNA-미토콘드리아 축을 표적으로 하는 것은 만성 간질환에 대한 강력한, 병인 비의존적 치료 전략을 대표한다.

papers.title: Liver-on-a-Chip: Applications for clinical modeling of liver disease using microscale systems
papers.abstract: Liver-on-a-chip (LOC) systems are tunable, microscale environments that can incorporate additional layers of physiologic complexity in comparison to 2D cell culture. LOCs are an in vitro adjunct and potential alternative to in vivo animal models that utilize human-derived cells, typically embedded in a synthetic device containing natural or engineered materials. This enables LOC models to exhibit a high level of customization per organ, disease, or condition. LOCs typically contain dynamic flow to cells embedded in a series of microchannels within the device. This perturbation aims to recreate mechanobiological forces seen in vivo and encourage cell-to-cell interactions in a 3D environment. These models have proven to be particularly advantageous in modeling organs with complex spatial zonation, such as the liver, as oxygen and nutrient gradients can more accurately be represented under these dynamic conditions. LOC systems have also been proposed to improve the accuracy of drug toxicity screening for clinical applications because they employ human-derived cells in more physiologically relevant conditions. This review will first discuss fabrication techniques and considerations when recreating biological microenvironments. Next, the advances of LOC systems and applications for modeling liver disease and infection will be explored. Finally, current limitations and advances for implementing LOC devices into clinical and commercial settings will be examined.
papers.abstractKo: Liver-on-a-chip(LOC) 시스템은 2D cell culture에 비해 생리학적 복잡성의 추가 층을 통합할 수 있는 조절 가능한(microscale) 미세 환경이다. LOC는 자연 유래 또는 공학적으로 제작된 재료를 포함하는 합성 장치에 일반적으로 내장된 human-derived cells를 활용하는 in vitro 보조 수단이자 in vivo 동물 모델의 잠재적 대안이다. 이를 통해 LOC 모델은 각 장기, 질환 또는 조건에 대해 높은 수준의 맞춤화를 구현할 수 있다. LOC에는 일반적으로 장치 내 일련의 microchannels에 내장된 세포에 대한 동적 flow가 포함된다. 이러한 perturbation은 in vivo에서 관찰되는 mechanobiological forces를 재현하고 3D 환경에서 cell-to-cell interactions를 촉진하는 것을 목표로 한다. 이러한 모델은 산소 및 영양소 기울기(gradient)가 이러한 동적 조건에서 보다 정확하게 표현될 수 있으므로, 간과 같이 복잡한 공간 zonation을 가진 장기를 모델링하는 데 특히 유리한 것으로 입증되었다. LOC 시스템은 또한 human-derived cells를 보다 생리적으로 관련성 있는 조건에서 사용하기 때문에 임상 적용을 위한 약물 독성 선별(drug toxicity screening)의 정확도를 향상시킬 수 있는 것으로 제안되어 왔다. 본 종설(review)에서는 먼저 생물학적 microenvironments를 재현할 때의 제작 기법과 고려사항을 논의할 것이다. 다음으로, 간 질환 및 감염을 모델링하기 위한 LOC 시스템의 발전과 적용을 탐구할 것이다. 마지막으로, LOC 장치를 임상 및 상업적 환경에 구현하기 위한 현재의 한계와 발전을 검토할 것이다.
