papers.title: Glycosylated extracellular matrix drives immune suppression by modulating macrophage-T cell crosstalk in triple-negative breast cancer
papers.abstract: The tumor extracellular matrix (ECM) is increasingly recognized as a key driver of immune suppression and therapy resistance in cancer. However, the specific ECM components and mechanisms that create this immunosuppressive environment remain poorly understood, hindering the development of new therapies. Here, we use comprehensive multi omics profiling of triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), an aggressive and treatment-resistant subtype, to investigate this issue. We report that ECM immunomodulation in TNBC is mediated by post-translational glycan modifications on ECM proteins. Using decellularized human TNBC samples, we show that targeted enzymatic removal of these ECM glycans modifies the tumor immune microenvironment. This modification reprograms tumor-associated myeloid cells toward an immunomodulatory phenotype and improves infiltration of T cells. Notably, ECM desialylation alters selectin and selectin-ligand programs on T cells, consistent with improved trafficking and intratumoral access. In parallel, macrophage-T cell interactions are reshaped, leading to reduced T cell exhaustion. Our findings identify ECM glycan modifications as critical regulators of the innate and adaptive TNBC immune microenvironment. They suggest that targeting ECM glycosylation could offer potential strategies to boost anti-tumor immunity in this aggressive breast cancer subtype.
papers.abstractKo: 종양 세포외기질(extracellular matrix, ECM)은 암에서 면역 억제와 치료 저항성의 핵심 동인으로 점차 인식되고 있다. 그러나 이러한 면역억제성 환경을 형성하는 구체적인 ECM 구성 요소와 기전은 여전히 충분히 밝혀지지 않아 새로운 치료법 개발을 저해하고 있다. 여기서는 공격적이며 치료 저항성을 보이는 아형인 삼중음성 유방암(triple-negative breast cancer, TNBC)에 대한 포괄적인 multi omics profiling을 사용하여 이 문제를 조사하였다. 우리는 TNBC에서의 ECM 면역조절(immunomodulation)이 ECM 단백질의 번역후 당(glycan) 변형에 의해 매개됨을 보고한다. 탈세포화된 인간 TNBC 시료를 이용하여, 표적화된 효소적 ECM 당 제거가 종양 면역 미세환경(tumor immune microenvironment)을 변화시킴을 보여주었다. 이 변형은 종양 관련 골수계 세포(tumor-associated myeloid cells)를 면역조절성 표현형으로 재프로그래밍하고 T 세포의 침윤을 향상시켰다. 특히, ECM 탈시알화(desialylation)는 T 세포에서 selectin 및 selectin-ligand 프로그램을 변화시켰으며, 이는 개선된 이동성(trafficking) 및 종양내 접근(intratumoral access)과 일치하였다. 동시에, 대식세포-T 세포 상호작용이 재구성되어 T 세포 탈진(T cell exhaustion)이 감소하였다. 우리의 발견은 ECM 당 변형이 선천성 및 적응성 TNBC 면역 미세환경의 핵심 조절자임을 규명한다. 또한 ECM 당화(glycosylation)를 표적화하는 것이 이러한 공격적인 유방암 아형에서 항종양 면역을 증강시키기 위한 잠재적 전략이 될 수 있음을 시사한다.

papers.title: Nuclear export of R-loop by the DDX1 and XPO1 complex promotes senescence-associated secretory phenotype and inflammaging
papers.abstract: Cellular senescence contributes to inflammaging in part through the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP). R-loops, three-stranded nucleic acid structures, contribute to innate immune response in cancers; however, the role of R-loops in senescence and inflammaging remains largely unknown. Here we show that nuclear-derived cytoplasmic R-loops promote the SASP and inflammaging. We detect an accumulation of nuclear-derived R-loops in the cytoplasm of senescent cells with an enrichment in alpha-satellite repeats. These cytoplasmic R-loops localize into cytoplasmic chromatin fragments (CCFs) and activate the cGAS-STING innate immune pathway to drive the SASP. We identify the exportin-1 (XPO1)-DEAD-Box helicase 1 (DDX1) complex as essential for the nuclear export of R-loops and their subsequent localization into CCFs. Inhibition of XPO1 with KPT-330 suppresses nuclear R-loop export and its localization into CCFs, attenuates the SASP, mitigates age-associated inflammation and extends healthspan. These findings reveal nuclear export of R-loops as a potential target for suppressing age-associated inflammation.

KPT-330에 의한 XPO1 억제는 핵 R-loop 수출과 CCFs로의 위치화를 억제하고, SASP를 완화하며, 연령 관련 염증을 경감시키고, 건강수명(healthspan)을 연장한다. 이러한 발견은 노화 연관 염증을 억제하기 위한 잠재적 표적으로서 R-loop의 핵외 수출을 제시한다.

papers.title: The bacteroidal metabolite O-LysoPE facilitates hepatocyte-mediated immunosuppression in autoimmune hepatitis
papers.abstract: Autoimmune hepatitis (AIH) is a chronic inflammatory liver disease typically managed with broad-spectrum immunosuppressants that carry significant systemic side effects and often provide incomplete efficacy. While gut-microbiota-derived metabolites are known to influence AIH progression, the specific microbial drivers that maintain hepatic immune homeostasis remain poorly defined. Here, we show that Bacteroides acidifaciens (BA) and its metabolite 1-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine (O-LysoPE) are enriched in self-healing mouse models of hepatitis but markedly depleted in AIH patients. We demonstrate that O-LysoPE induces a 'hepatocyte-driven active immunosuppression' by targeting the Qa-1b (HLA-E): NKG2A immune checkpoint. Mechanistically, O-LysoPE selectively redirects the transcription factor Creb1 to the H2T23 promoter under inflammatory conditions, thereby upregulating hepatocytic Qa-1b expression. This elevation of Qa-1b engages the inhibitory receptor NKG2A on T cells, suppressing their overactivation and restoring a quiescent phenotype. Genetic disruption of H2T23 abrogates the hepatoprotective effects of O-LysoPE, confirming the central role of this metabolic-immune axis. Our findings reveal that the BA-O-LysoPE axis mobilizes the liver's intrinsic self-rescue mechanisms to restore immune quiescence. This study establishes a robust biological framework for liver-specific, targeted immunotherapy in AIH, offering a precision alternative to current systemic immunosuppression.
papers.abstractKo: 자가면역성 간염(autoimmune hepatitis, AIH)은 흔히 광범위한 면역억제제(broad-spectrum immunosuppressants)로 관리되는 만성 염증성 간질환으로, 이러한 약제는 상당한 전신 부작용을 동반하며 흔히 불완전한 효능만을 보인다. 장-미생물군유래 대사산물(gut-microbiota-derived metabolites)이 AIH의 진행에 영향을 미하는 것으로 알려져 있지만, 간 면역 항상성을 유지하는 특정 미생물 유발 요인은 아직 명확히 규명되지 않았다. 본 연구에서는 Bacteroides acidifaciens(BA)와 그 대사산물 1-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine(O-LysoPE)이 간염의 자가치유(self-healing) 마우스 모델에서 풍부하게 존재하는 반면 AIH 환자에서는 현저히 감소되어 있음을 보여준다. 우리는 O-LysoPE가 Qa-1b(HLA-E): NKG2A immune checkpoint를 표적하여 'hepatocyte-driven active immunosuppression'을 유도함을 입증한다. 기전적으로, O-LysoPE는 염증성 조건에서 전사인자 Creb1을 H2T23 프로모터로 선택적으로 재분배함으로써 간세포성(hepatocytic) Qa-1b 발현을 상향조절한다. 이러한 Qa-1b의 증가는 T 세포의 억제성 수용체 NKG2A를 활성화하여 그 과활성화를 억제하고 휴지(quiescent) 표현형을 회복시킨다. H2T23의 유전적 파괴는 O-LysoPE의 간보호 효과를 소실시켜, 이 대사-면역 축의 중심적 역할을 확인한다. 우리의 연구 결과는 BA-O-LysoPE 축이 간 고유의 자가구제(self-rescue) 기전을 동원하여 면역 휴지 상태를 회복함을 밝힌다. 본 연구는 AIH에서 간 특이적이고 표적화된 면역치료를 위한 견고한 생물학적 틀을 확립하며, 현재의 전신 면역억제에 대한 정밀 대안(precision alternative)을 제공한다.

papers.title: EasySCP unveils extensive liver zonation at single-cell proteomics resolution
papers.abstract: The broader application of single-cell proteomics (SCP) in biology has been limited by complex workflows and reliance on specialized instrumentation. Here we present EasySCP, a high-throughput method that integrates FACS-based single-cell sorting, an all-in-one, single-step digestion process in 384-well plates, and sensitive mass spectrometry. EasySCP identifies nearly 5000 proteins from individual HEK293 cell. Applied to female murine liver, EasySCP achieves spatially informed proteomics profiling of hepatocytes zonation, detecting an average of 3500 proteins per hepatocyte and uncovering zonation patterns for 3277 out of 5267 proteins. Building on 215 conserved zonation markers, we further develop hepatocyte spatial status score (HSS) that enables reconstruct liver zonation across single-cell and multi-omics datasets. Together, our study introduces EasySCP, a broadly accessible tool for dissecting cellular heterogeneity at single-cell proteomics resolution in both healthy and disease states, effectively bridging the gap between transcriptomics and functional proteomics.

EasySCP는 개별 HEK293 세포로부터 거의 5000개의 단백질을 동정한다. 암컷 마우스 간에 적용했을 때, EasySCP는 hepatocyte zonation의 공간 정보를 반영한 proteomics profiling을 달성하여 hepatocyte당 평균 3500개의 단백질을 검출하고 5267개 단백질 중 3277개에서 zonation 패턴을 밝혀낸다. 215개의 보존된 zonation marker를 바탕으로, 우리는 hepatocyte spatial status score(HSS)를 추가로 개발하여 단일세포 및 multi-omics 데이터셋 전반에서 간 zonation을 재구성할 수 있게 한다. 종합하면, 본 연구는 건강 상태와 질환 상태 모두에서 단일세포 proteomics 해상도로 세포 이질성을 분석할 수 있는 폭넓게 접근 가능한 도구인 EasySCP를 소개하며, transcriptomics와 기능적 proteomics 사이의 간극을 효과적으로 메운다.

papers.title: Disease-associated genetic variants can cause missense effects in tissue-specific protein isoforms
papers.abstract: Genetic variants can cause protein-coding mutations that result in disease. Variants are typically interpreted using the reference transcript for a gene. However, most human multi-exon genes have alternative isoforms. We show that, consistent with their reduced evolutionary constraint, coding exons in alternative isoforms harbour more population variants than exons of reference isoforms, and that these variants are more likely to cause nonsynonymous mutations. Common and rare disease-associated variants mapping to alternative transcripts can lead to amino acid substitutions predicted to be structurally damaging in the corresponding protein isoform. The alternative transcripts to which disease-associated variants map demonstrate high tissue-specificity, with many unannotated in reference human genomes, and only revealed by long-read RNA-sequencing. As an example, we report an unannotated, alternative transcript of the inflammasome regulator DPP9 that is lung epithelium-specific, that harbours a common genetic variant associated with severe COVID-19 and lung fibrosis. Using deep RNA sequencing of full-length transcript isoforms by targeted capture, we confirm the expression of the unannotated DPP9 isoform. The DPP9 isoform variant causes a p.Leu8Pro missense mutation in an alternative first exon, predicted to disrupt the encoded alpha helix, and we show that the variant alters DPP9 enzymatic activity. Our findings highlight the importance of considering alternative isoforms, their tissue-specific expression, and full-length transcripts in variant interpretation, with implications for uncovering underappreciated mechanisms of both common and rare disease.
papers.abstractKo: 유전적 변이(genetic variants)는 단백질 암호화 변이(protein-coding mutations)를 유발하여 질환을 초래할 수 있다. 변이는 일반적으로 유전자의 reference transcript를 사용하여 해석된다. 그러나 대부분의 인간 multi-exon 유전자는 alternative isoforms를 가진다. 우리는 대체 isoform의 coding exon이 reference isoform의 exon보다 집단 변이(population variants)를 더 많이 보유하며, 이는 이들의 감소된 evolutionary constraint와 일치하고, 이러한 변이가 nonsynonymous mutation을 유발할 가능성이 더 높음을 보인다. alternative transcript에 매핑되는 common 및 rare disease-associated variants는 해당 protein isoform에서 구조적으로 손상될 것으로 예측되는 amino acid substitution을 초래할 수 있다. disease-associated variants가 매핑되는 alternative transcript는 높은 tissue-specificity를 보이며, 그중 다수는 reference human genome에서 주석화되지 않았고(long-read RNA-sequencing)에 의해 비로소 밝혀진다. 예로서, 우리는 inflammasome regulator DPP9의 주석화되지 않은 alternative transcript가 lung epithelium-specific이며, severe COVID-19 및 lung fibrosis와 연관된 common genetic variant를 보유하고 있음을 보고한다. targeted capture를 이용한 full-length transcript isoform의 deep RNA sequencing을 사용하여, 우리는 주석화되지 않은 DPP9 isoform의 발현을 확인하였다. papers.title: Adiposity and cancer: systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract: Obesity is a major health challenge. Here we show that body mass index is positively associated with risk of 19 cancers and inversely associated with 3, based on a systematic review and meta-analysis of prospective studies of 25 cancer types. We searched PubMed, EMBASE and Scopus through to 23 April 2025, identifying 226 articles comprising 1.5 million incident cancers. We identified positive associations for leukaemia, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, bladder cancer and glioma, not previously identified by major consensus reports. Associations differed according to region and sex, with stronger associations for postmenopausal breast and ovarian cancers in East Asia, weaker associations for gallbladder cancer in East Asia and in men, and stronger associations for colorectal cancer in men. Body mass index and waist circumference showed similar associations with cancer. We reviewed Mendelian randomization and imaging-based studies; genetic findings were generally consistent with observational associations, while imaging data were limited. Our findings underscore the impact of obesity on cancer risk.

papers.title: Efferocytosis of apoptotic bodies drives SARS-CoV-2 infection and macrophage inflammation
papers.abstract: SARS-CoV-2 typically utilises host receptor angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) for viral entry. Despite low ACE2 expression, monocyte-derived macrophages, the predominant lung macrophage during severe COVID-19, are often found with SARS-CoV-2 in infected lungs. As macrophage inflammation and cytokine storm are key immunopathological events that drive severe COVID-19, insights into mechanisms underlying viral entry into macrophages are critical to devise novel COVID-19 therapies. Mounting evidence supports that COVID-19 pathogenesis is associated with apoptosis, a type of programmed cell death which releases large extracellular vesicles called apoptotic bodies (ApoBDs). Here, we show that ApoBDs from SARS-CoV-2-infected cells carried infectious virions. Macrophages efferocytose these ApoBDs, enabling SARS-CoV-2 entry and pro-inflammatory responses including inflammasome and NF-κB signalling. To demonstrate targetability of this ApoBD efferocytosis-mediated viral entry, we screen for inhibitors of SARS-CoV-2-induced ApoBD formation and identified T-type voltage-gated calcium channel (T-channel) blockers. Mechanistically, T-channel blockers impair the extracellular calcium influxes required for ApoBD biogenesis. Importantly, blockade of ApoBD formation by T-channel blockers is able to limit cell-to-cell viral transmission, macrophage inflammation and lung immunopathology. Our discovery reveals a novel route for SARS-CoV-2 infection and cytokine storm induction, expanding our understanding of COVID-19 pathogenesis and demonstrating a therapeutic target for infectious diseases.
papers.abstractKo: SARS-CoV-2는 일반적으로 바이러스 진입을 위해 숙주 수용체인 angiotensin-converting enzyme 2(ACE2)를 이용한다. ACE2 발현이 낮음에도 불구하고, 중증 COVID-19에서 우세한 폐 대식세포인 단핵구 유래 대식세포(monocyte-derived macrophages)에서는 감염된 폐에서 SARS-CoV-2가 종종 검출된다. 대식세포 염증과 cytokine storm은 중증 COVID-19를 유발하는 핵심 면역병리학적 사건이므로, 대식세포로의 바이러스 진입 기전을 이해하는 것은 새로운 COVID-19 치료법을 고안하는 데 중요하다. 축적되는 증거는 COVID-19 병인이 apoptosis와 연관되어 있음을 지지하는데, apoptosis는 apoptotic bodies(ApoBDs)라 불리는 큰 extracellular vesicles를 방출하는 programmed cell death의 한 형태이다. 본 연구에서 우리는 SARS-CoV-2 감염 세포에서 유래한 ApoBDs가 감염성 virions를 운반함을 보여준다. 대식세포는 이러한 ApoBDs를 efferocytose하며, 이를 통해 SARS-CoV-2의 진입과 inflammasome 및 NF-κB signalling을 포함한 pro-inflammatory responses가 가능해진다. ApoBD efferocytosis 매개 바이러스 진입의 표적 가능성을 입증하기 위해, 우리는 SARS-CoV-2 유도 ApoBD 형성의 억제제를 스크리닝하였고 T-type voltage-gated calcium channel(T-channel) blockers를 확인하였다. 기전적으로, T-channel blockers는 ApoBD biogenesis에 필요한 extracellular calcium influxes를 저해한다. 중요하게도, T-channel blockers에 의한 ApoBD 형성 차단은 cell-to-cell viral transmission, 대식세포 염증 및 폐 면역병리(lung immunopathology)를 제한할 수 있다. 우리의 발견은 SARS-CoV-2 감염과 cytokine storm 유도의 새로운 경로를 밝혀 COVID-19 병인에 대한 이해를 확장하고, 감염성 질환을 위한 치료 표적을 제시한다.

papers.title: Adiposity and cancer: epidemiology, mechanisms and future perspectives
papers.abstract: Excess adiposity is a major modifiable risk factor for at least 19 cancer types, and the burden of obesity-related cancer is expected to rise substantially in the coming decades. A comprehensive understanding of underlying mechanisms and precise risk associations will be critical to inform targeted prevention strategies and reduce this burden. In this Review, we examine key biological mechanisms linking adiposity and cancer, including sex hormones, hyperinsulinaemia and chronic inflammation, alongside emerging insights from omics technologies, and tumour subtype-specific associations. We also highlight priorities for future research, including imaging-based adiposity measures, integration of multi-omics approaches and expanded data collection in lower-income settings and understudied populations. Finally, we consider the potential implications of emerging obesity pharmacotherapies, which may facilitate substantial weight loss at scale.

papers.title: Liposomal mitoxantrone plus tislelizumab in patients with relapsed or refractory extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma: a phase 1b/2 trial
papers.abstract: Treatment options for relapsed or refractory extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma (R/R ENKTL) remain limited. In this phase 1b/2 trial (NCT05464433), we evaluated the safety and efficacy of liposomal mitoxantrone (Lipo-MIT) plus anti-PD-1 tislelizumab in this setting. During dose escalation, patients received Lipo-MIT (16 or 20 mg/m 2 ) plus tislelizumab using a 3 + 3 design, followed by dose expansion at the recommended phase 2 dose (RP2D). The primary endpoint of the dose-escalation phase was dose-limiting toxicities (DLTs), which were assessed to determine the RP2D. The primary efficacy endpoint of the dose-expansion phase was the best complete response (CR) rate. Between July 23 2022 and November 28 2024, 40 patients received study treatment (dose-escalation, n = 6; dose-expansion, n = 34). No DLTs were observed and the RP2D of Lipo-MIT was 20 mg/m 2 . The prespecified primary efficacy endpoint was met, with a CR rate of 53% (21/40; one-sided 95% lower confidence bound, 38%). The median progression-free survival (secondary endpoint) was 8.2 months (95% confidence interval, 6.1-not estimable) after a median follow-up of 15.3 months. The most common grade ≥ 3 adverse events were leukopenia (53%), neutropenia (40%), and febrile neutropenia (18%). In conclusion, Lipo-MIT plus tislelizumab showed promising anti-tumor activity with an acceptable safety profile in R/R ENKTL.

DLT는 관찰되지 않았고, Lipo-MIT의 RP2D는 20 mg/m 2였다. 사전에 지정된 1차 유효성 종료점이 충족되었으며, CR 비율은 53%(21/40; 단측 95% 하한 신뢰경계, 38%)였다. 중앙 무진행 생존기간(progression-free survival, PFS)(2차 종료점)은 중앙 추적 관찰 기간 15.3개월 후 8.2개월(95% 신뢰구간, 6.1-추정 불가)이었다. 가장 흔한 grade ≥ 3 이상반응은 백혈구감소증(leukopenia)(53%), 호중구감소증(neutropenia)(40%), 발열성 호중구감소증(febrile neutropenia)(18%)이었다. 결론적으로, Lipo-MIT와 tislelizumab 병용은 R/R ENKTL에서 허용 가능한 안전성 프로파일과 유망한 항종양 활성을 보였다.

papers.title: Hyperglycemia aggravates vitiligo through succinate/SUCNR1-mediated T cell activation
papers.abstract: Vitiligo is an autoimmune skin disease characterized by depigmentation, mainly due to CD8+ T cell-mediated destruction of melanocytes. Hyperglycemia exacerbates autoimmune responses and is associated with vitiligo; however, the underlying immunometabolic mechanisms are poorly understood. Here, we demonstrated the correlation between hyperglycemia and vitiligo in a case-control study and demonstrated that hyperglycemia aggravated vitiligo based on a mouse model. Targeted metabolomics identified succinate as the potential metabolite mediating hyperglycemia-aggravated vitiligo. Mechanistically, succinate promotes the activation of CD8+ T cells through succinate receptor 1 (SUCNR1) and promotes keratinocytes to secrete CXCL9 and CXCL10 by enhancing the stability and nuclear translocation of hypoxia-inducible factor-1α, facilitating the skin-homing of CD8+ T cells. Thus, hyperglycemia aggravates vitiligo through succinate/SUCNR1 axis-regulated CD8+ T cell hyperactivation. Our study provides insights into the long-observed yet previously unclear mechanism by which hyperglycemia accelerates vitiligo progression and highlights SUCNR1 as a potential therapeutic target.
papers.abstractKo: 제1형 백반증(vitiligo)은 탈색소를 특징으로 하는 자가면역 피부질환으로, 주로 CD8+ T 세포 매개 멜라노사이트 파괴에 기인한다. 고혈당은 자가면역 반응을 악화시키고 백반증과 연관되어 있으나, 그 기저 면역대사 기전은 충분히 밝혀지지 않았다. 본 연구에서는 증례-대조 연구(case-control study)에서 고혈당과 백반증 간의 상관관계를 입증하였고, 마우스 모델에 근거하여 고혈당이 백반증을 악화시킴을 보여주었다. 표적 대사체학(targeted metabolomics)은 고혈당에 의해 악화되는 백반증을 매개하는 잠재적 대사산물로서 succinate를 확인하였다. 기전적으로, succinate는 succinate receptor 1(SUCNR1)을 통해 CD8+ T 세포의 활성화를 촉진하고, 저산소 유도 인자-1α(hypoxia-inducible factor-1α)의 안정성과 핵 이동을 증가시켜 케라티노사이트가 CXCL9와 CXCL10을 분비하도록 촉진함으로써 CD8+ T 세포의 피부 호밍(skin-homing)을 용이하게 한다. 따라서 고혈당은 succinate/SUCNR1 축이 조절하는 CD8+ T 세포 과활성화를 통해 백반증을 악화시킨다. 본 연구는 오랫동안 관찰되었으나 그 기전이 명확하지 않았던 고혈당이 백반증 진행을 가속화하는 현상에 대한 통찰을 제공하며, SUCNR1을 잠재적 치료 표적으로 제시한다.

papers.title: Immune responses in aging adults
papers.abstract: As a widely distributed network of cells, tissues, and organs, the human immune system is profoundly vulnerable to the effects of aging. Intrinsic and extrinsic stressors progressively erode its structural integrity and functional resilience, weakening core protective responses and increasing susceptibility to infection, malignancy, and tissue degeneration. At the same time, aging heightens the risk of chronic inflammation and autoimmune disease. Hematopoietic stem cells become uniquely compromised as aging intensifies metabolic and replicative stress. Their continuous high-volume turnover results in diminished self-renewal capacity, skewed lineage output, and dominance of expanded clones. These changes undermine innate immune competence and amplify inflammatory activity. Adaptive immune function declines with age through coordinated cellular and molecular programs. T and B lymphocytes exhibit a decline in naive cells, progressive loss of stemness, shortened lifespan, and constrained clonal diversity. Aging lymphocytes reconfigure transcriptional networks, undergo widespread organelle dysfunction, develop maladaptive stress responses, and redistribute into noncanonical tissue niches. Collectively, these alterations reduce antigen specificity and precision, promote innate-like immune behavior, and confer resistance to tolerance. These mechanisms result in concurrent immunodeficiency and autoimmunity, exemplified by two autoimmune diseases disproportionately affecting older adults: rheumatoid arthritis and giant cell arteritis.
papers.abstractKo: 인체 면역계는 세포, 조직, 기관으로 이루어진 광범위한 네트워크로서, 노화의 영향에 매우 취약하다. 내재적 및 외재적 스트레스 요인은 그 구조적 완전성과 기능적 회복탄력성을 점진적으로 침식하여 핵심 방어 반응을 약화시키고, 감염, 악성종양, 조직 퇴행에 대한 감수성을 증가시킨다. 동시에 노화는 만성 염증과 자가면역질환의 위험을 높인다. 조혈모세포(hematopoietic stem cells)는 노화가 대사적 및 복제적 스트레스를 강화함에 따라 특히 심하게 손상된다. 이들 세포의 지속적인 대량 turnover는 자가재생 능력의 저하, 계통(lineage) 산출의 편향, 그리고 확장된 클론의 우세를 초래한다. 이러한 변화는 선천면역 능력을 약화시키고 염증 활성을 증폭시킨다. 적응면역 기능은 세포 및 분자 프로그램의 조정된 변화를 통해 연령과 함께 저하된다. T 및 B 림프구는 naive cell의 감소, stemness의 점진적 소실, 수명 단축, 그리고 제한된 clonal diversity를 보인다. 노화 림프구는 전사 조절 네트워크를 재구성하고, 광범위한 소기관 기능장애를 겪으며, 부적응적 스트레스 반응을 형성하고, 비정형(noncanonical) 조직 niche로 재분포한다. 총체적으로 이러한 변화는 항원 특이성과 정밀도를 저하시켜, 선천면역 유사(innate-like) 면역 행동을 촉진하고, 관용(tolerance)에 대한 저항성을 부여한다. 이러한 기전은 면역결핍과 자가면역을 동시에 초래하며, 고령층에서 과도하게 발생하는 두 가지 자가면역질환인 류마티스 관절염(rheumatoid arthritis)과 거대세포 동맥염(giant cell arteritis)으로 예시된다.

papers.title: Aging reprograms microglia toward an inflammasome-linked response to traumatic brain injury
papers.abstract: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) disproportionately kills and disables older adults, yet the biology driving this vulnerability remains unresolved. In this issue of the JCI, Lu et al. combined single-cell transcriptomics, metabolomics, and chromatin profiling in mice, validated in human TBI tissue, to define an age-dependent microglial dichotomy. They report that an NLRP3+/IL-1β-linked state dominates the aged brain, while a Lysozyme+/Lyz2+ state predominates in the young. Microglia-targeted perturbation of NLRP3 and ELF1 each shifted the balance and improved survival in mouse models of TBI, and the repurposed drug Imeglimin improved outcomes in these models, confirming that this pathway is druggable. By connecting NLRP3 inflammasome dominance, ELF1-driven transcription, and glycolytic reprogramming to the loss of a protective Lyz2+ response, this work converts age from a clinical risk factor to a set of druggable microglial targets.
papers.abstractKo: 외상성 뇌손상(traumatic brain injury, TBI)은 고령 성인에서 사망과 장애를 불균형적으로 초래하지만, 이러한 취약성을 유발하는 생물학적 기전은 아직 규명되지 않았다. 이번 JCI 호에서 Lu 등은 마우스에서 단일세포 전사체학(single-cell transcriptomics), 대사체학(metabolomics), 및 크로마틴 프로파일링(chromatin profiling)을 결합하고, 이를 인간 TBI 조직에서 검증하여 연령 의존적 microglial 이분성을 규명하였다. 이들은 NLRP3+/IL-1β-연관 상태가 노화된 뇌에서 우세한 반면, Lysozyme+/Lyz2+ 상태는 젊은 뇌에서 우세함을 보고하였다. NLRP3와 ELF1에 대한 microglia 표적 교란은 각각 균형을 이동시키고 TBI 마우스 모델에서 생존율을 향상시켰으며, 재창출 약물(repurposed drug) Imeglimin은 이러한 모델에서 결과를 개선하여 이 경로가 약물 표적화 가능함(druggable)을 확인하였다. NLRP3 inflammasome 우세, ELF1-유도 전사, 그리고 해당작용(glycolytic) 재프로그래밍을 보호적 Lyz2+ 반응의 소실과 연결함으로써, 본 연구는 노화를 임상적 위험 인자에서 약물 표적이 가능한 microglial 표적들의 집합으로 전환한다.

papers.title: GPR182 and the reframing of lacteal chylomicron uptake
papers.abstract: Historically, research on chylomicron entry into intestinal lymphatic vessels (lacteals) has been polarized between paracellular and transcellular transport models. In this issue of the JCI, Sun et al. identified GPR182 as a lipoprotein receptor in lymphatic endothelial cells (LECs), profoundly advancing our understanding of intestinal lipid absorption. They observed poor fat absorption in GPR182-deficient mice and demonstrated the role of GPR182 in transporting chylomicrons across the LECs into the lacteal lumen. This discovery establishes a molecular basis for transcellular transport of chylomicrons, challenging the traditional view that lacteal lipid entry is predominantly paracellular. By linking receptor-mediated uptake to impaired fat absorption and protection against fat-induced obesity and steatosis, this study expands the biological and translational implications of lacteal transport. Consequently, rather than favoring a single model, future research should investigate the integration of both paracellular and transcellular transport models in vivo.
papers.abstractKo: 역사적으로, 장 림프관(lacteals)으로의 chylomicron 유입에 대한 연구는 세포간(paracellular) 및 세포내(transcellular) 수송 모델 사이에서 양극화되어 왔다. 이번 JCI 호에서는 Sun et al.이 림프관 내피세포(lymphatic endothelial cells, LECs)에서 GPR182를 지단백질 수용체(lipoprotein receptor)로 규명하여, 장 지질 흡수에 대한 우리의 이해를 크게 진전시켰다. 이들은 GPR182 결핍 마우스에서 지방 흡수가 저하됨을 관찰하였고, chylomicron을 LECs를 가로질러 lacteal 내강으로 운반하는 과정에서 GPR182의 역할을 입증하였다. 이러한 발견은 chylomicron의 세포내 수송에 대한 분자적 근거를 확립하며, lacteal로의 지질 유입이 주로 세포간 경로라는 전통적 견해에 도전한다. 수용체 매개 흡수(receptor-mediated uptake)를 지방 흡수 장애 및 지방 유도 비만과 steatosis로부터의 보호와 연결함으로써, 이 연구는 lacteal 수송의 생물학적 및 중개의학적 함의를 확장한다. 따라서 향후 연구는 단일 모델을 선호하기보다, in vivo에서 세포간 및 세포내 수송 모델이 어떻게 통합되는지를 조사해야 한다.

papers.title: Pancreatic islet α cell function and proliferation require the arginine transporter SLC7A2
papers.abstract: Interrupting glucagon signaling decreases gluconeogenesis and the fractional extraction of amino acids by liver from blood, resulting in lower glycemia. The resulting hyperaminoacidemia stimulates α cell proliferation and glucagon secretion via a liver/α cell axis. We hypothesized that α cells detect and respond to circulating amino acids' levels via a unique amino acid transporter repertoire. We found that Slc7a2/SLC7A2 is the most highly expressed cationic amino acid transporter in α cells, with its expression being 3-fold greater in α than β cells in both mouse and human. Employing cell culture, zebrafish, and knockout mouse models, we found that the cationic amino acid arginine and SLC7A2 are required for α cell proliferation in response to interrupted glucagon signaling. Ex vivo and in vivo assessment of islet function in Slc7a2-/- mice showed decreased arginine-stimulated glucagon and insulin secretion. We found that arginine activation of mTOR signaling and induction of the glutamine transporter SLC38A5 was dependent on SLC7A2, showing that the role of both in α cell proliferation is dependent on arginine transport and SLC7A2. Finally, we identified single nucleotide polymorphisms in SLC7A2 associated with HbA1c. Together, these data indicate a central role for SLC7A2 in amino acid-stimulated α cell proliferation and islet hormone secretion.
papers.abstractKo: glucagon signaling의 차단은 gluconeogenesis와 혈액으로부터 간에 의한 amino acid의 fractional extraction을 감소시켜, 그 결과 혈당을 낮춘다. 그에 따른 hyperaminoacidemia는 liver/α cell axis를 통해 α cell proliferation과 glucagon secretion을 자극한다. 우리는 α cells가 고유한 amino acid transporter repertoire를 통해 순환하는 amino acid 수준을 감지하고 이에 반응한다고 가정하였다. 우리는 Slc7a2/SLC7A2가 α cells에서 가장 높게 발현되는 cationic amino acid transporter이며, 그 발현이 mouse와 human 모두에서 β cells보다 α cells에서 3배 더 높다는 것을 발견하였다. cell culture, zebrafish, 그리고 knockout mouse models를 이용하여, cationic amino acid arginine과 SLC7A2가 interrupted glucagon signaling에 대한 반응으로 일어나는 α cell proliferation에 필요함을 확인하였다. papers.title: Bittersweet: how hyperglycemia exacerbates vitiligo progression through the succinate/SUCNR1 axis
papers.abstract: Vitiligo is a depigmenting disease marked by progressive T cell-driven destruction of melanocytes in the skin, hair, and mucosa. While vitiligo is known to be a T cell-mediated autoimmune disease, its triggers have remained poorly understood and treatment options limited. In this issue of the JCI, Kang et al. demonstrated how hyperglycemia exacerbates vitiligo progression through the succinate/SUCNR1 axis. These findings identify succinate as a potential biomarker for disease activity and highlight an independent pathway for targeting in therapeutic intervention. More broadly, the findings linking succinate and glucose metabolism to vitiligo suggest that lifestyle factors could be modified to slow development of vitiligo and other autoimmune diseases linked to succinate.
papers.abstractKo: Vitiligo는 피부, 모발, 점막에서 멜라노사이트(melanocyte)가 진행성 T cell-유도 파괴를 받는 탈색소 질환이다. Vitiligo가 T cell-매개 자가면역질환으로 알려져 있음에도 불구하고, 그 유발 인자들은 오랫동안 충분히 밝혀지지 않았고 치료 옵션도 제한적이었다. 본 JCI 호에서는 Kang et al.이 고혈당이 succinate/SUCNR1 축을 통해 vitiligo 진행을 어떻게 악화시키는지 입증하였다. 이러한 발견은 succinate를 질병 활성도의 잠재적 biomarker로 제시하며, 치료적 중재에서 표적화할 수 있는 독립적인 경로를 강조한다. 보다 넓게는, succinate와 포도당 대사를 vitiligo와 연결하는 이러한 결과는 lifestyle factors를 조절함으로써 vitiligo 및 succinate와 연관된 다른 자가면역질환의 발생을 늦출 수 있음을 시사한다.

papers.title: Functional, molecular, and digital measurements of biological age
papers.abstract: The reality of an aging population demands a deeper understanding of aging as a biological process, rather than as a chronological descriptor. Chronological age poorly captures interindividual heterogeneity in physiological and functional decline, disease susceptibility, and mortality risk. In contrast, biological age encompasses deterioration at the molecular, cellular, tissue, organ, functional, and organismal levels and provides insight into why two individuals with the same chronological age exhibit differences in physiological function, disease susceptibility, and mortality risk. While early models of biological age relied on functional markers or composite scores derived largely from longitudinal cohort studies, more recent models integrate molecular profiling with machine learning to ascertain biological aging trajectories. In parallel, new artificial intelligence tools have been applied to various imaging modalities and other forms of complex data to elucidate latent patterns and estimate biological age. In this state-of-the-art Review, we explore historical and modern approaches to estimating biological age and highlight key conceptual, technical, and translational challenges that remain unresolved. As geroscience-guided interventions are incorporated into clinical evaluations, robust and accurate interpretable measures of biological aging are crucial to ascertain treatment effects in clinical trials.
papers.abstractKo: 고령화 인구의 현실은 연대기적 서술로서가 아니라 생물학적 과정으로서의 노화에 대한 더 깊은 이해를 요구한다. 연대기적 연령은 생리적 및 기능적 저하, 질병 감수성, 사망 위험에서의 개인 간 이질성을 제대로 포착하지 못한다. 반면 생물학적 연령은 분자, 세포, 조직, 장기, 기능 및 개체 수준에서의 손상을 포괄하며, 동일한 연대기적 연령을 가진 두 개인이 왜 생리적 기능, 질병 감수성 및 사망 위험에서 차이를 보이는지에 대한 통찰을 제공한다. 생물학적 연령의 초기 모델들은 주로 종단 코호트 연구(longitudinal cohort studies)에서 도출된 기능적 지표 또는 복합 점수에 의존하였으나, 최근의 모델들은 분자 프로파일링(molecular profiling)과 machine learning을 통합하여 생물학적 노화 궤적을 규명한다. 동시에, 새로운 artificial intelligence 도구들은 다양한 영상 양식(imaging modalities) 및 기타 복잡한 데이터 형식에 적용되어 잠재 패턴을 밝히고 생물학적 연령을 추정하고 있다. 본 최첨단 종설(state-of-the-art Review)에서는 생물학적 연령을 추정하기 위한 역사적 및 현대적 접근법을 살펴보고, 여전히 해결되지 않은 핵심 개념적, 기술적, 번역적(translational) 과제를 강조한다. geroscience-guided interventions가 임상 평가에 통합됨에 따라, 임상시험에서 치료 효과를 규명하기 위해서는 강건하고 정확하며 해석 가능한 생물학적 노화 지표가 필수적이다.

papers.title: HSD3B1 links ileal steroid metabolism to bile acid regulation in patients with prostate cancer
papers.abstract: Androgen deprivation therapy (ADT), a cornerstone of advanced prostate cancer treatment, effectively suppresses androgen signaling but frequently induces systemic metabolic dysregulation. Here, we delineate an unrecognized intestinal steroid/bile acid regulatory axis that mechanistically links androgen suppression to extratumoral metabolic aberrations. HSD3B1 is the most common inherited link to prostate cancer mortality and mediates its effects by regulating steroid metabolism. Integrated metabolomic profiling of patients undergoing ADT revealed a rapid genotype-associated reduction in circulating bile acids, most pronounced in carriers of the adrenal-permissive HSD3B1 (1245C) allele. Surprisingly, analyses in human intestinal tissue and mechanistic investigations in in vitro models identified the terminal ileum as a unique site of HSD3B1 and SLC10A2 (ASBT) coexpression, where catalytically active 3βHSD1 is transcriptionally governed by liver receptor homolog-1 (LRH-1). Pharmacologic or genetic LRH-1 inhibition coordinately suppressed HSD3B1 and SLC10A2 expression and function, while inducing adaptive HSD11B2 upregulation and enhanced glucocorticoid inactivation. This LRH-1-dependent regulatory program persisted independently of androgen and glucocorticoid receptor signaling under in vitro conditions modeling androgen deprivation. These findings establish LRH-1 as a central integrator of intestinal steroidogenesis and bile acid transport and implicate the LRH-1/HSD3B1/SLC10A2 network as a mechanistic driver of ADT-associated metabolic disturbances and a potential target for therapeutic intervention.
papers.abstractKo: 안드로겐 박탈 요법(androgen deprivation therapy, ADT)은 진행성 전립선암 치료의 핵심이지만, 안드로겐 신호를 효과적으로 억제하는 동시에 전신적 대사 조절 이상(systemic metabolic dysregulation)을 흔히 유발한다. 여기서 우리는 안드로겐 억제와 종양 외(extra-tumoral) 대사 이상을 기전적으로 연결하는, 아직 인식되지 않았던 장내 스테로이드/담즙산(steroid/bile acid) 조절 축을 규명한다. HSD3B1은 전립선암 사망과 가장 흔히 연관되는 유전적 요인이며, 스테로이드 대사 조절을 통해 그 효과를 매개한다. ADT를 시행 중인 환자들의 통합 대사체학(integrated metabolomic) 분석에서 순환하는 담즙산의 빠른 유전자형 관련 감소가 관찰되었으며, 이는 부신 허용형(adrenal-permissive) HSD3B1 (1245C) 대립유전자 보유자에서 가장 두드러졌다. 놀랍게도, 인간 장 조직 분석과 in vitro 모델에서의 기전적 연구는 회장 말단(terminal ileum)을 HSD3B1과 SLC10A2(ASBT) 공발현의 독특한 위치로 확인하였고, 이곳에서 촉매적으로 활성인 3βHSD1은 liver receptor homolog-1(LRH-1)에 의해 전사적으로 조절된다. 약리학적 또는 유전적 LRH-1 억제는 HSD3B1 및 SLC10A2의 발현과 기능을 협응적으로 억제하는 동시에, 적응적 HSD11B2 상향조절과 글루코코르티코이드(glucocorticoid) 비활성화 증가를 유도하였다. 이러한 LRH-1 의존적 조절 프로그램은 안드로겐 박탈을 모사한 in vitro 조건에서 안드로겐 및 글루코코르티코이드 수용체(glucocorticoid receptor) 신호와 독립적으로 지속되었다. 이들 발견은 LRH-1을 장내 스테로이드생합성(steroidogenesis)과 담즙산 수송의 중심 통합자로 확립하며, LRH-1/HSD3B1/SLC10A2 네트워크가 ADT 연관 대사 장애의 기전적 동인(mechanistic driver)이며 치료적 개입의 잠재적 표적임을 시사한다.

papers.title: Oncogenic KRAS-driven type I interferon signalling primes pancreatic cancer for necroptosis
papers.abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is projected to become the second leading cause of cancer-related death within this decade. Here, we show that its major driver oncogene KRAS activates the cGAS-STING-TBK1 axis, inducing a type I interferon (IFN) response that primes PDAC cells for necroptosis. Using genetically engineered mouse models, we find that cancer cell-specific deletion of caspase-8 is sufficient to trigger necroptotic cell death, eliminating most pancreatic precursor lesions. Mechanistically, KRAS-driven IFN signalling induces ISGF3-dependent expression of necroptosis-related interferon-stimulated genes, including MLKL. This renders PDAC cells selectively vulnerable to necroptosis upon caspase-8 inhibition. Therapeutically, pharmacologic caspase inhibition reduces tumour burden in aggressive PDAC models and human patient-derived organoids. A pan-cancer transcriptomic analysis links necroptosis gene expression with Ras pathway activity and IFN signatures across multiple tumour types. These findings reveal a KRAS-induced IFN program that sensitises tumour cells to necroptosis, highlighting a therapeutic vulnerability in PDAC with broader relevance across IFN-activated cancers.
papers.abstractKo: 췌관선암종(pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, PDAC)은 향후 10년 이내에 암 관련 사망의 두 번째 주요 원인이 될 것으로 예측된다. 본 연구에서는, PDAC의 주요 driver oncogene인 KRAS가 cGAS-STING-TBK1 축을 활성화하여 type I interferon(IFN) 반응을 유도하고, 이로써 PDAC 세포를 necroptosis에 대해 priming함을 보여준다. 유전적으로 공학화된 마우스 모델(genetically engineered mouse models)을 사용하여, 암세포 특이적 caspase-8 결실이 necroptotic cell death를 유발하기에 충분하며, 이는 대부분의 췌장 전구 병변을 제거함을 확인하였다. 기전적으로, KRAS에 의해 유도되는 IFN 신호전달은 MLKL을 포함한 necroptosis 관련 interferon-stimulated genes의 ISGF3 의존적 발현을 유도한다. 이로 인해 PDAC 세포는 caspase-8 억제 시 선택적으로 necroptosis에 취약해진다. 치료적으로, 약리학적 caspase 억제는 공격적인 PDAC 모델과 인간 환자 유래 오가노이드(human patient-derived organoids)에서 종양 부담을 감소시킨다. 범암종 전사체 분석(pan-cancer transcriptomic analysis)에서는 여러 종양 유형에 걸쳐 necroptosis 유전자 발현이 Ras pathway 활성 및 IFN signature와 연관됨을 보여준다. 이러한 결과는 KRAS에 의해 유도되는 IFN 프로그램이 종양 세포를 necroptosis에 민감화(sensitises)함을 밝히며, IFN이 활성화된 암 전반에 걸쳐 더 넓은 관련성을 지닌 PDAC의 치료적 취약성을 강조한다.

papers.title: Deciphering small sequence differences in T cell receptor-antigen pairing
papers.abstract: T cells have important functions in development and disease processes through T cell receptor (TCR)-dependent activities. Many tools were developed to predict the binding between TCRs and antigens. However, one of the uncertainties is whether such tools can decipher how small changes in the TCRs or antigenic peptides contribute to binding. We develop a deep learning model, pMTnet-omni, which not only predicts the binding vs. non-binding of TCRs towards pMHCs, but also distinguishes the stronger vs. weaker binding of TCRs similar in sequence. We leverage this capability to interpret the biological rules that govern TCR-antigen pairing. This also enables pMTnet-omni to accurately predict variant TCRs with desired stronger or weaker binding to the antigen, in conjunction with a Lab-in-the-Loop (LiL) mechanism. We show that pMTnet-omni can also predict binding of TCRs towards similar pMHCs. Overall, we provide a flexible toolkit for research and translational applications involving antigens and TCRs.
papers.abstractKo: T 세포는 T cell receptor (TCR)-의존적 활성에 의해 발달 및 질환 과정에서 중요한 기능을 수행한다. TCR과 항원 간의 결합을 예측하기 위해 많은 도구들이 개발되었다. 그러나 하나의 불확실성은 이러한 도구들이 TCR 또는 항원성 펩타이드의 작은 변화가 결합에 어떻게 기여하는지를 판별할 수 있는지 여부이다. 우리는 deep learning 모델인 pMTnet-omni를 개발하였으며, 이는 TCR의 pMHCs에 대한 binding vs. non-binding을 예측할 뿐만 아니라, 서열이 유사한 TCR들 사이의 stronger vs. weaker binding도 구별한다. 우리는 이 능력을 활용하여 TCR-antigen pairing을 지배하는 생물학적 규칙을 해석하였다. 또한 이는 Lab-in-the-Loop (LiL) 메커니즘과 결합하여, 항원에 대해 desired stronger or weaker binding을 갖는 variant TCRs를 정확하게 예측할 수 있게 한다. 우리는 pMTnet-omni가 유사한 pMHCs에 대한 TCRs의 binding도 예측할 수 있음을 보인다. 전반적으로, 우리는 항원 및 TCRs와 관련된 연구 및 중개(translational) 응용을 위한 유연한 도구상자(toolkit)를 제공한다.

papers.title: Spatial cellular order underlies locally-confined mechanisms of immune resistance in oropharyngeal cancer
papers.abstract: Oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinomas (OPSCCs) frequently result from oncogenic human papilloma virus (HPV) infections (HPV-OPSCC). The mechanisms underlying effective immune escape, despite abundant viral antigens, are incompletely understood. Here, we performed single-cell spatial gene expression profiling of HPV-OPSCC to characterize cellular organization and mechanisms of immune resistance. We describe distinct tumor-parenchymal immune foci that differ in cytokine expression, spatial location, immune cell infiltration and cancer cell states. Furthermore, immune foci display profound differences related to co-inhibitory receptor signaling and immunosuppressive myeloid cells, suggesting that different tumor-parenchymal regions may be dominated by distinct, locally-confined mechanisms of immunosuppression. Additionally, senescent-like HPV-OPSCC cells lacking HPV transcripts (HPVoff) are evident across the tumor parenchyma and able to evade HPV-specific T cell-mediated immunity in vitro. HPVoff cells are enriched within hypoxic regions and near IFN-γ producing T cells suggesting that both hypoxia and IFN-γ signaling can promote the HPVoff phenotype. In conclusion, our findings highlight a complex cellular interplay underlying heterogeneous cancer cell states, spatial immune cell organization, and diverse mechanisms of immune escape.
papers.abstractKo: 구인두 편평세포암(oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinomas, OPSCCs)은 흔히 종양원성 인간유두종바이러스(human papilloma virus, HPV) 감염(HPV-OPSCC)으로 인해 발생한다. 풍부한 바이러스 항원에도 불구하고 효과적인 면역 회피를 뒷받침하는 기전은 아직 충분히 밝혀지지 않았다. 본 연구에서는 HPV-OPSCC의 단일세포 공간 유전자 발현 프로파일링(single-cell spatial gene expression profiling)을 수행하여 세포 조직화와 면역 저항성 기전을 규명하였다. 우리는 사이토카인 발현, 공간적 위치, 면역세포 침윤 및 암세포 상태가 서로 다른 독립적인 종양-실질(tumor-parenchymal) 면역 초점(foci)을 기술한다. 또한 면역 초점은 공억제 수용체(co-inhibitory receptor) 신호전달 및 면역억제성 골수계 세포(myeloid cells)와 관련된 현저한 차이를 보이며, 이는 서로 다른 종양-실질 영역이 서로 구분되는, 국소적으로 제한된(locally-confined) 면역억제 기전에 의해 지배될 수 있음을 시사한다. 추가로, HPV 전사체를 결여한 노화 유사(senescent-like) HPV-OPSCC 세포(HPVoff)는 종양 실질 전반에서 관찰되며 in vitro에서 HPV 특이적 T 세포 매개 면역을 회피할 수 있다. HPVoff 세포는 저산소(hypoxic) 영역과 IFN-γ를 생산하는 T 세포 근처에 풍부하며, 이는 저산소증과 IFN-γ 신호전달 모두 HPVoff 표현형을 촉진할 수 있음을 시사한다. 결론적으로, 우리의 발견은 이질적인 암세포 상태, 공간적 면역세포 조직화, 그리고 다양한 면역 회피 기전의 기저에 있는 복잡한 세포 간 상호작용을 강조한다.

papers.title: PAR3-mediated coordination of hepatocyte proliferation, maturation, and architecture in liver development and regeneration
papers.abstract: The liver's ability to coordinate cell proliferation, polarization, and maturation with architectural assembly is fundamental to its metabolic functions and regenerative capacity. However, the mechanisms that integrate these processes remain incompletely understood. Using murine and human models, we show that hepatic polarity and bile canaliculi (BC) formation initiate at sites of cell division during the hepatoblast stage, and that BC elongation is temporally associated with oriented cell division during hepatocyte differentiation. This process involves PAR3- and YAP-dependent modulation of ERK/MAPK signaling. PAR3 forms a protein complex that localizes a subset of IQGAP1 to tight junctions, thereby restricting ERK/MAPK activation at the basolateral membrane. This regulation is required for efficient BC elongation and hepatocyte maturation. Together, these findings reveal a stage-dependent mechanism linking liver architecture to functional maturation and provide insights into liver development, regeneration, and potential therapeutic strategies for metabolic liver disease and liver failure.

papers.title: Nitrate-Sialin2 axis couples ER-mitochondrial calcium signaling with fatty acid metabolism to drive white adipose browning
papers.abstract: White adipose browning is a promising route to restore energy balance; however, how inorganic anion signals engage intracellular organelle networks to drive this process remains unclear. Here, we identify Sialin2 as a nitrate sensor that converts dietary nitrate into a spatially confined thermogenic program by coupling ER-mitochondria Ca 2+ transfer with lipid routing into mitochondrial oxidation. Sialin2 localizes to mitochondria and the endoplasmic reticulum (ER), where it strengthens ER-mitochondria contacts and engages the inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate receptor type 1 (IP3R1)-voltage-dependent anion channel 1 (VDAC1)-mitochondrial calcium uniporter 1 (MCU1) conduit to enhance inducible mitochondrial Ca 2+ uptake. In parallel, Sialin2 associates with lysosomal acid lipase (LIPA), acyl-CoA synthetase long-chain family member 3 (ACSL3), and carnitine palmitoyltransferase 1 A (CPT1A) to channel lipid-droplet-derived fatty acids into β-oxidation, thereby fueling the tricarboxylic acid cycle and uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1)-dependent respiration. Loss of Slc17a5 abolishes nitrate-evoked browning and metabolic benefits, whereas nitrate supplementation improves adipose thermogenesis and systemic metabolic indices in male mice with diet-induced obesity without adrenergic stimulation. Together, these findings identify an organelle-specific nitrate-sensing mechanism that couples inorganic anion signalling to substrate routing in adipocytes and establish a non-hormonal pathway for restoring metabolic homeostasis.
papers.abstractKo: 백색 지방의 browning은 에너지 균형을 회복하기 위한 유망한 경로이지만, 무기 음이온(inorganic anion) 신호가 세포내 소기관 네트워크와 어떻게 연결되어 이 과정을 유도하는지는 아직 불분명하다. 본 연구에서는 Sialin2를 식이성 nitrate를 ER-미토콘드리아 Ca 2+ 전달과 지질의 미토콘드리아 산화로의 routing을 결합함으로써 공간적으로 국한된 열생성 프로그램으로 전환하는 nitrate sensor로 규명하였다. Sialin2는 mitochondria와 endoplasmic reticulum(ER)에 국소화되며, 이곳에서 ER-미토콘드리아 접촉을 강화하고 inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate receptor type 1(IP3R1)-voltage-dependent anion channel 1(VDAC1)-mitochondrial calcium uniporter 1(MCU1) conduit를 관여시켜 유도성 mitochondrial Ca 2+ 흡수를 증가시킨다. 동시에 Sialin2는 lysosomal acid lipase(LIPA), acyl-CoA synthetase long-chain family member 3(ACSL3), carnitine palmitoyltransferase 1 A(CPT1A)와 결합하여 lipid-droplet 유래 fatty acid를 β-oxidation으로 유도함으로써 tricarboxylic acid cycle과 uncoupling protein 1(UCP1)-의존성 respiration을 구동한다. papers.title: Adipose tissue as a humoral–neuronal hub in metabolic regulation
papers.abstract: Adipose tissue has emerged as a dynamic endocrine organ that coordinates systemic energy balance and cardiometabolic health. This Review highlights the dual humoral and neuronal pathways through which adipose tissue regulates systemic metabolism. Humoral signals include peptide hormones, lipid mediators, metabolites, chemokines and exosomal microRNAs secreted by adipose depots. Neuronal circuits control adipose function rapidly and precisely: sympathetic efferents trigger lipolysis in white adipose tissue and thermogenesis in brown adipose tissue, whereas sensory afferents detect chemical, thermal and mechanical signals to adjust sympathetic activity. Nutritional and environmental stimuli (for example, diet, cold exposure and exercise), along with pathological states (for example, obesity, type 2 diabetes mellitus, lipodystrophy and ageing-associated disorders), dynamically modulate these endocrine and neural outputs. Methodological innovations, such as omics based on mass spectrometry or liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry, secretome labelling, adipose tissue organoid models and click chemistry, enable high-resolution characterization of adipose-derived signals and their targets. Finally, we discuss translational opportunities, including synthetic analogues of lipophilic hormones, and future therapeutic strategies that harness adipose communication networks.
papers.abstractKo: 지방조직(adipose tissue)은 전신 에너지 균형과 심대사 건강(cardiometabolic health)을 조정하는 역동적인 내분비 기관으로 부상하였다. 본 Review는 지방조직이 전신 대사(systemic metabolism)를 조절하는 이중의 체액성(humoral) 및 신경성(neuronal) 경로를 강조한다. 체액성 신호에는 지방 저장부위(adipose depots)에서 분비되는 펩타이드 호르몬, 지질 매개체(lipid mediators), 대사산물(metabolites), 케모카인(chemokines) 및 엑소좀성 microRNA(exosomal microRNAs)가 포함된다. 신경 회로(neuronal circuits)는 지방조직 기능을 빠르고 정밀하게 조절한다. 교감성 원심성 신경(sympathetic efferents)은 백색 지방조직(white adipose tissue)에서 지방분해(lipolysis)를, 갈색 지방조직(brown adipose tissue)에서 열발생(thermogenesis)을 유도하는 반면, 감각성 구심성 신경(sensory afferents)은 화학적, 열적 및 기계적 신호를 감지하여 교감 신경 활성(sympathetic activity)을 조절한다. 영양 및 환경 자극(예: 식이, 한랭 노출 및 운동)은 병적 상태(예: 비만, 제2형 당뇨병(type 2 diabetes mellitus), 지방이영양증(lipodystrophy) 및 노화 관련 장애(ageing-associated disorders))와 함께 이러한 내분비 및 신경 출력을 역동적으로 조절한다. 질량분석(mass spectrometry) 또는 액체크로마토그래피-질량분석(liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry)에 기반한 오믹스(omics), secretome labeling, 지방조직 오가노이드 모델(adipose tissue organoid models), 그리고 click chemistry와 같은 방법론적 혁신은 지방조직 유래 신호와 그 표적의 고해상도 특성 규명을 가능하게 한다. 마지막으로, 우리는 지질친화성 호르몬(lipophilic hormones)의 합성 유사체(synthetic analogues)를 포함한 중개적 기회(translational opportunities)와, 지방조직 소통 네트워크(adipose communication networks)를 활용하는 미래의 치료 전략을 논의한다.

papers.title: mRNA-based tuberculosis vaccines BNT164a1 and BNT164b1 are immunogenic, well tolerated and efficacious in rodent models
papers.abstract: We designed and preclinically tested two mRNA-lipid-nanoparticle-based vaccine candidates to protect against tuberculosis. BNT164a1 and BNT164b1 encode the same eight Mycobacterium tuberculosis antigens expressed across different infection stages: Ag85A, Hrp1, ESAT-6, RpfD, RpfA, HbhA, M72 and VapB47. BNT164a1 utilizes nucleoside-unmodified mRNA, whereas BNT164b1 utilizes N 1 -methylpseudouridine-modified mRNA. Prime-boost immunization with BNT164 candidates elicited antibody and/or T cell responses against all antigens in three mouse strains (C57BL/6, BALB/c and HLA-A2.1/DR1 humanized mice). The candidates demonstrated favorable safety profiles in a rat toxicity study and significantly reduced bacterial burdens of two M. tuberculosis strains in murine aerosol challenge models. BNT164 protection was correlated with granuloma infiltration by CD8 + T cells with memory precursor phenotypes. In conclusion, BNT164a1 and BNT164b1 were immunogenic, well tolerated and efficacious in preclinical models and have entered phase 1/2 clinical trials ( NCT05537038 , NCT05547464 ).
papers.abstractKo: 결핵(tuberculosis)을 방어하기 위한 두 가지 mRNA-lipid-nanoparticle 기반 백신 후보를 설계하고 전임상적으로 시험하였다. BNT164a1과 BNT164b1은 감염의 서로 다른 단계에 걸쳐 발현되는 동일한 8개의 Mycobacterium tuberculosis 항원, 즉 Ag85A, Hrp1, ESAT-6, RpfD, RpfA, HbhA, M72 및 VapB47를 암호화한다. BNT164a1은 nucleoside-unmodified mRNA를 사용하며, BNT164b1은 N 1 -methylpseudouridine-modified mRNA를 사용한다. BNT164 후보물질로 prime-boost 면역화하였을 때 C57BL/6, BALB/c 및 HLA-A2.1/DR1 humanized mice의 세 가지 마우스 계통에서 모든 항원에 대한 항체 및/또는 T 세포 반응이 유도되었다. 이 후보물질들은 랫드 독성 연구에서 양호한 안전성 프로파일을 보였고, 마우스 aerosol challenge 모델에서 두 M. tuberculosis 균주의 세균 부하를 유의하게 감소시켰다. BNT164에 의한 보호 효과는 memory precursor phenotype을 가진 CD8 + T 세포의 granuloma 침윤과 상관관계가 있었다. 결론적으로, BNT164a1과 BNT164b1은 전임상 모델에서 immunogenic하고 well tolerated하며 efficacious하였고, phase 1/2 임상시험(NCT05537038, NCT05547464)으로 진입하였다.

papers.title: Bidirectional integrin β1 activation synergizes neurovascular coupling and enhances bone regeneration
papers.abstract: Reconstruction of large segmental bone defects remains challenging because current grafting strategies often fail to coordinate angiogenesis, neurogenesis, and osteogenesis. Here we developed a functional scaffold (peptide/Talin1 plasmid/PLA-HA/GelMA, PTPG) capable of simultaneously delivering peptides and Talin1 plasmids. We hypothesized that this scaffold enables neurovascularized bone regeneration through bidirectional activation of integrin β1 (ITGB1). The REDV-IKVAV (Arg-Glu-Asp-Val-Gly-Gly-Gly-Ile-Lys-Val-Ala-Val) peptide triggers "outside-in" ITGB1 signaling in endothelial and Schwann cells, while Talin1 plasmid-mediated "inside-out" activation. This PTPG scaffold synergistically enhances cell proliferation, migration and secretion, which are eliminated by ITGB1 silencing. In vivo, PTPG scaffold promotes aligned neurovascular networks guiding bone deposition. Single-cell RNA sequencing demonstrates enrichment of endothelial H-type signatures and repair-associated Schwann cell phenotypes, with activation of ITGB1-focal adhesion kinase-paxillin signaling. Collectively, this scaffold integrates structural support with peptide and genetic cues to promote coordinated angiogenesis, neurogenesis, and osteogenesis, offering a promising strategy for functional bone regeneration.

papers.title: Dietary omega-6 lipids promote postinjury aberrant bone formation in obesity
papers.abstract: Obesity is associated with impaired wound healing, but the mechanisms linking excess adiposity to aberrant tissue repair remain unresolved. Heterotopic ossification (HO) is a severe example of pathologic tissue repair in which mesenchymal progenitor cells (MPCs) undergo aberrant osteochondral differentiation within soft tissue, leading to joint contractures and pain. Here, we show that accumulation of dietary omega-6 (ω-6) lipids in the injury site is a key mechanism linking obesity to HO. Specifically, in mice fed a high-fat diet (HFD), injured tissues were enriched in linoleic and arachidonic acids, providing substrate for myeloid cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2)-dependent prostaglandin E2 (PGE2) production. PGE2 then drove a transcriptional program in mesenchymal progenitor cells that promoted osteochondral differentiation. An isocaloric, low linoleic acid HFD reduced HO despite comparable obesity, demonstrating that dietary lipid composition, rather than adiposity alone, drove pathological repair. Clinical data mirrored these findings, showing that obesity conferred increased HO risk, and COX-2 inhibition reduced HO exclusively in obese patients. Together, these findings identify injury site ω-6 lipid enrichment as the key signal linking the diet to MPC reprogramming, pointing to dietary lipid modulation as an actionable strategy to limit HO in obesity.
papers.abstractKo: 비만은 상처 치유 장애와 연관되지만, 과도한 지방 축적(excess adiposity)과 비정상적 조직 수복(aberrant tissue repair)을 연결하는 기전은 아직 규명되지 않았다. 이소성 골화(heterotopic ossification, HO)는 중간엽 전구세포(mesenchymal progenitor cells, MPCs)가 연부 조직 내에서 비정상적 골연골 분화(aberrant osteochondral differentiation)를 겪어 관절 구축과 통증을 유발하는 병적 조직 수복(pathologic tissue repair)의 심각한 예이다. 본 연구에서는 손상 부위(injury site)에서 식이 omega-6(ω-6) 지질이 축적되는 것이 비만과 HO를 연결하는 핵심 기전임을 보여준다. 구체적으로, 고지방식이(high-fat diet, HFD)를 먹인 생쥐에서 손상된 조직은 linoleic acid와 arachidonic acid가 풍부하였으며, 이는 myeloid cyclooxygenase-2(COX-2)-의존적 prostaglandin E2(PGE2) 생성을 위한 기질을 제공하였다. 이어서 PGE2는 중간엽 전구세포에서 골연골 분화를 촉진하는 전사 프로그램(transcriptional program)을 유도하였다. 등칼로리(isocaloric) 저 linoleic acid HFD는 유사한 비만에도 불구하고 HO를 감소시켰으며, 이는 지방량(adiposity) 자체가 아니라 식이 지질 조성(dietary lipid composition)이 병적 수복(pathological repair)을 유도함을 입증한다. 임상 자료는 이러한 발견을 반영하여, 비만이 HO 위험 증가를 초래하고 COX-2 억제가 비만 환자에서만 HO를 감소시킨다는 것을 보여주었다. 종합하면, 이러한 결과는 손상 부위의 ω-6 지질 풍부화(ω-6 lipid enrichment)가 식이와 MPC 재프로그래밍을 연결하는 핵심 신호임을 규명하며, 비만에서 HO를 제한하기 위한 실행 가능한 전략으로서 식이 지질 조절(dietary lipid modulation)을 제시한다.

papers.title: Macrophage–neutrophil crosstalk via the Selplg–Sell–YAP axis drives NETosis and MASH-associated liver fibrosis
papers.abstract: Background and aims Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH)-associated fibrosis is a pivotal stage toward end-stage liver disease. However, the immune mechanisms orchestrating the transition from inflammation to fibrosis remain elusive. We aimed to dissect the myeloid-cell crosstalk driving this transition and identify therapeutic targets. Approach and results Single-cell transcriptomic analysis of MASH mouse livers revealed expansion of infiltrating Selplg + macrophages and enhanced macrophage-neutrophil communication through the Selplg-Sell axis. This axis was consistently activated in CDAHFD- and WD+CCl 4 -induced MASH fibrosis models, and its cellular components were spatially enriched and associated with fibrosis severity in human MASLD liver tissues. Structural modeling showed that macrophage-derived Selplg engaged neutrophil Sell through a glycan-dependent interface involving sialyl-Lewis X (sLeX) recognition. In primary cell co-culture systems, Selplg-Sell engagement required direct cell-cell contact and activated neutrophil p38-MST1/2-YAP signaling, leading to YAP-dependent transcriptional activation of neutrophil extracellular trap (NET) effector programs. NETs subsequently acted as extracellular scaffolds that promoted integrin-dependent activation of latent TGF-β1, thereby driving hepatic stellate cell activation. Pharmacological blockade with the sLeX mimetic TBC-1269 or YAP inhibition attenuated hepatic inflammation, NET burden, and fibrosis under both preventive and therapeutic settings. Macrophage-lineage-specific Selplg deficiency further recapitulated these protective effects, confirming macrophage-derived Selplg as an upstream driver of this pathogenic circuit. Conclusions This study defines a macrophage-neutrophil-HSC signaling axis linking metabolic inflammation to fibrotic remodeling in MASH. Macrophage-derived Selplg drives Sell-dependent YAP-mediated NETosis, while NETs further promote latent TGF-β1 activation and HSC activation. These findings support the axis as a therapeutic target for MASH-associated liver fibrosis.

papers.title: Natural killer cell-mediated immunosurveillance modulates liver cancer evolution through cancer stemness enhancement and lipid metabolism reprogramming
papers.abstract: Tumor evolution enables liver cancer cells to acquire survival advantages and evade therapy-induced cell death. However, the role of natural killer (NK) cells in liver cancer evolution remains unclear. Here, we establish immune-humanized spatiotemporal liver cancer models and integrate single-cell, spatial transcriptomic, and CRISPR/Cas9 screening analyses to investigate this process. We demonstrate that early NK cell-mediated immunosurveillance promotes tumor cell state transition and impairs subsequent adaptive immune responses. Mechanistically, NK cells induce lipid metabolic reprogramming, particularly cholesterol accumulation, and enhance tumor stemness, both of which promote liver cancer evolution. Furthermore, combined anti-LAG-3 treatment and liver X receptor activation suppress tumor evolution and improve the efficacy and durability of immune checkpoint blockade in advanced liver cancer. Collectively, our findings identify that NK cell-mediated early immunosurveillance promotes liver cancer evolution and suggest immunometabolic therapy as a potential strategy for advanced liver cancer.
papers.abstractKo: 종양 진화(tumor evolution)는 간암 세포가 생존상의 이점을 획득하고 치료 유도 세포 사멸을 회피할 수 있게 한다. 그러나 간암 진화에서 natural killer(NK) 세포의 역할은 여전히 불분명하다. 본 연구에서는 면역 인간화(spatiotemporal immune-humanized) 간암 모델을 확립하고 단일세포, 공간 전사체(spatial transcriptomic), 및 CRISPR/Cas9 스크리닝 분석을 통합하여 이 과정을 조사하였다. 우리는 초기 NK 세포 매개 면역감시(immune surveillance)가 종양 세포 상태 전환을 촉진하고 이후의 적응 면역 반응을 저해함을 입증하였다. 기전적으로, NK 세포는 특히 cholesterol 축적을 특징으로 하는 지질 대사 재프로그래밍(lipid metabolic reprogramming)을 유도하고 종양 stemness를 향상시키며, 이 두 현상 모두 간암 진화를 촉진한다. 더 나아가, anti-LAG-3 치료와 liver X receptor 활성화의 병용은 종양 진화를 억제하고 진행성 간암에서 immune checkpoint blockade의 효능과 지속성을 향상시킨다. 종합하면, 우리의 결과는 NK 세포 매개 초기 면역감시가 간암 진화를 촉진함을 규명하며, 면역대사 치료(immunometabolic therapy)가 진행성 간암에 대한 잠재적 전략임을 시사한다.

papers.title: Oligoclonal expansion of atypical Vδ2− γδ T cells in Good’s Syndrome
papers.abstract: Good's syndrome is a rare adult-onset immunodeficiency characterized by thymoma, hypogammaglobulinemia, B-cell lymphopenia, and T-cell dysfunction. Despite well-characterized defects in conventional immune subsets, the impact of this disorder on unconventional T cells, including γδ T cells, remains largely unexplored. In this study, we analyse γδ T cells in 10 patients with Good's syndrome using immunophenotyping, functional assays, and T-cell receptor (TCR)δ repertoire profiling of peripheral blood and thymoma tissue. Our analyses reveal a pronounced expansion of the Vδ2⁻ γδ T-cell compartment, composed primarily of Vδ1⁺, Vδ3⁺ and the exceptionally rare Vδ8⁺ subsets. The Vδ2⁻ cells are characterized by an activated and effector phenotype and a private and oligoclonal TCRδ repertoire. The thymoma tissue contains distinct clonotypes compared to circulation, suggesting clonal focusing in response to the tumor. Together, our findings show that γδ T-cell perturbations are integral characteristics of Good's syndrome and broaden our understanding of immune dysregulation in this acquired immunodeficiency.
papers.abstractKo: Good's syndrome은 흉선종, 감마글로불린저하증(hypogammaglobulinemia), B-cell 림프구감소증, 그리고 T-cell 기능장애를 특징으로 하는 드문 성인 발병 면역결핍증이다. 잘 규명된 conventional immune subset의 결함에도 불구하고, γδ T cells를 포함한 unconventional T cells에 대한 이 질환의 영향은 아직 대부분 탐구되지 않았다. 본 연구에서는 면역표현형 분석(immunophenotyping), 기능적 분석(functional assays), 그리고 말초혈액과 흉선종 조직의 T-cell receptor (TCR)δ repertoire profiling을 사용하여 Good's syndrome 환자 10명에서 γδ T cells를 분석하였다. 우리의 분석은 주로 Vδ1⁺, Vδ3⁺ 및 매우 드문 Vδ8⁺ subset으로 구성된 Vδ2⁻ γδ T-cell compartment의 현저한 확장을 보여준다. Vδ2⁻ 세포는 활성화되고 effector phenotype을 가지며, private하고 oligoclonal한 TCRδ repertoire를 특징으로 한다. 흉선종 조직은 순환 혈액과 비교하여 서로 구별되는 clonotype를 포함하고 있어, 종양에 대한 반응으로 clonal focusing이 일어남을 시사한다. 종합하면, 우리의 연구 결과는 γδ T-cell perturbation이 Good's syndrome의 핵심적 특징임을 보여주며, 이 후천성 면역결핍에서의 면역 조절 이상에 대한 이해를 넓혀준다.

papers.title: Tumor-resident T cells and dendritic cells form an in situ archetype during immunotherapy response in melanoma
papers.abstract: Tumor-resident (TR) T cells, known as tissue-resident memory (TRM) T cells in mice, play a central role in melanoma immunosurveillance, yet their contribution to immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) therapy has not been comprehensively explored. We performed spatial and single-cell profiling on 32 metastatic melanoma lymph node samples, from treatment-naïve, ICI-resistant and ICI-responsive patients. Here we show that tumor areas in ICI-responders were enriched for both CD8 + and CD4 + TR. CD8 + TR cells were clonally expanded, and both CD8 + and CD4 + TR cells upregulated cytotoxicity-related gene expression, suggesting functional anti-tumor immunity. Conversely, ICI-resistant tumors displayed chronic IFN-γ response pathways, linked to T cell exhaustion. We further identified a spatially organized immune triad composed of CD8⁺ TR, CD4⁺ TR, and type-3 dendritic cells (DC3) that is exclusive to responding tumors. These findings define coordinated cellular interactions within the tumor microenvironment that underpin successful immunotherapy and provide a framework for spatial biomarkers of response.

CD8 + TR 세포는 클론성 확장(clonally expanded)을 보였고, CD8 + 및 CD4 + TR 세포 모두 세포독성(cytotoxicity) 관련 유전자 발현을 상향 조절하여, 기능적 항종양 면역(functional anti-tumor immunity)을 시사하였다. 반면 ICI-내성 종양은 T 세포 탈진(T cell exhaustion)과 연관된 만성 IFN-γ 반응 경로(chronic IFN-γ response pathways)를 보였다. 우리는 더 나아가 반응성 종양에만 존재하는, CD8⁺ TR, CD4⁺ TR, 그리고 3형 수지상세포(type-3 dendritic cells, DC3)로 구성된 공간적으로 조직화된 면역 3요소(immune triad)를 확인하였다. 이러한 발견은 성공적인 면역치료를 뒷받침하는 종양 미세환경 내의 조정된 세포 간 상호작용을 규정하며, 반응의 공간적 biomarker를 위한 틀을 제공한다.

papers.title: AAV-mediated long-term TBX18 expression causes cardiac fibrosis and fails to induce pacemaker activity in rodents
papers.abstract: Gene therapy-based biological pacemakers have been proposed as an alternative to their hardware-based counterparts. In this context, short-term ectopic expression of the T-box transcription factor 18 (TBX18) in the ventricle has been reported to generate potent, short-term pacemaker function in various animal models. Here, we investigated the impact of adeno-associated virus-mediated (AAV-mediated), long-term expression of TBX18 and compared the outcomes with those of the pacemaker ion channel hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated potassium and sodium channel 2 (Hcn2). Our findings revealed that CMV-driven ectopic TBX18 expression in mouse hearts led to severe cardiac fibrosis. At lower, nonfibrogenic levels, TBX18 maintained its transcriptional function but failed to induce pacemaker phenotypes. TBX18-expressing cells showed suppressed expression of key working myocardial genes, but the pacemaker gene program was not induced. Electrophysiological studies showed abnormal automaticity in TBX18-expressing cells, combined with prolonged repolarization and various current changes. However, no hyperpolarization-activated funny current was detected. In a complete atrioventricular block rat model, AAV-mediated Hcn2 expression induced robust ectopic pacemaker activity in the presence of isoproterenol, whereas TBX18 expression neither generated such activity nor augmented Hcn2-mediated pacing. In conclusion, at functionally nonfibrogenic levels, TBX18 is neither sufficient nor necessary to induce pacemaker activity. In contrast, Hcn2 generates reliable pacing, making it a more viable candidate for biological pacemaker development.
papers.abstractKo: 유전자 치료 기반 biological pacemakers는 hardware-based counterparts의 대안으로 제안되어 왔다. 이러한 맥락에서, 심실에서 T-box transcription factor 18(TBX18)의 단기 ectopic expression이 다양한 동물 모델에서 강력한 단기 pacemaker function을 생성하는 것으로 보고되었다. 여기에서 우리는 adeno-associated virus-mediated(AAV-mediated) 장기 TBX18 발현의 영향을 조사하고, 그 결과를 pacemaker ion channel hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated potassium and sodium channel 2(Hcn2)의 결과와 비교하였다. 우리의 연구 결과, mouse hearts에서 CMV-driven ectopic TBX18 발현은 심한 cardiac fibrosis를 초래하였다. 더 낮고 섬유화 유발성이 없는 수준에서는 TBX18가 전사 기능(transcriptional function)을 유지하였지만 pacemaker phenotype을 유도하지 못하였다. TBX18-expressing cells는 주요 working myocardial genes의 발현이 억제되었으나, pacemaker gene program은 유도되지 않았다. 전기생리학적 연구에서는 TBX18-expressing cells에서 비정상적 automaticity가 나타났고, 이에 더해 재분극(repolarization) 연장과 다양한 전류 변화가 동반되었다. 그러나 hyperpolarization-activated funny current는 검출되지 않았다. complete atrioventricular block rat model에서 AAV-mediated Hcn2 발현은 isoproterenol 존재하에서 강력한 ectopic pacemaker activity를 유도한 반면, TBX18 발현은 그러한 activity를 생성하지도 않았고 Hcn2-mediated pacing을 증강하지도 않았다. 결론적으로, 기능적으로 비섬유화성 수준에서 TBX18는 pacemaker activity를 유도하는 데 충분하지도 않고 필요하지도 않다. 반대로 Hcn2는 신뢰할 수 있는 pacing을 생성하므로 biological pacemaker 개발을 위한 보다 실현 가능한 후보이다.

papers.title: Spatiotemporal organisation of residual disease in mouse and human BRCA1-deficient mammary tumours and breast cancer
papers.abstract: Breast cancer remains a leading cause of death worldwide. Although chemotherapy reduces primary and metastatic tumour burden, persisting drug-tolerant tumour cell populations, known as minimal residual disease (MRD), pose a significant risk of recurrence and therapy resistance. In this study, we describe the spatiotemporal organisation of therapy response and MRD in BRCA1;p53-deficient mouse mammary tumours and human clinical samples. By integrating single-cell RNA sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, and imaging mass cytometry across multiple treatment timepoints, we characterise dynamic interactions between tumour cell subpopulations and their surrounding microenvironment. Our multiomic analysis uncovers a distinct, chemotherapy-tolerant epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) cancer cell population that displays a conserved expression programme in human BRCA1-deficient tumours, significantly correlates with adverse clinical outcomes, and can be pharmacologically targeted in preclinical models. We reveal the spatial distribution of residual EMT-like tumour cells within discrete anatomical niches, providing a framework for understanding the persistence of MRD and potential therapeutic vulnerabilities.
papers.abstractKo: 유방암은 전 세계적으로 여전히 주요 사망 원인 중 하나이다. 화학요법(chemotherapy)은 원발성 및 전이성 종양 부담을 감소시키지만, minimal residual disease(MRD)로 알려진 지속적 약물 내성 종양 세포 집단은 재발과 치료 저항성에 중대한 위험을 초래한다. 본 연구에서는 BRCA1;p53 결핍 마우스 유선 종양과 인간 임상 검체에서 치료 반응과 MRD의 시공간적 조직(spatiotemporal organisation)을 기술한다. 여러 치료 시점에 걸쳐 단일세포 RNA sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, imaging mass cytometry를 통합함으로써, 종양 세포 아집단과 그 주변 미세환경 사이의 동적 상호작용을 규명하였다. 우리의 multiomic 분석은 인간 BRCA1 결핍 종양에서 보존된 발현 프로그램을 보이는, 화학요법 내성 epithelial-mesenchymal transition(EMT) 암세포 집단을 밝혀냈으며, 이는 불량한 임상 결과와 유의하게 상관하고 전임상 모델에서 약리학적으로 표적화할 수 있다. 우리는 서로 구획화된 해부학적 niche 내에 잔존 EMT-like 종양 세포의 공간적 분포를 밝힘으로써, MRD의 지속성과 잠재적 치료 취약성을 이해하기 위한 틀을 제시한다.

papers.title: Placental nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide modulates the timing of labor
papers.abstract: Labor is mediated proximately by prostaglandin signaling within gestational tissues and must be tightly regulated for birth to occur after appropriate fetal development. Metabolic changes accompanying gestational aging have been postulated as a determinant of birth timing, but specific nutrients, sensors, and messengers remain obscure. We report that placental nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD + ) dynamically tunes gestational length. Depletion of placental NAD + in mice provoked labor onset, mediated by the role of NAD + as a cofactor for 15-hydroxy prostaglandin dehydrogenase, an enzyme responsible for suppressing prostaglandin accumulation. Augmentation of placental NAD + prolonged gestation at baseline and in a model of preterm labor. These findings suggest a central role for metabolic exhaustion in provoking labor and reveal potential therapeutic avenues for preterm labor and the optimization of labor induction.

papers.title: A first-in-class pulsatile FXR agonist for bile-acid-related liver diseases
papers.abstract: Nuclear receptors are central regulators of metabolism 1 , yet therapeutic strategies that enforce continuous receptor activation frequently lead to reduced efficacy and unacceptable toxicity. Here we report a first-principles drug design strategy that aligns pharmacokinetics with physiological signalling cycles. We developed linafexor, a potent non-bile-acid agonist of the farnesoid X receptor (FXR) 2 ; it is engineered for rapid systemic clearance, which enables pulsatile receptor activation that mirrors endogenous bile acid dynamics 3-5 . Linafexor has robust efficacy across multiple preclinical models of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis 6 , liver fibrosis 7 , primary biliary cholangitis and primary sclerosing cholangitis 8,9 . Transcriptomic analyses reveal that, unlike long-acting FXR agonists 10,11 , linafexor preserves cyclic FXR signalling, avoids receptor downregulation and prevents broad transcriptional dysregulation. Direct manipulation of delivery patterns demonstrates that sustained FXR activation-independent of compound identity-induces severe toxicity, establishing activation duration as a determinant of therapeutic index. In phase 1 clinical studies (ClinicalTrials.gov; NCT05082779), linafexor administered once daily produces transient FXR pathway engagement, marked by (1) induction of FGF19 12-14 , a key endocrine mediator of bile acid feedback regulation; and (2) suppression of C4 15 , an intermediate reflecting hepatic bile acid synthesis, with no treatment-related adverse events. Together, these findings identify pulsatile FXR activation as a mechanistically grounded and clinically translatable strategy, and establish linafexor as a first-in-class therapeutic for bile acid-related liver diseases.

papers.title: Corylin promotes healthy aging via RAGA–mTOR suppression and sex-dependent activation of SIRT3
papers.abstract: Aging is accompanied by progressive physiological decline and an increased risk of chronic disease, motivating the search for interventions that promote healthy longevity. We found that mid-life administration of Corylin, a flavonoid derived from Psoralea corylifolia, improves metabolic function, muscle integrity, and physical performance in mice maintained on a standard diet. Corylin significantly extends median lifespan in female mice, with an 11.9% increase and a 33% higher survival rate at 125 weeks, whereas no comparable benefit is observed in males. Here, we show that integrated multi-omics analyses across multiple tissues reveal coordinated age-associated molecular changes modulated by Corylin. These analyses link Corylin treatment to suppression of mechanistic target of rapamycin signaling, which is further supported by direct interaction between Corylin and Ras-related GTP-binding protein A. In addition, Corylin restores sirtuin 3 protein levels and energy-associated metabolic programs in female mice, providing mechanistic insight into sex-dependent longevity benefits.

papers.title: Infection-induced glucose starvation triggers NINJ1-dependent macrophage lysis and Candida escape
papers.abstract: Pathogens compete for glucose with macrophages, which disrupts host glycolysis, modulates antimicrobial responses and causes macrophage death. We show that glucose starvation induced by major fungal pathogens Candida albicans and Candida auris causes macrophage lysis by activating NINJ1, the executioner of membrane rupture during cell death. In glucose-starved macrophages, NINJ1 ruptures membranes independently of known cell death programs. Consistently, NINJ1 is the dominant effector of fungal-induced macrophage damage amongst host cell death factors. Supplementation of the amino acid alanine rescues glucose-starved macrophages better than glucose, and it does so by inhibiting NINJ1 oligomerization. Moreover, C. albicans infection disrupts amino acid metabolism in mice and reduces serum alanine. Finally, NINJ1-mediated membrane rupture enables C. albicans egress from macrophages together with the toxin candidalysin. We establish the mechanism of glucose starvation-induced macrophage damage by NINJ1, and demonstrate the roles of NINJ1 and alanine in immune responses to Candida and fungal escape.

papers.title: GATHeR: graph-based accurate tool for immunoglobulin heavy- and light-chain reconstruction
papers.abstract: Recovering full-length, paired B-cell receptor (BCR) sequences from scRNA-seq reads remains difficult, especially in naive and memory B cells where immunoglobulin transcripts are sparse. Incomplete constant-region coverage in current methods limits isoform, subclass, and allele resolution. Here we present GATHeR, an open-source tool that assembles and annotates paired heavy- and light-chain BCR sequences and extends assembled sequences into constant regions. This enables confident subclass and allele assignment and recovery of membrane-bound isoforms, including the transmembrane segment and cytoplasmic tail, thereby distinguishing surface BCRs from secreted antibodies. GATHeR supports Smart-seq2/3 and 10x Genomics libraries and outperforms existing methods across benchmarks, with the largest gains in naive and memory B cells. Notably, in these populations the constant-region extension also enables detection of splice variation, including intron-containing heavy-chain transcripts with read-level support. By delivering high-fidelity receptor, isoform, and clonal lineage information, GATHeR broadens the analytical reach of scRNA-seq for B-cell immunology.

papers.title: A prognostic human brain network for diffuse midline glioma
papers.abstract: Diffuse midline gliomas (DMGs) are near-universally lethal tumours of the childhood central nervous system 1,2 . In animal models, DMGs form brain-wide integrated networks through neuron-to-glioma synapses 3-6 and glioma-to-glioma gap junctional coupling 3 . This extensive connectivity robustly promotes the growth and invasion of DMG 3-9 and other glial malignancies 10-12 through paracrine mechanisms and direct neuron-to-glioma synapses. However, the organization and clinical implications of these connections in the living human brain remain to be elucidated. Here, we develop tumour network mapping to compute the brain-wide connectivity profile of DMG, defining a conserved brain network across pontine and thalamic DMG associated with patient short-term survival (DMG network). Tumour functional connectivity with the DMG network was independently predictive of patient overall survival across two external validation cohorts. Tumour growth mapped to DMG network-specific trajectories and peak in-network neurometabolic changes across development spatiotemporally aligned with the peak age incidence of DMG. Analyses of single-nucleus RNA sequencing data confirmed diverse synaptic gene enrichment in high-connectivity DMG. Strikingly, incidental surgical resection of high-connectivity thalamic DMG tissue conferred a significant survival advantage. Collectively, these data define a conserved and prognostically important brain network in children with DMG, consistent with the hypothesis that DMGs exploit otherwise healthy brain circuits to promote tumour growth.
papers.abstractKo: 확산성 중선부 교종(diffuse midline gliomas, DMGs)은 소아 중추신경계에서 거의 예외 없이 치명적인 종양이다1,2. 동물 모델에서 DMG는 뉴런-교종 시냅스(neuron-to-glioma synapses)3-6와 교종-교종 간 gap junctional coupling3을 통해 뇌 전반에 걸친 통합 네트워크를 형성한다. 이러한 광범위한 연결성은 paracrine 기전과 직접적인 뉴런-교종 시냅스를 통해 DMG3-9 및 기타 교세포성 악성종양10-12의 성장과 침윤을 강력하게 촉진한다. 그러나 살아 있는 인간 뇌에서 이러한 연결의 조직화와 임상적 함의는 아직 밝혀지지 않았다. 여기서 우리는 종양 network mapping을 개발하여 DMG의 뇌 전반 connectivity profile을 산출하고, 뇌교(pontine) 및 시상(thalamic) DMG 전반에 걸쳐 환자의 단기 생존과 연관된 보존된 뇌 네트워크(DMG network)를 규정하였다. DMG network와의 종양 functional connectivity는 두 개의 외부 검증 코호트에서 환자의 overall survival을 독립적으로 예측하였다. 종양 성장은 DMG network 특이적 trajectory에 매핑되었고, 발달 전반에 걸친 네트워크 내 neurometabolic 변화의 최대치는 DMG의 발생 연령 최빈값과 시공간적으로 정렬되었다. 단일 핵 RNA sequencing(single-nucleus RNA sequencing) 데이터 분석은 높은 connectivity를 갖는 DMG에서 다양한 시냅스 관련 유전자(enrichment)의 증가를 확인하였다. 특히, 우연히 절제된 높은 connectivity의 시상 DMG 조직은 유의한 생존 이점을 부여하였다. 종합하면, 이들 데이터는 DMG를 가진 소아에서 보존되고 예후적으로 중요한 뇌 네트워크를 규정하며, 이는 DMG가 종양 성장을 촉진하기 위해 그렇지 않으면 정상인 뇌 회로를 이용한다는 가설과 일치한다.

papers.title: Long-range mutual activation establishes Rho and Rac polarity during cell migration
papers.abstract: In migrating cells, the GTPase Rac organizes a protrusive front, whereas Rho organizes a contractile back. How these GTPases are positioned at opposite poles remains unclear. We leverage optogenetics, mechanical perturbations, and mathematical modelling to reveal a surprising mechanochemical long-range mutual activation between front and back polarity programmes that complements their well-known local mutual inhibition. Rac-based protrusions elevate membrane tension, stimulating an mTORC2-dependent activation of Rho at the opposite side of the cell. Conversely, Rho-mediated contractility induces cortical-flow-based regulation of phosphoinositide signalling that triggers Rac activation distally. We develop a minimal mechanochemical model to explain how long-range facilitation, together with local inhibition, enables robust Rho and Rac partitioning. Our findings demonstrate how the actin cortex and plasma membrane interact as an integrated mechanochemical system for long-range Rac-Rho patterning. This circuit is required for efficient polarity and migration in primary human T cells and is conserved in epithelial cells, highlighting the generality of this mechanism.

Rac 기반 돌출은 막 장력(membrane tension)을 증가시켜 세포의 반대편에서 mTORC2 의존적 Rho 활성화를 자극한다. 반대로 Rho 매개 수축성(contractility)은 세포질 피질 흐름(cortical-flow)-기반 phosphoinositide 신호전달 조절을 유도하여 원위부(distally)에서 Rac 활성화를 촉발한다. 우리는 장거리 촉진(long-range facilitation)이 국소 억제와 결합하여 어떻게 강인한 Rho 및 Rac 분할(partitioning)을 가능하게 하는지 설명하는 최소 기계화학적 모델(minimal mechanochemical model)을 개발하였다. 우리의 결과는 actin cortex와 plasma membrane이 장거리 Rac-Rho 패터닝(patterning)을 위한 통합된 기계화학 시스템으로 상호작용함을 보여준다. 이 회로는 일차 human T cells에서 효율적인 극성 및 이동에 필요하며, 상피세포(epithelial cells)에서도 보존되어 있어 이 기전의 일반성을 강조한다.
