CUT&RUN profiling은 LSD1이 retinoid metabolism, lipid homeostasis, 및 immune genes에서 AP-1 motif가 풍부한 enhancer 영역을 점유함을 보여주었다. LSD1 소실은 이러한 부위에서 H3K4me1/2 및 유전자 활성화를 증가시켜, 준비 상태(poised)의 AP-1-retinoid program에 허가를 부여하였다. 단일세포 공간 분석(single-cell spatial analyses)은 분리된 keratinocyte 아집단이 dendritic cells를 모집하고 CD4+ T cell 반응을 활성화하기 위해 retinoid signaling을 개시함을 보여주었다. 국소적 LSD1 억제는 2개의 모델에서 피부 편평세포암(cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma)을 억제하는 동시에 keratinocyte-immune cell crosstalk를 증폭시켰다. 기능적 교란은 retinoid signaling이 이에 부분적으로 기여하는 반면, CD4+ T cells는 종양 제어에 필수적임을 밝혔다. 이러한 결과는 LSD1을 상피 면역 역량(epithelial immune competence)의 핵심 억제자로 규정하고, LSD1 억제를 retinoid-AP-1 enhancer circuit를 활성화하여 피부암에서 CD4 의존적 종양 면역을 유도하는 치료 전략으로 제시한다.

papers.title: CD8+ T cell loss induces autoinflammation in inborn errors of cell death
papers.abstract: Systemic autoinflammatory diseases (SAID) with inborn errors of cell death (IECD) are caused by overactivation of programmed cell death (PCD). However, the pathogenesis by which PCD leads to autoinflammation remains unclear. Here, we identified IECD patients carrying compound heterozygous RIPK1 variants K377E/R390G with autoinflammatory manifestations. Mechanistically, K377E and R390G mutations suppress NF-κB signaling and activate RIPK1 to promote cell death. CD8 + T cells of the patients displayed overactivated RIPK1 and excessive cell death, leading to an elevated CD4/CD8 ratio, which could also be detected in patients with cleavage-resistant mutation of RIPK1 or SHARPIN deficiency. We show that the increased cell death of CD8 + T cells promotes TNF and IFN-γ secretion to activate monocytes/macrophages, which triggers overproduction of proinflammatory cytokines. In addition, disruption of the communication between T cells and monocytes/macrophages through pharmacologic blockade of TNF and IFN attenuates proinflammatory cytokine production in macrophages and relieves all the symptoms in patients. This study further clarifies the mechanism for a group of IECD with SAID. Increased CD4/CD8 ratio and augmented RIPK1 activation in T cells provide potentially additional criteria for diagnosis of RIPK1-dependent IECD and a combination of TNF/JAK inhibitor could be an effective therapy for the diagnosed patients.
papers.abstractKo: 세포사(programmed cell death, PCD)의 선천적 이상(inborn errors of cell death, IECD)에 의한 전신 자가염증성 질환(systemic autoinflammatory diseases, SAID)은 PCD의 과활성화에 의해 발생한다. 그러나 PCD가 자가염증으로 이어지는 발병 기전은 아직 명확하지 않다. 여기서 우리는 자가염증성 표현형을 보이는 복합 이형접합 RIPK1 변이 K377E/R390G를 보유한 IECD 환자들을 확인하였다. 기전적으로, K377E 및 R390G 변이는 NF-κB 신호전달을 억제하고 RIPK1을 활성화하여 세포사를 촉진한다. 환자의 CD8 + T 세포는 과활성화된 RIPK1과 과도한 세포사를 나타냈으며, 이는 상승된 CD4/CD8 비율로 이어졌고, 이는 RIPK1의 절단 저항성(cleavage-resistant) 변이 또는 SHARPIN 결핍 환자에서도 검출될 수 있었다. 우리는 CD8 + T 세포의 증가된 세포사가 TNF 및 IFN-γ 분비를 촉진하여 단핵구/대식세포를 활성화하고, 그 결과 proinflammatory cytokines의 과생산을 유발함을 보여준다. 또한 TNF와 IFN의 약리학적 차단을 통해 T 세포와 단핵구/대식세포 간의 소통을 차단하면 대식세포에서 proinflammatory cytokines 생산이 감소하고 환자들의 모든 증상이 완화된다. 본 연구는 SAID를 동반한 IECD의 한 군에 대한 기전을 추가로 규명한다. papers.title: Peritumoural adipose tissue promotes ferroptosis resistance by 3-hydroxykynurenine-mediated suppression of ferritinophagy
papers.abstract: The peritumoural adipose tissue (PAT) is a key contributor to cancer therapy resistance, yet its role in regulating ferroptosis remains unclear. Here we demonstrate that PAT confers ferroptosis resistance to cancer cells by upregulating ferritin (FTH1/FTL) and sequestering intracellular iron. PAT-derived kynurenine (KYN) was identified as the principal mediator. KYN is taken up by cancer cells and metabolized to 3-hydroxykynurenine, which directly binds to nuclear receptor coactivator 4 (NCOA4). This interaction inhibits NCOA4-mediated ferritinophagy, preventing ferritin degradation and limiting the free iron pool required for ferroptosis. In murine models, pharmacological inhibition of the KYN pathway synergized with PD-1 blockade to overcome ferroptosis resistance and suppress tumour progression. These findings reveal a PAT-KYN-ferritinophagy axis that promotes ferroptosis resistance, highlighting the potential of targeting adipose-tumour cross-talk to enhance immunotherapy in PAT-associated tumours.
papers.abstractKo: 종양주위 지방조직(peritumoural adipose tissue, PAT)은 암 치료 저항성의 주요 기여 인자이나, ferroptosis 조절에서의 역할은 아직 명확하지 않다. 본 연구에서는 PAT가 ferritin(FTH1/FTL)을 상향조절하고 세포내 철을 격리함으로써 암세포에 ferroptosis 저항성을 부여함을 입증하였다. PAT 유래 kynurenine(KYN)이 주요 매개인자로 확인되었다. KYN은 암세포로 유입되어 3-hydroxykynurenine으로 대사되며, 이는 nuclear receptor coactivator 4(NCOA4)에 직접 결합한다. 이러한 상호작용은 NCOA4 매개 ferritinophagy를 억제하여 ferritin 분해를 방지하고 ferroptosis에 필요한 자유 철 저장고(free iron pool)를 제한한다. 마우스 모델에서 KYN pathway의 약리학적 억제는 PD-1 blockade와 상승적으로 작용하여 ferroptosis 저항성을 극복하고 종양 진행을 억제하였다. 이러한 발견은 ferroptosis 저항성을 촉진하는 PAT-KYN-ferritinophagy 축을 제시하며, PAT 연관 종양에서 면역치료를 강화하기 위해 지방조직-종양 상호작용(adipose-tumour cross-talk)을 표적으로 삼을 가능성을 강조한다.

papers.title: FYN/LCK kinase balance as a metabolic switch orchestrates progenitor-exhausted T-cell differentiation in hepatocellular carcinoma
papers.abstract: Background and aims Immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) shows therapeutic promise in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) but is associated with suboptimal responses in patients. Progenitor-exhausted T (Tpex) cells are key responders to ICB, but the regulatory mechanisms governing Tpex maintenance in HCC remain elusive. Approach and results Through an integrated analysis of HCC single-cell RNA-sequencing datasets, we constructed an exhausted CD8 + T-cell atlas and identified the kinase FYN as a marker of Tpex cells in ICB responders. FYN deficiency in CD8 + T cells induced LCK hyperactivation, which drove terminal exhaustion under high-affinity antigen stimulation. Mechanistically, LCK hyperactivation disrupted metabolic homeostasis by triggering excessive glycolysis and impairing mitochondrial function in Tpex cells. Conversely, LCK inhibition elevated compensatory FYN activity, restored mitochondrial fitness, and preserved Tpex cell stemness. In preclinical HCC models, transient LCK inhibition during T-cell expansion enhanced adoptive cell therapy efficacy by increasing Tpex cell persistence and stemness. Additionally, preemptive low-dose LCK inhibition before anti-PD-1 therapy expanded the Tpex cell pool, reduced terminal exhaustion, and improved therapeutic outcomes. Conclusions This study establishes the FYN/LCK balance as a critical regulator of the terminal exhaustion of Tpex cells through metabolic reprogramming. These findings suggest that modulating the FYN/LCK kinase balance is a promising strategy to overcome immunotherapy resistance in HCC.
papers.abstractKo: 배경 및 목적 면역관문차단(immune checkpoint blockade, ICB)은 간세포암(hepatocellular carcinoma, HCC)에서 치료적 가능성을 보이지만, 환자에서 최적 이하의 반응과 연관되어 있다. 전구체-소진(progenitor-exhausted, Tpex) T 세포는 ICB에 대한 핵심 반응 세포이지만, HCC에서 Tpex 유지에 관여하는 조절 기전은 아직 명확히 밝혀지지 않았다. 접근 및 결과 HCC 단일세포 RNA 시퀀싱(single-cell RNA-sequencing) 데이터셋의 통합 분석을 통해, 우리는 소진된 CD8 + T 세포 아틀라스(atlas)를 구축하고 ICB 반응자에서 Tpex 세포의 표지자로서 kinase FYN을 확인하였다. CD8 + T 세포에서 FYN 결핍은 LCK의 과활성화(hyperactivation)를 유도하였고, 이는 높은 친화성 항원 자극 하에서 말기 소진(terminal exhaustion)을 촉진하였다. 기전적으로, LCK 과활성화는 과도한 해당작용(glycolysis)을 유발하고 미토콘드리아 기능을 손상시킴으로써 Tpex 세포의 대사 항상성(metabolic homeostasis)을 붕괴시켰다. 반대로, LCK 억제는 보상적 FYN 활성을 증가시키고, 미토콘드리아 적합성(mitochondrial fitness)을 회복시켰으며, Tpex 세포의 stemness를 보존하였다. 전임상 HCC 모델에서 T 세포 확장 동안의 일시적 LCK 억제는 Tpex 세포의 지속성(persistence)과 stemness를 증가시켜 adoptive cell therapy의 효능을 향상시켰다. 또한 anti-PD-1 치료 전에 저용량 LCK 억제를 선제적으로(preemptive) 시행하면 Tpex 세포 풀(pool)이 확장되고, 말기 소진이 감소하며, 치료 결과가 개선되었다. 결론 본 연구는 FYN/LCK 균형이 대사 재프로그래밍(metabolic reprogramming)을 통해 Tpex 세포의 말기 소진을 조절하는 핵심 조절자임을 확립한다. 이러한 결과는 FYN/LCK kinase 균형을 조절하는 것이 HCC에서 면역치료 저항성을 극복하기 위한 유망한 전략임을 시사한다.

papers.title: NCX1 reverse mode promotes calcium-dependent Neutrophil Extracellular Trap formation and lung damage in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
papers.abstract: Neutrophil-driven inflammation is central to the pathogenesis of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Emerging evidence suggests that Ca²⁺ signaling is critical in regulating neutrophil activation, recruitment and tissue residency. In this study, we investigated the function of Na⁺/Ca²⁺ exchanger 1 (NCX1), a Ca²⁺/cation membrane transporter, in neutrophils during COPD pathogenesis. Analysis of human specimens show that NCX1 is primarily upregulated in neutrophils from patients with mixed chronic bronchitis and emphysema. Cigarette smoke exposure induces NCX1 upregulation and promotes its reverse-mode transport activity, leading to elevated intracellular Ca²⁺ levels and enhanced NETs formation. Neutrophil-specific genetic deletion of Slc8a1 or pharmacological inhibition of NCX1 reverse transport effectively suppresses Ca²⁺ influx, NETs release, and neutrophil accumulation and retention, thereby ameliorating chronic bronchitis and emphysematous changes. Collectively, our findings identify NCX1 as a regulator of Ca²⁺-dependent NETs release in neutrophils. Targeting NCX1-mediated Ca²⁺ influx or NETs formation represents a potential therapeutic strategy for neutrophilic inflammation in COPD.

papers.title: Proteomic landscape of Ewing sarcoma primary tumors and metastases
papers.abstract: Ewing sarcoma (EWS), a rare pediatric bone tumor, poses unique therapeutic challenges due to its distinct microenvironment and limited molecular understanding. To gain a comprehensive molecular and functional view of the tumors in their microenvironment, we perform a deep mass spectrometry-based proteomic analysis of 170 tumor samples from 74 patients from primary, relapsed, and metastatic tumors. Analysis of more than 10,000 proteins across patients reveals insights into cancer prognosis, chemo-resistance, and progression. Our analyses suggest that ferroptosis pathways may be associated with chemotherapy response in EWS, and we delineate molecular subclasses that correlate the tumor immune landscape with DNA damage repair, ubiquitin-related proteins, and patient outcomes. Multiplexed immunofluorescence imaging indicates possible associations between neutrophils and poorer prognosis, and between macrophages/T cells and a more favorable prognosis. Altogether, this investigation provides valuable insights into the intricate biology of EWS, paving the way for developing therapeutic strategies.
papers.abstractKo: Ewing sarcoma(EWS)는 드문 소아 뼈 종양으로, 그 독특한 미세환경과 제한된 분자적 이해로 인해 독특한 치료적 도전을 제기한다. 미세환경 내 종양에 대한 포괄적인 분자 및 기능적 관점을 얻기 위해, 우리는 원발성, 재발성 및 전이성 종양으로부터 74명의 환자에서 얻은 170개의 종양 시료에 대해 심층 mass spectrometry 기반 proteomic 분석을 수행하였다. 환자 전반에 걸쳐 10,000개 이상의 단백질을 분석한 결과는 암 예후, 항암화학요법 저항성 및 진행에 대한 통찰을 제공한다. 우리의 분석은 ferroptosis 경로가 EWS에서 항암화학요법 반응과 연관될 수 있음을 시사하며, 또한 종양 면역 landscape를 DNA 손상 복구, ubiquitin 관련 단백질 및 환자 결과와 연관시키는 분자적 아형을 규명하였다. Multiplexed immunofluorescence 이미징은 neutrophils와 더 나쁜 예후 사이, 그리고 macrophages/T cells와 더 유리한 예후 사이의 가능한 연관성을 시사한다. 종합하면, 본 연구는 EWS의 복잡한 생물학에 대한 귀중한 통찰을 제공하며, 치료 전략 개발을 위한 길을 닦는다.

papers.title: Facile induction of immune tolerance by an interleukin-2–TGFβ surrogate agonist
papers.abstract: CD4 + regulatory T cells (T reg cells) are essential for immune tolerance 1 . Peripherally induced T reg cells (pT reg cells) complement thymic T reg cells by broadening T reg cell reactivity in response to a changing antigenic landscape 2 . Although both TGFβ and IL-2 synergistically promote functional pT reg cell development in vitro 3-6 , their combined roles in inducing pT reg cell generation in vivo have not been exploited for tolerizing immunotherapy. Here we designed an IL-2-TGFβ 'surrogate' co-agonist by creating a single-chain fusion protein between IL-2 and a low-affinity TGFβ mimic agonist derived from a helminth parasite 7 . This IL-2-TGFβ surrogate functions as an AND-gated co-agonist and enabled simultaneous cis-activation of IL-2-STAT5 and TGFβ-SMAD2/3 signalling specifically in T cells that express IL-2 receptors. The IL-2-TGFβ surrogate agonist robustly induced antigen-specific, functional and stable pT reg cells in vivo within peripheral lymphoid organs in mice immunized with ovalbumin (OVA) and myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein (MOG) 35-55 . The induced pT reg cells display an effector-like, actively expanding state with high RORγt expression, enabling efficient migration and suppression of intestinal inflammation. Treatment with this agonist effectively quelled immune activation in mouse models of allergen-induced allergic inflammation and self-antigen-driven autoimmune neuroinflammation, suggesting a strategy for the induction of antigen-specific pT reg cells in vivo to establish immune tolerance in inflammatory, allergic and autoimmune diseases.
papers.abstractKo: CD4 + 조절 T 세포(T reg cells)는 면역 관용(immune tolerance)에 필수적이다 1 . 말초 유도 T reg 세포(peripherally induced T reg cells, pT reg cells)는 변화하는 항원 환경에 대한 T reg 세포 반응성을 확장함으로써 흉선 유래 T reg 세포(thymic T reg cells)를 보완한다 2 . TGFβ와 IL-2는 모두 시험관 내(in vitro)에서 기능적 pT reg 세포의 발달을 상승적으로 촉진하지만 3-6 , pT reg 세포 생성을 유도하는 데 있어 이들의 결합된 in vivo 역할은 관용 유도 면역치료(tolerizing immunotherapy)에 활용된 바 없다. 여기서 우리는 기생충(helminth parasite)에서 유래한 낮은 친화성의 TGFβ mimic agonist로부터 얻은 IL-2와의 단일가닥 융합 단백질(single-chain fusion protein)을 생성함으로써 IL-2-TGFβ ‘surrogate’ 공동 작용제(co-agonist)를 설계하였다 7 . 이 IL-2-TGFβ surrogate는 AND-gated co-agonist로 기능하며, IL-2 수용체를 발현하는 T 세포에서만 IL-2-STAT5 및 TGFβ-SMAD2/3 신호전달의 동시에 cis-activation을 가능하게 하였다. IL-2-TGFβ surrogate agonist는 ovalbumin(OVA) 및 myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein(MOG) 35-55로 면역화한 마우스의 말초 림프기관(peripheral lymphoid organs) 내에서 in vivo 항원-특이적, 기능적이며 안정적인 pT reg 세포를 강력하게 유도하였다. 유도된 pT reg 세포는 높은 RORγt 발현을 갖는 effector-like, actively expanding 상태를 나타내어 장 염증의 효율적인 이동과 억제를 가능하게 한다. 이 agonist로의 치료는 알레르겐 유도 알레르기 염증 및 자가항원 구동 자가면역 신경염증의 마우스 모델에서 면역 활성화를 효과적으로 억제하였으며, 이는 염증성, 알레르기성 및 자가면역 질환에서 면역 관용을 확립하기 위해 in vivo에서 항원-특이적 pT reg 세포를 유도하는 전략을 시사한다.

papers.title: Intravenous albumin after outpatient paracentesis reduces the risk of AKI hospitalization: A national cohort study
papers.abstract: Background and aims Guidelines recommend i.v. albumin after large-volume paracentesis to prevent postparacentesis circulatory dysfunction and acute kidney injury (AKI). However, real-world effects of albumin on paracentesis outcomes in outpatient settings are understudied. We aimed to address this using national data from a well-established cirrhosis cohort. Approach and results This was a retrospective cohort study of Veterans with cirrhosis undergoing outpatient paracentesis. Albumin administration and paracentesis volumes were extracted, in addition to hospitalization for AKI within 7 days of outpatient paracentesis. Mixed-effects logistic regression identified factors associated with albumin administration and the association between albumin and incident AKI hospitalization. Among 9467 patients who received 56,941 outpatient paracentesis procedures, i.v. albumin was used 17% of the time. The use was higher with Model for End-Stage Liver Disease-Sodium; (OR: 1.02, 95% CI: 1.02-1.03, p Conclusions Albumin administration after outpatient paracentesis was associated with a reduced risk of hospitalization with AKI, with a greater effect at lower estimated glomerular filtration rates. Strategies that tailor albumin administration based on intravascular volume and hemodynamics should be prospectively tested.

papers.title: Impaired glycosylation promotes rapid transition to hepatocellular carcinoma in model of diet-induced steatotic liver disease
papers.abstract: Obesity-linked steatosis is a significant risk factor for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC); however, the molecular mechanisms underlying the transition from metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) to HCC remain unclear. Here, we explored the role of the ER-associated protein NgBR, an essential component of the cis-prenyltransferase (cis-PTase) enzyme, in chronic liver disease. Hepatocyte-specific NgBR deletion in mice (N-LKO) intensified triacylglycerol (TAG) accumulation, inflammatory responses, ER/oxidative stress, and fibrosis, ultimately resulting in HCC development with 100% penetrance after 4 months on a high-fat diet. Similarly, liver-specific knockout of DHDDS, NgBR's cis-PTase partner, and a knockin model carrying a human NgBR mutation that impairs cis-PTase activity developed HCC under high-fat diet conditions, although with lower penetrance. A single-cell transcriptomic atlas from affected livers provides a detailed molecular analysis of the transition from liver pathophysiology to HCC development. Mechanistically, NgBR deficiency promoted excessive hepatic TAG accumulation by enhancing lipid uptake and impairing VLDL secretion. Importantly, pharmacological inhibition of diacylglycerol acyltransferase-2 (DGAT2), a key enzyme in TAG synthesis, abrogated diet-induced liver damage and HCC burden in N-LKO mice. Overall, our findings establish cis-PTase as a critical suppressor of MASLD-HCC conversion and suggest DGAT2 inhibition may serve as a promising therapeutic approach to delay HCC formation in advanced metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis.

papers.title: The liver regulates ectopic calcification in Abcc6-deficient models of pseudoxanthoma elasticum
papers.abstract: Pseudoxanthoma Elasticum (PXE) is a rare disease caused by loss of function of the ATP-binding cassette C (ABC) member 6 (Abcc6) gene and characterized by ectopic calcification of multiple tissues, but the physiological reasons underlying ectopic calcification in PXE remain unclear. In a murine model of Abcc6-deficient PXE in which animals developed robust cardiac calcification after heart injury, we show the critical importance of the liver in mediating ectopic cardiac calcification. Tissue-specific deletion of Abcc6 in the liver, but not in the heart, was sufficient to cause post-injury cardiac calcification. Metabolomics and gene expression analysis demonstrated deficiencies in nucleotide metabolism, cellular energetics, and defects in cellular respiration underlying ectopic calcification in PXE. Functional abnormalities in cellular respiration in the injured heart were similar in animals with global or liver-specific Abcc6 deficiency, showing that hepatic Abcc6 expression regulated cellular respiration in the injured heart. We show that ectopic calcification in PXE was primarily dystrophic and that treatment with clodronate or etidronate, which prevent the growth of calcium hydroxyapatite mineralization, was sufficient to rescue the phenotype of ectopic cardiac calcification in Abcc6-deficient states. Taken together, these observations highlight the role of the liver in regulating target tissue metabolic and mitochondrial function in causing ectopic calcification in Abcc6-deficient states.

Metabolomics와 유전자 발현 분석은 PXE의 이소성 석회화의 기저에 nucleotide metabolism, cellular energetics의 결함, 그리고 cellular respiration의 이상이 있음을 입증하였다. 손상된 심장에서의 cellular respiration의 기능적 이상은 전신적(global) Abcc6 결핍 또는 간 특이적 Abcc6 결핍을 가진 동물들에서 유사하였으며, 이는 간의 Abcc6 발현이 손상된 심장의 cellular respiration을 조절함을 보여준다. 우리는 PXE에서의 이소성 석회화가 주로 dystrophic하였으며, calcium hydroxyapatite mineralization의 성장을 억제하는 clodronate 또는 etidronate 치료가 Abcc6 결핍 상태에서 이소성 심장 석회화 표현형을 회복시키기에 충분했음을 보여주었다. 종합하면, 이러한 관찰은 Abcc6 결핍 상태에서 이소성 석회화를 유발하는 표적 조직의 대사 및 미토콘드리아 기능을 조절하는 데 있어 간의 역할을 강조한다.

papers.title: Simultaneous spatial transcriptomics and morphology profiling as tools to explore how microglia change with age
papers.abstract: Cellular morphology is tightly linked to function, but how subcellular transcript localization contributes remains unclear. Using microglia, the brain's resident macrophages, as a model, we combined multiplexed error-robust fluorescence in situ hybridization with immunohistochemistry to map how morphology and subcellular mRNA localization interact with function in young and aged mouse brains. We show that mRNA spatial organization varies across microglial states and defines distinct localization patterns within their processes, revealing morphological heterogeneity within transcriptomically defined populations. Notably, we found a subpopulation of disease-associated-like microglia with a ramified morphology (that is, displaying numerous processes), challenging the conventional assumption between morphology and microglial states. Finally, we found that aging may reshape mRNA distributions and their co-localization networks, shifting microglial programs from intracellular signaling and regulation of phagocytosis toward migration and catabolic regulation. Our findings highlight the role of subcellular transcript organization in shaping microglial morphology and function, offering new avenues for studying and modulating microglial states in health, disease and aging.
papers.abstractKo: 세포 형태(cellular morphology)는 기능과 밀접하게 연관되어 있지만, 세포소기관 이하(subcellular) 전사체 국소화(transcript localization)가 이에 어떻게 기여하는지는 명확하지 않다. 뇌 상주 대식세포(brain's resident macrophages)인 미세아교세포(microglia)를 모델로 하여, 우리는 다중화된 오차 강건 형광 제자리 혼성화(multiplexed error-robust fluorescence in situ hybridization)와 면역조직화학(immunohistochemistry)을 결합하여 어린 및 노령 마우스 뇌에서 형태와 세포소기관 이하 mRNA 국소화가 기능과 어떻게 상호작용하는지 지도화하였다. 우리는 mRNA의 공간적 조직(spatial organization)이 미세아교세포 상태(state)에 따라 달라지며, 그 돌기(processes) 내에서 서로 다른 국소화 패턴을 규정하여 전사체학적으로 정의된 집단 내에서 형태학적 이질성(morphological heterogeneity)을 드러냄을 보여준다. 특히, 우리는 가지상 형태(ramified morphology, 즉 수많은 돌기(processes)를 보이는)를 갖는 질병 연관 유사(disease-associated-like) 미세아교세포의 하위집단을 발견하였으며, 이는 형태와 미세아교세포 상태 사이의 기존 가정에 도전한다. 마지막으로, 우리는 노화가 mRNA 분포와 이들의 공국소화 네트워크(co-localization networks)를 재구성하여, 미세아교세포 프로그램을 세포내 신호전달(intracellular signaling) 및 식세포작용(phagocytosis) 조절에서 이동(migration)과 이화작용 조절(catabolic regulation)로 전환시킬 수 있음을 발견하였다. 우리의 연구 결과는 미세아교세포의 형태와 기능을 형성하는 데 있어 세포소기관 이하 전사체 조직(subcellular transcript organization)의 역할을 강조하며, 건강, 질병 및 노화에서 미세아교세포 상태를 연구하고 조절하기 위한 새로운 방향을 제시한다.

papers.title: Cell type-specific epigenetic regulatory circuitry of coronary artery disease loci
papers.abstract: Coronary artery disease is the leading cause of death worldwide. Recently, hundreds of genomic loci have been shown to increase risk for the disease, however, the molecular mechanisms underlying signals from risk loci remain largely unclear. Here, we integrate the latest statistics of coronary artery disease genetics from over one million individuals with epigenetic data from 45 cell types to identify genes and transcription factors whose regulation is affected by variants. Applying two statistical approaches, we identify 1580 candidate disease genes, including 23.5% non-coding RNA genes. Enrichment analysis and phenome-wide association studies link the candidate genes to disease-specific pathways and risk factors. We conduct a proof-of-concept biological validation for the non-coding RNA gene IQCH-AS1 via knockout in a human preadipocyte strain. Our study not only pinpoints CAD candidate genes in a cell type-specific manner but also highlights the roles of an understudied ncRNA gene in CAD genetics.

papers.title: Graft-derived VWF drives platelet activation and thrombocytopenia during porcine liver xenotransplantation to brain-dead human recipients
papers.abstract: BACKGROUNDGenetically engineered porcine livers are being developed as a bridge therapy for acute liver failure, providing detoxification and restoration of hepatic protein synthesis. Severe xenograft-associated thrombocytopenia remains a major limitation, and human mechanistic data are scarce.METHODSPlatelet kinetics were characterized in 3 human decedents undergoing extracorporeal cross-circulation with transgenic porcine livers. Platelet counts, transfusion requirements, and clearance patterns were assessed to distinguish consumption from marrow suppression or hypersplenism. Antibody- and complement-directed inhibitors were administered to test immune-mediated mechanisms. Mechanistic studies focused on porcine von Willebrand factor-dependent (pVWF-dependent) platelet activation, including ex vivo blockade with the anti-VWF nanobody caplacizumab, a VWF-directed antibody fragment that prevents VWF-platelet binding. A fourth decedent received caplacizumab during porcine liver perfusion.RESULTSIn all 3 initial cases, 80%-90% of circulating and transfused platelets were rapidly cleared, a pattern inconsistent with marrow suppression or hypersplenism. Antibody and complement inhibition failed to ameliorate thrombocytopenia. Recipient plasma induced robust pVWF-mediated platelet activation analogous to human type IIb von Willebrand disease, which was completely abrogated ex vivo by caplacizumab. In a fourth decedent treated with caplacizumab, aberrant platelet activation was prevented, although full hematologic recovery was limited by preexisting disseminated intravascular coagulation.CONCLUSIONSEarly thrombocytopenia during porcine liver xenotransplantation appears to be primarily driven by pVWF-mediated platelet activation rather than by classical immune or splenic mechanisms. Targeted VWF blockade with agents such as caplacizumab may mitigate platelet loss and improve the safety profile of extracorporeal porcine liver support in acute liver failure.

papers.title: A large-scale genome-wide association meta-analysis for nevus count provides direct insights into the genetics of melanoma
authors: G. J. M. Shanika R. Jayasinghe
papers.abstract: A greater understanding of the biology of nevi will provide insights into the etiology of melanoma. Our large-scale meta-analysis of 14 nevus genome-wide association studies (GWAS) includes 85,965 individuals of European ancestry. We identify 29 nevus-associated loci (p -8 ), of which 24 have not been previously reported in a GWAS conducted for nevus count alone. We further identify 255 candidate genes for nevus loci, including SIKE1 which is involved in immune response regulation. This is of interest because immune response regulation influences the formation of nevi and melanoma susceptibility. Gene-set enrichment analyses prioritise immune response-related pathways and cancers that do not have a pigmentation component (e.g. breast, prostate, and glioma). This suggests that the biology underlying nevus count captures risk pathways beyond pigmentation that are relevant to melanoma. In sex-specific analyses, we observe higher total-body nevus count in females than in males, however the genetic architecture is largely shared (genetic correlation = 0.863, 95% CI = 0.453 - 1.273), indicating the difference may be influenced by environmental and behavioural factors rather than genetics. A nevus polygenic risk score explains 5% of the variance in nevus count, indicating its potential to enhance melanoma risk prediction.

papers.title: RHD6LA regulates root hair responses to both symbionts and commensals
papers.abstract: While intracellular symbiosis with rhizobia relies on Nod factor signaling through the conserved common symbiosis signaling pathway (CSSP), it remains unclear how legumes simultaneously manage interactions with commensal soil microbes. Using single cell RNA-sequencing, we show that commensal soil bacteria induce a Nod factor-independent transcriptional response in specific root hairs. This response is similar to the rhizobium response in the CSSP-deficient cyclops mutant, which is unable to accommodate rhizobia in root hair infection threads. Both responses include the nodulation gene NODULATION SIGNALING PATHWAY 2 (NSP2) and a transcription factor, which we name ROOT HAIR DEFECTIVE 6 LIKE A (RHD6LA). We show that RHD6LA is required for facilitating infection thread formation in response to rhizobia and for preventing exaggerated root hair responses to commensal soil bacteria. The overlap between commensal and symbiotic signaling highlights the complexity of legume-microbe interactions at the root hair interface and suggests additional mechanisms for microbial discrimination in rhizobium-responsive root hairs.

papers.title: Extracellular vesicle engineering using a small scaffold protein
papers.abstract: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are promising drug-delivery vehicles owing to their biocompatibility and low immunogenicity. Furthermore, we show that a truncated 144-amino acid variant, EN144, efficiently loads diverse therapeutic cargoes and outperforms conventional scaffolds. By fusing EN144 to the IL-6 decoy receptor gp130, we create engineered decoy EVs that potently inhibit inflammatory IL-6 trans-signaling. In mouse models, these EVs reduce inflammation, improve survival in sepsis, and, when targeted to cartilage, alleviate tissue damage in osteoarthritis. Our work establishes EN144 as a minimal, high-performance scaffold for EV engineering and demonstrates its broad therapeutic potential for inflammatory diseases.

papers.title: Phytochromes facilitate social behaviour in marine diatoms
papers.abstract: The phytochrome superfamily comprises photosensory proteins that enable organisms to perceive changes in light intensity and quality and is widespread across plants, fungi, algae, and microbes. In terrestrial plants, phytochromes sense red and far-red light to regulate key developmental and physiological processes. In marine environments, however, where red and far-red wavelengths penetrate only the upper few meters of water, the function of phytochromes has remained unclear. Recent work shows that diatom phytochromes exhibit photoreversible responses across a broad spectral range, extending beyond red and far-red, suggesting a role in underwater light sensing. Here, we examine the role of phytochromes in light perception and collective behavior in the marine diatom Phaeodactylum tricornutum. Comparing wild-type and phytochrome knockout strains under different light wavelengths reveals that activation of phytochromes by blue or far-red light synchronizes cell movements into a coordinated "wobbling dance." This behavior is absent in phytochrome-deficient mutants, demonstrating the essential role of phytochromes. Our results further suggest that this collective motion involves intercellular communication, potentially mediated by variable red and far-red autofluorescence. Together, these findings uncover a previously unrecognized light-driven social behavior in marine diatoms and highlight the ecological significance of phytochrome-mediated communication in microbial communities.
papers.abstractKo: 피토크롬(superfamily)은 생물체가 광도와 광질의 변화를 인지할 수 있게 하는 광감각 단백질로 구성되며, 식물, 균류, 조류, 미생물 전반에 널리 분포한다. 육상식물에서 피토크롬은 적색광과 원적색광을 감지하여 주요 발달 및 생리적 과정을 조절한다. 그러나 적색광과 원적색광 파장은 물의 상부 수 미터에만 침투하는 해양 환경에서는 피토크롬의 기능이 아직 명확하지 않다. 최근 연구는 규조류(diatom) 피토크롬이 적색광과 원적색광을 넘어서는 넓은 분광 범위에서 광가역적 반응을 나타내며, 수중 광감지에서 역할을 시사함을 보여주었다. 여기에서 우리는 해양 규조류 Phaeodactylum tricornutum에서 광인식과 집단 행동에서 피토크롬의 역할을 검토하였다. 서로 다른 광파장 조건에서 wild-type과 피토크롬 knockout strain을 비교한 결과, 청색광 또는 원적색광에 의한 피토크롬 활성화가 세포 운동을 동기화하여 조정된 "wobbling dance"로 이끈다는 것을 확인하였다. 이러한 행동은 피토크롬 결핍 mutant에서는 관찰되지 않았으며, 이는 피토크롬의 필수적 역할을 입증한다. 또한 우리의 결과는 이 집단 운동이 세포간 신호전달(intercellular communication)을 포함하며, 가변적인 적색 및 원적색 autofluorescence에 의해 매개될 가능성을 시사한다. 종합하면, 이러한 발견은 해양 규조류에서 이전에 인식되지 않았던 빛-유도 사회적 행동을 밝혀내며, 미생물 군집에서 피토크롬 매개 통신의 생태학적 중요성을 강조한다.

papers.title: Spatial single-cell proteotyping reveals immunotherapy-resistant features within the complex tumor microenvironment of metastatic NSCLC
papers.abstract: BACKGROUNDImmune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) targeting the programmed cell death 1 axis have revolutionized metastatic non-small cell lung cancer (mNSCLC) treatment. However, disease progression remains a concern, and the role of the complex tumor microenvironment (TME) in treatment failure is not fully understood.METHODSIn this biomarker study involving 103 patients with mNSCLC, including 81 patients who received ICI treatment, we evaluated the association between heterogeneous immune cell subsets and ICI efficacy through single-cell spatial profiling of pretreatment tumor tissue, using a 29-marker multiplex IHC platform built for in-depth dissection of the TME.RESULTSAmong various types of intratumoral lymphocytes, including Th1, Treg, and NK cells, only CD8+ T cells (tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes [TILs]) were associated with ICI efficacy. Computational tissue segmentation underscored the importance of direct physical interactions between CD8+ TILs and cancer cells for ICI efficacy. TIL phenotyping identified CD39/CD103/Ki-67 positivity as a hallmark of exhausted yet functional tumor-reactive CD8+ TILs. Immunosuppressive tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) and cancer-associated fibroblasts were independent unfavorable adversaries. High CD73 expression on cancer cells was suggested to confer tolerance to ICI in EGFR/ALK-oncogene+ NSCLC, potentially through M2-TAM accumulation and aberrant angiogenesis.CONCLUSIONOur study delineates the clinical relevance of heterogeneous immune cell subsets in ICI-treated mNSCLC, aiding the development of targeted therapeutic strategies.FUNDINGOsaka Cancer Society, KANAE Foundation for the Promotion of Medical Science, SGH Foundation, and YOKOYAMA Foundation for Clinical Pharmacology.

TIL phenotype 분석은 CD39/CD103/Ki-67 양성을 기능적이면서도 탈진된(exhausted yet functional) 종양 반응성 CD8+ TILs의 특징적 표지로 확인하였다. 면역억제성 종양연관 대식세포(tumor-associated macrophages, TAMs)와 cancer-associated fibroblasts는 독립적인 불리한 인자였다. 암세포에서의 높은 CD73 발현은 EGFR/ALK-oncogene+ NSCLC에서 ICI에 대한 관용(tolerance)을 부여하는 것으로 시사되었으며, 이는 M2-TAM 축적 및 비정상적 혈관신생(aberrant angiogenesis)을 통해 매개될 가능성이 있다. 결론 본 연구는 ICI 치료를 받은 mNSCLC에서 이질적인 면역세포 아형의 임상적 관련성을 규명하여, 표적 치료 전략 개발에 기여한다. 연구비 Osaka Cancer Society, KANAE Foundation for the Promotion of Medical Science, SGH Foundation, 및 YOKOYAMA Foundation for Clinical Pharmacology.

papers.title: Hepatocyte CEBPA-ORM1 axis restricts alcohol-associated liver disease
papers.abstract: Background and aims Alcohol-associated liver disease (ALD) represents a global health burden with limited therapeutic strategies. While the hepatocyte transcription factor CCAAT/enhancer-binding protein α (CEBPA) regulates hepatic gene expression and liver fibrosis, its role in ALD pathogenesis remains undefined. Here, hepatocyte CEBPA was examined for its modulation of alcohol-associated hepatic steatosis and ALD. Approach and results Hepatocyte-specific CEBPA knockout mice, adeno-associated virus serotype transduction studies, and reporter gene assays were carried out using acute and chronic mouse ALD models. Western blotting was performed on liver tissues from human patients with ALD. Hepatic CEBPA expression decreased during ALD progression in human patient cohorts. Hepatocyte-specific Cebpa -knockout mice exhibited exacerbated alcohol-associated steatosis in both the acute and chronic ALD models. Inducible ablation of CEBPA in hepatocytes during late-stage ALD, accelerated disease progression, demonstrating the persistent protective function of CEBPA. Global transcriptomics identified Orm1 encoding orosomucoid 1 (ORM1) as the top CEBPA-upregulated gene in hepatocytes, while reporter assays and chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP) revealed that CEBPA directly activated Orm1 transcription by binding CEBPA response elements upstream of the Orm1 promoter. Loss of hepatocyte ORM1 potentiated the severity of ALD in mice. Conversely, restoring CEBPA or ORM1 via i.v. adeno-associated virus serotype 8 delivery or i.p. administeration of recombinant ORM1 protein rescued hepatic lipid accumulation and reduced disease progression. Consistently, serum ORM1, a hepatocyte-secreted hepatokine, inversely correlated with ALD severity in patients. Conclusions These findings identify the hepatocyte CEBPA-ORM1 axis as a critical suppressor of ALD, offering therapeutic targets and nominating serum ORM1 as a potential biomarker for staging ALD severity.
papers.abstractKo: 배경 및 목적 알코올 관련 간질환(alcohol-associated liver disease, ALD)은 전 세계적 건강 부담을 유발하며 치료 전략은 제한적이다. 간세포 전사인자 CCAAT/enhancer-binding protein α (CEBPA)는 간 유전자 발현과 간 섬유화를 조절하지만, ALD 발병에서의 역할은 아직 규명되지 않았다. 본 연구에서는 간세포 CEBPA가 알코올 관련 간 지방증과 ALD를 어떻게 조절하는지 검토하였다. 접근법 및 결과 급성 및 만성 마우스 ALD 모델을 이용하여 간세포 특이적 CEBPA knockout 마우스, adeno-associated virus serotype transduction 연구, 및 reporter gene assay를 수행하였다. 인간 ALD 환자의 간 조직에서 Western blotting을 실시하였다. 인간 환자 코호트에서 ALD 진행 동안 간 CEBPA 발현은 감소하였다. 간세포 특이적 Cebpa knockout 마우스는 급성 및 만성 ALD 모델 모두에서 알코올 관련 지방증이 악화된 양상을 보였다. 후기 ALD 동안 간세포에서 CEBPA를 유도적으로 제거하였을 때 질환 진행이 가속화되어, CEBPA의 지속적인 보호 기능이 입증되었다. 전반적 transcriptomics 분석에서 Orm1을 암호화하는 orosomucoid 1 (ORM1)이 간세포에서 CEBPA에 의해 가장 강하게 상향조절되는 유전자임이 확인되었고, reporter assay 및 chromatin immunoprecipitation(ChIP)은 CEBPA가 Orm1 promoter 상류의 CEBPA response element에 결합함으로써 Orm1 transcription을 직접 활성화함을 보여주었다. 간세포 ORM1의 결손은 마우스에서 ALD의 중증도를 증가시켰다. 반대로, i.v. adeno-associated virus serotype 8 전달 또는 i.p. 재조합 ORM1 단백질 투여를 통해 CEBPA 또는 ORM1을 회복시키면 간 지질 축적이 구조되었고 질환 진행이 감소하였다. 일관되게, 간세포 분비 hepatokine인 혈청 ORM1은 환자에서 ALD 중증도와 역상관을 보였다. 결론 이러한 결과는 간세포 CEBPA-ORM1 축을 ALD의 중요한 억제인자로 규명하며, 치료 표적을 제시하고 혈청 ORM1을 ALD 중증도 단계화를 위한 잠재적 바이오마커로 제안한다.

papers.title: Hyperinsulinaemia as a cause of obesity and cardiometabolic diseases
papers.abstract: This narrative Review explores the role of hyperinsulinaemia as a potential independent contributor to obesity and cardiometabolic diseases. We argue that scientific discussions about the role of hyperinsulinaemia as a causal factor in these conditions have not sufficiently distinguished between postprandial insulin excursions and chronically elevated basal levels of insulin. We summarize findings from observational and experimental human trials, as well as preclinical models, and outline how reasonable evidence suggests that chronic (basal) exposure to elevated levels of insulin, rather than normal postprandial insulin excursions in isolation, might have a role in promoting or exacerbating the development of adiposity. We discuss the putative contributors to hyperinsulinaemia, including genetic predisposition, early-life influences, diet, environmental pollutants and physical inactivity, highlighting causality knowledge gaps relevant to the prevention of obesity and cardiometabolic diseases.
papers.abstractKo: 이 서술적 리뷰(narrative Review)는 비만 및 심심대사성 질환에 대한 잠재적 독립 기여 인자로서 고인슐린혈증(hyperinsulinaemia)의 역할을 탐구한다. 우리는 이러한 상태에서 고인슐린혈증이 인과적 요인으로서 수행하는 역할에 관한 과학적 논의가 식후 인슐린 상승(postprandial insulin excursions)과 만성적으로 상승된 기저 인슐린 수치(chronically elevated basal levels of insulin)를 충분히 구분하지 못해 왔다고 주장한다. 우리는 관찰 및 실험적 인체 시험(observational and experimental human trials), 그리고 전임상 모델(preclinical models)로부터의 결과를 요약하고, 정상적인 식후 인슐린 상승을 단독으로 보는 것보다, 상승된 인슐린 수준에 대한 만성적(basal) 노출이 지방축적(adiposity)의 발달을 촉진하거나 악화하는 데 역할을 할 수 있음을 시사하는 타당한 근거를 어떻게 제시하는지 개괄한다. 우리는 유전적 소인(genetic predisposition), 초기 생애 영향(early-life influences), 식이(diet), 환경 오염물질(environmental pollutants), 신체 비활동(physical inactivity)을 포함한 고인슐린혈증의 추정 기여 요인(putative contributors)을 논의하며, 비만 및 심심대사성 질환의 예방과 관련된 인과성 지식 공백(causality knowledge gaps)을 강조한다.

papers.title: Single-cell genomics highlight MYC-associated metabolic activation and altered cell interactions in T-prolymphocytic leukemia progression
papers.abstract: T-prolymphocytic leukemia (T-PLL) typically presents with rapidly progressing tumor burden. However, 15-25% of cases are diagnosed at an indolent stage with asymptomatic and stable low-level blood lymphocytosis over up to 2-3 years before advancing to active-stage disease. To define the molecular changes underlying this transition, we perform single-cell RNA sequencing of 28 treatment-naïve samples including 11 longitudinally acquired indolent/active pairs, paralleled by longitudinal whole genome sequencing. This reveals both patient-specific lesions and common global alterations of gene expression. Strong upregulations of MYC-target gene signatures in active T-PLL samples associated with enhanced energy metabolism implicate acquired autonomy from energetic restrictions. Recurrent downregulation of genes of the T-cell-receptor signaling cascade and reduced interactions of the T-PLL cell with non-leukemic cell types further indicate progressive independence from regulatory survival signals and escape from micromilieu-mediated control. This single-cell and disease-stage resolved genomic analysis of T-PLL provides insights into shared mechanisms of tumor evolution, which have to prove their amenability as targetable lesions.
papers.abstractKo: T-전림프구성 백혈병(T-prolymphocytic leukemia, T-PLL)은 일반적으로 빠르게 진행하는 종양 부담을 보인다. 그러나 15–25%의 증례는 무증상이며 안정적인 저수준 혈중 림프구증가증(low-level blood lymphocytosis)을 보이는 indolent stage에서 진단되며, 활성기(active-stage) 질환으로 진행하기 전까지 최대 2–3년 동안 이러한 상태가 지속된다. 이러한 전이를 뒷받침하는 분자적 변화를 규명하기 위해, 우리는 11쌍의 종적 획득(longitudinally acquired)된 indolent/active pair를 포함한 28개의 치료 경험이 없는 치료 전 샘플에서 single-cell RNA sequencing을 수행하였고, 이를 종적 whole genome sequencing과 병행하였다. 그 결과 환자 특이적 병변과 더불어 유전자 발현의 공통적인 전반적 변화가 확인되었다. 활성 T-PLL 샘플에서 에너지 대사 증가와 연관된 MYC-target gene signatures의 강한 상향조절은 에너지적 제한으로부터의 획득된 자율성을 시사한다. 또한 T-cell-receptor signaling cascade 유전자들의 반복적인 하향조절과 T-PLL 세포와 비백혈병성(non-leukemic) 세포 유형 간 상호작용의 감소는 조절성 생존 신호로부터의 점진적 독립성과 미세환경(micromilieu) 매개 통제로부터의 회피를 추가로 시사한다. 질병 단계별로 해상된 이러한 T-PLL의 single-cell 및 genomic 분석은 종양 진화의 공통 기전에 대한 통찰을 제공하며, 이러한 기전이 표적화 가능한 병변으로서의 치료 가능성에 적합한지 입증되어야 한다.

papers.title: Unbiased recording and identification of thymic cellular interactomes using synthetic Notch receptors
papers.abstract: Cellular interactions between thymocytes and other immune and stromal thymic cells play a key role in T cell maturation and homeostasis. Previous efforts delineating the cellular interactomes that support T cell development have mostly relied on imaging techniques, genetic deletion of essential molecular factors and bone marrow chimeras. Here, using synthetic NOTCH receptors we took a direct and unbiased genetic approach to fluorescently label cells in physical contact with CD4 + and CD4 + CD8 + thymocytes in vivo in mice. Prospective isolation and transcriptional characterization at single-cell level of the interacting cells exposed the thymic cellular interactome that supports these T cells and how ageing erodes these interactions. Cellular interactors included, among others, dendritic cells, B cells, IL-17 + γδ T cells, fibroblast subsets and thymic epithelial cells. Ligand-receptor pair analyses highlighted signals involved in survival, differentiation and antigen presentation. Our work provides a new means to study thymic cellular interactions.
papers.abstractKo: 흉선세포(thymocytes)와 다른 면역 및 기질성 흉선 세포(thymic stromal cells) 간의 세포 상호작용은 T 세포 성숙과 항상성에서 핵심적인 역할을 한다. T 세포 발달을 지지하는 세포 interactome을 규명하기 위한 선행 연구들은 주로 영상 기법, 필수 분자 인자의 유전적 결실, 그리고 골수 키메라(bone marrow chimera)에 의존해 왔다. 여기에서 우리는 synthetic NOTCH receptors를 사용하여, 마우스 in vivo에서 CD4 + 및 CD4 + CD8 + 흉선세포(thymocytes)와 물리적으로 접촉하는 세포를 형광으로 표지하는 직접적이고 편향되지 않은 유전학적 접근법을 적용하였다. 상호작용 세포를 단일세포 수준에서 전향적으로 분리하고 전사체적 특성을 분석함으로써, 이들 T 세포를 지지하는 흉선 세포 interactome과 노화가 이러한 상호작용을 어떻게 약화시키는지를 규명하였다. 세포 상호작용자(cellular interactors)에는 수지상세포(dendritic cells), B 세포, IL-17 + γδ T 세포, 섬유아세포 하위집단(fibroblast subsets), 그리고 흉선 상피세포(thymic epithelial cells) 등이 포함되었다. ligand-receptor pair 분석은 생존, 분화 및 항원 제시에 관여하는 신호를 부각시켰다. 우리의 연구는 흉선 세포 상호작용(thymic cellular interactions)을 연구하기 위한 새로운 수단을 제공한다.

papers.title: Multi-modal dissection of cell-type specific TDP-43 pathology in the motor cortex
papers.abstract: Cytoplasmic TDP-43 pathology is a pathological sign of ALS/ALS-FTD and a converging disease event across different genotypes, phenotypes and CNS areas. To understand this process and target it therapeutically, we need to define which cell types are affected and which cell-type specific effects make them particularly vulnerable. We coupled flow-cytometry nuclear sorting and sequencing with single-nucleus multi-omic ATAC-seq and RNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics to define the transcriptional cell type of affected neurons in the post-mortem ALS/ALS-FTD motor cortex (30 ALS, 20 ALS-FTD & 32 control samples). Here, we show that mainly excitatory cortical neurons are affected by TDP-43 pathology and define the cell types that are affected the most: intratelencephalic L2-L3-LINC00507-FREM3, L3-L5-RORB-LNX2, L3-L5-RORB-ADGRL4 & L6-THEMIS-LINC00343 neurons and extratelencephalic L5-FEZF2-NTNG1 neurons. Transcriptional aberrations by TDP-43 pathology, like cryptic exon inclusion, are cell-type specific and affect distinct gene sets in each cell type, highlighting the need to address TDP-43 pathology in a cell-type specific manner.
papers.abstractKo: 세포질 TDP-43 병리는 ALS/ALS-FTD의 병리학적 징후이자 서로 다른 유전형, 표현형 및 CNS 영역 전반에 걸친 수렴성 질환 사건이다. 이 과정을 이해하고 이를 치료적으로 표적으로 삼기 위해서는 어떤 세포 유형이 영향을 받는지, 그리고 어떤 세포 유형 특이적 효과가 이들을 특히 취약하게 만드는지를 규명할 필요가 있다. 우리는 flow-cytometry nuclear sorting과 sequencing을 single-nucleus multi-omic ATAC-seq 및 RNA-seq, 그리고 spatial transcriptomics와 결합하여 사후(post-mortem) ALS/ALS-FTD 운동피질(30 ALS, 20 ALS-FTD 및 32 대조군 샘플)에서 영향을 받는 뉴런의 전사적 세포 유형을 규명하였다. 여기서 우리는 주로 흥분성 피질 뉴런이 TDP-43 병리의 영향을 받는다는 것을 보여주고, 가장 크게 영향을 받는 세포 유형을 규정한다: intratelencephalic L2-L3-LINC00507-FREM3, L3-L5-RORB-LNX2, L3-L5-RORB-ADGRL4 및 L6-THEMIS-LINC00343 뉴런과 extratelencephalic L5-FEZF2-NTNG1 뉴런. cryptic exon inclusion과 같은 TDP-43 병리에 의한 전사 이상은 세포 유형 특이적이며 각 세포 유형에서 서로 다른 유전자 집합에 영향을 미치므로, TDP-43 병리를 세포 유형 특이적 방식으로 다룰 필요성을 강조한다.

papers.title: Selective weakening of population-coupled synaptic activity in vivo in a mouse model of amyloid-beta pathology
papers.abstract: Synaptic dysfunction in Alzheimer's disease (AD) may drive synapse loss and cognitive impairment. Whether AD-related synaptic pathophysiology occurs globally, or in specific synapses, is unclear. We investigate in vivo AD-related synaptic dysfunction during early-stage amyloidosis in App NL-G-F mice. We find reduced presynaptic GABAergic proteins at c-Fos-positive excitatory neurons and increased calcium-mediated activity at excitatory and inhibitory neuronal assemblies. In vivo synaptic structure/function imaging finds reduced density and calcium-mediated activity of GABAergic axonal boutons. Rather than occurring globally, reduced synaptic activity is focused at GABAergic boutons strongly coupled to population activity in the amyloid microenvironment. The selective weakening of population-coupled synaptic activity also occurs in excitatory dendritic spines. Spatial transcriptomics finds parvalbumin-positive inhibitory neurons show differential gene expression associated with downregulated GABAergic synaptic transmission at early stages. We propose that early-stage AD-related synaptic pathophysiology is focused at population-coupled synapses, with molecular measures implicating abnormal synaptic processing as an early-stage feature in parvalbumin-positive interneurons.
papers.abstractKo: 알츠하이머병(AD)에서의 시냅스 기능장애는 시냅스 소실과 인지 장애를 유발할 수 있다. AD 관련 시냅스 병태생리가 전반적으로(global) 발생하는지, 아니면 특정 시냅스에 국한되는지는 명확하지 않다. 우리는 App NL-G-F 마우스에서 초기 amyloidosis 동안 in vivo AD 관련 시냅스 기능장애를 조사하였다. 그 결과 c-Fos 양성 흥분성 뉴런에서 presynaptic GABAergic proteins가 감소하고, 흥분성 및 억제성 뉴런 집합체(neuronal assemblies)에서 calcium-mediated activity가 증가함을 확인하였다. In vivo 시냅스 구조/기능 영상(imaging)에서는 GABAergic axonal boutons의 밀도와 calcium-mediated activity 감소가 관찰되었다. 시냅스 활동의 감소는 전반적으로(global) 발생하는 것이 아니라, amyloid microenvironment에서 population activity와 강하게 결합된 GABAergic boutons에 집중되어 있었다. population-coupled synaptic activity의 선택적 약화는 흥분성 dendritic spines에서도 발생하였다. Spatial transcriptomics에서는 parvalbumin 양성 억제성 뉴런이 초기 단계에서 downregulated GABAergic synaptic transmission과 연관된 차등 유전자 발현(differential gene expression)을 보였다. 우리는 초기 단계 AD 관련 시냅스 병태생리가 population-coupled synapses에 집중되어 있으며, 분자적 지표는 parvalbumin 양성 interneurons에서 비정상적인 시냅스 처리(synaptic processing)를 초기 단계의 특징으로 시사한다고 제안한다.

papers.title: The glycolytic metabolite phosphoenolpyruvate restricts cGAS-driven inflammation to promote healthy aging
papers.abstract: Aging involves multiple detrimental changes in the systemic milieu, leading to functional deterioration and age-related diseases. However, the potential self-protective adaptive alterations during aging remain underexplored. Here we show that phosphoenolpyruvate (PEP), a glycolytic metabolite, acts as a protective factor against age-related chronic inflammation. Longitudinal analyses in mice and humans reveal a biphasic PEP trajectory, characterized by initial accumulation followed by progressive decline. Blocking PEP accumulation exacerbates inflammation and accelerates aging phenotypes, whereas PEP administration before its decline promotes healthy aging in mice. In aged humans, high PEP levels strongly correlate with lower inflammation and healthier traits. Mechanistically, PEP acts as an endogenous inhibitor of the cyclic GMP-AMP synthase (cGAS)-stimulator of interferon genes (STING) pathway by competitively binding to cGAS. Moreover, PEP alleviates neuroinflammation and improves cognitive function in an Alzheimer's disease mouse model. Thus, our findings define PEP accumulation as an evolutionarily conserved geroprotective mechanism, positioning PEP as a promising intervention for aging and associated diseases.
papers.abstractKo: 노화는 전신 환경(systemic milieu)에 여러 해로운 변화를 동반하여 기능 저하와 연령 관련 질환을 초래한다. 그러나 노화 동안 나타나는 잠재적인 자기보호적 적응 변화는 아직 충분히 연구되지 않았다. 여기서 우리는 해당과정(glycolytic) 대사산물인 phosphoenolpyruvate(PEP)가 연령 관련 만성 염증에 대한 보호 인자로 작용함을 보여준다. 마우스와 인간에서의 종단 분석(longitudinal analyses)은 PEP의 이중상(biphasic) 궤적을 밝혀내었는데, 이는 초기 축적 이후 점진적 감소로 특징지어진다. PEP 축적을 차단하면 염증이 악화되고 노화 표현형이 가속화되는 반면, PEP 감소 이전에 PEP를 투여하면 마우스에서 건강한 노화(healthy aging)를 촉진한다. 노화된 인간에서는 높은 PEP 수준이 낮은 염증 및 더 건강한 특성과 강하게 상관된다. 기전적으로, PEP는 cyclic GMP-AMP synthase(cGAS)-stimulator of interferon genes(STING) 경로에 대해 cGAS에 경쟁적으로 결합함으로써 작동하는 내인성 억제제(endogenous inhibitor)이다. 또한 PEP는 알츠하이머병 마우스 모델에서 신경염증을 완화하고 인지 기능을 개선한다. 따라서 우리의 발견은 PEP 축적을 진화적으로 보존된 geroprotective 기전으로 규정하며, PEP를 노화 및 연관 질환에 대한 유망한 중재(intervention)로 자리매김한다.

papers.title: Dietary restriction in aging and longevity
papers.abstract: Different types of dietary restriction (DR) have been practiced by humans for religious and medical purposes for millennia, but only during the past three decades has the scientific study of DR at cellular and molecular levels proliferated. Here we review the evidence testing a variety of DR paradigms in the context of aging, focusing on mammalian findings. We discuss potential DR mimetics that modulate autophagy, FGF21, AMPK, mTORC1, NAD + metabolism, SIRTs, GLP-1R and other pathways as well as organismal and cellular adaptations to DR, including the roles of fasting, hunger, changes in body temperature and fat loss. We also consider the potential negative effects of DR such as increased vulnerability to infections and impaired wound healing. Further, we discuss preclinical evidence evaluating the potential of DR to improve healthspan and treat, prevent or delay age-related diseases including cancer, cardiovascular diseases and neurodegeneration. Finally, we consider the future opportunities for translation, and the challenges inherent to this complex research field.
papers.abstractKo: 서로 다른 유형의 식이 제한(dietary restriction, DR)은 수천 년 동안 종교적 및 의학적 목적으로 인간에 의해 시행되어 왔으나, 세포 및 분자 수준에서 DR에 대한 과학적 연구가 확대된 것은 불과 지난 30년 동안의 일이다. 여기에서는 노화의 맥락에서 다양한 DR 패러다임을 검증한 근거를 검토하며, 포유류 연구 결과에 초점을 맞춘다. 우리는 autophagy, FGF21, AMPK, mTORC1, NAD + metabolism, SIRTs, GLP-1R 및 기타 경로를 조절하는 잠재적 DR mimetics와, fasting, hunger, 체온 변화 및 지방 감소의 역할을 포함한 DR에 대한 개체 및 세포 수준의 적응을 논의한다. 또한 감염에 대한 취약성 증가 및 상처 치유 장애와 같은 DR의 잠재적 부정적 효과도 고려한다. 나아가, 암, 심혈관 질환 및 신경퇴행을 포함한 연령 관련 질환을 개선, 치료, 예방 또는 지연시키는 데 있어 healthspan을 향상시킬 수 있는 DR의 잠재력을 평가한 전임상 근거를 논의한다. 마지막으로, 번역을 위한 향후 기회와 이 복잡한 연구 분야에 본질적으로 수반되는 과제들을 검토한다.

papers.title: Tumor cell–derived IFN spatially reprograms osteopontin-enriched macrophage niches to promote PARP inhibitor resistance
papers.abstract: Poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase inhibitors (PARPis) benefit homologous recombination-deficient (HRD) malignancies, yet resistance remains a major challenge. Leveraging specimens from a prospective neoadjuvant niraparib monotherapy trial in treatment-naive, high-grade serous ovarian cancer, we integrated PhenoCycler-Fusion spatial profiling, scRNA-Seq, and multiplex immunohistochemistry to identify 2 therapeutic-modulated cellular neighborhoods: an IFN+ tumor cell-enriched niche that expands in resistant lesions and a niche enriched in tumor-associated macrophage (TAM) that persists but acquires enhanced immunosuppressive features. Mechanistically, sustained tumor cell-derived IFN induced osteopontin (SPP1) expression in TAMs via STAT signaling, creating immunosuppressive niches enriched in Tregs and myofibroblastic cancer-associated fibroblasts with intensified cell-cell interactions. SPP1 directly suppressed T cell signaling and effector function. High baseline SPP1+ cells predicted lower response rate (30.0% vs. 76.2%; P = 0.021) and shorter progression-free survival (median 13.5 vs. 28.3 months; P = 0.0006). In HRD mouse models, SPP1 blockade restored PARPi sensitivity, reversed acquired resistance, and enhanced T cell cytotoxicity-effects abrogated in immunodeficient mice, confirming immune dependence. These data establish a spatial IFN-SPP1 axis whereby persistent tumor cell IFN reprograms TAMs to promote PARPi resistance, position SPP1 as a key therapeutic target and prognostic biomarker for this therapy, and underscore therapeutic potential of microenvironment-targeted strategies to overcome PARPi resistance.
papers.abstractKo: Poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase inhibitors(PARPis)는 homologous recombination-deficient(HRD) 악성 종양에 유익하지만, 저항성은 여전히 주요한 과제이다. 치료 경험이 없는 고등급 장액성 난소암에서 수행된 전향적 신보조 niraparib 단독요법 시험의 검체를 활용하여, 우리는 PhenoCycler-Fusion 공간 프로파일링, scRNA-Seq, 및 multiplex immunohistochemistry를 통합하여 2개의 치료 조절 세포성 미세환경(cellular neighborhood)을 규명하였다: 저항성 병변에서 확장되는 IFN+ 종양 세포가 풍부한 니치와, 지속되지만 더 강화된 면역억제 특성을 획득하는 tumor-associated macrophage(TAM) 풍부 니치이다. 기전적으로, 지속적인 종양 세포 유래 IFN은 STAT signaling을 통해 TAMs에서 osteopontin(SPP1) 발현을 유도하여, Tregs 및 myofibroblastic cancer-associated fibroblasts가 풍부하고 세포-세포 상호작용이 강화된 면역억제성 니치를 형성하였다. SPP1은 T cell signaling과 effector function을 직접 억제하였다. 기저 시점의 높은 SPP1+ 세포는 더 낮은 반응률(30.0% vs. 76.2%; P = 0.021)과 더 짧은 progression-free survival(중앙값 13.5 vs. 28.3개월; P = 0.0006)을 예측하였다. HRD 마우스 모델에서 SPP1 차단은 PARPi 감수성을 회복시키고, 획득 저항성을 역전시키며, T cell cytotoxicity를 증가시켰는데, 이러한 효과는 면역결핍 마우스에서 소실되어 면역 의존성을 확인하였다. 이러한 자료는 지속적인 종양 세포 IFN이 TAMs를 재프로그래밍하여 PARPi 저항성을 촉진하는 공간적 IFN-SPP1 축을 확립하며, SPP1을 이 치료의 핵심 치료 표적 및 예후 바이오마커로 제시하고, PARPi 저항성을 극복하기 위한 미세환경 표적 전략의 치료적 잠재성을 강조한다.

papers.title: The genetic basis of dermatophytosis skin infection susceptibility
papers.abstract: Dermatophytosis is a fungal infection affecting keratinized tissues such as skin, nails, and hair, presenting as red and itchy patches, nail thickening, or hair loss. It affects around 20% of the global population but the genetic architecture remains poorly understood. We performed a genome-wide association meta-analysis of over 250,000 cases and 1.37 million controls from FinnGen, Estonian Biobank, UK Biobank, and the Million Veteran Program and identified 30 genome-wide significant loci, including seven missense variants and two loci in high linkage disequilibrium with missense variants. Top associations were near ZNF646, HLA-DQB1, FLG, FTO, SLURP2, and KRT77. Additionally, dermatophytosis subtype analyses revealed 44 signals. Our results highlight the role of disrupted keratin biology, skin barrier defects, immune dysfunction, and obesity in dermatophytosis risk. We also observed genetic overlap with other skin conditions and obesity-related traits, providing insights into disease mechanisms and potential targets for prevention and treatment.
papers.abstractKo: 표피진균증(dermatophytosis)은 피부, 손발톱, 모발과 같은 각질화 조직(keratinized tissues)에 영향을 미치는 진균 감염으로, 홍반성이고 가려운 반점, 손발톱 비후, 또는 탈모로 나타난다. 이는 전 세계 인구의 약 20%에 영향을 미치지만, 그 유전적 구조는 아직 충분히 밝혀지지 않았다. 우리는 FinnGen, Estonian Biobank, UK Biobank, 및 Million Veteran Program에서 25만 건이 넘는 환자와 137만 명의 대조군을 대상으로 전장 유전체 연관성 메타분석(genome-wide association meta-analysis)을 수행하여 30개의 전장 유전체 수준에서 유의한 좌위(genome-wide significant loci)를 확인하였고, 이에는 7개의 missense variant와 missense variant와 높은 연관 불평형(high linkage disequilibrium)에 있는 2개의 좌위가 포함되었다. 주요 연관성은 ZNF646, HLA-DQB1, FLG, FTO, SLURP2, 및 KRT77 근처에서 관찰되었다. 추가로, 표피진균증 아형(subtype) 분석에서 44개의 신호가 밝혀졌다. 우리의 결과는 표피진균증 위험에서 교란된 keratin 생물학, 피부 장벽 결함, 면역 기능 이상, 및 비만의 역할을 강조한다. 또한 우리는 다른 피부 질환 및 비만 관련 형질과의 유전적 중복(genetic overlap)을 관찰하여, 질병 기전과 예방 및 치료를 위한 잠재적 표적에 대한 통찰을 제공하였다.

papers.title: Tumor-induced orexigenic imbalance lowers protein appetite and drives early organ wasting symptoms
papers.abstract: Cancer cachexia (CC) is characterized by organ wasting and ensuing involuntary weight loss. Despite advances, underlying mechanisms initiating CC remain unclear, including early symptoms like anorexia. Here, we use a fly gut-tumor model with a precise time-window before organ wasting starts. We show that tumor-induced factors involved in inflammation (unpaired 3/ Interleukin-6-like) and reduced insulin signaling (ImpL2/ Insulin Growth Factor Binding Protein) decrease NPF (Neuropeptide F/ Neuropeptide Y) in the brain prior to organ wasting. This early NPF decrease triggers low protein-specific food appetite and anorexia. We find that ImpL2 reduces NPF signaling while upd3 helps by concurrently affecting the blood brain barrier. Tumor-induced NPF decrease, and early reduction of protein appetite drive the onset of weight loss and exacerbate the risk of death during organ wasting. Altogether, we provide evidence for an early orexigenic brain imbalance causing low protein appetite that regulates the onset and outcome of organ wasting.
papers.abstractKo: 암 악액질(cancer cachexia, CC)은 장기 소모와 그에 따른 비의도적 체중 감소를 특징으로 한다. 진전이 있었음에도 불구하고, CC를 시작시키는 근본 기전은 식욕부진(anorexia)과 같은 초기 증상을 포함하여 여전히 명확하지 않다. 여기서 우리는 장기 소모가 시작되기 전의 정밀한 시간 창(time-window)을 갖는 초파리 장-종양 모델(fly gut-tumor model)을 사용하였다. 우리는 염증(unpaired 3/Interleukin-6-like)과 인슐린 신호전달 감소(ImpL2/Insulin Growth Factor Binding Protein)에 관여하는 종양 유도 인자들이 장기 소모 이전에 뇌에서 NPF(Neuropeptide F/Neuropeptide Y)를 감소시킨다는 것을 보여준다. 이러한 초기 NPF 감소는 낮은 단백질-특이적 음식 식욕과 식욕부진을 유발한다. 우리는 ImpL2가 NPF signaling을 감소시키는 반면, upd3는 혈액-뇌 장벽(blood brain barrier)에 동시에 영향을 미침으로써 이를 돕는다는 것을 발견하였다. 종양 유도 NPF 감소와 단백질 식욕의 초기 감소는 체중 감소의 발현을 촉진하고 장기 소모 동안 사망 위험을 악화시킨다. 종합하면, 우리는 장기 소모의 발현과 결과를 조절하는 낮은 단백질 식욕을 유발하는 초기 orexigenic 뇌 불균형에 대한 증거를 제시한다.

papers.title: Lysine-11 ubiquitination drives type-I/III interferon induction by cGAS–STING and Toll-like receptors 3 and 4
papers.abstract: Pattern recognition receptor (PRR)-induced interferon (IFN) is critical for effective immunity. The PRRs Toll-like receptor (TLR) 3, TLR4 and cyclic GMP-AMP synthase (cGAS), together with the stimulator of IFN genes (STING), signal through TANK-binding kinase 1 (TBK1), which activates the type-I/III IFN-inducing transcription factor interferon-response factor 3 (IRF3). The mechanism by which these PRRs activate TBK1 remains unresolved. Here we show that lysine-11 (K11)-linked ubiquitination drives TBK1 activation by these PRRs. The E3 ligase ANKIB1 attaches K11-linked ubiquitin chains to components of the TLR3- and cGAS-STING-induced signalosomes. This facilitates Optineurin recruitment to these complexes, in turn enabling recruitment and activation of TBK1 and IRF3, defining an uncharacterized signalling axis. In mice, ANKIB1 deficiency dampens IFN induction via TLR3 and cGAS-STING, reducing interferonopathy and compromising protection against HSV-1, respectively. Together, our results demonstrate an unanticipated and critical role for ANKIB1-generated K11-linked ubiquitination in the immune response activated by cGAS-STING, TLR3 and TLR4.
papers.abstractKo: 패턴 인식 수용체(pattern recognition receptor, PRR)에 의해 유도되는 인터페론(interferon, IFN)은 효과적인 면역에 필수적이다. Toll-like receptor(TLR) 3, TLR4 및 cyclic GMP-AMP synthase(cGAS)와 stimulator of IFN genes(STING)는 함께 TANK-binding kinase 1(TBK1)을 통해 신호를 전달하며, TBK1은 type-I/III IFN을 유도하는 전사 인자인 interferon-response factor 3(IRF3)을 활성화한다. 이러한 PRR들이 TBK1을 활성화하는 기전은 아직 규명되지 않았다. 여기에서 우리는 lysine-11(K11)-연결 ubiquitination이 이러한 PRR들에 의한 TBK1 활성화를 유도함을 보인다. E3 ligase ANKIB1은 TLR3- 및 cGAS-STING-유도 signalosome의 구성 성분들에 K11-연결 ubiquitin 사슬을 부가한다. 이는 이들 복합체로 Optineurin의 모집을 촉진하고, 이어서 TBK1과 IRF3의 모집 및 활성화를 가능하게 하며, 이는 아직 특성화되지 않은 signaling axis를 정의한다. 생쥐에서 ANKIB1 결핍은 각각 TLR3 및 cGAS-STING을 통한 IFN 유도를 약화시켜 interferonopathy를 감소시키고 HSV-1에 대한 방어를 손상시킨다. 종합하면, 우리의 결과는 cGAS-STING, TLR3 및 TLR4에 의해 활성화되는 면역 반응에서 ANKIB1이 생성하는 K11-연결 ubiquitination의 예상치 못했지만 결정적인 역할을 보여준다.

papers.title: T- and B-cell–targeting DNA/MVA HCV vaccines induce strong and broad cellular and humoral immunity in mice and rhesus macaques
papers.abstract: Background and aims The hepatitis C virus (HCV) is a major cause of liver cirrhosis and cancer in humans, and an effective vaccine is urgently needed. Here, we evaluated the immunogenicity of a DNA prime and modified vaccinia Ankara (MVA) boost vaccine expressing H77 genotype 1a HCV immunogens to induce both T- and B-cell responses. Approach and results The non-structural (NS) immunogens expressed NS3, NS4, and NS5. The structural plus p7 immunogen (S-p7) expressed Core, E1, E2, and p7. We tested the immunogenicity of these vaccines in mice and rhesus macaques (RMs) with 2 or 3 doses of DNA followed by 1 or 2 doses of MVA. The NS immunogens induced CD4 and CD8 T-cell responses against multiple NS proteins, with a dominant CD4 T-cell response to NS3 and NS5, and a dominant CD8 T-cell response to NS3. The S-p7 immunogen induced E2-binding IgG titer with neutralizing activity against autologous and heterologous HCV pseudovirus particles. In addition, the S-p7 immunogen induced a CD4 and CD8 T-cell response directed against E1 (0.08% and 0.09%, respectively) and E2 (0.13% and 0.18%, respectively) in RMs. Co-delivery of S-p7 and NS vaccines elicited a T-cell response against the majority of HCV proteins, which was comparable to the T-cell response observed in humans with HCV resolution. Conclusions These findings show that the DNA/MVA prime/boost vaccination induces a strong and broad CD4 and CD8 T-cell response to multiple HCV proteins and a neutralizing antibody response. These results aid in the development of vaccines for HCV.
papers.abstractKo: 배경 및 목적 C형 간염 바이러스(hepatitis C virus, HCV)는 인간에서 간경변과 암의 주요 원인이며, 효과적인 백신이 시급히 필요하다. 본 연구에서는 T세포 및 B세포 반응을 모두 유도하기 위해 H77 genotype 1a HCV immunogen을 발현하는 DNA prime 및 modified vaccinia Ankara(MVA) boost 백신의 면역원성을 평가하였다. 접근법 및 결과 비구조(non-structural, NS) immunogen은 NS3, NS4, 및 NS5를 발현하였다. 구조(structural) plus p7 immunogen(S-p7)은 Core, E1, E2, 및 p7을 발현하였다. 우리는 2 또는 3회 DNA 투여 후 1 또는 2회 MVA 투여를 시행한 마우스와 rhesus macaques(RMs)에서 이들 백신의 면역원성을 시험하였다. NS immunogen은 여러 NS 단백질에 대한 CD4 및 CD8 T세포 반응을 유도했으며, NS3와 NS5에 대한 우세한 CD4 T세포 반응과 NS3에 대한 우세한 CD8 T세포 반응을 보였다. S-p7 immunogen은 자가 및 이종 HCV pseudovirus particles에 대한 중화 활성을 가지는 E2 결합 IgG 역가를 유도하였다. 또한, S-p7 immunogen은 RMs에서 E1(각각 0.08% 및 0.09%)과 E2(각각 0.13% 및 0.18%)를 표적으로 하는 CD4 및 CD8 T세포 반응을 유도하였다. S-p7 및 NS 백신의 공동 투여는 HCV 단백질의 대부분에 대한 T세포 반응을 유발하였으며, 이는 HCV resolution을 보인 인간에서 관찰된 T세포 반응과 비교 가능한 수준이었다. 결론 이러한 결과는 DNA/MVA prime/boost vaccination이 여러 HCV 단백질에 대한 강력하고 광범위한 CD4 및 CD8 T세포 반응과 중화 항체 반응을 유도함을 보여준다. 이러한 결과는 HCV 백신 개발에 도움이 된다.

papers.title: Aspartyl-tRNA synthetase 1 (DARS1) reshapes hepatocellular carcinoma proteome and promotes aggressiveness through noncanonical SAGA–MYC signaling modulation
papers.abstract: Background and aims Aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases (ARSs) exert canonical and emerging noncanonical roles in cancer. Given the frequent alterations in aspartate metabolism in HCC, we investigated the clinical and functional significance of aspartyl-tRNA synthetase (DARS1) in HCC. Approach and results DARS1 expression was evaluated in tumor and matched nontumoral tissues, in silico cohorts, and plasma samples. Functional assays were performed in liver cancer cell lines after genetic and pharmacological modulation of DARS1. In vivo validation was conducted using xenograft and orthotopic tumor models. Protein interactors of DARS1 were characterized by quantitative proteomics and confirmed by biochemical approaches. DARS1 abundance was increased in HCC, especially in highly aggressive tumors, and in plasma from patients with HCC​​​​​​. DARS1 overexpression increased aggressiveness in vitro and xenograft and orthotopic tumor formation in vivo, while genetic and pharmacological blockade of DARS1 impaired stemness in vitro without affecting normal-like cells. Proteomic profiling revealed a significant enrichment of high-aspartate proteins in DARS1-overexpressing cells, demonstrating a reshaping of the HCC proteome. Beyond its canonical role, DARS1 was found in the nucleus interacting with members of the SAGA transcriptional coactivator complex, including SUPT7L. This interaction affected MYC regulation, as DARS1 depletion reduced MYC protein levels, increased its phosphorylation, and enhanced drug-induced senescence, linking DARS1-SAGA activity to MYC-driven oncogenic pathways. Conclusions DARS1 is frequently overexpressed in HCC and detectable in plasma, supporting its potential as a liquid biopsy biomarker. Functionally, DARS1 represents a novel vulnerability of HCC, acting through both proteome reshaping and noncanonical nuclear interactions with the SAGA complex that modulate MYC activity.
papers.abstractKo: 배경 및 목적 아미노아실-tRNA 합성효소(aminoacyl-tRNA synthetases, ARSs)는 암에서 정형적(canonical) 및 새롭게 제시되는 비정형적(noncanonical) 역할을 수행한다. HCC에서 아스파르트산 대사(aspartate metabolism)의 변형이 빈번하다는 점을 고려하여, 우리는 HCC에서 aspartyl-tRNA synthetase(DARS1)의 임상적 및 기능적 중요성을 조사하였다. 접근 및 결과 DARS1 발현은 종양 및 짝을 이룬 비종양 조직, in silico 코호트, 그리고 혈장 시료에서 평가되었다. 기능 분석은 DARS1의 유전적 및 약리학적 조절 후 간암 세포주에서 수행되었다. 생체 내 검증은 xenograft 및 orthotopic 종양 모델을 이용하여 수행되었다. DARS1의 단백질 상호작용체는 정량적 proteomics로 특성화되었고 생화학적 방법으로 확인되었다. DARS1의 양은 HCC에서, 특히 고도 공격성 종양과 HCC 환자의 혈장에서 증가하였다. DARS1 과발현은 시험관 내에서 공격성을 증가시켰고, 생체 내에서 xenograft 및 orthotopic 종양 형성을 촉진한 반면, DARS1의 유전적 및 약리학적 차단은 정상 유사 세포에는 영향을 주지 않으면서 시험관 내 stemness를 저해하였다. Proteomic profiling은 DARS1 과발현 세포에서 높은 aspartate 단백질(high-aspartate proteins)의 유의한 풍부화를 보여 주어, HCC proteome의 재구성을 입증하였다. 정형적 역할을 넘어, DARS1은 핵에서 SAGA transcriptional coactivator complex의 구성원들, including SUPT7L,과 상호작용하는 것으로 밝혀졌다. 이 상호작용은 MYC 조절에 영향을 미쳐, DARS1 고갈은 MYC 단백질 수준을 감소시키고, 그 인산화를 증가시키며, 약물 유도 노화를 강화하여, DARS1-SAGA 활성과 MYC-구동 종양원성 경로를 연결하였다. 결론 DARS1은 HCC에서 빈번히 과발현되며 혈장에서 검출 가능하므로, liquid biopsy biomarker로서의 잠재성을 뒷받침한다. 기능적으로 DARS1은 HCC의 새로운 취약성(novel vulnerability)을 나타내며, proteome 재구성과 MYC 활성을 조절하는 SAGA complex와의 비정형적 핵 내 상호작용을 통해 작용한다.

papers.title: Tissue-specific clonal selection and differentiation of CD4⁺ T cells during infection
papers.abstract: Pathogen-specific CD4⁺ T cells expand and contract during infection, generating memory clones that shape subsequent immune responses. How distinct tissue environments influence differentiation and clonal selection of polyclonal T cells remains unclear. Here we develop Tracking Recently Activated Cell Kinetics (TRACK) mice, a dual-recombinase fate-mapping system enabling the spatial and temporal labeling of recently activated CD4⁺ T cells. Using TRACK mice during influenza infection, we observed organ-specific transcriptional differentiation and clonal selection in lung, mediastinal lymph nodes (medLNs) and spleen. During the effector phase, spleen-derived CD4⁺ T cells adopted a stem-like migratory phenotype, whereas medLN-activated cells differentiated into T follicular helper cells. T cell receptor sequencing showed low clonal overlap between tissues during the effector response, consistent with distinct antigenic landscapes. During memory formation, overlap increased between lung- and medLN-derived cells, while splenic clones retained a distinct repertoire. These findings define tissue-dependent mechanisms that shape CD4⁺ T cell fate and clonal architecture.
papers.abstractKo: 병원체 특이적 CD4⁺ T 세포는 감염 동안 증식하고 수축하며, 이후의 면역 반응을 형성하는 기억 클론(memory clones)을 생성한다. 서로 다른 조직 환경이 다클론성(polycolonal) T 세포의 분화와 클론 선택에 어떻게 영향을 미치는지는 아직 명확하지 않다. 여기에서 우리는 최근 활성화된 CD4⁺ T 세포의 공간적 및 시간적 표지를 가능하게 하는 이중 재조합효소(fate-mapping) 시스템인 Tracking Recently Activated Cell Kinetics(TRACK) 마우스를 개발하였다. 인플루엔자 감염 동안 TRACK 마우스를 이용하여, 우리는 폐, 종격동 림프절(mediastinal lymph nodes, medLNs) 및 비장에서 기관 특이적 전사체 분화와 클론 선택을 관찰하였다. 효과기 단계 동안 비장 유래 CD4⁺ T 세포는 줄기세포 유사(stem-like) 이동성 표현형(migratory phenotype)을 획득한 반면, medLN에서 활성화된 세포는 T follicular helper 세포로 분화하였다. T 세포 수용체 서열 분석(T cell receptor sequencing) 결과, 효과기 반응 동안 조직 간 클론 중복이 낮았으며, 이는 서로 다른 항원성 지형(antigenic landscapes)과 일치하였다. 기억 형성 동안에는 폐 유래 세포와 medLN 유래 세포 사이의 중복이 증가한 반면, 비장 클론은 뚜렷한 레퍼토리(repertoire)를 유지하였다. 이러한 결과는 CD4⁺ T 세포 운명과 클론 구조(clonal architecture)를 형성하는 조직 의존적 기전을 규정한다.

papers.title: Clusters of vascular aging manifestations predict incident cardiovascular events in the community
papers.abstract: Vascular aging is the accumulation of functional and structural changes of vessels throughout life. While earlier studies have shown that single manifestation of vascular aging is associated with an increased risk of cardiovascular disease (CVD), it is unknown how the different manifestations of vascular aging cluster at the individual level, and whether individuals with different vascular aging patterns have different risk of progression to overt CVD. Here, we identify three patterns of vascular aging including healthy vascular aging (HVA), arteriosclerosis and atherosclerosis. Vascular aging manifestations were evaluated non-invasively by carotid ultrasound methods. The main and the validation analysis were conducted on 8360 and 2086 participants in two separate prospective cohorts. We find that arteriosclerosis and atherosclerosis compared to HVA clusters are independent predictors of CVD, and improve risk stratification for stroke among those at intermediate risk. Vascular aging evaluation may help identify those at increased risk of CVD.
papers.abstractKo: 혈관 노화(vascular aging)는 생애 전반에 걸쳐 혈관의 기능적 및 구조적 변화가 축적되는 것을 의미한다. 이전 연구들에서 혈관 노화의 단일 표현형이 심혈관질환(cardiovascular disease, CVD) 위험 증가와 연관됨이 보고되었지만, 혈관 노화의 서로 다른 표현형이 개인 수준에서 어떻게 군집을 이루는지, 그리고 서로 다른 혈관 노화 패턴을 가진 개인들이 현성(manifest) CVD로 진행할 위험이 서로 다른지는 알려져 있지 않다. 본 연구에서는 건강한 혈관 노화(healthy vascular aging, HVA), 동맥경화증(arteriosclerosis), 죽상동맥경화증(atherosclerosis)을 포함하는 세 가지 혈관 노화 패턴을 규명하였다. 혈관 노화 표현형은 경동맥 초음파(carotid ultrasound) 방법으로 비침습적으로 평가하였다. 주요 분석과 검증 분석은 두 개의 별도 전향적 코호트에서 각각 8360명과 2086명의 참가자를 대상으로 수행되었다. 우리는 HVA 군집과 비교했을 때 동맥경화증과 죽상동맥경화증이 CVD의 독립적 예측인자이며, 중간 위험군에서 뇌졸중(stroke) 위험층화(risk stratification)를 향상시킨다는 것을 확인하였다. 혈관 노화 평가는 CVD 위험이 증가한 대상을 식별하는 데 도움을 줄 수 있다.

papers.title: Inhibition of 15-hydroxy prostaglandin dehydrogenase promotes cartilage regeneration
papers.abstract: Aging or injury to the joints can lead to cartilage degeneration and osteoarthritis (OA), for which there are limited effective treatments. We found that expression of 15-hydroxy prostaglandin dehydrogenase (15-PGDH) is increased in the articular cartilage of aged or injured mice. Both systemic and local inhibition of 15-PGDH with a small-molecule inhibitor (PGDHi) led to regeneration of articular cartilage and reduction in OA-associated pain. Using single-cell RNA-sequencing and multiplexed immunofluorescence imaging of cartilage, we identified the major chondrocyte subpopulations. Inhibition of 15-PGDH decreased hypertrophic-like chondrocytes expressing 15-PGDH and increased extracellular matrix-synthesizing articular chondrocytes. Cartilage regeneration appears to occur through gene expression changes in preexisting chondrocytes, rather than stem or progenitor cell proliferation. 15-PGDH inhibition could be a potential disease-modifying and regenerative approach for osteoarthritis.

papers.title: Structural basis for the recruitment and selective phosphorylation of Akt by mTORC2
papers.abstract: The mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) protein kinase forms two multiprotein complexes, mTORC1 and mTORC2, that function in distinct signaling pathways. mTORC1 is regulated by nutrients, and mTORC2 is a central node in phosphoinositide-3 kinase (PI3K) and small guanosine triphosphate Ras signaling networks commonly deregulated in cancer and diabetes. Although mTOR phosphorylates many substrates in vitro, in cells, mTORC1 and mTORC2 have high specificity: mTORC2 phosphorylates the protein kinases Akt and PKC, but not closely related kinases that are mTORC1 substrates. To understand how mTORC2 recognizes substrates, we created semisynthetic probes to trap the mTORC2 :: Akt complex and determine its structure. Whereas most protein kinases recognize amino acids adjacent to the phosphorylation site, local sequence contributes little to substrate recognition by mTORC2. Instead, the specificity determinants were secondary and tertiary structural elements of Akt that bound the mTORC2 component mSin1 distal to the mTOR active site and were conserved among at least 18 related substrates. These results reveal how mTORC2 recognizes its canonical substrates and may enable the design of mTORC2-specific inhibitors.

papers.title: Single intramuscular injection of self-amplifying RNA of Nppa to treat myocardial infarction
papers.abstract: Self-amplifying RNA (saRNA) enables sustained protein expression from a single administration. In this study, we developed an intramuscular saRNA-lipid nanoparticle (saNppa-LNP) therapy encoding natriuretic peptide type A ( Nppa ) for cardioprotection. A single injection induced sustained pro-atrial natriuretic peptide (pro-ANP) secretion for 4 weeks; pro-ANP was subsequently cleaved by the cardiac protease corin into active ANP, producing robust cardioprotection in mouse and swine myocardial infarction models. At equivalent doses, saNppa achieved greater efficacy than conventional mRNA. Single-nucleus transcriptomics identified natriuretic peptide receptor 1-positive ( Npr1 + ) endothelial and epicardial cells as primary effectors, with saNppa-LNPs reshaping their paracrine profile to promote cardiomyocyte regeneration and suppress fibrosis. Longitudinal biosafety assessments revealed no systemic toxicity. Together, these results demonstrate that one-shot saNppa-LNP therapy offers durable cardioprotection, supporting the broader potential of saRNA-LNP-based approaches for cardiac therapy.

papers.title: Targeting amyloid-β pathology by chimeric antigen receptor astrocyte (CAR-A) therapy
papers.abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is the leading cause of dementia and is characterized by progressive amyloid accumulation followed by tau-mediated neurodegeneration. Despite advances in anti-amyloid immunotherapies, important limitations remain, highlighting the need for new therapeutic strategies. Here, we introduce anti-amyloid chimeric antigen receptors expressed in astrocytes (CAR-A) and validate their function in vitro. We show that two CAR-A designs reduce amyloid and associated pathology after plaque formation and prevent early plaque deposition in vivo. Single-nucleus RNA sequencing shows that CAR-A treatment induces a distinct glial response to amyloid pathology involving coordinated activity of astrocytes and microglia. Each construct additionally elicits distinctive, receptor-specific effects in astrocytes or microglia. Together, these findings support the therapeutic potential of CAR-A as a disease-modifying strategy for AD.
papers.abstractKo: Alzheimer's disease (AD)는 치매의 주요 원인으로, 진행성 amyloid 축적에 이어 tau 매개 신경퇴행을 특징으로 한다. anti-amyloid 면역치료의 발전에도 불구하고 중요한 한계가 여전히 남아 있으며, 이는 새로운 치료 전략의 필요성을 강조한다. 본 연구에서는 astrocyte에 발현되는 anti-amyloid chimeric antigen receptors (CAR-A)를 도입하고 in vitro에서 그 기능을 검증하였다. 두 가지 CAR-A 설계가 plaque 형성 후 amyloid 및 관련 병리를 감소시키고, in vivo에서 초기 plaque 침착을 방지함을 보여주었다. Single-nucleus RNA sequencing은 CAR-A 치료가 astrocyte와 microglia의 조정된 활성을 포함하는 amyloid 병리에 대한 독특한 glial 반응을 유도함을 보여준다. 또한 각 construct는 astrocyte 또는 microglia에서 수용체 특이적인 독특한 효과를 추가로 유발한다. 종합하면, 이러한 결과는 AD에 대한 disease-modifying 전략으로서 CAR-A의 치료적 잠재력을 지지한다.

papers.title: Microbiota-mediated induction of beige adipocytes in response to dietary cues
papers.abstract: Interactions between diet and the gut microbiota are fundamental to metabolic health, shaping energy balance and disease susceptibility 1-5 . However, the underlying mechanisms by which dietary and microbial factors converge to regulate host physiology remain unclear. Here we show that protein availability profoundly modulates the functional landscape of the gut microbiota and promotes remodelling of white adipose tissue (WAT). Specifically, low-protein diets (LPDs) robustly induce signature genes of browning in WAT to a similar extent to that seen in response to classical stimuli, such as cold exposure or β-adrenergic receptor activation 6-8 . LPD-mediated browning was markedly diminished in germ-free mice, and this defect was rescued by colonization with defined bacterial consortia made up of strains that were isolated and down-selected from the faeces of either LPD-fed mice or healthy human volunteers with 18 F-fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography (FDG-PET)-confirmed brown- or beige-fat activity 9-12 . Microbiota-induced browning was mediated both by bile acids driving the activation of the farnesoid X receptor (FXR) in adipose progenitor cells, and by nrfA-encoding commensal-derived ammonia driving the expression of fibroblast growth factor 21 (FGF21) in hepatocytes. The bile acid-FXR and ammonia-FGF21 axes both have non-redundant, essential roles in promoting WAT browning. These findings highlight a mechanistic link between diet, gut microbial metabolism and adipose tissue remodelling, uncovering microbiota-dependent pathways by which the host responds to dietary cues.
