papers.title: Somatic deficiency of the human E3 ubiquitin ligase CBL in leukocytes impairs B cell but not T cell development and function
papers.abstract: The E3 ubiquitin ligase Casitas B-lineage lymphoma (CBL) promotes positive selection and antigen responses in mouse T lymphocytes by ubiquitinating ZAP70. Conversely, mouse CBL and CBL-B mutually redundantly regulate SYK ubiquitination and B cell receptor signaling. Here we studied individuals with somatically homozygous CBL loss-of-function variants in leukocytes. Human CBL is largely redundant for the development and function of human T cells. Conversely, B cell development is altered at the immature stage, with a tenfold increase in transitional cells, enhanced survival of autoreactive clones and impaired tolerance manifested by autoantibody production. B cell maturation is intrinsically impaired by reduced apoptosis and dysregulated B cell receptor signaling. CBL deficiency impairs humoral immunity by limiting memory B cell formation and reducing class switching and somatic hypermutation. Consequently, antigen-specific B cell generation and adaptive immune memory are disrupted, predisposing individuals to infection. Human CBL is critical for B cell development and function but redundant for T cell biology.

papers.title: Metabolic adaptations rewire CD4+ T cells in a subset-specific manner in human critical illness with and without sepsis
papers.abstract: Metabolic and immunologic dysfunction, including pathological CD4 + T cell immunosuppression, are archetypal in critical illness, but whether these factors are mechanistically linked remains incompletely defined. Here we characterized the metabolic properties of human CD4 + T cells from critically ill patients with and without sepsis and healthy adults. CD4 + T cells in critical illness showed subset-specific metabolic plasticity, with regulatory T (T reg ) cells preferentially acquiring glycolytic capacity that associated with sustained cellular fitness and worsened clinical illness. Adapted T reg cells were more metabolically flexible and stabilized suppressive markers FOXP3 and TIGIT under mitochondrial stress. Single-cell transcriptomics suggested reactive oxygen species (ROS) and kynurenine metabolism as drivers of T reg cell remodeling. Subsequent inhibition of ROS and kynurenine metabolism attenuated glycolytic adaptation and suppressive rewiring, respectively, in T reg cells. papers.title: Genetic and non-genetic factors distinctly shape the variation of the immune response in cattle
papers.abstract: Increasing agricultural production while reducing the reliance on synthetic inputs such as antibiotics is an important challenge. For cattle breeding, this implies better understanding the genetics underlying meat production and the immune response. Here, we use systems immunology to investigate the genetic and environmental drivers of immune variation in Belgian White Blue male cattle, a breed historically bred for meat production. While seasonality and other non-genetic factors account for much of the immune variation observed, genome-wide association studies identify loci with major effects on specific immunophenotypes. Genetics also emerges as the primary driver of cytokine production. Finally, we develop a predictive model linking genetic data to cytokine responses. Our findings support the selection of cattle with improved immunity and advance our understanding of mammalian immune variation.

papers.title: Microbial activation of the GLP-2R mitigates gastrointestinal inflammation
papers.abstract: There is an urgent need for sustainable protein sources to meet rising global nutritional demands. Here, we show that a commercially scalable microbial lysate from Methylococcus capsulatus Bath (McB), used as a dietary protein, orchestrates host-diet-microbe interactions that protect against gastrointestinal inflammation. McB administration rapidly reshapes the gut microbiota and upregulates microbial fermentation pathways, while robustly increasing peripherally induced regulatory T cells (pTregs) across intestinal regions, independent of the microbiota. In contrast, McB-driven induction of tolerogenic Th17 cells requires a functional microbiota with intact fermentation capacity. In models of mucositis and colitis, McB preserves villus architecture, restores mucosal integrity, and reduces disease severity. Mechanistically, these effects depend on microbial fermentation and functional GLP-2 receptor signalling, yet are independent of endogenous GLP-2 secretion, indicating a fermentation-driven molecular mimicry of GLP-2R activation. Collectively, our findings position microbial lysates as a sustainable nutritional strategy that improves gastrointestinal health through defined immune and microbial pathways.

papers.title: Blood-based obesity biomarkers and their relevance for disease risk
papers.abstract: Obesity is a risk factor for chronic diseases and early death; however, the underlying mechanisms are not fully understood. Whereas insulin resistance and inflammation are established pathways in several of these relationships, it is less clear how increases in body adipose tissue relate to these pathways and disease risk. Several adipose tissue-derived blood-based biomarkers have been identified as purported mediators, including adipokines, inflammatory cytokines and sex steroid hormones. Traditionally, these markers were discovered in animal models and their relevance in humans has then been investigated in epidemiological studies. Today, proteomics and metabolomics approaches in human observational studies are used to discover obesity biomarkers in blood, supported by Mendelian randomization studies to draw causal inferences. Here we review adipose tissue-derived blood-based obesity biomarkers and their relevance for disease risk, along with their potential role as mediators. Proteomics and metabolomics studies have partly re-identified traditional biomarkers, but more large-scale prospective analyses are needed to obtain evidence of the relevance of omics-based and traditional obesity biomarkers to disease.

papers.title: Chronic low-dose exposure to chlorpyrifos reduces life span in a wild fish by accelerating aging
papers.abstract: Low concentrations of chemicals are widespread in the environment, but exploration of the effects of their chronic exposures on animal life span in the wild is limited. papers.title: Macrophage MR1 antigen presentation promotes MAIT cell immunity and lung microbiota modulation

papers.title: A high-throughput, flow cytometry approach to measure phase behavior and exchange in biomolecular condensates
papers.abstract: Biomolecular condensates are essential for cellular organization, yet their formation dynamics and molecular content exchange properties remain poorly understood. Here we show that flow cytometry provides a high-throughput, solution-based platform for analyzing condensate behavior at the single-droplet level. Using self-interacting NPM1 condensates as a model, we demonstrate that this approach quantifies phase behavior across protein and salt conditions, measures the partitioning of diverse macromolecules-including antibodies, lipids, small-molecule drugs, and RNA-and detects molecular colocalization with high statistical precision. Importantly, we establish a high-throughput assay to track real-time molecular exchange between preformed condensates and newly added, orthogonally tagged protein. These measurements reveal that condensate aging significantly reduces molecular dynamisms, likely due to altered biophysical properties with time. Compared to conventional imaging techniques that require surface immobilization or complex instrumentation, our method enables rapid, quantitative characterization of condensate dynamics and molecular content, providing a scalable framework for probing condensate function.

papers.title: Deep-learning analysis of 3D microarchitectural remodeling in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy

These findings define genotype-specific microstructural differences in HCM, offering insights to improve diagnostics and targeted therapies.

HCM 심장에서 얻은 조직의 분석은 심근세포 부피, 형태 및 세포외 부피에서 유전자형 특이적 차이를 밝혔으며, 병원성 변이(pathogenic variant)는 더 큰 동심성 세포 비대와 구조적 혼란(disarray)을 보인 반면 변이 음성 사례는 주로 섬유화를 나타냈다. 돼지 HCM 모델의 종단적 분석은 심근세포 비대에 앞서 초기 발병 섬유화를 확인하였다. 전사체 및 형태학적 변화를 통합하여, 우리는 세포 및 세포외 리모델링과 연관된 유전자들을 확인하였다. 이러한 발견은 HCM에서 유전자형 특이적 미세구조 차이를 규정하며, 진단과 표적 치료를 개선하기 위한 통찰을 제공한다.

papers.title: Multi-omics profiling of cachexia-targeted tissues reveals a spatio-temporally coordinated response to cancer
papers.abstract: Cachexia is a wasting disorder associated with high morbidity and mortality in patients with cancer. Tumour-host interaction and maladaptive metabolic reprogramming are substantial, yet poorly understood, contributors to cachexia. Here we present a comprehensive overview of the spatio-temporal metabolic reprogramming during cachexia, using integrated metabolomics, RNA sequencing and 13 C-glucose tracing data from multiple tissues and tumours of C26 tumour-bearing male mice at different disease stages. We identified one-carbon metabolism as a tissue-overarching pathway characteristic for metabolic wasting in mice and patients and linked to inflammation, glucose hypermetabolism and atrophy in muscle. The same metabolic rewiring also occurred in five additional mouse models, namely Panc02, 8025, Apc Min , LLC and KPP, and a humanised cachexia mouse model. Together, our study provides a molecular framework for understanding metabolic reprogramming and the multi-tissue metabolite-coordinated response during cancer cachexia progression, with one-carbon metabolism as a tissue-overarching mechanism linked to wasting.
papers.abstractKo: 악액질(cachexia)은 암 환자에서 높은 이환율과 사망률과 연관된 소모성 장애이다. 종양-숙주 상호작용과 부적응적 대사 재프로그래밍은 악액질의 중요한 기여 요인이지만, 아직 충분히 이해되지 않았다. 여기에서 우리는 서로 다른 질병 단계의 C26 종양 이식 수컷 마우스의 여러 조직 및 종양으로부터 얻은 통합 metabolomics, RNA sequencing 및 13 C-glucose tracing 데이터를 사용하여, 악액질 동안의 시공간적 대사 재프로그래밍에 대한 포괄적인 개요를 제시한다. 우리는 one-carbon metabolism을 마우스와 환자에서 대사성 소모(metabolic wasting)의 특징적인 조직-전반적(pathway overarching) 경로로 규명하였고, 이를 염증, 포도당 과대대사(glucose hypermetabolism) 및 근육 위축과 연관지었다. 동일한 대사 재배선은 추가로 다섯 가지 마우스 모델, 즉 Panc02, 8025, Apc Min, LLC 및 KPP, 그리고 인간화된 악액질 마우스 모델에서도 발생하였다. 종합하면, 본 연구는 암 악액질 진행 동안의 대사 재프로그래밍과 다중 조직 대사산물 조정 반응을 이해하기 위한 분자적 틀을 제시하며, one-carbon metabolism이 소모와 연관된 조직-전반적 기전으로 작용함을 보여준다.

papers.title: Intranasal DC-targeting vaccine booster elicits durable and cross-clade protective immunity against sarbecoviruses in mice
papers.abstract: Short-lived, clade-specific immune responses with limited mucosal priming are limitations of current COVID-19 mRNA vaccines. We have developed a nasal booster vaccine candidate that induced robust, sustained, cross-clade, systemic, and mucosal protective immunity. Two recombinant Clec9A-specific monoclonal antibodies fused to the receptor binding domain (RBD) from Omicron XBB.1.5 and SARS-CoV-1 were generated. In Comirnaty mRNA-vaccinated mice, boosting with both constructs combined (Clec9AOMNI) induced cross-clade neutralizing antibodies and T cell responses that were greater in magnitude and more sustained compared with bivalent Comirnaty (BC) mRNA vaccine booster. Persistence of RBD-specific follicular helper CD4+ T cells, germinal center B cells, and long-lived plasma cells that facilitated affinity maturation correlated with detection of triple cross-reactive B cells binding the RBDs of ancestral SARS-CoV-2, XBB.1.5, and SARS-CoV-1. Remarkably, intranasal boosting with Clec9AOMNI elicited robust and durable immunity across the upper and lower airways while concurrently boosting the systemic immunity to levels matching or exceeding those from systemic boosting. Correspondingly, Clec9AOMNI nasal booster conferred superior protection against SARS-CoV-2 challenge compared with BC mRNA booster, with undetectable viral titers in the respiratory tract. Hence, Clec9AOMNI is a promising nasal booster vaccine candidate that has the potential to mitigate pandemic threats from emerging sarbecoviruses.
papers.abstractKo: 단기간 지속되며 mucosal priming이 제한된 clade-specific 면역반응은 현재 COVID-19 mRNA 백신의 한계이다. 우리는 강력하고 지속적이며 cross-clade, systemic 및 mucosal protective immunity를 유도하는 비강(nasal) 부스터 백신 후보를 개발하였다. Omicron XBB.1.5 및 SARS-CoV-1의 receptor binding domain(RBD)과 융합된 두 개의 recombinant Clec9A-specific monoclonal antibody를 생성하였다. Comirnaty mRNA 백신을 접종한 마우스에서 두 construct를 함께 병용한 부스팅(Clec9AOMNI)은 bivalent Comirnaty(BC) mRNA 백신 부스터에 비해 더 큰 규모이면서 더 지속적인 cross-clade neutralizing antibody와 T cell response를 유도하였다. RBD-specific follicular helper CD4+ T cells, germinal center B cells, 및 affinity maturation을 촉진하는 long-lived plasma cells의 지속성은 ancestral SARS-CoV-2, XBB.1.5, 및 SARS-CoV-1의 RBD에 결합하는 triple cross-reactive B cells의 검출과 상관관계를 보였다. 주목할 만하게도, intranasal boosting with Clec9AOMNI는 상기도와 하기도 전반에 걸쳐 강력하고 지속적인 면역을 유도하는 동시에, systemic boosting에서 얻어지는 수준과 같거나 이를 상회하는 수준으로 systemic immunity를 함께 강화하였다. 이에 상응하여, Clec9AOMNI nasal booster는 BC mRNA booster에 비해 SARS-CoV-2 challenge에 대한 우수한 보호효과를 제공하였고, 호흡기에서 검출 불가능한 viral titer를 보였다. 따라서 Clec9AOMNI는 새롭게 등장하는 sarbecoviruses로 인한 팬데믹 위협을 완화할 잠재력을 지닌 유망한 nasal booster vaccine candidate이다.

papers.title: NRF2–COX2–PGE2 axis drives immune cold tumors and predicts resistance to combination immunotherapy in hepatocellular carcinoma
papers.abstract: Background and aims Atezolizumab plus bevacizumab (Atez/Bev) is the first-line immunotherapy for advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), yet many patients show primary or acquired resistance. We aimed to identify tumor-intrinsic mechanisms driving immune cold tumor microenvironments (TMEs) and Atez/Bev resistance. Approach and results We used a genetically heterogeneous immunocompetent HCC mouse model generated by hydrodynamic injection of a barcoded oncogene library, integrating single-cell RNA sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, and bulk RNA sequencing of human HCC tissues. Retrospective analyses included a multi-institutional registry of 549 Atez/Bev-treated patients and 199 surgically resected HCC patients. External validation used RNA-seq data from 247 patients registered in the IMbrave150 and GO30140 trials. In mice, Atez/Bev eliminated hot tumors, while pre-existing cold tumors with exhausted effector T cells and Tregs predominated later. Barcode analysis revealed enrichment of NFE2L2 (NRF2) in resistant tumors. NRF2 overexpression suppressed immune infiltration and conferred resistance, which was reversed by NRF2 or COX2 inhibition. In human cohorts, both non-responders and patients with acquired resistance exhibited high NRF2/COX2 expression and immune exclusion, confirmed by spatial profiling. High NRF2 activity predicted shorter progression-free survival (PFS), whereas concomitant COX2 inhibitor use correlated with longer PFS. Plasma prostaglandin E2 (PGE 2 ) independently predicted poor response and survival. In IMbrave150/GO30140, NRF2 and prostaglandin pathway activation correlated with Atez/Bev resistance but not sorafenib response, validating a treatment-specific mechanism. Conclusions Tumor-intrinsic activation of the NRF2-COX2-PGE 2 axis drives immune cold TMEs and mediates Atez/Bev resistance in HCC. Targeting this pathway may enhance efficacy, and plasma PGE 2 represents a non-invasive biomarker for stratification.
papers.abstractKo: 배경 및 목적 아테졸리주맙과 베바시주맙(Atez/Bev)은 진행성 간세포암(HCC)에 대한 1차 면역치료이지만, 많은 환자에서 일차 또는 후천적 저항성이 나타난다. 본 연구는 immune cold 종양 미세환경(TME)과 Atez/Bev 저항성을 유도하는 종양 고유의 기전을 규명하고자 하였다. 접근 및 결과 우리는 바코드화된 oncogene library의 hydrodynamic injection으로 생성된 유전적으로 이질적인 면역능숙(immune-competent) HCC 마우스 모델을 사용하였고, single-cell RNA sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, 그리고 인간 HCC 조직의 bulk RNA sequencing을 통합하였다. 후향적 분석에는 549명의 Atez/Bev 치료 환자와 199명의 외과적 절제 HCC 환자로 구성된 다기관 registry가 포함되었다. 외부 검증은 IMbrave150 및 GO30140 시험에 등록된 247명의 환자에서 얻은 RNA-seq 데이터를 사용하였다. 마우스에서 Atez/Bev는 hot tumor를 제거하였으나, 이후에는 exhausted effector T cells 및 Tregs를 가진 기존의 cold tumor가 우세하였다. Barcode 분석은 저항성 종양에서 NFE2L2(NRF2)의 풍부화를 보여주었다. NRF2 과발현은 면역 침윤을 억제하고 저항성을 부여하였으며, 이는 NRF2 또는 COX2 억제로 역전되었다. 인간 코호트에서 반응하지 않는 환자와 후천적 저항성을 보인 환자 모두 높은 NRF2/COX2 발현과 면역 배제를 나타냈고, 이는 spatial profiling으로 확인되었다. 높은 NRF2 활성은 더 짧은 progression-free survival(PFS)을 예측한 반면, COX2 inhibitor의 동시 사용은 더 긴 PFS와 연관되었다. 혈장 prostaglandin E2(PGE2)는 독립적으로 불량한 반응과 생존을 예측하였다. IMbrave150/GO30140에서 NRF2 및 prostaglandin pathway 활성화는 Atez/Bev 저항성과 상관되었으나 sorafenib 반응과는 상관되지 않아, 치료 특이적 기전을 검증하였다. 결론 종양 고유의 NRF2-COX2-PGE2 축 활성화는 immune cold TME를 유도하고 HCC에서 Atez/Bev 저항성을 매개한다. 이 경로를 표적화하면 효능을 향상시킬 수 있으며, 혈장 PGE2는 층화(stratification)를 위한 비침습적 biomarker이다.

papers.title: ER stress signaling at the interphase between MASH and HCC
papers.abstract: HCC is the most frequent primary liver cancer with an extremely poor prognosis and often develops on preset of chronic liver diseases. Major risk factors for HCC include metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis, a complex multifactorial condition associated with abnormal endoplasmic reticulum (ER) proteostasis. To cope with ER stress, the unfolded protein response engages adaptive reactions to restore the secretory capacity of the cell. Recent advances revealed that ER stress signaling plays a critical role in HCC progression. Here, we propose that chronic ER stress is a common transversal factor contributing to the transition from liver disease (risk factor) to HCC. Interventional strategies to target the unfolded protein response in HCC, such as cancer therapy, are also discussed.
papers.abstractKo: HCC는 가장 흔한 원발성 간암으로, 예후가 극히 불량하며 종종 만성 간질환의 기저 위에서 발생한다. HCC의 주요 위험 인자에는 metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis가 포함되며, 이는 비정상적인 endoplasmic reticulum (ER) proteostasis와 연관된 복합적인 다인자성 질환이다. ER stress에 대처하기 위해 unfolded protein response는 세포의 분비 능력을 회복시키는 적응 반응을 유도한다. 최근의 진전은 ER stress signaling이 HCC 진행에서 중요한 역할을 한다는 점을 밝혀냈다. 본고에서는 만성 ER stress가 간질환(위험 인자)에서 HCC로의 전환에 기여하는 공통의 횡단적 요인이라고 제안한다. 또한 암 치료와 같이 HCC에서 unfolded protein response를 표적으로 하는 중재 전략에 대해서도 논의한다.

papers.title: Genetic predisposition to porto-sinusoidal vascular disorder
papers.abstract: Porto-sinusoidal vascular disorder (PSVD) is a rare liver disease. The pathophysiological mechanisms underlying the development of PSVD are unknown. Isolated cases of PSVD associated with gene mutations have been reported, but no overview is available. Therefore, we performed an extensive literature search to provide a comprehensive overview of gene mutations associated with PSVD. We identified 34 genes and 1 chromosomal abnormality associated with PSVD in the literature, and we describe here 1 additional gene mutation ( TBL1XR1 mutation, leading to Pierpont syndrome). These gene mutations are associated either with extrahepatic organ involvement as part of syndromes (Adams-Oliver, telomere biology disorders, retinal vasculopathy with cerebral leukoencephalopathy and systemic manifestations, immune deficiencies, cystic fibrosis, cystinosis, Williams-Beuren, Turner, Pierpont) or with isolated PSVD ( KCNN3 , DGUOK , FOPV , GIMAP5 , FCHSD1 , TRMT5 , HRG gene mutations). Most of the cases were revealed by signs or complications of portal hypertension. When analyzing the cell types in which these genes are expressed, we found that these genes are predominantly expressed in immune cells, suggesting that these cells may play a more important role in the development of PSVD than previously thought. In addition, pathway analyses suggested that there may be 2 types of PSVD associated with gene mutations: those resulting directly from morphogenetic abnormalities and those secondary to immune changes.
papers.abstractKo: 포르토-시누소이드 혈관질환(porto-sinusoidal vascular disorder, PSVD)은 드문 간 질환이다. PSVD 발생의 기저가 되는 병태생리학적 기전은 알려져 있지 않다. 유전자 돌연변이와 관련된 PSVD의 단독 사례들이 보고된 바 있으나, 전체적인 개요는 마련되어 있지 않다. 따라서 우리는 PSVD와 연관된 유전자 돌연변이에 대한 포괄적 개요를 제공하기 위해 광범위한 문헌 검색을 수행하였다. 문헌에서 PSVD와 연관된 34개 유전자와 1개의 염색체 이상을 확인하였으며, 여기에서는 추가적인 1개의 유전자 돌연변이(TBL1XR1 mutation, Pierpont syndrome으로 이어짐)를 기술한다. 이러한 유전자 돌연변이는 증후군의 일부로서 간외 장기 침범(Adams-Oliver, telomere biology disorders, retinal vasculopathy with cerebral leukoencephalopathy and systemic manifestations, immune deficiencies, cystic fibrosis, cystinosis, Williams-Beuren, Turner, Pierpont)과 연관되거나, 또는 단독 PSVD(KCNN3, DGUOK, FOPV, GIMAP5, FCHSD1, TRMT5, HRG gene mutations)와 연관된다. 대부분의 사례는 문맥고혈압(portal hypertension)의 징후 또는 합병증으로 인해 발견되었다. 이러한 유전자들이 발현되는 세포 유형을 분석한 결과, 이들 유전자는 주로 면역세포에서 발현되며, 이는 이러한 세포가 이전에 생각했던 것보다 PSVD 발생에서 더 중요한 역할을 할 수 있음을 시사한다. 또한 경로 분석(pathway analyses)은 유전자 돌연변이와 연관된 PSVD가 2가지 유형일 가능성을 제시하였다. 즉, 형태형성 이상(morphogenetic abnormalities)에서 직접 기인하는 경우와 면역 변화에 이차적인 경우이다.

papers.title: Precision phenotyping of type 2 diabetes in chinese populations using a variational autoencoder-informed tree model
papers.abstract: Type 2 diabetes (T2D) exhibits clinical heterogeneity, yet most existing classification models are derived from European populations and face challenges in clinical application. Here, we evaluate the generalizability of a tree-like graph structure from Scottish data to 32,501 newly diagnosed T2D patients from a multi-center Chinese cohort comprising over 8.6 million individuals. We observe similar distribution between the Scottish and Chinese individuals in heart and kidney outcomes, but diabetic retinopathy varies across ancestries even within similar phenotypes. To capture T2D Chinese-specific heterogeneity, we apply a variational autoencoder (VAE) framework to identify key clinical features and construct a tree structure using the Discriminative Dimensionality Reduction Tree (DDRTree) algorithm. This Chinese tree model is validated in two independent external cohorts and revealed longitudinal phenotypic shifts trending toward higher-risk branches. Our findings emphasize the need for population-specific classification frameworks to advance precision diabetology through individualized risk prediction and specialized treatment guidelines.
papers.abstractKo: 제2형 당뇨병(type 2 diabetes, T2D)은 임상적 이질성을 보이지만, 기존의 대부분의 분류 모델은 유럽 인구집단에서 도출되었으며 임상 적용에 어려움이 있다. 본 연구에서는 86만 명 이상의 개인을 포함하는 다기관 중국 코호트에서 새로 진단된 32,501명의 T2D 환자에게 스코틀랜드 데이터로부터 도출된 tree-like graph structure의 일반화 가능성을 평가하였다. 우리는 심장 및 신장 결과에서 스코틀랜드와 중국 개인 간에 유사한 분포를 관찰하였으나, 당뇨병성 망막병증(diabetic retinopathy)은 유사한 표현형 내에서도 조상(ancestry)에 따라 달랐다. T2D의 중국 특이적 이질성을 포착하기 위해, 주요 임상 특징을 식별하고 Discriminative Dimensionality Reduction Tree(DDRTree) 알고리즘을 사용하여 tree structure를 구축하기 위해 variational autoencoder(VAE) 프레임워크를 적용하였다. 이 중국 tree model은 두 개의 독립적인 외부 코호트에서 검증되었으며, 더 높은 위험의 branch를 향하는 종적 표현형 변화(longitudinal phenotypic shifts)를 밝혀냈다. 본 연구 결과는 개별화된 위험 예측과 특화된 치료 지침을 통해 precision diabetology를 발전시키기 위해 집단 특이적 분류 프레임워크의 필요성을 강조한다.

papers.title: Identification of modifiable plasma protein markers of cardiometabolic risk in children and adolescents with obesity
papers.abstract: Pediatric obesity is linked to multi-organ inflammation and an increased risk of cardiometabolic and steatotic liver disease. To identify circulating biomarkers of cardiometabolic risk, we performed proximity extension assay proteomics, to quantify 149 inflammation- and cardiovascular-related proteins in a cross-sectional study of 4024 children and adolescents (2377 with obesity and 1647 with normal weight). We identified protein signatures linked to obesity, dyslipidemia, insulin resistance, hyperglycemia, hypertension, and related cardiometabolic phenotypes. Using machine learning, a three-protein panel (CDCP1, FGF21, HAOX1) combined with liver enzymes improved prediction of steatotic liver disease versus liver enzymes alone (receiver operating characteristic-area under the curve (ROC-AUC) = 0.83 vs. 0.77; DeLong's test, P < 0.05). During a 1-year non-pharmacological obesity intervention (n = 184), reductions in adiposity were associated with decreased inflammatory cytokines (including CDCP1, FGF21), which correlated with improvements in cardiometabolic risk profiles. Here we show that circulating proteomic signatures may mediate obesity-related cardiometabolic risk in youth.

papers.title: Microbiota-induced T cell plasticity enables immune-mediated tumour control
papers.abstract: Therapies that harness the immune system to target and eliminate tumour cells have revolutionized cancer care. Immune checkpoint blockade (ICB), which boosts the anti-tumour immune response by inhibiting negative regulators of T cell activation 1-3 , is remarkably successful in a subset of cancer patients. Yet a significant proportion do not respond to treatment, emphasizing the need to understand factors influencing the therapeutic efficacy of ICB 4-9 . The gut microbiota, consisting of trillions of microorganisms residing in the gastrointestinal tract, has emerged as a critical determinant of immune function and response to cancer immunotherapy, with several studies demonstrating association of microbiota composition with clinical response 10-16 . However, a mechanistic understanding of how gut commensal bacteria influence the efficacy of ICB remains elusive. Here we use a gut commensal microorganism, segmented filamentous bacteria (SFB), which induces an antigen-specific T helper 17 (T H 17) cell effector program in the small intestine lamina propria (SILP) 17 , to investigate how colonization with this microbe affects the efficacy of ICB in restraining distal growth of tumours sharing antigen with SFB. We find that anti-programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1) treatment effectively inhibits the growth of implanted SFB antigen-expressing melanoma only if mice are colonized with SFB. Through T cell receptor (TCR) clonal lineage tracing, fate mapping and peptide-major histocompatability complex (MHC) tetramer staining, we identify tumour-associated SFB-specific T helper 1 (T H 1)-like cells derived from the homeostatic T H 17 cells induced by SFB colonization in the SILP. These gut-educated ex-T H 17 cells produce high levels of the pro-inflammatory cytokines interferon (IFN)-γ and tumour necrosis factor (TNF) within the tumour microenvironment (TME), enhancing antigen presentation and promoting recruitment, expansion and effector functions of CD8 + tumour-infiltrating cytotoxic lymphocytes and thereby enabling anti-PD-1-mediated tumour control. Conditional ablation of SFB-induced IL-17A + CD4 + T cells, precursors of tumour-associated T H 1-like cells, abolishes anti-PD-1-mediated tumour control and markedly impairs tumour-specific CD8 + T cell recruitment and effector function within the TME. Our data, as a proof of principle, define a cellular pathway by which a single, defined intestinal commensal imprints T cell plasticity that potentiates PD-1 blockade, and indicate targeted modulation of the microbiota as a strategy to broaden ICB efficacy.

T 세포 활성화의 음성 조절자(negative regulators)를 억제함으로써 항종양 면역 반응을 증강하는 면역 체크포인트 차단(immune checkpoint blockade, ICB)은 일부 암 환자에서 현저한 성공을 거두고 있다1-3. 그러나 상당한 비율의 환자들은 치료에 반응하지 않으며, 이는 ICB의 치료 효능에 영향을 미치는 요인들을 이해할 필요성을 강조한다4-9. 위장관(gastrointestinal tract)에 존재하는 수조 개의 미생물로 이루어진 장내 미생물총(gut microbiota)은 면역 기능과 암 면역치료에 대한 반응의 중요한 결정 인자로 부상하였고, 여러 연구에서 미생물총 조성과 임상 반응의 연관성이 입증되었다10-16. 그러나 장 상재균(gut commensal bacteria)이 ICB의 효능에 어떻게 영향을 미치는지에 대한 기전적 이해는 여전히 불명확하다. 여기에서 우리는 소장 고유판(small intestine lamina propria, SILP)에서 항원 특이적 T helper 17 (T H 17) 세포 effector program을 유도하는 장 상재 미생물인 segmented filamentous bacteria (SFB)를 이용하여17, 이 미생물의 집락화(colonization)가 SFB와 항원을 공유하는 종양의 원거리 성장(distal growth)을 억제하는 데 있어 ICB의 효능에 어떻게 영향을 미치는지 조사하였다. 우리는 anti-programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1) 치료가 SFB 항원을 발현하는 이식 멜라노마(implanted SFB antigen-expressing melanoma)의 성장을 SFB에 의해 집락화된 마우스에서만 효과적으로 억제함을 확인하였다. T cell receptor (TCR) 클론 계통 추적(clonal lineage tracing), fate mapping 및 peptide-major histocompatibility complex (MHC) tetramer 염색을 통해, 우리는 SILP에서 SFB 집락화에 의해 유도된 항상성(homeostatic) T H 17 세포로부터 유래한 종양 관련 SFB 특이적 T helper 1 (T H 1)-유사 세포를 확인하였다. 이러한 장에서 교육된(gut-educated) ex-T H 17 세포는 종양 미세환경(tumour microenvironment, TME) 내에서 높은 수준의 pro-inflammatory cytokines interferon (IFN)-γ와 tumour necrosis factor (TNF)를 생성하여 항원 제시(antigen presentation)를 강화하고, CD8 + 종양 침윤 세포독성 림프구(tumour-infiltrating cytotoxic lymphocytes)의 유입, 확장 및 effector functions를 촉진함으로써 anti-PD-1 매개 종양 억제를 가능하게 한다. 종양 관련 T H 1-like 세포의 전구체인 SFB 유도 IL-17A + CD4 + T 세포의 조건부 제거(conditional ablation)는 anti-PD-1 매개 종양 억제를 소실시키고 TME 내 종양 특이적 CD8 + T 세포의 유입 및 effector function을 현저히 저해한다. 원리 증명(proof of principle)으로서 우리의 자료는 단일의 정의된 장 상재균이 T 세포 plasticity를 각인하여 PD-1 차단을 증강하는 세포 경로를 규정하며, 미생물총의 표적 조절(targeted modulation)이 ICB 효능을 확대하기 위한 전략이 될 수 있음을 시사한다.

papers.title: The ubiquitin ligase KLHL6 drives resistance to CD8+ T cell dysfunction
papers.abstract: The multifaceted dysfunction of tumour-infiltrating T cells, including exhaustion and mitochondrial dysfunction, remains a major obstacle in cancer immunotherapy 1-6 . Transcriptomic and epigenomic regulation of T cell dysfunction have been extensively studied 7-9 , but the role of proteostasis in regulating these obstacles remains less defined. Here we combined computational analyses of atlases of T cell exhaustion and mitochondrial fitness with performed targeted in vivo CRISPR screens, which identified the E3 ubiquitin ligase KLHL6 as a dual-negative regulator of both T cell exhaustion and mitochondrial dysfunction. Mechanistically, KLHL6 expression promoted TOX poly-ubiquitination and subsequent proteasomal degradation, thereby attenuating the transition of progenitor exhausted T cells towards terminal exhaustion. Simultaneously, KLHL6 maintained mitochondrial fitness by constraining the excessive mitochondrial fission that occurs during chronic T cell receptor stimulation by means of post-translational regulation of the PGAM5-Drp1 axis. However, KLHL6 is naturally downregulated by T cell receptor ligation, mitigating its potentially beneficial ubiquitin ligase activities during exposure to chronic stimulation. Enforcing KLHL6 expression in T cells markedly improved efficacy and long-term persistence against tumours and during viral infections in vivo. These findings uncover KLHL6 as a multifunctional, clinically actionable target for cancer immunotherapy, and highlight the potential of modulating proteostasis and ubiquitin modification to improve immunotherapy.

T cell dysfunction의 전사체 및 후성유전체(epigenomic) 조절은 광범위하게 연구되어 왔으나7-9, 이러한 장애를 조절하는 데 있어 proteostasis의 역할은 아직 덜 규명되어 있다. 여기서 우리는 T cell exhaustion 및 mitochondrial fitness의 atlas에 대한 계산 분석과 표적화된 in vivo CRISPR screens를 결합하였고, 그 결과 E3 ubiquitin ligase KLHL6가 T cell exhaustion과 mitochondrial dysfunction 모두의 이중 음성 조절인자(dual-negative regulator)임을 확인하였다. 기전적으로, KLHL6 발현은 TOX poly-ubiquitination 및 그에 따른 proteasomal degradation을 촉진하여, progenitor exhausted T cells가 terminal exhaustion으로 전이하는 것을 완화하였다. 동시에 KLHL6는 post-translational regulation of the PGAM5-Drp1 axis를 통해 만성 T cell receptor stimulation 동안 발생하는 과도한 mitochondrial fission을 억제함으로써 mitochondrial fitness를 유지하였다. 그러나 KLHL6는 T cell receptor ligation에 의해 자연적으로 하향 조절되며, 이로써 만성 자극 노출 동안 잠재적으로 유익한 ubiquitin ligase 활성은 약화된다. papers.title: Cholesterol-lowering effects of oats induced by microbially produced phenolic metabolites in metabolic syndrome: a randomized controlled trial
papers.abstract: Oats have various positive effects on human health, but the underlying mechanisms are not fully understood. To identify oat-microbiome-host interactions contributing to metabolic improvements, we conducted two randomized controlled dietary interventions in parallel-design in individuals with metabolic syndrome, comparing a short-term, high-dose and a six-week, moderate oat intake with respective controls (DRKS00022169). Both oat diets lead to an increase in plasma ferulic acid (0.64 [0.26, 1.02], P = 0.002; 0.55 [0.21, 0.89], P = 0.003), while the high-dose oat-diet also increased dihydroferulic acid (1.23 [0.44, 2.01], P = 0.003). Here we show that microbial phenolic metabolites are driving factors for the cholesterol-lowering effect of oats, which might be of relevance since short-term, high-dose oat-diet is a suitable approach to alleviate obesity-related lipid disorders.

papers.title: Loss of Fsr quorum sensing promotes biofilm formation and worsens outcomes in enterococcal infective endocarditis
papers.abstract: Infective endocarditis (IE) is a severe heart infection caused predominantly by Gram-positive bacteria forming biofilm on heart valves. While biofilm formation is central to disease progression, the underlying bacterial mechanisms remain poorly understood. Here, we identify the Fsr quorum sensing (QS) system of Enterococcus faecalis as an unexpected negative regulator of biofilm and pathogenesis in IE. Using microfluidic and in vivo models, we show that blood flow prevents Fsr activation in early IE, with Fsr induction occurring only later, once bacteria form biofilm microcolonies and become shielded from flow. Deletion of Fsr promotes robust biofilm growth, driven partly through the downregulation of GelE and SprE proteases, reprograms metabolism by upregulating lrgAB to enhance pyruvate utilization, and increases gentamicin tolerance in vivo. Furthermore, we show that GelE cleaves the human pro-IL-1β into an active form, suggesting a species-specific mechanism for inflammation modulation by QS. In support of these findings, analysis of IE patient cohorts shows that naturally occurring Fsr-deficient E. faecalis strains are associated with prolonged bacteremia. Overall, our findings provide insights into how host blood flow impacts QS activation, which, in turn, regulates pathogenesis in IE, and highlight the Fsr QS as a potential determinant of clinical disease course.

Microfluidic 및 in vivo 모델을 이용하여, 혈류가 초기 IE에서 Fsr activation을 억제하며, Fsr induction은 세균이 biofilm microcolony를 형성하고 혈류로부터 보호받게 되는 이후에야 발생함을 보였다. Fsr의 결손은 견고한 biofilm 성장을 촉진하였고, 이는 부분적으로 GelE 및 SprE protease의 하향 조절에 의해 유도되었으며, lrgAB의 상향 조절을 통해 pyruvate 이용을 강화하도록 metabolism을 재프로그램하였고, in vivo에서 gentamicin tolerance를 증가시켰다. 또한, GelE가 인간 pro-IL-1β를 활성형으로 절단한다는 점을 보여, QS에 의한 inflammation 조절의 종(species)-특이적 기전을 시사하였다. 이러한 결과를 뒷받침하듯, IE 환자 코호트 분석에서 자연적으로 발생하는 Fsr 결손 E. faecalis 균주는 prolonged bacteremia와 연관되어 있었다. 종합하면, 본 연구는 숙주 혈류가 QS activation에 미치는 영향과, 이것이 다시 IE에서 병원성을 조절하는 방식을 이해하는 데 통찰을 제공하며, Fsr QS가 임상적 질병 경과의 잠재적 결정인자임을 강조한다.

papers.title: 6-Phosphogluconate dehydrogenase promotes mitochondrial fusion and immune suppression in tumor-associated monocytic suppressor cells
papers.abstract: The mechanisms underlying the metabolic adaptation of myeloid cells within the tumor microenvironment remain incompletely understood. Here, we identify 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase (6PGD), a rate-limiting enzyme in the pentose phosphate pathway (PPP), as an important regulator of monocytic-myeloid derived suppressor cell (M-MDSC) function. Our findings reveal that tumor M-MDSCs upregulate 6PGD expression via IL-6/STAT3 signaling. Blocking 6PGD, using either genetic or pharmacological approaches, impairs the immunosuppressive function of M-MDSCs and suppresses tumor growth. Mechanistically, 6PGD inhibition leads to the accumulation of its substrate, 6-phosphogluconate (6PG), within M-MDSCs, activates the JNK1-IRS1 and PI3K-AKT-pDRP1 signaling pathways, leading to mitochondrial fragmentation and elevated mitochondrial reactive oxygen species (ROS). This metabolic shift drives M-MDSCs toward an M1-like proinflammatory phenotype. Furthermore, 6PGD blockade synergizes with anti-PD-1 immunotherapy in a preclinical tumor model, substantially improving therapeutic outcomes. Our data reveals 6PGD as a possible therapeutic target to disrupt M-MDSC function and improve cancer immunotherapy outcomes.
papers.abstractKo: 종양 미세환경 내 골수계 세포의 대사 적응을 뒷받침하는 기전은 아직 완전히 이해되지 않았다. 여기서 우리는 펜토오스 인산 경로(pentose phosphate pathway, PPP)의 속도 제한 효소인 6-phosphogluconate dehydrogenase(6PGD)를 monocytic-myeloid derived suppressor cell(M-MDSC) 기능의 중요한 조절자로 규명하였다. 우리의 결과는 종양 M-MDSC가 IL-6/STAT3 신호전을 통해 6PGD 발현을 상향조절함을 보여준다. 유전적 또는 약리학적 접근을 사용하여 6PGD를 차단하면 M-MDSC의 면역억제 기능이 손상되고 종양 성장이 억제된다. 기전적으로, 6PGD 억제는 M-MDSC 내에서 그 기질인 6-phosphogluconate(6PG)의 축적을 유도하고, JNK1-IRS1 및 PI3K-AKT-pDRP1 신호전달 경로를 활성화하여 미토콘드리아 단편화와 미토콘드리아 reactive oxygen species(ROS) 증가를 초래한다. 이러한 대사적 전환은 M-MDSC를 M1-like proinflammatory phenotype으로 유도한다. 또한, 6PGD 차단은 전임상 종양 모델에서 anti-PD-1 면역치료와 상승작용을 나타내어 치료 결과를 현저히 향상시킨다. 우리의 데이터는 M-MDSC 기능을 교란하고 암 면역치료 결과를 개선하기 위한 가능한 치료 표적으로서 6PGD를 제시한다.

papers.title: T cell receptor–engineered T cells targeting the TP53R248Q neoantigen elicit antitumor effects in human cancer models
papers.abstract: Malignant tumors with TP53 mutations exhibit poor therapeutic outcomes and high recurrence rates. T cell receptor-based (TCR-based) T cell therapy shows great promise for targeting intracellular cancer neoantigens. However, the immunogenic potential of TP53 hotspot mutations remains poorly characterized. Here, we identified an immunogenic neoantigen derived from the recurrent TP53R248Q mutation, presented by the prevalent HLA-A*11:01 allele. Additionally, we isolated a TP53R248Q-reactive TCR that specifically recognized the TP53R248Q mutation without any discernible cross-activity with cognate WT TP53 or other TP53 mutants at the same codon position. Functional characterization revealed that TP53R248Q TCR-T cells exhibited selective cytotoxicity against tumor cells expressing both the TP53R248Q mutation and HLA-A*11:01 in vitro. Importantly, the adoptive transfer of TP53R248Q TCR-T cells exhibited significant antitumor activity in a clinically relevant patient-derived xenograft model engrafted with TP53R248Q/HLA-A*11:01-positive human tumor tissues. Collectively, our study validates the immunogenicity of the TP53R248Q hotspot mutation and provides a TCR with high therapeutic potential for the development of T cell therapies targeting TP53R248Q/HLA-A*11:01-positive cancers.
papers.abstractKo: TP53 변이를 가진 악성 종양은 불량한 치료 결과와 높은 재발률을 보인다. T cell receptor-based(TCR-based) T 세포 치료는 세포내 암 neoantigen을 표적화하는 데 큰 가능성을 보인다. 그러나 TP53 hotspot 변이의 면역원성(immunogenic potential)은 아직 충분히 규명되지 않았다. 본 연구에서는 높은 빈도의 HLA-A*11:01 대립유전자에 의해 제시되는, 재발성 TP53R248Q 변이에서 유래한 면역원성 neoantigen을 규명하였다. 또한, 우리는 동일한 codon 위치의 WT TP53 또는 다른 TP53 변이와는 뚜렷한 교차 반응성(cross-activity) 없이 TP53R248Q 변이를 특이적으로 인지하는 TP53R248Q 반응성 TCR을 분리하였다. 기능적 특성 분석에서 TP53R248Q TCR-T 세포는 in vitro에서 TP53R248Q 변이와 HLA-A*11:01을 모두 발현하는 종양 세포에 대해 선택적 세포독성(selective cytotoxicity)을 나타냈다. 특히, TP53R248Q TCR-T 세포의 adoptive transfer는 TP53R248Q/HLA-A*11:01 양성 인간 종양 조직이 이식된 임상적으로 관련성 있는 patient-derived xenograft 모델에서 유의한 항종양 활성을 보였다. 종합하면, 본 연구는 TP53R248Q hotspot 변이의 면역원성을 검증하고, TP53R248Q/HLA-A*11:01 양성 암을 표적하는 T 세포 치료 개발을 위해 높은 치료 잠재력을 지닌 TCR을 제시한다.

papers.title: A centrally positioned cluster of multiple centrioles in antigen-presenting cells fosters T cell activation
papers.abstract: Cellular polarization plays a crucial role in regulating immunological processes and is often associated with reorientation of the centrosome. During immune synapse formation, centrosome repositioning in lymphocytes assists in T cell activation. While a single centrosome, consisting of two centrioles, is present in T cells, antigen-presenting cells such as dendritic cells amplify centrioles during maturation and immune activation. How centriole amplification in antigen-presenting cells affects immune synapse formation and T cell activation is unclear. In this study, we combine experimental data with mathematical and computational modelling to provide evidence that extra centrioles in dendritic cells form over-active microtubule organizing centers, which cluster during dendritic cell-T cell interactions and, unlike in T cells, localize close to the cell center. Perturbing either centrosome integrity or centriole numbers and configuration in dendritic cells results in impaired T cell activation. Collectively, our results highlight a crucial role for centriole amplification and optimal centrosome positioning in antigen-presenting cells for controlling T cell responses.
papers.abstractKo: 중심체(centrosome)의 재배향(reorientation)과 밀접하게 연관되어 있는 세포 극성화(cellular polarization)는 면역학적 과정의 조절에서 중요한 역할을 한다. 면역 시냅스(immune synapse) 형성 동안 림프구에서의 중심체 재배치는 T 세포 활성화를 돕는다. T 세포에는 2개의 중심소체(centriole)로 구성된 단일 중심체가 존재하는 반면, 수지상세포(dendritic cell)와 같은 항원제시세포(antigen-presenting cell)는 성숙 및 면역 활성화 동안 중심소체를 증폭한다. 항원제시세포에서의 중심소체 증폭이 면역 시냅스 형성과 T 세포 활성화에 어떻게 영향을 미치는지는 불분명하다. 본 연구에서 우리는 실험 데이터와 수학적 및 계산적 모델링을 결합하여, 수지상세포 내 추가 중심소체가 과활성화된 미세소관 조직화 중심(microtubule organizing center)을 형성하며, 이들이 수지상세포-T 세포 상호작용 동안 군집(cluster)을 이루고, T 세포와는 달리 세포 중심에 가깝게 위치함을 보여주는 근거를 제시한다. 수지상세포에서 중심체의 완전성(integrity) 또는 중심소체 수와 배열(configuration) 중 어느 하나를 교란하면 T 세포 활성화가 저해된다. 종합하면, 본 연구 결과는 T 세포 반응을 조절하는 데 있어 항원제시세포에서의 중심소체 증폭과 최적의 중심체 위치 결정이 결정적 역할을 함을 강조한다.

papers.title: Single-cell-resolved transcriptional dynamics of human subcutaneous adipose tissue during lifestyle- and bariatric surgery-induced weight loss
papers.abstract: Human white adipose tissue undergoes major remodelling during sustained weight gain that may compromise tissue function and drive cardiometabolic comorbidities. Although weight loss reverses many of these complications, the cellular and molecular adaptations of adipose tissue to different weight loss interventions are poorly understood. Here we show how abdominal subcutaneous adipose tissue (SAT) in men and women with severe obesity adapts to modest lifestyle-induced (8-10%) weight loss followed by substantial bariatric surgery-induced (20-45%) weight loss, using single-nucleus RNA sequencing (snRNA-seq) combined with bulk RNA-seq, and three-dimensional light-sheet fluorescence microscopy. To enable interactive exploration, all snRNA-seq data are available in a browsable format on the Single Cell Portal ( SCP2849 ). Lifestyle-induced weight loss activated proadipogenic gene programmes in progenitor cells, indicating early beneficial effects on SAT. Subsequent surgery-induced weight loss drove profound compositional and transcriptional remodelling of SAT, including increased vascularization and marked reduction of myeloid cell populations. Collectively, our study indicates that following major and sustained weight loss, SAT from individuals with severe obesity has the capacity to return to a state comparable to that observed in lean individuals.

The LiverRisk score (LRS), a non-invasive stratification tool, could enhance early identification of patients at risk for liver disease; however, it has not been validated in a large U.S. Veteran cohort with sufficient liver-related outcomes. Approach We conducted a retrospective cohort study of Veterans Health Administration (VHA) patients from 1999 to 2023. Individuals with chronic liver disease, viral hepatitis, or missing LRS values were excluded using laboratory and ICD-10 data. Patients were classified into minimal (LRS Results Among 170,998 Veterans (93% male; median age 60; 63% White), 71%, 26%, 2%, and 0.5% were classified as minimal-risk, low-risk, medium-risk, and high-risk, respectively. Over 13.5 years median follow-up, 15,463 (9%) developed a liver-related event, 6219 (3.6%) died of liver causes, and 640 (0.5%) developed HCC. C-statistics were 0.61 for events, 0.70 for mortality, and 0.71 for HCC. Accuracy was highest among Hispanic/Latino Veterans (mortality 0.77, 95% CI 0.73-0.81; HCC 0.82, 95% CI 0.75-0.90) versus non-Hispanic Whites (mortality 0.62, 95% CI 0.61-0.62). Its integration into clinical alerts and lab reports could support proactive patient care and liver disease prevention.

papers.title: PARP inhibition generates enhanced CD8+ central memory T cells by transcriptional and metabolic reprogramming
papers.abstract: CD8 + central memory T (T CM ) cells provide stronger antitumor immunity than more-differentiated effector memory counterparts. Here we show that poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibition induces CD8 + T CM cells with superior memory by activating the SIRT-1-FOXO1 pathway and inducing metabolic and transcriptional switches through inhibition of enzymatic activity and enhanced PARP trapping. Together, this results in suppression of the cell cycle and upregulation of memory and fatty acid oxidation gene expression, and reprogramming CD8 + T cells into T CM cells with enhanced metabolic fitness and substantially higher recall capabilities. PARP inhibitor treatment of tumor-bearing mice resulted in an increase in the number of 'superior T CM ' cells within the tumor microenvironment and enhanced immune-mediated antitumor responses. PARP inhibitor-treated CD8 + T cells were more effective in adoptive cell therapy. Furthermore, the frequency of CD8 + memory T cells and the expression of their memory markers was increased in patients with cancer treated with PARP inhibitor. Together, these data show that PARP inhibition directly reprograms CD8 + T cells, enhancing metabolic fitness and generating highly effective therapeutically superior memory cells.
papers.abstractKo: CD8 + 중앙기억 T(T CM) 세포는 더 분화된 효과기 기억(effector memory) 대응세포보다 더 강한 항종양 면역을 제공한다. 본 연구에서는 poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase(PARP) 억제가 SIRT-1-FOXO1 경로를 활성화하고 효소 활성을 억제하며 PARP trapping을 강화함으로써 대사 및 전사적 전환을 유도하여, 보다 우수한 기억을 지닌 CD8 + T CM 세포를 유도함을 보였다. 그 결과 세포주기가 억제되고 기억 및 지방산 산화(fatty acid oxidation) 유전자 발현이 상향 조절되며, CD8 + T 세포가 대사 적합성(metabolic fitness)이 향상되고 재자극 반응(recall capability)이 현저히 높은 T CM 세포로 재프로그래밍된다. 종양 보유 마우스에서 PARP 억제제 처리 시 종양 미세환경 내 'superior T CM' 세포 수가 증가하고 면역 매개 항종양 반응이 강화되었다. PARP 억제제로 처리한 CD8 + T 세포는 adoptive cell therapy에서 더 효과적이었다. 또한, PARP 억제제로 치료받은 암 환자에서 CD8 + memory T 세포의 빈도와 이들의 기억 표지자(memory markers) 발현이 증가하였다. 종합하면, 이러한 데이터는 PARP 억제가 CD8 + T 세포를 직접 재프로그래밍하여 대사 적합성을 향상시키고 치료적으로 매우 우수한 기억 세포를 생성함을 보여준다.

papers.title: Senotoxins target senescence via lipid binding specificity, ion imbalance and lipidome remodeling
papers.abstract: Senescence is a driver of aging and a barrier to tumor progression, but its persistent accumulation drives inflammation and relapse. Thus, the success of chemotherapy could be jeopardized when senescence emerges in the tumor microenvironment. Here we identified the senolytic properties of a pore-forming toxin, sticholysin I (StnI). StnI and our engineered improved form, StnIG, selectively hampers viability of chemotherapy-induced senescent cancer cells, as well as senescent primary cells. We show that its selectivity is mediated by specific binding and lipid ratios associated with senescence, including compromised membrane bilayer asymmetry. Mechanistically, StnIG triggers sodium and calcium influx and an enduring potassium efflux in senescent cells. Calcium triggers the opening of calcium-activated potassium channels, leading to cell death by apoptosis and pyroptosis. Finally we show that StnIG synergizes with senescence-inducing chemotherapy to drive remission of solid tumors in mice. Our findings define StnI and StnIG as senotoxins with translational potential for cancer therapy.
papers.abstractKo: 세포 노화(senescence)는 노화의 주요 동인이자 종양 진행의 장벽이지만, 그 지속적인 축적은 염증과 재발을 유발한다. 따라서 종양 미세환경에서 세포 노화가 발생할 경우 화학요법의 성공이 저해될 수 있다. 본 연구에서는 기공 형성 독소(pore-forming toxin)인 sticholysin I(StnI)의 노화세포 제거(senolytic) 특성을 규명하였다. StnI와 우리가 설계한 개선형인 StnIG는 화학요법에 의해 유도된 노화 암세포뿐만 아니라 노화된 일차 세포(primary cells)의 생존력을 선택적으로 저해한다. 우리는 그 선택성이 세포 노화와 연관된 특정 결합 및 지질 비율에 의해 매개되며, 여기에는 손상된 막 이중층 대칭성(membrane bilayer asymmetry)이 포함됨을 보였다. 기전적으로, StnIG는 노화 세포에서 나트륨과 칼슘 유입을 유발하고 지속적인 칼륨 유출을 일으킨다. 칼슘은 칼슘 활성화 칼륨 채널(calcium-activated potassium channels)의 개방을 촉발하여 apoptosis와 pyroptosis에 의한 세포사를 유도한다. 마지막으로, StnIG가 세포 노화를 유도하는 화학요법과 상승작용을 보여 마우스에서 고형 종양의 관해를 유도함을 보였다. 우리의 발견은 StnI와 StnIG를 암 치료를 위한 번역적 잠재력을 지닌 senotoxins로 규정한다.

papers.title: Hypoxia-driven remodeling of SELENOP+ macrophages shapes T cell dynamics and promotes ovarian cancer metastasis
papers.abstract: High-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC) is characterized by extensive transcoelomic dissemination and the accumulation of ascites. However, how site-specific tumor microenvironment (TME) drives progression remains unknown. Here we show the co-occurrence and spatial co-localization of SELENOP + macrophages and precursor exhausted CD8 + T cells and demonstrate that SELENOP + macrophages activate T cells via selenoprotein P in vitro and in vivo. We further identify a dynamic transition in the SELENOP + /SPP1 + macrophage populations as tumor metastasis, driven by increased hypoxia malignant epithelial cells through VEGFA-EPHB2 signaling. We also reveal that anti-VEGFA intervention controls ovarian tumor growth by increasing SELENOP + macrophages and cytotoxicity of CD8 + T cells in vivo. Taken together, these findings spotlight the role of tumor-induced TME remodeling in subverting immune-mediated tumor control and thus facilitating HGSOC metastasis in females. Collectively, our results provide a foundation for the development of targeted therapeutic interventions aimed at impeding HGSOC metastatic trajectory.
papers.abstractKo: 고등급 장액성 난소암(high-grade serous ovarian cancer, HGSOC)은 광범위한 복강내 파종(transcoelomic dissemination)과 복수(ascites)의 축적으로 특징지어진다. 그러나 부위 특이적 종양 미세환경(tumor microenvironment, TME)이 어떻게 진행을 유도하는지는 알려져 있지 않다. 본 연구에서는 SELENOP+ 대식세포와 전구 소진(pre-exhausted) CD8+ T 세포의 동시 발생 및 공간적 공위치(spatial co-localization)를 보여주고, SELENOP+ 대식세포가 selenoprotein P를 통해 in vitro 및 in vivo에서 T 세포를 활성화함을 입증한다. 또한 종양 전이와 함께 SELENOP+/SPP1+ 대식세포 집단에서의 동적 전이를 확인하였으며, 이는 VEGFA-EPHB2 신호전달을 통한 저산소성(hypoxia) 악성 상피세포의 증가에 의해 구동된다. 아울러 anti-VEGFA 개입이 in vivo에서 SELENOP+ 대식세포와 CD8+ T 세포의 세포독성(cytotoxicity)을 증가시켜 난소 종양 성장을 조절함을 밝혔다. 종합하면, 이러한 결과는 종양 유도 TME 재형성이 면역 매개 종양 조절을 교란하여 여성에서 HGSOC 전이를 촉진하는 역할을 조명한다. 전체적으로, 우리의 결과는 HGSOC의 전이 궤적을 저지하기 위한 표적 치료적 개입 개발의 토대를 제공한다.

papers.title: Repurposing Resmetirom suppresses MASH-associated hepatocellular carcinoma, with mechanistic implications of MDK/LRP1-mediated metabolic reprogramming and immunosuppression
papers.abstract: Background and aims The mechanisms underlying metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH)-associated hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) are poorly understood, and effective treatments are lacking. This study explored the translational potential of Resmetirom, a clinically approved thyroid hormone receptor beta (Thrb) agonist, and investigated the mechanistic basis of MASH-associated hepatocarcinogenesis. Approach and results Repurposing Resmetirom for MASH-HCC treatment demonstrated significant tumor-suppressive effects across multiple preclinical models. To further investigate its mechanisms, we employed a Western diet plus CCl 4 -induced murine MASH-HCC model, complemented by single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) analyses of liver and tumor tissues. These analyses revealed active cell-cell communication within the tumor microenvironment, particularly involving hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) and dysplastic hepatocytes (dys-Heps). These cells showed marked upregulation of midkine (MDK), which in human HCC correlated with shorter relapse-free survival, specifically in non-viral, non-alcohol-associated cases. In mouse models, MDK facilitated M2-like macrophage polarization via interaction with the receptor LRP1, contributing to disease progression from MASH to fibrosis and eventual HCC. Silencing LRP1 in macrophages abolished MDK-driven M2 polarization and increased cytotoxic cytokine secretion, while LRP1-positive macrophages contributed to T cell exhaustion through the CXCL16-CXCR6 axis. MDK expression negatively correlated with Thrb and lipolytic genes, but positively with lipogenesis genes. Resmetirom treatment not only significantly suppressed tumor growth and reduced steatosis but also decreased MDK expression and increased Thrb levels. Combining Resmetirom and an MDK inhibitor (iMDK) synergistically suppressed tumorigenesis in vivo. Conclusions Targeting the MDK/LRP1 axis with Resmetirom offers a promising therapeutic strategy for MASH-associated HCC, addressing both metabolic dysfunction and tumor progression.
papers.abstractKo: 배경 및 목적 대사 기능 이상 관련 지방간염(metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis, MASH) 관련 간세포암(hepatocellular carcinoma, HCC)의 기전은 충분히 밝혀지지 않았으며, 효과적인 치료법도 부족하다. 본 연구는 임상적으로 승인된 갑상선 호르몬 수용체 β(thyroid hormone receptor beta, Thrb) 작용제인 Resmetirom의 전환 가능성(translational potential)을 탐색하고, MASH 관련 간발암의 기전적 기초를 조사하였다. 접근 및 결과 MASH-HCC 치료를 위해 Resmetirom을 재창출(repurposing)한 결과, 여러 전임상 모델에서 유의한 종양 억제 효과가 나타났다. 기전을 추가로 규명하기 위해, 우리는 Western diet와 CCl 4 로 유도한 murine MASH-HCC 모델을 사용하였고, 여기에 간 및 종양 조직의 single-cell RNA sequencing(scRNA-seq) 분석을 보완하였다. 이러한 분석은 종양 미세환경 내에서 활발한 세포-세포 소통을 보여주었으며, 특히 hepatic stellate cells(HSCs)와 dysplastic hepatocytes(dys-Heps)가 관여함이 확인되었다. 이들 세포는 midkine(MDK)의 현저한 상향조절을 보였고, 인간 HCC에서는 MDK가 특히 비바이러스성, 비알코올 관련(non-viral, non-alcohol-associated) 사례에서 더 짧은 relapse-free survival과 연관되었다. 마우스 모델에서 MDK는 수용체 LRP1과의 상호작용을 통해 M2-like macrophage polarization을 촉진하여, MASH에서 fibrosis를 거쳐 최종적으로 HCC에 이르는 질병 진행에 기여하였다. 대식세포에서 LRP1을 침묵화(silencing)하면 MDK 유도 M2 polarization이 소실되었고 세포독성 cytokine 분비가 증가하였으며, LRP1 양성 대식세포는 CXCL16-CXCR6 축을 통해 T cell exhaustion에 기여하였다. MDK 발현은 Thrb 및 lipolytic genes와는 음의 상관관계를 보인 반면, lipogenesis genes와는 양의 상관관계를 보였다. Resmetirom 치료는 종양 성장을 유의하게 억제하고 steatosis를 감소시켰을 뿐 아니라 MDK 발현도 낮추고 Thrb 수준은 증가시켰다. Resmetirom과 MDK inhibitor(iMDK)를 병용하면 생체 내(in vivo)에서 tumorigenesis가 상승적으로 억제되었다. 결론 Resmetirom으로 MDK/LRP1 축을 표적화하는 것은 MASH 관련 HCC에 대한 유망한 치료 전략을 제공하며, 대사 기능 이상과 종양 진행을 모두 해결할 수 있다.

papers.title: Biologically interpretable deep learning–derived MRI phenotypes reveal lymph node involvement and neoadjuvant therapy response in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
papers.abstract: Background and aims Accurate N-staging of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (iCCA) remains challenging using noninvasive approaches. We aimed to develop a model to refine lymph node (LN) involvement stratification and inform therapeutic consideration. Approach and results This study enrolled a discovery cohort (n=682), an internal test cohort from the FU-iCCA (n=204), and an external multicenter cohort (n=88) for model development, and a neoadjuvant therapy (NAT) cohort (n=145) for therapeutic evaluation of the model. A SwinU-CliRad framework was constructed by integrating Swin UNEt TRansformers (Swin UNETR)-based magnetic resonance imaging-derived outputs of LN involvement with clinicoradiological features. Correlations between SwinU outputs and tumor multi-omics profiles were explored. The SwinU-CliRad model achieved areas under the curve (AUCs) of 0.932, 0.867, and 0.888 in LN risk stratification, and outperformed radiologist-based assessments by correcting more misclassifications than it introduced across the discovery, internal, and external test cohorts (18.8% vs. 7.3%, 18.1% vs. 4.9%, and 17.0% vs. 5.7%), respectively. In the NAT cohort, patients classified as high LN-involved risk by the SwinU-CliRad exhibited lower residual viable tumor rates than those with low LN-involved risk, with higher rates of pathological complete response (12.0% vs. 4.2%) and major pathological response (14.0% vs. 8.4%). SwinU outputs were associated with KRAS mutations, MUC5AC overexpression, and the large-duct histological subtype. Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis linked LN involvement to an immune-suppressive stroma tumor microenvironment. Conclusions The SwinU-CliRad model can serve as a biologically interpretable tool for LN risk stratification in iCCA surgical candidates, with high-risk patients identified by the model potentially deriving benefit from NAT.
papers.abstractKo: 배경 및 목적 간내 담관암(intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, iCCA)의 정확한 N-staging은 비침습적 접근법만으로는 여전히 어렵다. 우리는 림프절(lymph node, LN) 침범의 층화(stratification)를 정교화하고 치료적 고려를 제공할 수 있는 모델을 개발하고자 하였다. 접근 및 결과 본 연구는 모델 개발을 위해 discovery cohort(n=682), FU-iCCA의 internal test cohort(n=204), external multicenter cohort(n=88)를 등록하였고, 모델의 치료적 평가를 위해 neoadjuvant therapy(NAT) cohort(n=145)를 사용하였다. SwinU-CliRad framework는 LN 침범에 대한 Swin UNEt TRansformers(Swin UNETR)-based magnetic resonance imaging 유래 출력과 clinicoradiological features를 통합하여 구축되었다. SwinU outputs와 종양 multi-omics profiles 간의 상관관계를 탐색하였다. SwinU-CliRad 모델은 LN 위험 층화에서 area under the curve(AUC) 0.932, 0.867, 0.888을 달성하였고, discovery, internal, external test cohorts에서 더 많은 오분류(misclassification)를 교정한 동시에 자신이 도입한 오분류는 더 적어 radiologist-based assessments를 능가하였다(각각 18.8% vs. 7.3%, 18.1% vs. 4.9%, 17.0% vs. 5.7%). NAT cohort에서 SwinU-CliRad에 의해 높은 LN 침범 위험으로 분류된 환자들은 낮은 LN 침범 위험 환자들보다 잔존 생존 종양(residual viable tumor) 비율이 더 낮았으며, 병리학적 완전 반응(pathological complete response)이 더 높은 비율로 나타났다(12.0% vs. 4.2%), 또한 major pathological response도 더 높았다(14.0% vs. 8.4%). SwinU outputs는 KRAS mutations, MUC5AC overexpression, 그리고 large-duct histological subtype과 연관되었다. single-cell RNA sequencing 분석은 LN 침범이 면역억제성 기질(stroma) 종양 미세환경(tumor microenvironment)과 연관됨을 보여주었다. 결론 SwinU-CliRad 모델은 iCCA 수술 후보 환자에서 LN 위험 층화를 위한 생물학적으로 해석 가능한 도구로 활용될 수 있으며, 이 모델에 의해 고위험으로 식별된 환자들은 NAT로부터 이득을 얻을 가능성이 있다.

papers.title: Transcriptomic signature-guided depletion of intermediate alveolar epithelial cells ameliorates pulmonary fibrosis in mice
papers.abstract: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) has identified intermediate epithelial states in pulmonary fibrosis, including KRT5-/KRT17+ aberrant basaloid cells in humans and Krt8+ alveolar differentiation intermediates (ADIs) in mice. Their functional contributions to fibrogenesis, however, remain unclear. Here, we introduce an RNA-sensing-dependent protein translation technology that enables selective targeting of Krt8+ ADI cells in vitro and in vivo. Transcriptomic analysis revealed Small Proline-Rich Protein 1 A (SPRR1A) mRNA as a shared marker of murine Krt8+ ADIs and human KRT5-/KRT17+ basaloid cells, distinguishing them from other lung cell populations. Using programmable RNA sensors, we demonstrated selective EGFP-labeling of Krt8+ ADI cells in vivo, which faithfully recapitulated their transcriptomic and phenotypic features. To test function, we developed an RNA-sensing-driven diphtheria toxin receptor (DTR) system for conditional ablation of Sprr1a+ cells. Targeted depletion markedly reduced fibrosis in bleomycin-injured mice, establishing transitional epithelial cells as pathogenic drivers and highlighting their potential as therapeutic targets in pulmonary fibrosis.
papers.abstractKo: 단일세포 RNA 시퀀싱(scRNA-seq)은 폐섬유화에서 중간 상피 상태를 규명하였으며, 여기에는 인간의 KRT5-/KRT17+ aberrant basaloid cells와 생쥐의 Krt8+ alveolar differentiation intermediates(ADIs)가 포함된다. 그러나 이들의 섬유화 형성에서의 기능적 기여는 여전히 불명확하다. 여기에서 우리는 in vitro 및 in vivo에서 Krt8+ ADI cells를 선택적으로 표적화할 수 있게 하는 RNA-sensing-dependent protein translation 기술을 도입하였다. 전사체 분석은 Small Proline-Rich Protein 1 A(SPRR1A) mRNA가 생쥐 Krt8+ ADIs와 인간 KRT5-/KRT17+ basaloid cells의 공통 표지자이며, 이들을 다른 폐 세포 집단과 구별함을 보여주었다. Programmable RNA sensors를 사용하여, 우리는 in vivo에서 Krt8+ ADI cells의 선택적 EGFP 표지를 입증하였고, 이는 이들의 전사체 및 표현형 특징을 충실히 재현하였다. 기능을 검증하기 위해, 우리는 Sprr1a+ cells의 조건부 제거를 위한 RNA-sensing-driven diphtheria toxin receptor(DTR) 시스템을 개발하였다. 표적 제거는 bleomycin으로 손상된 생쥐에서 섬유화를 현저히 감소시켰으며, 이를 통해 과도기 상피세포가 병인성 동인임을 확립하고 폐섬유화에서 치료 표적으로서의 잠재성을 부각하였다.

papers.title: Once and thrice weekly interval training in adults with central obesity: a randomized controlled trial
papers.abstract: Obesity is a global public health crisis that is aggravated and mirrored by the high prevalence of physical inactivity. This single-center, assessor-blinded, three-group, randomized controlled trial in Hong Kong examined the therapeutic value of high-intensity interval training (HIIT) delivered in one session per week via a "weekend warrior" approach versus three sessions per week for reducing body adiposity in adults with overweight and central obesity. Participants were randomly assigned in a 1:1:1 ratio to once-weekly HIIT (H1), thrice-weekly HIIT (H3), and control (CON) groups (n = 105 per group). The interventions lasted for 16 weeks. The HIIT groups performed a total of 75 minutes of HIIT per week (either in one session or three sessions), while the control group received biweekly health education classes. Outcomes were assessed at baseline, week 16, and week 32. The primary outcome was the change in total body fat mass from baseline to week 16. Secondary outcomes were reported in the main text. Compared to CON at week 16, both HIIT groups showed decreased fat mass (adjusted mean differences: H1 vs. CON: -0.8 kg [95% CI: -1.4 to -0.2], P = 0.0107; H3 vs. CON: -1.0 kg [95% CI: -1.6 to -0.5], P = 0.0003). No study-related adverse events were reported. Here, we show that HIIT, performed once- or thrice-weekly, is safe and reduces fat mass in adults with overweight and central obesity. Trial Registration: ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT04887454.
papers.abstractKo: 비만은 전 세계적인 공중보건 위기이며, 높은 신체활동 부족 유병률에 의해 악화되고 이를 반영한다. 홍콩에서 수행된 이 단일기관, 평가자 눈가림(assessor-blinded), 3군 무작위 대조 임상시험은 과체중 및 중심성 비만 성인에서 체지방 감소를 위해, “weekend warrior” 접근법을 통한 주 1회 세션 고강도 인터벌 트레이닝(high-intensity interval training, HIIT)과 주 3회 세션을 제공하는 방식의 치료적 가치를 검토하였다. 참여자는 주 1회 HIIT(H1), 주 3회 HIIT(H3), 대조군(CON)에 1:1:1 비율로 무작위 배정되었으며(n = 105/군), 중재는 16주간 지속되었다. HIIT 군은 주당 총 75분의 HIIT를 수행하였고(한 세션 또는 세 세션), 대조군은 격주 건강 교육 강좌를 받았다. 결과는 기저시점, 16주, 32주에 평가되었다. 1차 결과는 기저시점부터 16주까지의 총 체지방량 변화였다. 2차 결과는 본문에 제시되었다. 16주 시점에서 CON과 비교하였을 때, 두 HIIT 군 모두 지방량 감소를 보였다(보정 평균 차이: H1 vs. CON: -0.8 kg [95% CI: -1.4 to -0.2], P = 0.0107; H3 vs. CON: -1.0 kg [95% CI: -1.6 to -0.5], P = 0.0003). 연구 관련 이상반응은 보고되지 않았다. 본 연구는 주 1회 또는 주 3회로 수행한 HIIT가 안전하며, 과체중 및 중심성 비만 성인에서 지방량을 감소시킨다는 것을 보여준다. 임상시험 등록: ClinicalTrials.gov 식별자: NCT04887454.

papers.title: Lipedema World Alliance Delphi Consensus-Based Position Paper on the Definition and Management of Lipedema: Results from the 2023 Lipedema World Congress in Potsdam
papers.abstract: Lipedema predominantly affects women and is characterized by an abnormal distribution of adipose tissue, accompanied by pain or discomfort in affected areas. Despite growing awareness, inconsistent diagnostic criteria and treatment approaches hinder medical care and research. This multi-phase Delphi study was conducted to address the need for internationally accepted consensus on fundamental aspects of the disease. Through online surveys and an in-person discussions, experts representing 19 countries evaluated on 62 original statements regarding (1) clarity, (2) agreement, (3) recommendation for inclusion, (4) strength of evidence, and (5) whether additional evidence was needed. Ultimately, 59 statements reached consensus across eight domains encompassing the definition and management of lipedema. The findings provide a framework to guide internationally applicable recommendations for patients with lipedema that may improve outcomes globally. Limited evidence in several areas highlights the importance of further research, standardization of data reporting, and international collaboration among healthcare providers, researchers, and patient advocates to address this women's health disparity effectively.

papers.title: Hepatokine fibrinogen-like protein 1 drives liver-kidney crosstalk to promote renal fibrosis
papers.abstract: The concept of organ-organ communication in systemic diseases has gained significant traction. Despite accumulating evidence of liver-kidney crosstalk, the underlying regulatory mechanisms remain poorly understood. Here, we identify hepatokine fibrinogen-like protein 1 (FGL1) as a pivotal mediator driving liver-kidney communication in renal fibrosis. Integrative RNA sequencing and clinical analyses revealed FGL1 upregulation in the liver post-renal injury, with subsequent selective accumulation in fibrotic kidneys. Hepatocyte-specific knockout of FGL1 improved renal morphology, attenuated collagen deposition, and inhibited fibrosis markers in unilateral ureteral obstruction and adenine-induced mouse models. Conversely, FGL1 overexpression exacerbated renal fibrosis. Mechanistically, FGL1 binds to TGF-β receptor ALK5 and blocks its interaction with K48-linked polyubiquitin. Structural analyses identified critical residues in FGL1-ALK5 interaction. Hepatic FGL1 is transcriptionally regulated by STAT3, and activated by inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, IL-1β and TNF-α). Pharmacological inhibition by p-hydroxybenzaldehyde (screened out from 4080 compounds) or an anti-FGL1 monoclonal antibody significantly reduced renal fibrosis without hepatotoxicity. These findings establish FGL1 as a key mediator of pathogenic liver-kidney crosstalk and highlights therapeutic strategies to targeting organ-organ networks in renal fibrosis.

FGL1의 간세포 특이적 결손(hepatocyte-specific knockout)은 일측성 요관 결찰(unilateral ureteral obstruction) 및 adenine 유도 마우스 모델에서 신장 형태를 개선하고, collagen 침착을 감소시키며, 섬유화 표지자(fibrosis markers)를 억제하였다. 반대로 FGL1 과발현은 신장 섬유화를 악화시켰다. 기전적으로, FGL1은 TGF-β receptor ALK5에 결합하여 K48-linked polyubiquitin과의 상호작용을 차단하였다. 구조 분석을 통해 FGL1-ALK5 상호작용에 중요한 잔기들이 규명되었다. 간 FGL1은 STAT3에 의해 전사적으로 조절되며, 염증성 cytokines(IL-6, IL-1β 및 TNF-α)에 의해 활성화된다. p-hydroxybenzaldehyde(4080개 화합물에서 선별됨) 또는 anti-FGL1 monoclonal antibody에 의한 약리학적 억제는 간독성 없이 신장 섬유화를 유의하게 감소시켰다. 이러한 결과는 FGL1을 병적 간-신장 상호작용의 핵심 매개인자로 확립하고, 신장 섬유화에서 장기-장기 네트워크를 표적화하는 치료 전략을 제시한다.

papers.title: Identification of ACBP as a potential target in ciliopathic obesity through multi-omics network analysis
papers.abstract: Ciliopathies are genetic disorders characterized by defective primary cilia function, with obesity as a clinical manifestation in certain cases, including Alström syndrome, which is caused by ALMS1 mutations. The link between cilia and lipid metabolism remains poorly understood, but evidence suggests a role for impaired autophagy. Autophagy affects both intra- and extracellular levels of ACBP, which can act as an obesogenic factor. Our multi-omics study reveals early hepatic dyslipidemia, impaired autophagy, and hepatic accumulation of ACBP in presymptomatic male mice lacking Alms1 gene. These conditions are consistent with the obesogenic phenotype and with alterations in the gut microbiota that manifest as the mice age and develop obesity. Importantly, reducing excessive ACBP with a neutralizing monoclonal antibody limits weight gain and metabolic defects in Alms1 -/- mice in an autophagy-independent manner. Altogether, the data support the idea that ciliopathy-associated obesity, particularly Alström syndrome, may be mitigated by ACBP neutralization.
papers.abstractKo: Ciliopathies는 1차 섬모(primary cilia) 기능 이상을 특징으로 하는 유전 질환으로, Alström syndrome을 포함한 일부 경우에서 obesity가 임상적 증상으로 나타난다. Alström syndrome은 ALMS1 돌연변이에 의해 유발된다. 섬모와 지질 대사(lipid metabolism) 사이의 연관성은 아직 잘 이해되지 않았으나, impaired autophagy의 역할을 시사하는 근거가 있다. Autophagy는 세포내 및 세포외 수준의 ACBP에 모두 영향을 미치며, ACBP는 obesogenic factor로 작용할 수 있다. 우리의 multi-omics 연구는 Alms1 gene이 결손된 presymptomatic male mice에서 초기 hepatic dyslipidemia, impaired autophagy, 및 hepatic accumulation of ACBP를 밝혀냈다. 이러한 상태는 obesogenic phenotype 및 장내 미생물군(gut microbiota)의 변화와 일치하며, 이는 mice가 나이를 먹고 obesity를 발달시킬 때 나타난다. 중요하게도, neutralizing monoclonal antibody로 과도한 ACBP를 감소시키면 autophagy-independent manner로 Alms1 -/- mice의 체중 증가와 대사 결함(metabolic defects)이 제한된다. 종합하면, 이러한 데이터는 ciliopathy-associated obesity, 특히 Alström syndrome이 ACBP neutralization에 의해 완화될 수 있다는 개념을 지지한다.

papers.title: Two-year persistence of MERS-CoV-specific antibody and T cell responses after MVA-MERS-S vaccination in healthy adults
papers.abstract: MVA-MERS-S, a vaccine candidate against Middle East respiratory syndrome (MERS), was recently evaluated in a randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind phase 1b clinical trial to assess its safety, immunogenicity, and optimal dosing in healthy adults in Hamburg and Rotterdam. A three-dose regimen was safe and elicited robust spike-specific antibody responses. We extended this trial to assess the two-year durability of MERS-CoV-specific antibody and T cell responses in 48 study participants of the Hamburg cohort. Our findings show that immune responses remain detectable for at least 24 months after the third vaccination. Antibodies persisted at levels comparable to the peak response observed after the second vaccination and were able to cross-neutralize MERS-CoV spike mutants. Although the immune correlates of protection against MERS remain unknown, the observed durability of humoral and cellular immune responses supports the potential of MVA-MERS-S as a promising MERS vaccine candidate and highlights the importance of a booster dose in sustaining long-term immunity.
papers.abstractKo: MVA-MERS-S는 중동호흡기증후군(Middle East respiratory syndrome, MERS)에 대한 백신 후보로, 최근 건강한 성인을 대상으로 함부르크와 로테르담에서 안전성, 면역원성 및 최적 용량을 평가하기 위한 무작위배정, 위약대조, 이중맹검 1b상 임상시험에서 평가되었다. 3회 투여 요법은 안전했으며 강력한 spike-specific 항체 반응을 유도하였다. 우리는 이 임상시험을 확장하여 함부르크 코호트의 48명의 연구 참여자에서 MERS-CoV-specific 항체 및 T 세포 반응의 2년 지속성을 평가하였다. 우리의 결과는 면역 반응이 세 번째 백신 접종 후 적어도 24개월 동안 검출 가능하게 유지됨을 보여준다. 항체는 두 번째 백신 접종 후 관찰된 최대 반응과 유사한 수준으로 지속되었으며 MERS-CoV spike 돌연변이체를 교차 중화할 수 있었다. MERS에 대한 보호의 면역학적 상관인자(immune correlates of protection)는 아직 알려져 있지 않지만, 관찰된 체액성 및 세포성 면역 반응의 지속성은 유망한 MERS 백신 후보로서 MVA-MERS-S의 잠재력을 뒷받침하며 장기 면역을 유지하는 데 있어 부스터 용량의 중요성을 강조한다.

papers.title: Endocrine regulation of the hepatic fasting response: cues, cooperation and consequences
papers.abstract: Upon fasting, mammals undergo a fasting response in which the liver's main role is producing fuel (glucose and ketone bodies) to supply extra-hepatic tissues. Glucose is produced by glycogenolysis and gluconeogenesis, and ketone bodies are produced by ketogenesis, which is preceded by lipolysis and fatty acid oxidation. Hepatic fuel production during fasting is controlled by hormonal and metabolic cues, collectively termed here 'fasting cues'. In this Review, we discuss fasting cues that directly signal hepatocytes and whose plasma levels increase upon fasting, namely, glucagon, glucocorticoids, growth hormone, adrenaline, free fatty acids, asprosin and GP73. We outline the fasting-dependent increases in blood levels of these cues, how they regulate transcription and the metabolic consequences of these cues in hepatocytes. We put particular emphasis on their role in directing fuel production. The perception of endocrine control of fuel production is shifting from the classic 'counter-regulatory' notion that fasting cues are simply opposing insulin action, to the realization that fasting cues cooperate with each other to elicit a synergistic response and also complement each other's actions indirectly. We discuss these modes of crosstalk and cooperation between fasting cues and describe the effects of signal integration on the transcriptional and metabolic response to fasting.
papers.abstractKo: 공복 상태에서 포유류는 공복 반응(fasting response)을 거치며, 이때 간의 주요 역할은 간외 조직에 공급할 연료(포도당과 케톤체)를 생산하는 것이다. 포도당은 글리코겐분해(glycogenolysis)와 포도당신생합성(gluconeogenesis)에 의해 생성되며, 케톤체는 케토제네시스(ketogenesis)에 의해 생성되는데, 이는 지질분해(lipolysis)와 지방산 산화(fatty acid oxidation)에 선행된다. 공복 중 간의 연료 생산은 호르몬 및 대사적 신호에 의해 조절되며, 이를 본고에서는 총칭하여 ‘공복 신호(fasting cues)’라고 한다. 본 종설에서는 간세포(hepatocytes)에 직접 신호를 전달하고 공복 시 혈장 농도가 증가하는 공복 신호, 즉 glucagon, glucocorticoids, growth hormone, adrenaline, free fatty acids, asprosin 및 GP73을 논의한다. 우리는 이러한 신호들의 혈중 농도가 공복 의존적으로 증가하는 양상, 이들이 전사(transcription)를 어떻게 조절하는지, 그리고 간세포에서 이들 신호의 대사적 결과를 개괄한다. 특히 연료 생산을 지시하는 이들의 역할에 중점을 둔다. 연료 생산에 대한 내분비 조절의 인식은, 공복 신호가 단순히 insulin 작용에 길항한다는 고전적인 ‘counter-regulatory’ 개념에서 벗어나, 공복 신호들이 서로 협력하여 상승작용적(synergistic) 반응을 유도하고 또한 서로의 작용을 간접적으로 보완한다는 사실의 인식으로 변화하고 있다. 우리는 공복 신호들 사이의 이러한 crosstalk 및 협력 양식을 논의하고, 신호 통합(signal integration)이 공복에 대한 전사적 및 대사적 반응에 미치는 영향을 기술한다.

papers.title: A catecholamine-independent pathway controlling adaptive adipocyte lipolysis
papers.abstract: Several adipose depots, including constitutive bone marrow adipose tissue, resist conventional lipolytic cues. However, under starvation, wasting or cachexia, the body eventually catabolizes stable adipocytes through unknown mechanisms. Here we developed a mouse model of brain-evoked depletion of all fat, including stable constitutive bone marrow adipose tissue, independent of food intake, to study this phenomenon. Genetic, surgical and chemical approaches demonstrated that catabolism of stable adipocytes required adipose triglyceride lipase-dependent lipolysis but was independent of local nerves, the sympathetic nervous system and catecholamines. Instead, concurrent hypoglycaemia and hypoinsulinaemia activated a potent catabolic state by suppressing lipid storage and increasing catecholamine-independent lipolysis via downregulation of cell-autonomous lipolytic inhibitors including G0s2. This was also sufficient to delipidate classical adipose depots and was recapitulated in tumour-associated cachexic mice. Overall, this defines unique adaptations of stable adipocytes to resist lipolysis in healthy states while isolating a potent catecholamine-independent neurosystemic pathway by which the body can rapidly catabolize all adipose tissues.
papers.abstractKo: 지속성(constitutive) bone marrow adipose tissue를 포함한 여러 adipose depot은 전형적인 lipolytic cue에 저항한다. 그러나 기아, 소모(wasting) 또는 cachexia에서는, 신체가 결국 아직 알려지지 않은 기전으로 안정적인 adipocyte를 catabolize한다. 여기에서 우리는 이 현상을 연구하기 위해, 식이 섭취와 무관하게 안정적인 지속성 bone marrow adipose tissue를 포함한 모든 fat의 brain-evoked depletion을 보이는 mouse model을 개발하였다. 유전적, 외과적 및 화학적 접근은 안정적인 adipocyte의 catabolism이 adipose triglyceride lipase-dependent lipolysis를 필요로 하지만 국소 신경, sympathetic nervous system 및 catecholamine과는 독립적임을 입증하였다. 대신, 동시적인 hypoglycaemia 및 hypoinsulinaemia는 G0s2를 포함한 세포자율적(cell-autonomous) lipolytic inhibitor의 downregulation을 통해 lipid storage를 억제하고 catecholamine-independent lipolysis를 증가시킴으로써 강력한 catabolic state를 활성화하였다. 이는 또한 classical adipose depot의 delipidation에 충분하였으며, tumor-associated cachexic mouse에서 재현되었다. 전반적으로, 이는 건강한 상태에서 lipolysis에 저항하는 안정적인 adipocyte의 고유한 적응을 규정하는 동시에, 신체가 모든 adipose tissue를 신속하게 catabolize할 수 있게 하는 강력한 catecholamine-independent neurosystemic pathway를 분리하여 제시한다.

papers.title: Obesity impairs gut repair via AFABP-mediated iron overload in intestinal stem cells
papers.abstract: Obesity impairs the function of multiple organs, but its effect on gut regeneration remains poorly defined. Here, we show that adipocyte fatty acid-binding protein (AFABP), an adipokine involved in fatty acid transport, impedes intestinal repair by disrupting iron homeostasis in intestinal stem cells (ISCs). Mechanistically, elevated AFABP secretion in obesity binds to plasma transferrin, leading to iron accumulation in ISCs. This accumulation disrupts peroxisome-mediated ISC differentiation, which is essential for intestinal repair following injury. Notably, AFABP overexpression in adipocytes of lean mice impedes ISC differentiation and gut repair. Conversely, AFABP depletion or the administration of AFABP inhibitors, iron chelators or peroxisome activators effectively mitigates colitis in obese animals. Overall, our findings reveal a mechanistic link between obesity and intestinal repair, and identify the adipose-gut axis as a therapeutic target for obesity-associated intestinal disorders.

papers.title: TIGIT disruption rescues the antitumor activity of low avidity TCR-engineered T cells by increasing TCR signal strength
papers.abstract: T-cell avidity is a major determinant of Adoptive T cell therapy (ACT) efficacy for cancer treatment. However, high-avidity tumor-specific T cells can rarely be isolated from cancer patients, highlighting the need for strategies to enhance the cytotoxic capacity of low-avidity cells. Here, we rescue the anti-tumor functions of low-avidity T cells against pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) by knocking-out TIGIT, a key inhibitory molecule expressed on exhausted CD8 + T cells infiltrating gastrointestinal tumors. We uncover that TIGIT disruption by base editing boosts the intracellular signal transduction derived from a weak T cell receptor (TCR) engagement enforcing cytoskeletal rearrangements, thus increasing T cell avidity and stabilizing the immunological synapse. Accordingly, TIGIT disruption enables low-avidity T cells to exert robust degranulation, comparable to that of high-avidity T cells, and potent and durable anti-tumor capacity in vivo in male mice. These results highlight TIGIT knockout as a potential strategy to enhance low-avidity T cell function and broaden the repertoire of TCR engineered T cells in the treatment of pancreatic cancer and other solid malignancies.

papers.title: Butyrophilin 2A2 promotes T cell immunoregulation via CD45 phosphatase activation and protects against murine autoimmune glomerulonephritis and pregnancy loss
papers.abstract: B7 costimulatory family member Butyrophilin 2A2 (BTN2A2) is predominantly expressed by antigen presenting cells and regulates T cell immunity, but molecular mechanisms are unclear. Using immunoblots analyzing TCR-initiated signaling intermediaries, co-immunoprecipitation studies, confocal microscopy, structural modeling-guided mutational analyses, and microscale thermophoresis, we demonstrate that BTN2A2 directly interacts with CD45RO, resulting in CD45 retention within the immune synapse during TCR activation. Recombinant BTN2A2 increases murine CD4+Foxp3+ regulatory T cells (Treg) and reduces T helper 17 (Th17) cells in vitro through mechanisms dependent on CD45 phosphatase activity. BTN2A2 therapy alleviates disease severity in murine nephrotoxic glomerulonephritis and autoimmune miscarriage while increasing Treg/Th17 ratios. Analyses of BTN2A2-deficient animals show exacerbation of disease associated with reduced Treg/Th17 ratios. BTN2A2 functions analogously on human T cells suppressing Th17, Th1 and Th2 responses while inducing Tregs. Together, our studies identify BTN2A2 as a modulator of CD45RO signaling in T cells, providing insight into how BTN2A2 regulates T cell-dependent immune responses including those mediating autoimmunity and transplant rejection.

papers.title: The public health burden of diabetes mellitus and thyroid disease: twin epidemics
papers.abstract: Thyroid dysfunction and diabetes mellitus frequently occur together, with evidence showing higher rates of each condition in individuals affected by the other. Beyond their statistical association, emerging research indicates shared mechanisms involving autoimmunity, obesity, ageing and insulin resistance, which might explain their bidirectional relationship. This Review synthesizes current evidence on these links, with a particular focus on how thyroid dysfunction influences glycaemic control and how antidiabetic therapies affect thyroid function. Unlike earlier reviews, we frame thyroid disorders within the broader category of non-communicable diseases (NCDs), emphasizing their public health relevance and the need for greater attention in global funding and policy agendas. By combining clinical insights with a population health perspective, this Review aims to promote earlier detection, integrated management strategies and recognition of thyroid disease as a neglected NCD priority.
papers.abstractKo: 갑상선 기능장애(thyroid dysfunction)와 당뇨병(diabetes mellitus)은 흔히 함께 발생하며, 한 질환의 영향을 받는 개인에서 다른 질환의 발생률이 더 높다는 근거가 제시되고 있다. 이러한 통계적 연관성을 넘어, 최근 연구는 자가면역(autoimmunity), 비만(obesity), 노화(aging) 및 인슐린 저항성(insulin resistance)을 포함하는 공통 기전이 두 질환의 양방향 관계를 설명할 수 있음을 시사한다. 본 Review는 이러한 연관성에 관한 현재의 근거를 종합하며, 특히 갑상선 기능장애가 혈당 조절(glycaemic control)에 미치는 영향과 항당뇨 치료(antidiabetic therapies)가 갑상선 기능에 미치는 영향에 초점을 맞춘다. 기존의 리뷰와 달리, 우리는 갑상선 질환을 비감염성 질환(non-communicable diseases, NCDs)이라는 더 넓은 범주 안에서 제시함으로써, 그 공중보건적 중요성과 글로벌 재원 조달 및 정책 의제에서 더 큰 주의가 필요함을 강조한다. 임상적 통찰과 인구건강(population health) 관점을 결합함으로써, 본 Review는 더 이른 진단, 통합적 관리 전략, 그리고 갑상선 질환이 소외된 NCD 우선순위로 인식되도록 촉진하는 것을 목표로 한다.
