papers.title: Chemotherapy-induced adipo-lineage cell senescence drives bone loss
papers.abstract: Chemotherapy-induced bone loss is a debilitating and common side effect of cancer treatment, though its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Here, we show that, despite the systemic administration of chemotherapy, cellular senescence is restricted to bone marrow adipo-lineage cells specifically Cxcl12-abundant reticular (CAR) cells and bone marrow adipocytes (BMAds). Induction of senescence within these populations promotes RANK ligand (RANKL)-mediated osteoclastogenesis, leading to significant bone loss. Notably, we find that inhibition of the p38MAPK-MK2 pathway suppresses the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP), including RANKL production abrogating bone loss. Furthermore, treatment with the senolytic combination dasatinib and quercetin (D + Q) selectively eliminates senescent CAR cells and BMAds, effectively preventing chemotherapy-induced bone loss. Given that nearly all chemotherapy treated patients experience bone loss and associated fracture risk, our findings offer a promising therapeutic avenue to preserve bone integrity and improve quality of life for cancer patients.
papers.abstractKo: 화학요법으로 유발되는 골 손실은 암 치료의 쇠약을 초래하는 흔한 부작용이지만, 그 기전은 아직 잘 알려져 있지 않다. 여기에서 우리는 전신적으로 화학요법을 투여하였음에도 불구하고, 세포 노화가 골수 지방계열 세포, 특히 Cxcl12-abundant reticular (CAR) 세포와 골수 지방세포(BMAds)에 제한적으로 나타난다는 것을 보여준다. 이러한 집단에서 노화가 유도되면 RANK ligand (RANKL)-매개 파골세포발생(osteoclastogenesis)이 촉진되어 유의한 골 손실로 이어진다. 주목할 점은 p38MAPK-MK2 경로의 억제가 RANKL 생성을 포함한 노화 관련 분비형 표현형(senescence-associated secretory phenotype, SASP)을 억제하여 골 손실을 제거한다는 것이다. 더 나아가, senolytic 조합 dasatinib과 quercetin (D + Q)으로 치료하면 노화된 CAR 세포와 BMAds를 선택적으로 제거하여 화학요법 유발 골 손실을 효과적으로 예방한다. 화학요법을 받은 거의 모든 환자에서 골 손실과 이에 수반되는 골절 위험이 발생한다는 점을 고려할 때, 우리의 연구 결과는 골의 완전성을 보존하고 암 환자의 삶의 질을 향상시키기 위한 유망한 치료적 접근을 제시한다.

papers.title: Capsaicin diet drives gut inflammation and exosomal miR-17-3p elevation in idiopathic short stature
papers.abstract: Idiopathic short stature (ISS) remains a major pediatric challenge with unclear causes and inconsistent responses to growth hormone therapy. Here we show that plasma exosomes from children with ISS contain elevated hsa-miR-17-3p that disrupts growth signaling and impairs cartilage cell proliferation. Elevated miR-17-3p suppresses ZNF148/SOS1 signaling, linking molecular dysfunction to dietary exposure in ISS. To investigate environmental triggers, we developed a capsaicin-rich diet rat model that recapitulates ISS, showing normal Gh/Igf-1 levels but elevated plasma miR-17-3p. The diet induced mild gut inflammation, increasing miR-17-3p in intestinal and plasma exosomes. Fecal samples from ISS children exhibited similar elevations in miR-17-3p and inflammatory markers, linking spicy diets to ISS pathogenesis. Finally, engineered exosomes designed to silence miR-17-3p, combined with localized growth hormone therapy, restored growth plate function. These findings uncover a diet-driven exosome axis underlying ISS and suggest new therapeutic strategies for children in high-capsaicin regions.
papers.abstractKo: 특발성 저신장증(ISS)은 원인이 불명확하고 성장호르몬 치료에 대한 반응이 일관되지 않아 여전히 주요한 소아과적 도전 과제이다. 여기서 우리는 ISS 소아의 혈장 exosome에 hsa-miR-17-3p가 증가되어 있으며, 이는 성장 신호전달을 교란하고 연골세포 증식을 저해함을 보인다. 증가된 miR-17-3p는 ZNF148/SOS1 signaling을 억제하여, ISS에서 분자적 기능 이상과 식이 노출을 연결한다. 환경적 유발 인자를 조사하기 위해 우리는 capsaisin-rich diet rat model을 개발하였고, 이는 ISS를 재현하며 정상적인 Gh/Igf-1 levels를 보이지만 혈장 miR-17-3p는 증가되어 있음을 보여주었다. 이 식이는 경미한 장 염증을 유도하여 장 및 혈장 exosome에서 miR-17-3p를 증가시켰다. ISS 소아의 대변 검체에서도 miR-17-3p와 염증 표지자가 유사하게 증가하여, 매운 음식 식이가 ISS 병태생성과 연관됨을 시사하였다. 마지막으로, miR-17-3p를 침묵(silence)하도록 설계된 engineered exosome을 국소 성장호르몬 치료와 병합하였을 때 성장판 기능이 회복되었다. 이러한 결과는 ISS의 기저에 있는 식이 유도 exosome axis를 규명하며, 고-capsaicin 지역의 소아를 위한 새로운 치료 전략을 제시한다.

papers.title: Design of precision therapeutics for a CKD risk allele by targeting Shroom3-Rock interaction
papers.abstract: Enhancer variants in Shroom3 associate with renal fibrosis (TIF), but with reduced albuminuria. Detailed mechanisms for these pleiotropic effects are unclear. Here, we focus on identifying the specific profibrotic Shroom3 motif and separating this from its anti-proteinuric function. Given the role for Rho-kinases (Rock) in TIF, and the interaction of Rock with Shroom3 ASD2-domain, we hypothesized that Shroom3-mediated Rock-activation is crucial for profibrotic function. To test this, we develop transgenic tools that overexpress wild-type- (WT-Sh3) or ASD2-domain deletion- Shroom3 (ASD2Δ-Sh3). During TIF, Shroom3 and Rock co-expression occur in injured tubular cells and fibroblasts. In tubular- & fibroblast- lines, ASD2Δ-Sh3 overexpression reduce Rock activation, and pro-fibrotic/pro-inflammatory transcripts downstream of TGFβ1/Wnt/Ctnnb1-signaling vs WT-Sh3. In vivo, inducible global-, or tubular-specific-, but not fibroblast-specific-, ASD2Δ-Sh3 overexpression mitigate TIF, vs WT-Sh3 overexpression. Importantly, ASD2Δ-Sh3 mice do not develop albuminuria, while overexpression of a distinct Fyn-binding deficient mutant Shroom3 (FBDM-Sh3) induces albuminuria. We then develop small molecule inhibitors of Shroom3-Rock interaction (P2Is) and confirm Rock inhibition with these agents in WT-Sh3 cell lines. Our lead P2I from these studies, BT1137, mitigates Rock-activation, profibrotic signaling and TIF in WT-Sh3 mice. Hence, we delineate the profibrotic Shroom3 motif and develop therapeutics for kidney disease from Shroom3 excess.

TIF에서 Rho-kinases(Rock)의 역할과 Rock와 Shroom3 ASD2-domain 간의 상호작용을 고려하여, Shroom3 매개 Rock 활성화가 섬유화 촉진 기능에 중요하다는 가설을 세웠다. 이를 검증하기 위해, wild-type-(WT-Sh3) 또는 ASD2-domain deletion- Shroom3(ASD2Δ-Sh3)를 과발현하는 transgenic 도구를 개발하였다. papers.title: Mutant p53 promotes clonal hematopoiesis by generating a chronic inflammatory microenvironment
papers.abstract: Older individuals with somatic TP53 mutations manifest clonal hematopoiesis (CH) and are at high risk of developing myeloid neoplasms. However, the underlying mechanisms are not fully understood. Here, we show that inflammatory stress confers a competitive advantage to p53 mutant hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) by activating the NLRP1 inflammasome and increasing the secretion of pro-inflammatory cytokines such as IL-1β, inhibiting WT HSPC fitness in a paracrine fashion. During aging, mutant p53 dysregulates pre-mRNA splicing in HSPCs, leading to enhanced NF-κB activation and increased secretion of IL-1β and IL-6, thereby generating a chronic inflammatory bone marrow microenvironment. Furthermore, blocking IL-1β with IL-1β neutralizing antibody or inhibiting IL-1β secretion using gasdermin D inhibitor decreases the fitness of p53 mutant HSPCs. Thus, our findings uncover an important role for mutant p53 in regulating inflammatory signaling in CH and suggest that curbing inflammation may prevent the progression of TP53-mutant CH to myeloid neoplasms.
papers.abstractKo: 체세포 TP53 돌연변이를 가진 고령 개인은 clonal hematopoiesis(CH)를 나타내며 myeloid neoplasm이 발생할 위험이 높다. 그러나 그 기저 기전은 완전히 밝혀지지 않았다. 여기에서 우리는 inflammatory stress가 NLRP1 inflammasome을 활성화하고 IL-1β와 같은 pro-inflammatory cytokine의 분비를 증가시킴으로써 p53 mutant hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells(HSPCs)에 경쟁적 우위를 부여하고, paracrine 방식으로 WT HSPC의 fitness를 억제함을 보여준다. 노화 동안 mutant p53는 HSPCs에서 pre-mRNA splicing을 dysregulate하여 NF-κB activation을 강화하고 IL-1β 및 IL-6 분비를 증가시킴으로써 chronic inflammatory bone marrow microenvironment를 생성한다. 또한 IL-1β neutralizing antibody로 IL-1β를 차단하거나 gasdermin D inhibitor를 사용하여 IL-1β 분비를 억제하면 p53 mutant HSPCs의 fitness가 감소한다. 따라서 우리의 연구 결과는 CH에서 inflammatory signaling을 조절하는 데 있어 mutant p53의 중요한 역할을 밝혀내며, inflammation을 억제하는 것이 TP53-mutant CH의 myeloid neoplasm으로의 진행을 예방할 수 있음을 시사한다.

papers.title: Antigen reactivity defines tissue-resident memory and exhausted T cells in tumors
papers.abstract: CD8 + T cells are an important weapon in the therapeutic armamentarium against cancer. While CD8 + CD103 + T cells with a tissue-resident memory T (T RM ) cell phenotype are associated with favorable prognoses, the tumor microenvironment also contains dysfunctional exhausted T (T EX ) cells that exhibit a variety of T RM -like features. Here we deconvolute T RM and T EX cells across human cancers, ascribing markers and gene signatures that distinguish these populations and enable their functional distinction. Although T RM cells have superior functionality and are associated with long-term survival post-tumor resection, they are not associated with responsiveness to immune checkpoint blockade. Tumor-associated T EX and T RM cells are clonally distinct, with the latter comprising tumor-independent bystanders and tumor-specific cells segregated from cognate antigen. Intratumoral T RM cells can be forced toward an exhausted fate when chronic antigen stimulation occurs, indicating that the presence or absence of continuous antigen exposure within the microenvironment is the key distinction between tumor-associated T EX and T RM populations. These results highlight unique functions for T RM and T EX cells in tumor control, underscoring the need for distinct strategies to harness these populations for cancer therapies.

T RM 세포는 더 우수한 기능을 가지며 종양 절제 후 장기 생존과 연관되지만, immune checkpoint blockade에 대한 반응성과는 연관되지 않는다. 종양 관련 T EX 및 T RM 세포는 clonally distinct하며, 후자는 종양 비의존성 bystander와 cognate antigen에서 분리된 종양 특이적 세포로 구성된다. 종양 내 T RM 세포는 만성 항원 자극이 발생할 때 exhausted fate로 유도될 수 있으며, 이는 미세환경 내 지속적인 항원 노출의 존재 여부가 종양 관련 T EX 및 T RM 집단을 구분하는 핵심 차이임을 시사한다. 이러한 결과는 종양 제어에서 T RM 및 T EX 세포의 고유한 기능을 부각시키며, 암 치료에서 이들 집단을 활용하기 위한 상이한 전략의 필요성을 강조한다.

papers.title: Tissue-resident exhausted and memory CD8+ T cells have distinct ontogeny, function and roles in disease
papers.abstract: The presence of CD8 + T cells coexpressing residency and exhaustion molecules in chronic diseases often correlate with clinical outcomes; however, the relationship between these cells and conventional tissue-resident memory (T RM ) cells or exhausted CD8 + T (T EX ) cells is unclear. Here we show that chronic antigen stimulation drives development of tissue-resident T EX (TR-T EX ) cells that are distinct from T RM cells generated after antigen clearance. TR-T EX and T RM cells are regulated by different transcriptional networks with only TR-T EX cells being Tox-dependent for residency programming. While T EX cells (including TR-T EX ) are unable to generate T RM cells after antigen withdrawal, T RM cells differentiate into T EX cells upon chronic antigen exposure. Cell-state-specific transcriptional signatures reveal a selective association of TR-T EX cells with patient responses to immune checkpoint blockade, and only TR-T EX but not T RM cells responded to PD-1 pathway inhibition in vivo. These data suggest that TR-T EX and T RM cells are developmentally divergent cell states that share a tissue-residency program but have distinct roles in disease control.

T EX 세포(TR-T EX 포함)는 항원 철회 후 T RM 세포를 생성할 수 없는 반면, T RM 세포는 만성 항원 노출 시 T EX 세포로 분화한다. cell-state-specific transcriptional signature는 환자의 immune checkpoint blockade 반응과 TR-T EX 세포의 선택적 연관성을 드러내며, 생체 내에서 PD-1 pathway inhibition에 반응한 것은 TR-T EX 세포뿐이었고 T RM 세포는 반응하지 않았다. 이러한 자료는 TR-T EX 및 T RM 세포가 조직 상주 프로그램(tissue-residency program)을 공유하지만 질병 조절에서 서로 다른 역할을 가지는, 발달적으로 분기된 세포 상태임을 시사한다.

papers.title: γδ T cell receptor recognition of CD1d in a lipid-independent manner
papers.abstract: The monomorphic antigen-presenting molecule CD1d presents lipid antigens to both αβ and γδ T cells. While type I natural killer T cells (NKT) display exquisite specificity for CD1d presenting α-galactosylceramide (α-GalCer), the extent of lipid specificity exhibited by CD1d-restricted γδ T cells remains unclear. Here, we demonstrate that human γδ T cell receptors (TCRs) can recognise CD1d in either a lipid-dependent or lipid-independent manner with weak to moderate affinity. Using small-angle X-Ray scattering, we find that γδ TCR-CD1d binding modality is conserved across distinct CD1d-restricted TCRs. In functional assays, CD1d γδ TCR affinity was a poor predictor of γδ T cell line activation. Moreover, CD1d presenting endogenous lipids was sufficient to stimulate T cell activation and induce γδ TCR-CD3 clustering and phosphorylation in a dose-dependent manner. Elongation of the γδ TCR-CD3 complex by the inclusion of the Cγ2 and Cγ3 -encoded constant domains perturbed cellular activation whilst maintaining the ability to form functional γδ TCR clusters. The crystal structure of a Vδ1 γδ + TCR-CD1d complex showed that the γδ TCR sat atop of the CD1d antigen-binding cleft but made no contacts with the presented lipid antigen. These findings provide a molecular basis for lipid-independent CD1d recognition by γδ TCRs.

I형 자연살해 T 세포(type I natural killer T cells, NKT)가 α-galactosylceramide(α-GalCer)를 제시하는 CD1d에 대해 매우 높은 특이성을 보이는 반면, CD1d-제한성(restricted) γδ T 세포가 나타내는 지질 특이성의 정도는 아직 명확하지 않다. 본 연구에서는 인간 γδ T 세포 수용체(TCRs)가 약한 내지 중등도의 친화도로 CD1d를 지질 의존적 또는 지질 비의존적 방식으로 인식할 수 있음을 입증한다. 소각 X선 산란(small-angle X-Ray scattering)을 이용하여, γδ TCR-CD1d 결합 방식이 서로 다른 CD1d-제한성 TCR들 사이에서 보존됨을 확인하였다. 기능 분석에서 CD1d γδ TCR 친화도는 γδ T 세포주(line) 활성화의 좋은 예측 인자가 아니었다. 또한, 내인성 지질(endogenous lipids)을 제시하는 CD1d만으로도 T 세포 활성화를 자극하고 γδ TCR-CD3 클러스터링 및 인산화를 농도 의존적으로 유도하기에 충분하였다. papers.title: Adenophages are an atypical macrophage population in exocrine glands sustained by ILC2-derived GM-CSF
papers.abstract: Granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor (GM-CSF, Csf2) is a potent proinflammatory cytokine 1 . At steady state, however, GM-CSF has a distinct homeostatic function, being essential for the differentiation and maintenance of alveolar macrophages 2-5 . Whether macrophage development in nonpulmonary tissues is similarly dependent on GM-CSF is unclear. Here we examine developing tissues of GM-CSF fate-mapping and reporter mice 6 . We show that type 2 innate lymphoid cells (ILC2s) in the salivary glands produce GM-CSF and identify a macrophage subset that we refer to as 'adenophages'. Adenophages are noncanonical macrophages that are derived from fetal monocytes and are progressively replaced by monocyte-dendritic cell progenitor-derived monocytes. These cells form a spatial niche triad with GM-CSF-producing ILC2s and myoepithelial cells and are required for efficient secretion of saliva. Importantly, adenophages are present throughout exocrine glands, including lacrimal glands and mammary glands, and are also present in humans, indicating a conserved role in exocrine glands across species.
papers.abstractKo: 과립구-대식세포 콜로니 자극 인자(granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor, GM-CSF, Csf2)는 강력한 친염증성 cytokine 1이다. 그러나 정상 상태(steady state)에서는 GM-CSF가 뚜렷한 항상성 기능을 가지며, 폐포 대식세포(alveolar macrophages)의 분화와 유지에 필수적이다 2-5. 비폐 조직(nonpulmonary tissues)에서의 대식세포 발달 역시 GM-CSF에 유사하게 의존하는지는 불분명하다. 본 연구에서는 GM-CSF fate-mapping 및 reporter 마우스 6의 발달 중인 조직을 조사하였다. 우리는 침샘(salivary glands)에서 2형 선천 림프구(type 2 innate lymphoid cells, ILC2s)가 GM-CSF를 생성함을 보이고, 우리가 ‘adenophages’라고 지칭하는 대식세포 아형(subset)을 규명하였다. Adenophages는 태아 단핵구(fetal monocytes)에서 유래하는 비전형적(noncanonical) 대식세포로서, 단핵구-수지상세포 전구세포(monocyte-dendritic cell progenitor)-유래 단핵구에 의해 점진적으로 대체된다. 이들 세포는 GM-CSF를 생산하는 ILC2s 및 근상피세포(myoepithelial cells)와 공간적 niche 삼중체(spatial niche triad)를 형성하며, 타액의 효율적 분비에 필요하다. 중요한 점은 adenophages가 눈물샘(lacrimal glands)과 유선(mammary glands)을 포함한 모든 외분비샘(exocrine glands)에 존재하며, 사람에서도 관찰된다는 것으로, 이는 종 간(exocrine glands across species) 외분비샘에서 보존된 역할을 시사한다.

papers.title: T follicular helper cells transiently unlock a plasticity state in germinal centre B cells during the humoral immune response
papers.abstract: During the germinal centre (GC) reaction, mature B cells undergo rapid and reversible phenotypic shifts that are essential for adaptive immunity. Here we report that GC B cells, unlike other mature B cells, transiently acquire a unique epigenetic plasticity, demonstrated by their enhanced capacity to reprogram to induced pluripotent stem cells. This plasticity depends on T follicular helper (T FH ) cells and is not due to increased proliferation or MYC activation. Instead, it involves weakening of B-cell identity and derepression of stem and progenitor programs driven by NF-κB and other T FH -derived signals. Thus, physiological GC plasticity is tightly constrained by the affinity maturation process of positive selection. Loss of histone 1, a chromatin compaction regulator restricting the accessibility of embryonic stem cell programs, further enhances GC plasticity by bypassing this gatekeeping mechanism. Importantly, patients with B-cell lymphoma enriched for GC plasticity signatures had worse outcomes, suggesting that this mechanism may also contribute to lymphomagenesis.

papers.title: FGF7 promotes load-bearing tendon regeneration and suppresses fibrosis
papers.abstract: Tissue fibrosis is a major cause of organ dysfunction. Preventing fibrosis in tissue pathological condition remains a significant clinical challenge. Here we investigate the role of fibroblast growth factor 7 (FGF7) in mitigating fibrosis and promoting regeneration of load-bearing tendons. Fgf7 knockout mice exhibit impaired motor function and disordered matrix assembly in tendons. Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals an enrichment of a pro-fibrotic cell subpopulation in Fgf7-deficient tendons, which is also predominant in human tendinopathy. Using ProTracer technology, we find that FGF7 deficiency drives proliferating cells toward this pro-fibrotic lineage. Furthermore, we find that FGF7 promotes the tenogenic differentiation of tendon stem/progenitor cells while suppressing their fibrotic differentiation. Importantly, a hydrogel loaded with recombinant FGF7 effectively reduces fibrosis and significantly promotes functional tendon regeneration in vivo. These findings elucidate FGF7's dual role in driving tenogenesis and inhibiting fibrosis, suggesting a potential therapeutic strategy.
papers.abstractKo: 조직 섬유화는 장기 기능장애의 주요 원인이다. 조직의 병적 상태에서 섬유화를 예방하는 것은 여전히 중요한 임상적 과제이다. 본 연구에서는 섬유아세포 성장인자 7(fibroblast growth factor 7, FGF7)이 섬유화를 완화하고 하중 지지성 건(load-bearing tendons)의 재생을 촉진하는 역할을 조사하였다. Fgf7 knockout 마우스는 운동 기능 저하와 건에서의 기질(matrix) 조립 이상을 보였다. 단일세포 RNA sequencing 결과, Fgf7 결핍 건에서 친섬유화(pro-fibrotic) 세포 아집단의 풍부도가 증가하였으며, 이는 인간 tendinopathy에서도 우세한 집단이었다. ProTracer 기술을 사용하여, FGF7 결핍이 증식 세포를 이 친섬유화 계통으로 유도함을 확인하였다. 또한 FGF7이 건 줄기/전구세포(tendon stem/progenitor cells)의 tenogenic 분화를 촉진하는 동시에 그들의 섬유화 분화를 억제함을 발견하였다. 중요한 점은, 재조합 FGF7을 탑재한 하이드로젤(hydrogel)이 in vivo에서 섬유화를 효과적으로 감소시키고 기능적 건 재생을 유의하게 촉진하였다는 것이다. 이러한 결과는 tenogenesis를 유도하고 섬유화를 억제하는 FGF7의 이중 역할을 밝히며, 잠재적 치료 전략을 제시한다.

papers.title: High-fat diet disrupts a septal control on feeding to promote obesity in male mice
papers.abstract: The global epidemic of diet-induced obesity poses a significant health challenge. Among brain regions regulating energy homeostasis, the lateral septum has emerged as a critical brake on feeding behavior to prevent overeating. However, the neural adaptations within the septal area under high-fat diet (HFD) and consequent contributions to obesity remain unknown. Utilizing high-throughput single-nucleus RNA sequencing, slice electrophysiology and in vivo calcium imaging, we identified HFD-induced alterations in the transcriptional profiles and neural activity within the septal area of male mice. The HFD suppresses septal neuronal activity by downregulating hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated channel 1 (Hcn1), and weakens inhibitory control over downstream targets through reduced expression of glutamate decarboxylase 2 (Gad2). Overexpression of Hcn1 and Gad2 enhances septal neuronal activity, restores GABA levels, and prevents HFD-driven overeating and obesity. These findings illustrate how diet disrupts the brain's feeding suppression system, leading to overeating and obesity.
papers.abstractKo: 식이 유도 비만의 전 세계적 유행은 중대한 보건학적 도전 과제를 제기한다. 에너지 항상성을 조절하는 뇌 영역들 중에서, 외측 패혈(lateral septum)은 과식(overeating)을 방지하기 위해 섭식 행동(feeding behavior)을 억제하는 핵심적인 브레이크로 부상하였다. 그러나 고지방식이(high-fat diet, HFD) 하에서 패혈 영역 내 신경 적응과 그에 따른 비만에 대한 기여는 아직 알려져 있지 않다. 고처리량 단일핵 RNA 시퀀싱(single-nucleus RNA sequencing), 절편 전기생리학(slice electrophysiology) 및 생체 내 칼슘 이미징(in vivo calcium imaging)을 활용하여, 우리는 수컷 생쥐의 패혈 영역 내 전사체 프로파일과 신경 활동에서 HFD에 의해 유도된 변화를 확인하였다. HFD는 과분극 활성화 cyclic nucleotide-gated channel 1(Hcn1)을 하향조절하여 패혈 신경 활동을 억제하고, glutamate decarboxylase 2(Gad2)의 발현 감소를 통해 하위 표적에 대한 억제성 조절을 약화시킨다. Hcn1 및 Gad2의 과발현은 패혈 신경 활동을 강화하고, GABA 수준을 회복시키며, HFD가 유도하는 과식과 비만을 예방한다. 이러한 결과는 식이가 뇌의 섭식 억제 시스템을 어떻게 교란하여 과식과 비만으로 이어지는지를 보여준다.

papers.title: Ribosome biogenesis as a potential therapeutic target in KRAS mutant colorectal cancer
papers.abstract: Molecular targeted therapies targeting KRAS signaling have significantly improved patient outcomes, but they have not achieved sufficient therapeutic efficacy in colorectal cancer (CRC). Here, we demonstrate that a subset of KRAS-mutant CRC cells transitions to a cellular state characterized by enhanced ribosome biogenesis upon KRAS signaling inhibition. The mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase inhibitor, trametinib, and AMG510 induce a cellular state characterized by a gene expression profile highly enriched for ribosome biogenesis. We find that they are vulnerable to the inhibition of RNA polymerase I, and they exhibit synergistic anti-tumor effects with trametinib in an autochthonous mouse model of intestinal tumors and human patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These observations demonstrate that high ribosome biogenesis induced by KRAS inhibition is indispensable to maintain this cellular state and is a potential therapeutic target. Overall, this study reveals novel mechanisms of drug tolerance to KRAS inhibition, thereby facilitating the development of new therapeutic strategies.
papers.abstractKo: KRAS signaling을 표적으로 하는 분자 표적 치료(molecular targeted therapy)는 환자 예후를 유의하게 개선했지만, colorectal cancer(CRC)에서는 충분한 치료 효능을 달성하지 못했다. 여기에서 우리는 KRAS-mutant CRC 세포의 일부가 KRAS signaling 억제에 반응하여 enhanced ribosome biogenesis로 특징지어지는 세포 상태로 전이함을 입증한다. mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase inhibitor인 trametinib과 AMG510은 ribosome biogenesis 관련 유전자 발현 프로파일이 현저히 풍부한 세포 상태를 유도한다. 우리는 이들이 RNA polymerase I 억제에 취약하며, 자가 발생성(autochthonous) 마우스 intestinal tumors 모델과 인간 patient-derived organoids(PDOs)에서 trametinib과의 상승적 항종양 효과를 나타냄을 발견한다. 이러한 관찰은 KRAS 억제에 의해 유도되는 높은 ribosome biogenesis가 이 세포 상태를 유지하는 데 필수적이며 잠재적 치료 표적임을 보여준다. 전반적으로, 본 연구는 KRAS 억제에 대한 새로운 약물 내성(drug tolerance) 기전을 밝힘으로써 새로운 치료 전략의 개발을 촉진한다.

papers.title: SREBP1-mediated lipogenesis promotes dedifferentiation and senescence of vascular smooth muscle cells through epigenetic remodeling
papers.abstract: Real or simulated microgravity induces a senescence-like modification of carotid artery in both human and animal observations, with the mechanisms not fully elucidated. Here, we aim to elucidate the role of sterol regulatory element-binding protein 1 (SREBP1, encoded by Srebf1) mediated lipogenesis in the process. Pharmacological activation of SREBP1 directly triggers senescence-like transformation in vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMC), while silencing Srebf1 exerts an opposite effect. Mechanistically, SREBP1-mediated lipogenesis upregulates acetyl-CoA pool to increase histone acetylation, modifying the chromatin accessibility which limiting recruitment of SRF/myocardin complexes to CArG boxes of contractile genes and opening the chromatin accessibility of aging genes. Srebf1 knockdown and local delivery of lentivirus or AAV-mediated VSMC specific expressing sh-Srebf1 significantly attenuates the senescence-like transformation of VSMC both in vitro and in vivo. Our findings reveal a previously unrecognized feature of SREBP1-mediated lipogenesis in vascular biology and SM-induced carotid artery remodeling.
papers.abstractKo: 실제 또는 시뮬레이션된 microgravity는 인간 및 동물 관찰 모두에서 경동맥(carotid artery)의 senescence-like 변형을 유도하며, 그 기전은 충분히 규명되지 않았다. 본 연구에서는 이 과정에서 sterol regulatory element-binding protein 1(SREBP1, Srebf1에 의해 암호화됨)이 매개하는 lipogenesis의 역할을 규명하고자 하였다. SREBP1의 약리학적 활성화는 혈관 평활근세포(vascular smooth muscle cells, VSMC)에서 직접적으로 senescence-like 변형을 유도하는 반면, Srebf1 침묵화(silencing)는 반대 효과를 나타낸다. 기전적으로, SREBP1 매개 lipogenesis는 acetyl-CoA pool을 증가시켜 histone acetylation을 높이고, 이에 따라 chromatin accessibility를 변화시켜 수축성(contractile) 유전자의 CArG box에 대한 SRF/myocardin complex의 모집을 제한하는 동시에 노화 유전자(aging genes)의 chromatin accessibility를 개방한다. Srebf1 knockdown과 lentivirus 또는 AAV 매개 VSMC 특이적 sh-Srebf1 발현의 국소 전달은 시험관 내(in vitro) 및 생체 내(in vivo) 모두에서 VSMC의 senescence-like 변형을 유의하게 완화하였다. 우리의 발견은 vascular biology 및 SM 유도 경동맥 리모델링에서 SREBP1 매개 lipogenesis의 이전에 알려지지 않았던 특징을 밝혀낸다.

papers.title: Head-to-head comparison between vibration-controlled transient elastography and histology in predicting liver-related events due to metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease
papers.abstract: Background and aims Liver stiffness measurement (LSM) by vibration-controlled transient elastography correlates well with liver-related events (LREs), but previous head-to-head comparisons with liver histology were limited by small sample size. This study aimed to compare the prognostic performance of LSM and histology for predicting LREs in patients with metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). Approach and results We analyzed data from 3532 metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease patients (mean age 51.9 y, 57.3% male) in the multicenter vibration-controlled transient elastography-prognosis cohort, all having undergone both LSM and liver biopsy. The primary outcome was LREs, defined as hepatic decompensation, liver transplantation, or liver-related death. Secondary outcomes included HCC and decompensation analyzed separately. Median baseline LSM was 8.8 kPa; 33.5% had F3-F4 fibrosis. Over a median follow-up of 56.6 months, 126 patients (3.6%) developed LREs (123 decompensation). LSM and histology demonstrated similar prognostic performance for LREs, with comparable 5-year AUROC values (0.870 vs. 0.869), integrated AUROCs (0.878 vs. 0.852), and integrated precision-recall curves (0.137 vs. 0.0.68). The 5-year integrated Brier scores were also similar (1.389% vs. 1.391%), and the integrated discrimination improvement index showed no significant difference. Similar results were found across all the outcomes, time points, and sensitivity analyses. Conclusions In this large metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease cohort, LSM by vibration-controlled transient elastography showed comparable prognostic accuracy to histology. As a noninvasive tool, LSM may serve as an alternative surrogate endpoint in clinical trials.
papers.abstractKo: 배경 및 목적 진동 제어 일과성 탄성측정법(vibration-controlled transient elastography)에 의한 간 경도 측정(liver stiffness measurement, LSM)은 간 관련 사건(liver-related events, LREs)과 잘 상관되지만, 간 조직학(liver histology)과의 기존 일대일 비교는 표본 수가 작다는 한계가 있었다. 본 연구는 metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease(MASLD) 환자에서 LREs 예측을 위한 LSM과 조직학의 예후 성능을 비교하고자 하였다. 접근 및 결과 우리는 다기관 vibration-controlled transient elastography-prognosis cohort에 등록된 metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease 환자 3532명(평균 연령 51.9세, 남성 57.3%)의 자료를 분석하였으며, 이들 모두는 LSM과 간 생검(liver biopsy)을 모두 시행받았다. 1차 평가변수는 간성 비대상성(hepatic decompensation), 간이식(liver transplantation), 또는 간 관련 사망(liver-related death)으로 정의된 LREs였다. 2차 평가변수에는 HCC와 비대상성을 각각 별도로 분석한 지표가 포함되었다. 기저 중앙값 LSM은 8.8 kPa였고, 33.5%에서 F3-F4 fibrosis가 있었다. 중앙값 추적 기간 56.6개월 동안 126명(3.6%)에서 LREs가 발생하였고(그중 123명은 비대상성), LSM과 조직학은 LREs에 대해 유사한 예후 성능을 보였으며, 비교 가능한 5년 AUROC 값(0.870 vs. 0.869), 통합 AUROC(integrated AUROC, 0.878 vs. 0.852), 및 통합 precision-recall 곡선(0.137 vs. 0.0.68)을 나타냈다. 5년 통합 Brier score도 유사하였고(1.389% vs. 1.391%), 통합 discrimination improvement index에서는 유의한 차이가 없었다. 모든 평가변수, 시점, 민감도 분석 전반에서 유사한 결과가 확인되었다. 결론 이 대규모 metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease 코호트에서 진동 제어 일과성 탄성측정법에 의한 LSM은 조직학과 비교 가능한 예후 정확도를 보였다. 비침습적 도구로서 LSM은 임상시험에서 대체 surrogate endpoint로 활용될 수 있다.

papers.title: Cancer-cell-secreted DDAH1 induces TGF-β1/Smad3 signaling pathway to promote fibrosis and aging in lung
papers.abstract: Lung aging is a multifactorial series of molecular alterations that leads to gradual deterioration of lung function and increased vulnerability to cancer. Tumor communicates with host organs partially through extracellular vesicles; however, the mechanistic drivers and consequences of lung aging in the context of cancer remain unclear. Here we identify cancer cell-secreted dimethylarginine dimethylaminohydrolase-1 (DDAH1) protein induces citrulline accumulation and promotes lung fibrosis and aging. Mechanistically, our single-cell sequencing and genetic knockout mice evidence that citrulline availability elevation inhibits peptidyl arginine deiminase 4-mediated transforming growth factor-β1 (TGF-β1) citrullination, thereby inducing the TGF-β1/Smad3 signaling pathway in lung fibroblasts. Notably, vacuolar protein sorting assists the packaging of DDAH1 into the late endosomes. The administration of DDAH1 inhibitor reduces fibrosis and alleviates lung aging. Conclusively, our findings reveal tumor-derived DDAH1 protein contributes to citrulline accumulation to promote lung aging, shedding light on the treatment and diagnosis of tumors by inhibiting senescent lung fibroblasts.

papers.title: Social determinants of health, accelerated biological aging, and long-term health outcomes
papers.abstract: Social determinants of health (SDHs) are the primary drivers of health inequalities, but whether biological aging plays a role in linking SDHs to health outcomes remains unclear. Here we utilize detailed information on social determinants across five domains, clinical parameters and electronic health records from the UK Biobank and US NHANES to examine the associations between combined SDHs, accelerated biological aging, and health outcomes. Compared with participants in the favourable SDH group, participants in the unfavourable SDH group had increased KDM-BA and phenotypic age acceleration. Moreover, unfavourable SDHs were associated with elevated risks of mortality and incident diseases. Accelerated biological aging significantly mediated the association between SDHs and all-cause and cause-specific mortality (UK Biobank: mediation proportion 13.46%-25.21%; US NHANES: 7.62%-22.16%). Also, accelerated biological aging served as a mediator between SDHs and incident diseases in the UK Biobank, with the mediation proportions ranging from 6.20% to 30.48%. The estimates were likely specific to the UK Biobank cohort considering its healthy volunteer bias and limited socioeconomic diversity. Overall, our study reveals that the biological aging discrepancy partially explains the associations of combined SDHs with mortality and chronic diseases. Assessing and delaying aging acceleration may be an effective way to narrow the health disparities caused by SDHs.
papers.abstractKo: 건강의 사회적 결정요인(SDHs)은 건강 불평등의 주요 동인이지만, 생물학적 노화가 SDHs와 건강 결과를 연결하는 데 역할을 하는지는 아직 명확하지 않다. 본 연구에서는 UK Biobank와 US NHANES의 5개 영역에 걸친 사회적 결정요인에 대한 상세 정보, 임상 변수 및 전자 건강기록(electronic health records)을 활용하여, 결합된 SDHs, 가속된 생물학적 노화, 그리고 건강 결과 간의 연관성을 조사하였다. 유리한 SDH 군에 속한 참가자와 비교할 때, 불리한 SDH 군의 참가자는 KDM-BA와 표현형 나이 가속(phenotypic age acceleration)이 증가하였다. 또한 불리한 SDHs는 사망률 및 신규 발생 질환의 위험 증가와 관련되었다. 가속된 생물학적 노화는 SDHs와 전체 사망(all-cause mortality) 및 원인별 사망(cause-specific mortality) 간의 연관성을 유의하게 매개하였다(UK Biobank: 매개 비율 13.46%-25.21%; US NHANES: 7.62%-22.16%). 또한 가속된 생물학적 노화는 UK Biobank에서 SDHs와 신규 발생 질환 간의 매개요인으로 작용하였으며, 매개 비율은 6.20%에서 30.48%까지 분포하였다. 이러한 추정치는 건강한 지원자 편향(healthy volunteer bias)과 제한된 사회경제적 다양성을 고려할 때 UK Biobank 코호트에 특이적일 가능성이 높다. 전반적으로, 본 연구는 생물학적 노화의 차이가 결합된 SDHs와 사망률 및 만성질환 간의 연관성을 부분적으로 설명함을 보여준다. 노화 가속을 평가하고 지연시키는 것은 SDHs로 인해 발생하는 건강 격차를 줄이는 효과적인 방법이 될 수 있다.

papers.title: Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals a quiescence-senescence continuum and distinct senotypes following chemotherapy
papers.abstract: Quiescence (reversible cell-cycle arrest) and senescence (irreversible arrest) are challenging to distinguish due to a lack of specific biomarkers, yet both arise simultaneously after chemotherapy. While senescence suppresses tumors by limiting proliferation and recruiting the immune system, quiescent cancer cells evade future therapies and may resume proliferation. Here, we pair time-lapse imaging of cell-cycle dynamics with single-cell RNA sequencing after etoposide treatment to differentiate these states, linking heterogeneous cell-cycle phenotypes to the transcriptomic landscape. We identify diverse senescent types (senotypes) and link them to two arrest pathways - a gradual path arising after a standard mitosis-to-G0 transition, and an alternative direct path driven by a mitotic slip. Using pseudotime trajectory analysis, we find that senescent phenotypes begin to manifest early and gradually along the first trajectory, even in shallow quiescent cells. These data support a model wherein, following chemotherapy, quiescence and senescence exist on a continuum of cell-cycle withdrawal at a transcriptome-wide level.
papers.abstractKo: 정지(quiescence, 가역적 세포주기 정지)와 세포 노화(senescence, 비가역적 정지)는 특이적 바이오마커의 부재로 인해 구별하기 어렵지만, 두 상태는 화학요법 후 동시에 발생한다. 세포 노화는 증식을 제한하고 면역계를 동원함으로써 종양을 억제하는 반면, 정지 상태의 암세포는 향후 치료를 회피하고 증식을 재개할 수 있다. 여기서 우리는 etoposide 처리 후 세포주기 역학의 time-lapse imaging과 single-cell RNA sequencing을 결합하여 이러한 상태를 구별하고, 이질적인 세포주기 표현형을 전사체적 환경(transcriptomic landscape)과 연결하였다. 우리는 다양한 세포 노화 유형(senotypes)을 규명하고, 이를 두 가지 정지 경로와 연결하였다. 즉, 표준적인 mitosis-to-G0 전이를 거친 후 발생하는 점진적 경로와, mitotic slip에 의해 유도되는 대안적 직접 경로이다. Pseudotime trajectory analysis를 사용하여, 우리는 세포 노화 표현형이 첫 번째 trajectory를 따라 초기부터 점차적으로, 심지어 얕은 정지 세포에서도 나타나기 시작함을 발견하였다. 이러한 자료는 화학요법 후 정지와 세포 노화가 전사체 전체 수준에서 세포주기 이탈(cell-cycle withdrawal)의 연속체(continuum) 위에 존재한다는 모델을 지지한다.

papers.title: Hepatic steatosis in humans is associated with preserved glucagon action on amino acid metabolism
papers.abstract: BACKGROUNDAmino acid (AA) concentrations are increased in prediabetes and diabetes. Since AAs stimulate glucagon secretion, which should then increase hepatic AA catabolism, it has been hypothesized that hepatic resistance (associated with hepatic fat content) to glucagon's actions on AA metabolism leads to hyperglucagonemia and hyperglycemia.METHODSTo test this hypothesis, we therefore studied lean and obese individuals, the latter group with and without hepatic steatosis as defined by proton density fat fraction (PDFF) > 5%. After an overnight fast, femoral vein, femoral artery, and hepatic vein catheters were placed. [3-3H] glucose and l-[1-13C,15N]-leucine were used to measure glucose turnover and leucine oxidation, respectively. During a hyperglycemic clamp, an AA mixture was infused together with insulin and glucagon (1.5 ng/kg/min 0-120 minutes; 3.0 ng/kg/min 120-240 minutes). Tracer-based measurement of hepatic leucine oxidation in response to rising glucagon concentrations and splanchnic balance (measured using arteriovenous differences across the liver) of the other AAs were the main outcomes measured.RESULTSThe presence of hepatic steatosis did not alter hepatic glucose metabolism and leucine oxidation in response to insulin and rising concentrations of glucagon. Splanchnic balance of a few AAs and related metabolites differed among the groups. However, across-group differences of AA splanchnic balance in response to glucagon were unaffected by the presence of hepatic steatosis.CONCLUSIONThe action of glucagon on hepatic AA metabolism is unaffected by hepatic steatosis in humans.TRIAL REGISTRATIONClinical Trials.gov: NCT05500586.FUNDINGNIH National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases DK116231, DK78646, DK116231, DK126206, and DK116231.
papers.abstractKo: 배경 아미노산(AA) 농도는 당뇨 전단계와 당뇨병에서 증가한다. AAs가 glucagon 분비를 자극하며, 이는 이어서 간의 AA catabolism을 증가시켜야 하므로, hepatic fat content와 관련된 glucagon의 AA metabolism에 대한 작용의 간 저항성(resistance)이 hyperglucagonemia와 hyperglycemia를 초래한다는 가설이 제기되어 왔다. 방법 이 가설을 검증하기 위해, 우리는 마른(lean) 사람들과 비만(obese) 사람들을 대상으로 연구를 수행했으며, 후자는 proton density fat fraction(PDFF) > 5%로 정의된 hepatic steatosis의 유무에 따라 구분하였다. 하룻밤 금식 후 femoral vein, femoral artery, 및 hepatic vein 카테터를 삽입하였다. [3-3H] glucose와 l-[1-13C,15N]-leucine을 사용하여 각각 glucose turnover와 leucine oxidation을 측정하였다. hyperglycemic clamp 동안, AA 혼합물을 insulin 및 glucagon과 함께 주입하였다(1.5 ng/kg/min 0-120분; 3.0 ng/kg/min 120-240분). 상승하는 glucagon 농도에 대한 tracer 기반 hepatic leucine oxidation 측정과, 다른 AAs의 splanchnic balance(간을 가로지르는 arteriovenous difference를 사용하여 측정)가 주요 평가 결과였다. 결과 hepatic steatosis의 존재는 insulin 및 상승하는 glucagon 농도에 대한 반응으로 hepatic glucose metabolism과 leucine oxidation을 변화시키지 않았다. 일부 AAs 및 관련 대사산물의 splanchnic balance는 군 간에 차이를 보였다. 그러나 glucagon에 대한 AA splanchnic balance의 군 간 차이는 hepatic steatosis의 존재에 의해 영향을 받지 않았다. 결론 인간에서 glucagon의 hepatic AA metabolism에 대한 작용은 hepatic steatosis의 영향을 받지 않는다. 임상시험 등록 Clinical Trials.gov: NCT05500586. 연구비 NIH National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases DK116231, DK78646, DK116231, DK126206, and DK116231.

papers.title: Leveraging engineered mitochondria through intercellular communication network for accelerated transport and delivery
papers.abstract: Inspired by the non-transmembrane transfer of mitochondria in cell-to-cell communications, herein, we report an original exploration to accelerate mitochondrial intercellular transport, and its application to exogenous cargo delivery. We discover that deliberate PINK1-targeted mitophagy downregulation elevates mitochondrial transit capacity via multifaceted drivers-morphological adaptation, metabolic reprogramming, and respiratory enhancement. Capitalizing on this, we engineer high-speed mitochondrial vehicles for photosensitizer hitchhiking, with spatiotemporal tracking elucidating its dynamic intercellular transit and physiological impacts. Through mitochondria's communication network-tunneling nanotubes (TNTs), the mitochondria-photosensitizer cotransporter achieves reinforced intercellular delivery, thereby inducing deep tumor penetration and enhanced photodynamic killing. Our work establishes a transformative mitochondria-hitchhiking platform for overcoming biological barriers in drug delivery and provides mechanistic insights into manipulating intercellular organelle transport for therapeutic applications.
papers.abstractKo: 세포 간 communication에서 미토콘드리아의 비막성(non-transmembrane) 전달에 착안하여, 본 연구에서는 미토콘드리아의 세포간(intercellular) 수송을 가속화하고 이를 외인성 cargo 전달에 적용하는 독창적인 탐구를 보고한다. 우리는 의도적인 PINK1-targeted mitophagy downregulation이 형태학적 적응(morphological adaptation), 대사 재프로그래밍(metabolic reprogramming), 호흡 강화(respiratory enhancement)라는 다면적 동인을 통해 미토콘드리아 이동 능력을 높인다는 것을 발견하였다. 이를 바탕으로, 우리는 photosensitizer hichhiking을 위한 고속 미토콘드리아 운반체를 설계하였고, 시공간적 추적(spatiotemporal tracking)을 통해 그 동적인 세포간 이동과 생리학적 영향을 규명하였다. 미토콘드리아의 communication network인 tunneling nanotubes (TNTs)를 통해, 미토콘드리아-photosensitizer 공수송체(cotransporter)는 강화된 세포간 전달(intercellular delivery)을 달성하여, 깊은 종양 침투와 향상된 photodynamic killing을 유도한다. 본 연구는 약물 전달에서 생물학적 장벽을 극복하기 위한 혁신적인 미토콘드리아-hitchhiking 플랫폼을 확립하고, 치료적 응용을 위해 세포간 소기관 수송을 조절하는 기전에 대한 통찰을 제공한다.

papers.title: Single-cell characterization of the gastrointestinal HIV reservoir reveals heterogeneous cellular phenotypes
papers.abstract: Human gastrointestinal (GI) tissues are a major site of HIV-1 viral persistence, but the nature of the GI reservoir remains poorly described. To characterize the GI HIV reservoir, we profiled cells from GI tissue and matched PBMCs from 10 people with HIV on antiretroviral therapy using single-cell RNA sequencing. We identified distinct compartment-specific patterns of gene expression, highlighting key differences between blood and colon CD4+ T cell populations. vRNA+ cells from both blood and GI tissue were heterogeneous and found in multiple subtypes of CD4+ T cells, although vRNA+ cells were particularly enriched in cells with Th17 or Treg17 phenotypes. Transcriptomic comparison of HIV vRNA+ and vRNA- T cells revealed 116 differentially expressed genes that were associated with HIV infection, including ZBED2, MAF, and IL17F. These data provide what we believe to be new information regarding the GI-resident HIV reservoir and suggest that compartment-specific patterns of gene expression are associated with HIV infection.
papers.abstractKo: 인간 위장관(gastrointestinal, GI) 조직은 HIV-1 바이러스 지속의 주요 부위이지만, GI 저장소의 성격은 아직 충분히 기술되지 않았다. GI HIV 저장소를 특성화하기 위해, 우리는 single-cell RNA sequencing을 사용하여 항레트로바이러스 치료(antiretroviral therapy) 중인 HIV 감염자 10명의 GI 조직 및 일치하는 PBMCs의 세포들을 프로파일링하였다. 우리는 혈액과 결장 colon CD4+ T cell 집단 간의 핵심 차이를 강조하는, 유전자 발현의 뚜렷한 구획 특이적(compartment-specific) 패턴을 확인하였다. 혈액과 GI 조직 모두에서의 vRNA+ 세포는 이질적이었고 CD4+ T cell의 여러 아형에서 발견되었으나, vRNA+ 세포는 특히 Th17 또는 Treg17 표현형을 가진 세포에서 풍부하게 나타났다. HIV vRNA+ 및 vRNA- T 세포의 전사체 비교는 HIV 감염과 연관된 116개의 차등 발현 유전자(differentially expressed genes)를 밝혀냈으며, 여기에는 ZBED2, MAF, IL17F가 포함되었다. 이러한 자료는 우리가 생각하기에 GI에 상주하는 HIV 저장소에 관한 새로운 정보를 제공하며, 구획 특이적 유전자 발현 패턴이 HIV 감염과 연관되어 있음을 시사한다.

papers.title: Mismatch repair deficiency drives malignant progression and alters the tumor immune microenvironment in glioblastoma models
papers.abstract: Mutations in DNA mismatch repair (MMR) pathway genes (MSH2, MSH6, MLH1, and PMS2) are linked to acquired resistance to temozolomide (TMZ) and high tumor mutation burden (TMB) in high-grade gliomas (HGGs), including glioblastomas (GBMs). However, the specific roles of individual MMR genes in the initiation, progression, TMB, microsatellite instability (MSI), and resistance to TMZ in gliomas remain unclear. Here, we developed de novo mouse models of germline and somatic MMR-deficient (MMRd) HGGs. Surprisingly, loss of Msh2 or Msh6 did not lead to high TMB, MSI, nor did it confer a response to anti-programmed cell death 1 (anti-PD-1) in GBM. Similarly, human GBM showed discordance between MMR gene mutations and the TMB and MSI. Germline MMRd promoted the progression from low-grade to HGG and reduced survival compared with MMR-proficient (MMRp) tumor-bearing mice. This effect was not tumor cell intrinsic but was associated with MMRd in the tumor immune microenvironment, driving immunosuppressive myeloid programs, reduced lymphoid infiltration, and CD8+ T cell exhaustion. Both MMR-reduced (MMRr) and MMRd GBM were resistant to TMZ, unlike MMRp tumors. Our study shows that N3-(2-fluoroethyl) imidazotetrazine (KL-50), an imidazotetrazine-based DNA targeting agent that induces MMR-independent cross-link-mediated cytotoxicity, was effective against germline and somatic MMRr and MMRd GBMs, offering a potential therapy for TMZ-resistant HGG with MMR alterations.
papers.abstractKo: DNA mismatch repair (MMR) 경로 유전자(MSH2, MSH6, MLH1, 및 PMS2)의 돌연변이는 glioblastoma(GBM)를 포함한 high-grade gliomas(HGGs)에서 temozolomide(TMZ)에 대한 획득성 내성과 높은 tumor mutation burden(TMB)과 연관된다. 그러나 glioma에서 개별 MMR 유전자가 개시, 진행, TMB, microsatellite instability(MSI), 그리고 TMZ에 대한 내성에서 수행하는 구체적 역할은 아직 명확하지 않다. 본 연구에서는 germline 및 somatic MMR 결핍(MMRd) HGG의 de novo mouse model을 구축하였다. 놀랍게도, Msh2 또는 Msh6의 소실은 높은 TMB나 MSI로 이어지지 않았으며, GBM에서 anti-programmed cell death 1(anti-PD-1)에 대한 반응도 유도하지 않았다. 마찬가지로, human GBM에서도 MMR gene mutation과 TMB 및 MSI 사이의 불일치가 관찰되었다. Germline MMRd는 low-grade에서 HGG로의 진행을 촉진하였고, MMR-proficient(MMRp) 종양 보유 마우스와 비교하여 생존을 감소시켰다. 이러한 효과는 종양 세포 고유의 것이 아니라 tumor immune microenvironment의 MMRd와 연관되어 있었으며, 면역억제성 myeloid 프로그램을 유도하고, lymphoid infiltration을 감소시키며, CD8+ T cell exhaustion을 초래하였다. MMRp 종양과 달리, MMR-reduced(MMRr) 및 MMRd GBM 모두 TMZ에 내성을 보였다. 본 연구는 MMR-independent cross-link-mediated cytotoxicity를 유도하는 imidazotetrazine 기반 DNA 표적제인 N3-(2-fluoroethyl) imidazotetrazine(KL-50)이 germline 및 somatic MMRr와 MMRd GBM에 대해 효과적이었음을 보여주며, 이는 MMR 변화를 동반한 TMZ-resistant HGG에 대한 잠재적 치료법을 제시한다.

papers.title: TMEM120A maintains adipose tissue lipid homeostasis through ER CoA channeling
papers.abstract: Efficient fatty acid (FA) re-esterification is essential for lipid homeostasis in adipocytes, yet the mechanisms coordinating Coenzyme A (CoA) availability at the endoplasmic reticulum (ER)-a major site of lipid synthesis-remain unclear. Here, we identify TMEM120A as an ER-resident CoA-binding protein that regulates intracellular FA metabolism. TMEM120A interacts with the ER-localized acyl-CoA synthetase ACSL1 and ACSL3 to promote long-chain acyl-CoA synthesis and channeling into the ER, thereby facilitating FA re-esterification and lipid cycling during lipolysis. By relieving acyl-CoA-mediated feedback inhibition of lipolysis, TMEM120A enhances lipid turnover while protecting against ER stress and lipotoxicity. Adipocyte-specific deletion of Tmem120a in mice impairs lipolysis-induced energy expenditure and exacerbates inflammation and metabolic dysfunction under high-fat diet conditions. These findings establish TMEM120A as a critical regulator of ER CoA handling and lipid flux, revealing a previously unrecognized mechanism that links intracellular CoA dynamics to systemic energy balance and metabolic health.
papers.abstractKo: 지방산(fatty acid, FA) 재에스터화는 지방세포(adipocyte)에서 지질 항상성(lipid homeostasis)에 필수적이지만, 지질 합성의 주요 장소인 소포체(endoplasmic reticulum, ER)에서 코엔자임 A(Coenzyme A, CoA) 가용성을 조정하는 기전은 아직 불분명하다. 본 연구에서는 TMEM120A를 세포내 지방산 대사를 조절하는 ER 상주 CoA 결합 단백질로 규명하였다. TMEM120A는 ER에 국재하는 acyl-CoA synthetase ACSL1 및 ACSL3와 상호작용하여 장쇄 acyl-CoA 합성과 ER로의 channeling을 촉진함으로써, 지질분해(lipolysis) 동안 지방산 재에스터화와 지질 순환(lipid cycling)을 용이하게 한다. acyl-CoA 매개 lipolysis의 피드백 억제를 완화함으로써, TMEM120A는 ER stress와 lipotoxicity로부터 보호하는 동시에 지질 회전율(lipid turnover)을 증가시킨다. 마우스에서 Tmem120a의 지방세포 특이적 결실은 lipolysis 유도 에너지 소비를 저해하고, 고지방식이(high-fat diet) 조건에서 염증과 대사 기능장애를 악화시킨다. 이러한 결과는 TMEM120A를 ER CoA 처리와 지질 flux의 핵심 조절인자로 확립하며, 세포내 CoA dynamics와 전신 에너지 항상성 및 대사 건강을 연결하는 이전에 알려지지 않은 기전을 제시한다.

papers.title: Tracing the origin of myofibroblasts in kidney fibrosis
papers.abstract: Kidney fibrosis is a key pathological feature of chronic kidney disease (CKD), characterized by the activation and accumulation of αSMA-positive myofibroblasts. The cellular origin of myofibroblasts in kidney fibrosis has been a subject of extensive research and debate. Previous studies suggested that myofibroblasts might arise from various cellular sources through mesenchymal transition processes, including epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) of tubular epithelial cells (TECs), endothelial-mesenchymal transition (EndoMT), and macrophage-mesenchymal transition (MMT) of bone marrow-derived cells. In this study, we systematically investigated the origin of myofibroblasts using renal cell lineage tracing tools during kidney fibrosis. Our findings indicated the absence of EMT, EndoMT, and MMT contributing to myofibroblasts, whereas resident fibroblasts were the primary source. Next, we developed and employed specialized dual recombinase-mediated lineage tracing tools, including EMTracer, EndoMTracer, and MMTracer, which revealed reversible partial mesenchymal transition occurring predominantly in the renal urothelial cells (UroCs) and parietal epithelial cells (PECs), minimally in endothelial cells, and not in TECs or macrophages. Our work elucidated the contribution of both complete and partial mesenchymal transition in various renal cell lineages and revealed the origin of myofibroblasts during kidney fibrosis, which may provide important insights into the diagnosis and treatment of CKD.
papers.abstractKo: 신장 섬유화(kidney fibrosis)는 만성 신장질환(chronic kidney disease, CKD)의 핵심 병리학적 특징으로, αSMA-양성 myofibroblast의 활성화와 축적으로 특징지어진다. 신장 섬유화에서 myofibroblast의 세포 기원은 광범위한 연구와 논쟁의 대상이었다. 이전 연구들은 myofibroblast가 세뇨관 상피세포(tubular epithelial cells, TECs)의 상피-간엽 전이(epithelial-mesenchymal transition, EMT), 내피-간엽 전이(endothelial-mesenchymal transition, EndoMT), 및 골수 유래 세포의 대식세포-간엽 전이(macrophage-mesenchymal transition, MMT)를 포함한 다양한 세포 기원을 통해 발생할 수 있다고 제안하였다. 본 연구에서는 신장 섬유화 동안 renal cell lineage tracing 도구를 사용하여 myofibroblast의 기원을 체계적으로 조사하였다. 우리의 결과는 myofibroblast에 기여하는 EMT, EndoMT 및 MMT가 없음을 나타냈으며, 반면 resident fibroblast가 주요 기원이었다. 다음으로 우리는 EMTracer, EndoMTracer 및 MMTracer를 포함한 특수한 dual recombinase-mediated lineage tracing 도구를 개발하여 적용하였고, 그 결과 가역적인 partial mesenchymal transition이 주로 신장 urothelial cell(UroCs)과 parietal epithelial cell(PECs)에서 발생하고, 내피세포에서는 매우 제한적으로 발생하며, TECs 또는 macrophage에서는 발생하지 않음을 보여주었다. 본 연구는 다양한 renal cell lineage에서 완전한 및 부분적인 mesenchymal transition의 기여를 규명하고 신장 섬유화 동안 myofibroblast의 기원을 밝혀냈으며, 이는 CKD의 진단과 치료에 중요한 통찰을 제공할 수 있다.

papers.title: Staphylococcus aureus fatty acid metabolism governs saeRS-mediated aggregation in joint infections
papers.abstract: Staphylococcus aureus can form aggregates within human synovial fluid, contributing to joint infections that are resistant to conventional therapies. However, the regulatory pathways underlying this process remain unclear. Here, we reveal that the S. aureus two-component system saeRS contributes to synovial aggregation by controlling the expression of fibrinectin-binding proteins A and B (FnbA/B), which bind to human fibrinogen and cause aggregation. We further demonstrate that the fatty acid kinase (fak) system is the primary regulator for SaeS activity under host conditions. Mechanistically, fak is epistatic to saeRS by scavenging exogenous fatty acids and altering the localization of SaeS into functional membrane microdomains (FMMs), which are essential for SaeS function. We also identify that undecanoic acid (UDA) is capable of inhibiting the fak pathway, demonstrating its efficacy and potential applicability in treating joint infections. Altogether, these findings highlight the fak-saeRS axis as a potential therapeutic target for joint infections and underscore UDA as a promising treatment for these infections.
papers.abstractKo: 황색포도상구균(Staphylococcus aureus)은 인간 활액(human synovial fluid) 내에서 응집체(aggregates)를 형성할 수 있으며, 이는 기존 치료법에 저항성을 보이는 관절 감염(joint infections)에 기여한다. 그러나 이러한 과정의 기저에 있는 조절 경로는 아직 명확하지 않다. 여기서 우리는 S. aureus의 2성분계(two-component system) saeRS가 인간 피브리노겐(human fibrinogen)에 결합하여 응집을 유발하는 fibrinectin-binding proteins A and B (FnbA/B)의 발현을 조절함으로써 활액 내 응집(synovial aggregation)에 기여함을 밝힌다. 또한 fatty acid kinase (fak) system이 숙주 조건에서 SaeS 활성의 주요 조절자임을 추가로 입증한다. 기전적으로, fak는 외인성 지방산(exogenous fatty acids)을 포획(scavenging)하고 SaeS의 위치를 SaeS 기능에 필수적인 functional membrane microdomains (FMMs)로 변경함으로써 saeRS에 대해 epistatic하다. 우리는 또한 undecanoic acid (UDA)가 fak 경로를 억제할 수 있음을 확인하였으며, 이는 관절 감염 치료에서의 효능과 잠재적 적용 가능성을 보여준다. 종합하면, 이러한 결과는 fak-saeRS 축을 관절 감염의 잠재적 치료 표적으로 부각시키고, UDA를 이러한 감염의 유망한 치료법으로 강조한다.

papers.title: Volatile and non-volatile pathogen cues shape host extracellular vesicles production in pre-infection response
papers.abstract: In natural environments, animals encounter pathogen-derived chemicals long before infection occurs. How such anticipatory cues influence extracellular vesicle (EV) dynamics, which are central to immune regulation, intercellular communication, and stress responses, remains unknown. Using Caenorhabditis elegans, we show that pathogen-derived volatile and non-volatile compounds trigger distinct EV pathways through separate sensory and molecular mechanisms. Non-volatile secretome components, including the tripeptide Ile-Pro-Pro, activate immune-dependent EV production, whereas volatile metabolites elicit immunity-independent EV formation. Both responses require sensory input from ASK, ADL, and AWC neurons and converge on a neural circuit involving RMG, AIB, and AIA interneurons. GPCRs SRI-19, SRI-36/39, and SRR-6 mediate non-volatile responses, with SRR-6 acting in the intestine to regulate muscle EVs release. Notably, pre-exposure to pathogen volatiles enhances offspring survival during subsequent infection in an SRI-19-dependent manner, suggesting a predictive, intergenerational benefit of pathogen detection. In summary, our findings uncover that pathogen-derived chemical cues shape host EV production via specialized sensory circuits, revealing how animals anticipate infection and prime protective physiological responses.
papers.abstractKo: 자연 환경에서 동물은 감염이 발생하기 훨씬 이전에 병원체 유래 화학물질에 노출된다. 이러한 예측적 신호가 면역 조절, 세포 간 communication, 스트레스 반응의 핵심인 extracellular vesicle (EV) dynamics에 어떤 영향을 미치는지는 알려져 있지 않다. Caenorhabditis elegans를 이용하여, 우리는 병원체 유래 휘발성 및 비휘발성 화합물이 서로 다른 감각 및 분자 기전을 통해 상이한 EV 경로를 유도함을 보여준다. 트리펩타이드 Ile-Pro-Pro를 포함한 비휘발성 secretome 성분은 면역 의존적 EV 생성을 활성화하는 반면, 휘발성 대사산물은 면역 비의존적 EV 형성을 유도한다. 두 반응 모두 ASK, ADL, 및 AWC 뉴런으로부터의 감각 입력을 필요로 하며, RMG, AIB, 및 AIA interneurons를 포함하는 신경 회로로 수렴한다. papers.title: Harnessing multivalency and FcγRIIB engagement to augment anti-CD27 immunotherapy
papers.abstract: Despite significant clinical progress, checkpoint blockade remains limited by variable response rates, resistance, and toxicity. Activating costimulatory receptors offers a promising alternative to enhance anti-tumor immunity. However, there is insufficient understanding of how to mimic physiological membrane-anchored costimulatory ligands. Here, we describe a strategy for developing effective agonists of the costimulatory receptor CD27 by increasing both antibody valency and FcγRIIB engagement. Engineered anti-CD27 antibodies capable of tetravalent binding to CD27 and selective FcγRIIB association exhibit potent T cell stimulatory activity and anti-tumor efficacy in pre-clinical models, compared to bivalent counterparts. The anti-tumor effects of the tetravalent antibody are mediated through CD8⁺ T cell activation without evidence of regulatory T cell depletion. Mechanistically, whereas the increase in avidity drives more efficient CD27 clustering, FcγRIIB engagement triggers polarization of receptor clusters to the cell-cell interface and reduces receptor internalization. This work provides a framework for developing more effective agonist-based T cell stimulatory therapies.
papers.abstractKo: 유의미한 임상적 진전에도 불구하고, checkpoint blockade는 여전히 가변적인 반응률, 내성, 및 독성에 의해 제한된다. 활성화성 costimulatory receptor를 표적화하는 것은 항종양 면역을 강화하기 위한 유망한 대안이다. 그러나 생리적 막 결합형(costimulatory) ligand를 모방하는 방법에 대해서는 충분한 이해가 부족하다. 본 연구에서는 항체 valency와 FcγRIIB 결합을 모두 증가시켜 costimulatory receptor CD27의 효과적인 agonist를 개발하는 전략을 제시한다. CD27에 대한 tetravalent 결합 및 선택적 FcγRIIB 결합이 가능한 engineered anti-CD27 antibody는 bivalent 대응체와 비교하여 전임상 모델에서 강력한 T cell 자극 활성 및 항종양 효능을 나타낸다. tetravalent antibody의 항종양 효과는 regulatory T cell의 고갈(depletion) 증거 없이 CD8⁺ T cell 활성화를 통해 매개된다. 기전적으로, avidity의 증가는 보다 효율적인 CD27 clustering을 유도하는 반면, FcγRIIB 결합은 receptor cluster의 세포-세포 접합부(cell-cell interface)로의 polarization을 유발하고 receptor internalization을 감소시킨다. 본 연구는 보다 효과적인 agonist 기반 T cell 자극 치료법을 개발하기 위한 틀을 제공한다.

papers.title: Autophagy-regulated mitochondrial inheritance controls early CD8+ T cell fate commitment
papers.abstract: T cell immunity deteriorates with age, accompanied by a decline in autophagy and asymmetric cell division. Here we show that autophagy regulates mitochondrial inheritance in CD8 + T cells. Using a mouse model that enables sequential tagging of mitochondria in mother and daughter cells, we demonstrate that autophagy-deficient T cells fail to clear premitotic old mitochondria and inherit them symmetrically. By contrast, autophagy-competent cells that partition mitochondria asymmetrically produce daughter cells with distinct fates: those retaining old mitochondria exhibit reduced memory potential, whereas those that have not inherited old mitochondria and exhibit higher mitochondrial turnover are long-lived and expand upon cognate-antigen challenge. Multiomics analyses suggest that early fate divergence is driven by distinct metabolic programmes, with one-carbon metabolism activated in cells retaining premitotic mitochondria. These findings advance our understanding of how T cell diversity is imprinted early during division and support the development of strategies to modulate T cell function.
papers.abstractKo: T 세포 면역은 나이가 들면서 저하되며, 이에 동반하여 autophagy와 비대칭 세포 분열(asymmetric cell division)이 감소한다. 여기에서 우리는 autophagy가 CD8+ T 세포에서 미토콘드리아 유전(mitochondrial inheritance)을 조절함을 보인다. 어미 세포와 딸 세포에서 미토콘드리아를 순차적으로 표지할 수 있는 마우스 모델을 사용하여, autophagy 결핍 T 세포는 분열 전 오래된 미토콘드리아를 제거하지 못하고 이를 대칭적으로 유전함을 입증하였다. 반대로, 미토콘드리아를 비대칭적으로 분배하는 autophagy-유능 세포는 서로 다른 운명을 지닌 딸 세포를 생성하는데, 오래된 미토콘드리아를 유지하는 세포는 기억 잠재력(memory potential)이 감소하는 반면, 오래된 미토콘드리아를 유전받지 않고 더 높은 미토콘드리아 turnover를 보이는 세포는 장수하며 cognate-antigen 도전에 따라 확장된다. Multiomics 분석은 초기 운명 분기(early fate divergence)가 서로 다른 대사 프로그램에 의해 주도되며, 분열 전 미토콘드리아를 유지하는 세포에서 one-carbon metabolism이 활성화됨을 시사한다. 이러한 발견은 T 세포 다양성이 분열 초기 단계에서 어떻게 각인되는지에 대한 우리의 이해를 진전시키며, T 세포 기능을 조절하기 위한 전략 개발을 뒷받침한다.

papers.title: Dysfunctional CD4 T cells in an oncovirus-specific TCR-transgenic in vivo model
papers.abstract: T cell exhaustion has been implicated in cancer and infectious diseases. In this study, we report a novel mouse model, "MolT-II", with T cells expressing a transgenic T cell receptor (TCR) specific for a Moloney virus envelope-derived, MHC class II-presented peptide epitope. Characterization of MolT-II CD4 T cells revealed that they are dysfunctional, showing severely impaired effector functions, reduced proliferation and increased baseline expression of co-inhibitory receptors such as PD-1, LAG-3 and CTLA-4, likely due to chronic exposure to a self-antigen. We further show that epitope-specific peptide vaccination combined with immune checkpoint blockade is able to restore the function of MolT-II CD4 T cells in vivo, associated with enhanced tumor control in mice. The MolT-II mouse strain thus represents an in vivo model for reversible CD4 T cell dysfunction, allowing the study of the role of CD4 T cell regulation in cancer, mechanisms underlying CD4 T cell dysfunction and exhaustion, and novel immunomodulatory therapies aiming to rescue dysfunctional T cells.
papers.abstractKo: T 세포 탈진(T cell exhaustion)은 암 및 감염성 질환과 연관되어 왔다. 본 연구에서는 Moloney virus envelope 유래의 MHC class II 제시 peptide epitope에 특이적인 transgenic T cell receptor(TCR)를 발현하는 T 세포를 가진 새로운 마우스 모델인 "MolT-II"를 보고한다. MolT-II CD4 T 세포의 특성 분석 결과, 이들은 기능장애 상태(dysfunctional)였으며, 현저히 저하된 effector function, 감소된 증식, 그리고 PD-1, LAG-3 및 CTLA-4와 같은 co-inhibitory receptor의 기저 발현 증가를 보였는데, 이는 아마도 자가항원(self-antigen)에 대한 만성적 노출 때문인 것으로 보인다. 또한 epitope-specific peptide vaccination과 immune checkpoint blockade를 병용하면 in vivo에서 MolT-II CD4 T 세포의 기능을 회복시킬 수 있으며, 이는 마우스에서 향상된 종양 조절과 연관되었다는 점을 보였다. 따라서 MolT-II 마우스 계통은 가역적 CD4 T 세포 기능장애에 대한 in vivo 모델을 대표하며, 암에서의 CD4 T 세포 조절 역할, CD4 T 세포 기능장애 및 탈진의 기저 기전, 그리고 기능장애 T 세포의 회복을 목표로 하는 새로운 immunomodulatory therapy의 연구를 가능하게 한다.

papers.title: Resistance potential of the HLA-A2-restricted immunodominant SARS-CoV-2-specific CD8+ T cell receptor repertoire to antigenic drift
papers.abstract: A major concern of COVID-19 is immune escape. While T cells are implicated in protection against severe disease, direct evaluation of their capacity to specifically target SARS-CoV-2 variants remains limited. We aim to narrow this gap by profiling the ability of CD8 + T cells to recognize SARS-CoV-2 mutations after vaccination and observe a high degree of phenotype and repertoire diversity. To better understand the breadth of antigen repertoire coverage, we interrogate the ability of SARS-CoV-2 specific TCRs to bind all point mutations of the immunodominant HLA-A2:S 269-277 epitope. While mutation space coverage is surprisingly vast, specific substitutions are not recognized by the vaccine-elicited repertoire. Structural analyses reveal a TCR sequence-based antigen recognition limitation intrinsic to vaccination. Further investigation reveals that this repertoire 'hole' is not present in the naive repertoire, suggesting future immune escape through these potential escape mutations could be relieved by modifications to vaccines.
papers.abstractKo: COVID-19의 주요 우려 중 하나는 면역 회피(immune escape)이다. T 세포가 중증 질환으로부터의 보호에 관여한다는 점이 시사되었으나, SARS-CoV-2 변이체를 특이적으로 표적하는 능력에 대한 직접적인 평가는 여전히 제한적이다. 우리는 백신 접종 후 CD8+ T 세포가 SARS-CoV-2 돌연변이를 인지하는 능력을 프로파일링하여 이러한 간극을 좁히고자 하였으며, 높은 수준의 phenotype 및 repertoire 다양성을 관찰하였다. 항원 repertoire 커버리지의 폭을 더 잘 이해하기 위해, 우리는 SARS-CoV-2 특이적 TCR이 면역우성(immunodominant) HLA-A2:S 269-277 epitope의 모든 점 돌연변이(point mutations)에 결합할 수 있는 능력을 조사하였다. mutation space 커버리지는 놀라울 정도로 광범위하지만, 특정 치환(substitutions)은 백신에 의해 유도된 repertoire에서 인지되지 않는다. 구조적 분석(structural analyses)은 백신 접종에 내재적인 TCR sequence 기반 항원 인지 제한을 드러낸다. 추가 조사는 이러한 repertoire ‘hole’이 naive repertoire에는 존재하지 않음을 보여주며, 이러한 잠재적 escape mutations를 통한 향후 면역 회피는 백신의 변형을 통해 완화될 수 있음을 시사한다.

papers.title: Single cell spatial transcriptomics integration deciphers the morphological heterogeneity of atherosclerotic carotid arteries
papers.abstract: The process of arterial atherosclerosis is characterised by accumulation of lipids and fibrous material with accompanying inflammation. As plaques progress, they restrict blood flow and cause rupture, which results in life threatening organ ischemia and dysfunction. Although extensively studied, a clear understanding of plaque heterogeneity and mechanisms that trigger their destabilization remains elusive. Our study reveals the molecular microarchitecture of human carotid artery plaques, using bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing combined with single-cell spatial transcriptomics, for which we present optimized cell segmentation algorithms. We identified distinct plaque morphologies linked to different cell type compositions, impacting early and advanced lesion formation, as well as destabilization. Spatial transcriptomics enabled us to further determine an inflammatory smooth muscle cell subtype, localize regions of neovascularization, and assign hotspots for macrophage activity within distinct cellular neighbourhoods across lesions. For different macrophage substates, we propose gradual and locally contained transdifferentiation of subluminal inflammatory HMOX1+ macrophages into a lipid-handling TREM2+ phenotype within border zones of the fibrous cap and necrotic core. Our findings provide insight into the complex heterogeneity of human atherosclerosis by unravelling location and proximity of different mural and immune cell substates involved in plaque progression and vulnerability.
papers.abstractKo: 동맥 죽상경화(arterial atherosclerosis) 과정은 염증을 동반하는 지질과 섬유성 물질의 축적으로 특징지어진다. 플라크가 진행함에 따라 혈류를 제한하고 파열을 유발하며, 이는 생명을 위협하는 장기 허혈과 기능장애를 초래한다. 광범위하게 연구되었음에도 불구하고, 플라크의 이질성과 그 불안정화를 유발하는 기전에 대한 명확한 이해는 여전히 부족하다. 본 연구는 최적화된 세포 분할 알고리즘(cell segmentation algorithms)을 제시하는 single-cell spatial transcriptomics와 bulk 및 single-cell RNA sequencing을 결합하여, 인간 경동맥 플라크의 분자적 미세구조(molecular microarchitecture)를 밝힌다. 우리는 다양한 세포 유형 조성에 연관된 상이한 플라크 형태(morphologies)를 확인하였으며, 이는 초기 및 진행성 병변 형성과 더불어 불안정화에 영향을 미쳤다. Spatial transcriptomics를 통해 추가로 염증성 평활근세포 아형(inflammatory smooth muscle cell subtype)을 규명하고, 신생혈관형성(neovascularization) 영역을 위치 지정하였으며, 병변 전반의 뚜렷한 세포성 미세환경(cellular neighbourhoods) 내에서 대식세포 활성의 hotspot을 할당할 수 있었다. 서로 다른 대식세포 상태(macrophage substates)에 대하여, 우리는 섬유성 캡(fibrous cap)과 괴사성 핵(necrotic core)의 경계 구역(border zones) 내에서, 관강하(subluminal) 염증성 HMOX1+ 대식세포가 지질 처리(lipid-handling) TREM2+ 표현형으로 점진적이고 국소적으로 제한된 전분화(transdifferentiation)를 거친다는 가설을 제시한다. 우리의 발견은 플라크 진행과 취약성에 관여하는 서로 다른 벽세포(mural) 및 면역세포 아형의 위치와 근접성을 규명함으로써 인간 죽상경화증(human atherosclerosis)의 복잡한 이질성에 대한 통찰을 제공한다.

papers.title: Lack of caspase 8 directs neuronal progenitor-like reprogramming and small cell lung cancer progression
papers.abstract: Most neuroendocrine cancers lack caspase 8 protein expression. While this feature was thought to facilitate escape from extrinsic apoptosis, its cancer-regulatory function has remained unexplored. Here, we devise a mouse model of small cell lung cancer (SCLC) recapitulating the lack of expression of caspase 8 seen in humans and uncover an unexpected role for necroptosis-fueled pre-tumoral inflammation resulting in reprogramming towards a neuronal progenitor cell-like state and increased metastatic disease. Notably, transcriptional signatures of this cellular state are enriched in relapsed and metastatic human SCLC. Mechanistically, caspase 8 loss within the pre-tumoral niche promotes inflammation marked by increased recruitment of regulatory T cells (Tregs) which are responsible for the promotion of metastatic disease. Importantly, inactivation of the necroptosis executioner MLKL reverses pre-tumoral inflammation, decreases metastasis as well as neuronal-like reprogramming. Taken together, our findings suggest that pre-tumoral inflammatory cell death contributes to neuronal progenitor mimicry, immunosuppression and increased metastasis in SCLC.

papers.title: PPP2R2A insufficiency enhances PD-L1 immune checkpoint blockade efficacy in lung cancer through cGAS-STING activation
papers.abstract: PP2A B55α, a regulatory subunit of protein phosphatase 2 (PP2A), is underexpressed in greater than 40% of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) cases due to loss of heterozygosity of PPP2R2A, the gene encoding this protein. Given that low PPP2R2A expression correlates with poor prognosis, treating PPP2R2A-deficient NSCLC represents an unmet medical need. Here, we show that PPP2R2A knockdown or its heterozygosity (PPP2R2A+/-) increases cytosolic DNA, leading to cGAS-STING-type I IFN pathway activation. PPP2R2A deficiency results in elevated expression of immune checkpoint protein PD-L1 via GSK-3β- and STING-dependent mechanisms. PPP2R2A+/- cancer cells have enhanced sensitivity to PD-L1 blockade in a mouse model of lung cancer due to modulation of the tumor immune microenvironment, resulting in increased NK cells and reduced infiltration and function of Tregs. Consequently, PD-L1 antibody treatment increases CD8+ T infiltration and activity, especially in tumors with PPP2R2A heterozygosity. Furthermore, systemic or Treg-specific IFNAR1 blockade reduces the efficacy of PD-L1 blockade in PPP2R2A+/- tumors. Patients with NSCLC with a low PPP2R2A/PD-L1 ratio respond better to immune checkpoint blockade (ICB). These findings underscore the therapeutic potential of ICB in treating PPP2R2A-deficient NSCLC and suggest that PPP2R2A deficiency could serve as a biomarker for guiding ICB-based therapies.

papers.title: Agonist signaling drives neutrophil subpopulations to promote/inhibit colorectal cancer liver metastasis
papers.abstract: Liver metastasis is a primary cause of death in colorectal cancer, yet the role of immune cells called neutrophils in this process remains complex. In this study, we identify three distinct neutrophil subtypes: anti-tumor high-density neutrophils, pro-tumor mature low-density neutrophils, and immature low-density neutrophils. Here we show that tumor-derived GM-CSF converts anti-tumor neutrophils into a pro-tumor state via the AKT-NF-κB-NFAT5 signaling axis. These activated neutrophils, when further stimulated by CXCR2 ligands, release web-like structures known as neutrophil extracellular traps which promote cancer spread by enhancing cancer cell growth, suppressing immune responses, and preparing the liver for metastasis. Importantly, we demonstrate that using antibodies depleting neutrophils or drugs inhibiting their pro-tumor activity effectively reduces liver metastasis in mice. Our work defines specific neutrophil subsets as key drivers of cancer progression and highlights their therapeutic potential in preventing metastatic spread.

papers.title: Human assembloids recapitulate periportal liver tissue in vitro
papers.abstract: The development of complex multicellular human in vitro systems holds great promise for modelling disease and advancing drug discovery and tissue engineering 1 . In the liver, despite the identification of key signalling pathways involved in hepatic regeneration 2,3 , in vitro expansion of human hepatocytes directly from fresh patient tissue has not yet been achieved, limiting the possibility of modelling liver composite structures in vitro. Here we first developed human hepatocyte organoids (h-HepOrgs) from 28 different patients. Patient-derived hepatocyte organoids sustained long-term expansion of hepatocytes in vitro and maintained patient-specific gene expression and bile canaliculus features and function of the in vivo tissue. After transplantation, expanded h-HepOrgs rescued the phenotype of a mouse model of liver disease. By combining h-HepOrgs with portal mesenchyme and our previously published cholangiocyte organoids 4-6 , we generated patient-specific periportal liver assembloids that retain the histological arrangement, gene expression and cell interactions of periportal liver tissue, with cholangiocytes and mesenchyme embedded in the hepatocyte parenchyma. We leveraged this platform to model aspects of biliary fibrosis. Our human periportal liver assembloid system represents a novel in vitro platform to investigate human liver pathophysiology, accelerate drug development, enable early diagnosis and advance personalized medicine.
papers.abstractKo: 제대로 발달한 다세포 인간 in vitro 시스템의 개발은 질병 모델링, 약물 발견 및 조직 공학의 발전에 큰 가능성을 지닌다 1 . 간에서는 간 재생에 관여하는 주요 신호전달 경로가 규명되었음에도 불구하고 2,3 , 신선한 환자 조직으로부터 인간 간세포를 직접 in vitro에서 증식시키는 것은 아직 달성되지 않았으며, 이는 in vitro에서 간 복합 구조를 모델링할 가능성을 제한한다. 여기서 우리는 먼저 28명의 서로 다른 환자로부터 인간 간세포 오가노이드(h-HepOrgs)를 확립하였다. 환자 유래 간세포 오가노이드는 in vitro에서 간세포의 장기적 증식을 유지하였고, 환자 특이적 유전자 발현 및 담세관(bile canaliculus)의 특징과 in vivo 조직의 기능을 유지하였다. 이식 후, 증식된 h-HepOrgs는 간 질환 마우스 모델의 표현형을 회복시켰다. h-HepOrgs를 문맥 간질(portal mesenchyme) 및 우리가 이전에 발표한 담관세포 오가노이드(cholangiocyte organoids) 4-6 와 결합함으로써, 우리는 간세포 실질에 담관세포와 간질이 내재된 형태로, periportal liver tissue의 조직학적 배열, 유전자 발현 및 세포 상호작용을 유지하는 환자 특이적 periportal liver assembloids를 생성하였다. 우리는 이 플랫폼을 이용하여 담도 섬유화(biliary fibrosis)의 여러 측면을 모델링하였다. 우리의 인간 periportal liver assembloid 시스템은 인간 간 병태생리를 연구하고, 약물 개발을 가속화하며, 조기 진단을 가능하게 하고, 정밀의학을 발전시키기 위한 새로운 in vitro 플랫폼을 대표한다.

papers.title: Transient hepatic reconstitution of trophic factors enhances aged immunity
papers.abstract: Ageing erodes human immunity, in part by reshaping the T cell repertoire, leading to increased vulnerability to infection, malignancy and vaccine failure 1-3 . Attempts to rejuvenate immune function have yielded only modest results and are limited by toxicity or lack of clinical feasibility 1,3-5 . Here we show that the liver can be transiently repurposed to restore age-diminished immune cues and improve T cell function in aged mice. These immune cues were found by performing multi-omic mapping across central and peripheral niches in young and aged animals, leading to the identification of Notch and Fms-like tyrosine kinase 3 ligand (FLT3L) pathways, together with interleukin-7 (IL-7) signalling, as declining with age. Delivery of mRNAs encoding Delta-like ligand 1 (DLL1), FLT3L and IL-7 to hepatocytes expanded common lymphoid progenitors, boosted de novo thymopoiesis without affecting haematopoietic stem cell (HSC) composition, and replenished T cells while enhancing dendritic cell abundance and function. Treatment with these mRNAs improved peptide vaccine responses and restored antitumour immunity in aged mice by increasing tumour-specific CD8 + infiltration and clonal diversity and synergizing with immune checkpoint blockade. These effects were reversible after dosing ceased and did not breach self-tolerance, in contrast to the inflammatory and autoimmune liabilities of recombinant cytokine treatments 6,7 . These findings underscore the promise of mRNA-based strategies for systemic immune modulation and highlight the potential of interventions aimed at preserving immune resilience in ageing populations.
papers.abstractKo: 노화는 부분적으로 T 세포 repertoire를 재구성함으로써 인간 면역을 약화시키며, 그 결과 감염, 악성종양 및 백신 실패에 대한 취약성이 증가한다 1-3 . 면역 기능을 회복시키려는 시도는 제한적인 성과만을 거두었으며, 독성 또는 임상적 실행 가능성의 부족으로 제약을 받아 왔다 1,3-5 . 여기에서 우리는 간(liver)을 일시적으로 재활용하여 노화로 감소한 면역 신호를 복원하고 노화 마우스에서 T 세포 기능을 향상시킬 수 있음을 보인다. 이러한 면역 신호는 젊은 및 노화 동물의 중심 및 말초 niche 전반에 걸친 multi-omic mapping을 수행하여 발견되었으며, 그 결과 Notch 및 Fms-like tyrosine kinase 3 ligand (FLT3L) 경로와 interleukin-7 (IL-7) 신호전달이 연령에 따라 감소하는 것으로 확인되었다. papers.title: Mazdutide versus dulaglutide in Chinese adults with type 2 diabetes
papers.abstract: Mazdutide is a once-weekly glucagon and glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor dual agonist developed for the treatment of type 2 diabetes (T2D) 1 . papers.title: Mazdutide versus placebo in Chinese adults with type 2 diabetes
papers.abstract: Despite advances in type 2 diabetes (T2D) management, unmet needs remain for therapies that effectively control hyperglycaemia while addressing comorbid metabolic disorders 1,2 . Here we assessed the efficacy and safety of the dual glucagon receptor (GCGR)/glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor (GLP-1R) agonist mazdutide monotherapy versus placebo in Chinese adults with T2D controlled inadequately with diet and exercise alone. In this phase 3 trial, 320 participants (mean glycated haemoglobin A1c (HbA 1c ) of 8.24%, body mass index of 28.2 kg m -2 and diabetes duration of 1.9 years) were randomized 1:1:1 to receive weekly subcutaneous injections of mazdutide (4 mg or 6 mg) or placebo for 24 weeks, followed by a 24-week extended mazdutide treatment. At week 24, mazdutide significantly reduced HbA 1c versus placebo (primary endpoint): -1.57% with mazdutide 4 mg and -2.15% with mazdutide 6 mg, versus -0.14% with placebo, with treatment differences of -1.43% and -2.02% (both P 1c 1c < 7.0% and weight loss ≥ 5%) versus placebo (P = 0.0006 for 4 mg; P < 0.0001 for 6 mg) at week 24. The most common adverse events-diarrhoea, decreased appetite and nausea-were consistent with GLP-1R agonists. These results establish mazdutide monotherapy as an effective intervention providing clinically meaningful glycaemic control and weight reduction alongside a favourable safety profile in this population.

papers.title: Denosumab attenuates knee osteoarthritis progression by inhibiting synovial inflammation via the RANK/TRAF6/FSTL1 signalling
papers.abstract: Synovitis has recently been shown to be a critical early stage in development of osteoarthritis (OA), and inhibiting synovitis significantly alleviates OA symptoms. Denosumab, a monoclonal antibody targeting RANKL, previously developed for osteoporosis. Here, we report the effect of denosumab on fibroblast-like synoviocytes (FLSs), attenuating synovitis and consequently OA progression. We first demonstrate that RANKL is highly expressed in the knee synovium of OA mice, as well as in patients. Next, we show that denosumab, injected systemically, accumulates in the synovium and effectively reduces synovitis through RANK/TRAF6/FSTL1 signalling in post-traumatic, inflammatory, and aged OA murine models and a beagle dog OA model, delaying OA progression. Finally, a single-arm clinical trial with primary endpoints of VAS and OKS scores, and secondary endpoints of WOMAC score and adverse events rate, shows that denosumab alleviates synovitis and pain, improving joint function in knee OA patients. These findings provide a translational basis for using denosumab to treat knee OA in the clinic.

Denosumab은 RANKL을 표적으로 하는 단일클론 항체로, 이전에 골다공증(osteoporosis) 치료를 위해 개발되었다. 여기에서 우리는 denosumab이 섬유아세포 유사 활막세포(fibroblast-like synoviocytes, FLSs)에 미치는 효과를 보고하며, 이를 통해 활막염을 완화하고 결과적으로 OA 진행을 억제함을 제시한다. 우리는 먼저 RANKL이 OA 마우스의 무릎 활막뿐 아니라 환자에서도 높게 발현됨을 입증한다. 다음으로, 전신적으로 주입된 denosumab이 활막에 축적되고, 외상 후(post-traumatic), 염증성(inflammatory), 및 노화(aged) OA 마우스 모델과 비글견(beagle dog) OA 모델에서 RANK/TRAF6/FSTL1 신호전달(signalling)을 통해 활막염을 효과적으로 감소시켜 OA 진행을 지연시킴을 보인다. 마지막으로, 1차 평가변수(primary endpoints)로 VAS 및 OKS 점수, 2차 평가변수(secondary endpoints)로 WOMAC 점수 및 이상반응 발생률(adverse events rate)을 설정한 단일군 임상시험(single-arm clinical trial)에서, denosumab이 무릎 OA 환자에서 활막염과 통증을 완화하고 관절 기능을 개선함을 보여준다. 이러한 발견은 임상에서 무릎 OA 치료를 위해 denosumab을 사용하는 데 대한 중개적(translational) 근거를 제공한다.

papers.title: GSDME-dependent pyroptosis drives abdominal aortic aneurysm via promoting vascular senescence
papers.abstract: Senescence contributes to the pathology of abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA); however, the regulation of senescence in AAA remains unclear. Here, we sought to determine the role of gasdermin-E (GSDME)-dependent non-canonical pyroptosis in AAA. GSDME-dependent non-canonical pyroptosis is activated in the lesioned vascular walls of mouse models and patients with AAA. GSDME deficiency inhibits vascular senescence and AAA progression. Combined analyses of single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq), bulk RNA-seq, and multiplex flow cytometry demonstrate that GSDME is essential for the reprogramming of vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMCs) and the shift in immune statuses of macrophages, monocytes, and neutrophils in AAA. Reintroduction of GSDME in VSMCs, but not in myeloid cells, in mice with a GSDME deletion background, recapitulates the induced vascular senescence and AAA, which is abolished by senolytic therapy with dasatinib plus quercetin. These results indicate that GSDME-dependent non-canonical pyroptosis in VSMCs may be a 'master switch' in AAA and a potential therapeutic target for managing AAA.
papers.abstractKo: 노화(senescence)는 복부 대동맥류(abdominal aortic aneurysm, AAA)의 병태생리에 기여하지만, AAA에서 노화의 조절은 아직 명확하지 않다. 여기서 우리는 gasdermin-E(GSDME) 의존성 비정형 pyroptosis의 AAA에서의 역할을 규명하고자 하였다. GSDME 의존성 비정형 pyroptosis는 AAA를 가진 마우스 모델과 환자의 병변 혈관벽에서 활성화되어 있다. GSDME 결손 배경의 마우스에서 골수계 세포(myeloid cells)가 아니라 VSMCs에 GSDME를 재도입하면, 유도된 혈관 노화와 AAA가 재현되며, 이는 dasatinib와 quercetin을 이용한 senolytic 치료로 소실된다. 이러한 결과는 VSMCs에서의 GSDME 의존성 비정형 pyroptosis가 AAA에서의 'master switch'일 수 있으며 AAA 관리를 위한 잠재적 치료 표적임을 시사한다.

papers.title: Integrating polygenic signals and single-cell multiomics identifies cell-type-specific regulomes critical for immune- and aging-related diseases
papers.abstract: Single-cell multiomics provides critical insights into how disease-associated variants identified through genome-wide association studies (GWASs) influence transcription factor eRegulons within a specific cellular context; however, the regulatory roles of genetic variants in aging and disease remain unclear. Here, we present scMORE, a method that integrates single-cell transcriptomes and chromatin accessibility with GWAS summary statistics to identify cell-type-specific eRegulons associated with diseases. scMORE effectively captures trait-relevant cellular features and demonstrates robust performance across simulated and real single-cell datasets, and GWASs for 31 immune- and aging-related traits, including Parkinson's disease (PD). In the human midbrain, scMORE identifies 77 aging-relevant eRegulons implicated in PD across seven brain cell types and reveals sex-dependent dysregulation of these eRegulons in PD neurons compared to both young and aged groups. By linking genetic variation to cell type-resolved eRegulon activity, scMORE illuminates how variants shape trait-relevant regulatory networks and provides a practical framework for mechanistic interpretation of GWAS signals.

papers.title: S100B triggers neuroendocrine macrophage networks to drive airway regeneration in mice
papers.abstract: The mammalian airway epithelium contains specialized cells that detect and respond to environmental injury, yet the mechanisms that coordinate epithelial repair remain poorly defined. Pulmonary neuroendocrine cells act as neurosensory sentinels within this epithelium and can reprogram to support regeneration. Here we show that the calcium-binding protein S100B is essential for maintaining the stem cell-like properties of pulmonary neuroendocrine cells during airway repair. Following epithelial injury, S100B expression is induced in these cells and released to engage macrophages that express the enzyme arginase-1, which in turn promotes the expansion of pulmonary neuroendocrine cells and their transition into regenerative intermediate cells. Modulating S100B activity, either by blocking S100B with pentamidine or by enhancing signaling driven by the protein kinase p110-alpha in airway epithelial cells, alters the reparative capacity of pulmonary neuroendocrine cells. These findings identify an S100B-arginase-1 signaling axis that governs macrophage-epithelial communication and highlight S100B as a potential therapeutic target for lung repair.
